FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 AS build
WORKDIR /build

# 1) POMs (para cache de dependÃªncias)
COPY pom.xml ./
COPY raiji-common/pom.xml ./raiji-common/
COPY raiji-security/pom.xml ./raiji-security/
COPY raiji-users/pom.xml ./raiji-users/
COPY raiji-rides/pom.xml ./raiji-rides/
COPY raiji-deliveries/pom.xml ./raiji-deliveries/
COPY raiji-app/pom.xml ./raiji-app/
RUN mvn -B dependency:go-offline || true

# 2) Fontes
COPY raiji-common/src ./raiji-common/src
COPY raiji-security/src ./raiji-security/src
COPY raiji-users/src ./raiji-users/src
COPY raiji-rides/src ./raiji-rides/src
COPY raiji-deliveries/src ./raiji-deliveries/src
COPY raiji-app/src ./raiji-app/src
RUN mvn -B clean package -DskipTests

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre AS runtime
WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY --from=build /build/raiji-app/target/raiji-app.jar ./app.jar

EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]

===== ./docs/API.md =====
# API - Raiji

## Busca de caronas

Endpoint para busca de caronas planejadas com vagas disponiveis.

### Endpoint

`GET /api/rides`

Autenticacao: Bearer token (qualquer usuario autenticado).

### Query parameters

| Param | Tipo | Obrigatorio | Descricao |
|---|---|---:|---|
| originCity | string | nao | Cidade de origem (contem, case-insensitive) |
| destinationCity | string | nao | Cidade de destino (contem, case-insensitive) |
| departureFrom | ISO datetime | nao | Data/hora minima de saida |
| departureTo | ISO datetime | nao | Data/hora maxima de saida |
| maxPrice | decimal | nao | Preco maximo |
| freeOnly | boolean | nao | Apenas caronas gratuitas (pricePerPassenger = null) |
| minSeats | int | nao | Vagas minimas disponiveis |
| page | int | nao (default 0) | Pagina |
| size | int | nao (default 20) | Tamanho da pagina |
| sort | string | nao (default departureDate,asc) | Ordenacao |

### Regras fixas

A busca sempre aplica:

- `status = PLANNED`
- `availableSeats > 0`
- `deleted_at IS NULL`

### Observacoes

- Nenhum campo de localizacao em tempo real e retornado (RN09).
- `freeOnly=true` retorna apenas caronas com `pricePerPassenger = null`.
- `maxPrice` filtra apenas caronas com `pricePerPassenger <= maxPrice`.
- `minSeats` filtra caronas com `availableSeats >= minSeats`.


---

## Solicitacao de vaga (S1-06 + S2-01)

### POST /api/rides/{rideId}/requests

Autenticacao: Bearer token com role `PASSENGER`.

A partir da S2-01 (RF18) o payload EXIGE a declaracao de bagagem
(`baggage` com pelo menos 1 item):

```json
{
  "passengerName": "JoÃ£o Silva",
  "baggage": [
    {
      "type": "mala",
      "quantity": 1,
      "lengthCm": 60,
      "widthCm": 40,
      "heightCm": 30,
      "description": "Mala de bordo"
    }
  ]
}
```

| Campo | Tipo | Obrigatorio | Regras |
|---|---|---:|---|
| passengerName | string | sim | 1..150 caracteres |
| baggage | array | sim | minimo 1 item |
| baggage[].type | string | sim | `mochila` \| `sacola` \| `mala` \| `caixa` |
| baggage[].quantity | int | sim | >= 1 |
| baggage[].lengthCm | int | sim | > 0 |
| baggage[].widthCm | int | sim | > 0 |
| baggage[].heightCm | int | sim | > 0 |
| baggage[].weightKg | decimal | nao | > 0 quando informado; ate 2 casas decimais (S2-03) |
| baggage[].description | string | nao | <= 500 caracteres |

Erros:

- `400` baggage ausente/vazio, quantity <= 0, dimensao <= 0, type fora do enum, nome invalido, weightKg <= 0 ou com mais de 2 casas
- `401` sem token Â· `403` sem role PASSENGER
- `404` carona inexistente
- `409` solicitacao duplicada, sem vagas, carona nao PLANNED ou partida passada

A resposta `201` ecoa a solicitacao com `status: PENDING` e a `baggage` declarada.

### GET /api/rides/{rideId}/requests (visao do motorista)

Autenticacao: Bearer token com role `DRIVER` (dono da carona).

Retorna as solicitacoes com a bagagem declarada â€” o motorista ve a bagagem
ANTES de aceitar/recusar:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "â€¦",
    "rideId": "â€¦",
    "passengerSub": "â€¦",
    "passengerName": "Maria Silva",
    "status": "PENDING",
    "joinedAt": "â€¦",
    "baggage": [
      { "type": "mala", "quantity": 1, "lengthCm": 60, "widthCm": 40, "heightCm": 30, "description": "Mala de bordo" }
    ]
  }
]
```

Observacoes:

- `type` e aceito em qualquer caixa na entrada e sempre devolvido em minusculas.
- Desde a S2-03 a soma de peso/volume das bagagens CONFIRMED e travada no
  aceite (PATCH abaixo); limites declarados em `cargoDetails.maxWeightKg`
  (carona) e `cargoVolumeLiters` (veiculo).

---

## Decisao do motorista (S2-02)

### PATCH /api/rides/{rideId}/requests/{requestId}

Autenticacao: Bearer token com role `DRIVER` (dono da carona).

O motorista decide apos ver a bagagem declarada (GET da S1-06/S2-01).
`ACCEPT` confirma o passageiro e decrementa `availableSeats`; `REJECT`
cancela a solicitacao com status `CANCELLED` (reutilizado â€” sem novo valor
de enum nem migration) e EXIGE `reason`. O passageiro e notificado nos
dois casos (NotificationService, S1-06).

Body (JSON):

```json
{ "decision": "ACCEPT" }
```

```json
{ "decision": "REJECT", "reason": "A bagagem excede a capacidade do veiculo." }
```

| Campo | Tipo | Obrigatorio | Regras |
|---|---|---:|---|
| decision | string | sim | `ACCEPT` \| `REJECT` (qualquer caixa na entrada) |
| reason | string | REJECT | 1..500 caracteres; obrigatorio quando REJECT |

Resposta `200`:

```json
{ "id": "â€¦", "status": "CONFIRMED", "confirmedAt": "â€¦" }
```

No REJECT: `{ "id": "â€¦", "status": "CANCELLED", "confirmedAt": null }`.

Erros:

- `400` decision ausente/fora do enum; REJECT sem reason; reason > 500; peso/volume acima da capacidade (S2-03)
- `401` sem token Â· `403` sem role DRIVER ou motorista nao dono da carona
- `404` carona ou solicitacao inexistente (ou de outra carona)
- `409` solicitacao ja decidida (status != PENDING); ACCEPT sem vagas

Observacoes:

- S2-03 (RN03/RN12): o ACCEPT tambem trava capacidade â€” `409` quando nao
  ha vaga (decisoes simultaneas sao serializadas por lock pessimista na
  carona) e `400` quando a soma de peso das bagagens CONFIRMED excede
  `cargoDetails.maxWeightKg` ou o volume total (L x A x C x quantidade)
  excede o `cargoVolumeLiters` do veiculo. Detalhes em docs/ARQUITETURA.md.

---

## Cancelamento de reserva (S2-04 Â· RF09 / RN06)

### DELETE /api/rides/{rideId}/requests/{requestId}

Autenticacao: Bearer token com role `PASSENGER` (dono da reserva) **ou**
`DRIVER` (dono da carona). O corpo e **opcional**:

```json
{ "reason": "Imprevisto pessoal" }
```

| Campo  | Tipo   | Obrigatorio | Regras                    |
|--------|--------|-------------|---------------------------|
| reason | string | nao         | ate 500 caracteres         |

Cancela a reserva ANTES da viagem e libera a vaga imediatamente:

- reserva **CONFIRMED** -> `availableSeats++` na hora (`seatReleased: true`);
- reserva **PENDING**   -> vagas permanecem intactas (`seatReleased: false`);
- a reserva vai para `CANCELLED` com `cancellationReason` e `cancelledAt`;
- o **motorista e notificado** (NotificationService).

Resposta `200`:

```json
{
  "id": "â€¦",
  "rideId": "â€¦",
  "status": "CANCELLED",
  "cancelledAt": "â€¦",
  "cancellationReason": "Imprevisto pessoal",
  "seatReleased": true
}
```

Erros:

- `401` sem token
- `403` ator nao e o passageiro da reserva nem o motorista da carona
- `404` carona ou reserva inexistente (ou reserva de outra carona)
- `409` reserva ja `CANCELLED`/`COMPLETED` **ou** carona nao esta `PLANNED`
  (viagem ja iniciada â€” RN06)

> O estorno automatico de caronas pagas canceladas e tratado na **S2-05**.

---

## Estorno automatico de caronas pagas (S2-05 Â· RN04)

O estorno e disparado automaticamente no **cancelamento** (DELETE da S2-04)
de uma reserva de carona **paga** (`pricePerPassenger != null`) que possua
`paymentIntentId` vinculado.

### Vinculando o pagamento no aceite

O `PATCH /api/rides/{rideId}/requests/{requestId}` (S2-02) aceita, de forma
**opcional**, o `paymentIntentId` no ACCEPT. Ele e gravado na reserva para
permitir o estorno futuro (a integracao de pagamento completa fica para
sprint futura):

```json
{ "decision": "ACCEPT", "paymentIntentId": "pi_1abc...DEF" }
```

### Comportamento no cancelamento

| Situacao                                   | Stripe        | Auditoria (`audit_log`)          |
|--------------------------------------------|---------------|----------------------------------|
| Carona paga + `paymentIntentId` + sucesso  | `refund(...)` | `ESTORNO_SUCESSO` (com refundId) |
| Carona paga + `paymentIntentId` + falha    | tenta         | `ESTORNO_FALHOU` (com o erro)    |
| Carona **gratuita** (`price == null`)      | **nao chama** | nenhum registro de estorno        |
| Carona paga **sem** `paymentIntentId`      | **nao chama** | nenhum registro de estorno        |

- **Falha no Stripe nao impede o cancelamento**: a reserva vai para
  `CANCELLED` e a vaga e liberada normalmente; o problema fica registrado como
  `ESTORNO_FALHOU`.
- Configuracao via `raiji.stripe.api-key` / `raiji.stripe.webhook-secret`
  (variaveis de ambiente `STRIPE_API_KEY` / `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`). Sem
  chave, o Stripe e considerado "nao configurado" e nenhuma chamada real e
  feita (o estorno falha de forma controlada). **Nunca commitar chaves.**
- Valor estornado = `pricePerPassenger` convertido para centavos.

# Arquitetura â€” decisÃµes registradas

## S2-03 Â· Trava de capacidade de assentos e carga (RN03 / RN12)

### Problema

Reservas confirmadas nunca podem exceder os assentos da carona nem a
capacidade de carga (peso e volume), **mesmo sob concorrÃªncia**: dois aceites
simultÃ¢neos da Ãºltima vaga nÃ£o podem ambos confirmar (a issue #10 pede
explicitamente testes de concorrÃªncia com ExecutorService).

### DecisÃ£o â€” lock pessimista na linha da carona

`RidePassengerService.decide()` (PATCH
`/api/rides/{rideId}/requests/{requestId}`) carrega a carona com
`RideRepository.findByIdForUpdate(...)`:

```java
@Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
@Query("select r from Ride r where r.id = :id")
Optional<Ride> findByIdForUpdate(@Param("id") UUID id);
```

- `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` serializa as decisÃµes sobre a mesma carona: a
  segunda transaÃ§Ã£o aguarda o commit da primeira e entÃ£o **relÃª**
  `available_seats` jÃ¡ decrementado â†’ responde **409** em vez de
  sobrescrever o contador.
- Escolhido pela **simplicidade** (observaÃ§Ã£o da issue #10): transaÃ§Ã£o curta,
  uma Ãºnica linha "quente" (a carona), sem necessidade de retry
  application-level sobre `OptimisticLockException`.
- O **lock otimista** (`@Version` herdado de `AuditableEntity`) permanece
  ativo em todas as entidades como rede de seguranÃ§a contra escrita perdida
  nos demais fluxos (ex.: ediÃ§Ã£o de carona), mas nÃ£o Ã© a linha de defesa do
  aceite â€” quem garante a serializaÃ§Ã£o Ã© o `FOR UPDATE`.

### Regras de capacidade aplicadas no ACCEPT

| Trava | Regra | Falha |
|---|---|---|
| Assentos | `rides.available_seats > 0` antes de decrementar | 409 |
| Peso | Î£ `weight_kg Ã— quantity` das bagagens **CONFIRMED** (+ as do candidato) â‰¤ `rides.cargo_max_weight_kg` | 400 |
| Volume | Î£ `length_cm Ã— width_cm Ã— height_cm Ã— quantity Ã· 1000` (litros) â‰¤ `vehicles.cargo_volume_liters` do veÃ­culo da carona | 400 |

- Peso e volume sÃ³ sÃ£o verificados **se existir** limite declarado
  (`cargoDetails.maxWeightKg > 0` na carona / `cargoVolumeLiters > 0` no
  veÃ­culo) â€” sem limite declarado, a trava Ã© ignorada (caronas e veÃ­culos
  antigos continuam vÃ¡lidos).
- `weightKg` Ã© **opcional** na declaraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem (contrato da S2-01
  permanece retrocompatÃ­vel); item sem peso contribui 0 kg na soma.
- SolicitaÃ§Ãµes PENDING **nÃ£o** reservam capacidade: entram na soma apenas as
  bagagens CONFIRMED e as da solicitaÃ§Ã£o em aceite.
- Exceder o limite Ã© erro de requisiÃ§Ã£o (**400**, critÃ©rio de aceite da
  issue); esgotar assentos Ã© conflito de estado (**409**).

### ConsistÃªncia

O `decide()` roda em uma Ãºnica transaÃ§Ã£o: lock â†’ validaÃ§Ãµes (dono, PENDING,
vagas, peso, volume) â†’ decremento de vagas â†’ `confirm()`/`cancel()` â†’ evento
de decisÃ£o (notificaÃ§Ã£o). Qualquer falha faz **rollback completo** â€” nenhuma
reserva fica em estado inconsistente e `available_seats` nunca fica negativo.

### Testes

- `CapacityLockApiIT.confirmacoesSimultaneasNaoEstouramLotacao`:
  `ExecutorService` + `CyclicBarrier` disparam 2 aceites simultÃ¢neos sobre a
  Ãºltima vaga â†’ exatamente 1Ã— 200 e 1Ã— 409, `available_seats = 0`, 1 reserva
  CONFIRMED.
- Limites: peso/volume **exatamente no limite** (aceito) e **1 acima**
  (400), alÃ©m da soma acumulada entre passageiros CONFIRMED.
- UnitÃ¡rios (`RidePassengerServiceTest`): mesmas fronteiras com mocks +
  verificaÃ§Ã£o do uso de `findByIdForUpdate`.

---

## S2-06 Â· Bloqueio no horÃ¡rio de saÃ­da e status automÃ¡tico (RF10 / RN05)

### Problema

Ao atingir o `departureDate`, a carona deve deixar de aceitar solicitaÃ§Ãµes e
aceites, e o status deve mudar de `PLANNED` para `IN_PROGRESS`
automaticamente â€” sem depender de uma aÃ§Ã£o do motorista.

### DecisÃ£o â€” scheduler idempotente + `Clock` injetÃ¡vel

- `RideStatusScheduler` (`@Component`) roda a cada 60 s
  (`@Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "${raiji.scheduler.fixed-delay:60000}")`,
  com `initial-delay` de 5 s). A cada execuÃ§Ã£o:
  `findByStatusAndDepartureDateLessThanEqualAndDeletedAtIsNull(PLANNED, now)`
  â†’ promove para `IN_PROGRESS`.
- **Idempotente por construÃ§Ã£o**: a consulta filtra `status = PLANNED`; uma
  carona jÃ¡ promovida nunca Ã© reprocessada (a 2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o retorna 0).
- **`Clock` injetÃ¡vel** (`TimeConfig#clock` = `systemDefaultZone` em produÃ§Ã£o):
  permite fixar o relÃ³gio nos testes unitÃ¡rios e validar o limite exato
  `departureDate == now()` (a consulta usa `<=`).

### Bloqueios no serviÃ§o (defesa em profundidade)

Mesmo antes do scheduler rodar, `RidePassengerService` bloqueia no limite:

| OperaÃ§Ã£o | Regra | Falha |
|---|---|---|
| `request()` (POST) | `departureDate <= now(clock)` **ou** carona nÃ£o `PLANNED` | 409 |
| `decide()` (PATCH) | carona nÃ£o `PLANNED` | 409 |
| `cancel()` (DELETE, S2-04) | carona nÃ£o `PLANNED` | 409 |

Assim o estado Ã© eventual-consistente via scheduler, mas as operaÃ§Ãµes de
escrita jÃ¡ respeitam o horÃ¡rio de saÃ­da imediatamente.

### Testes

- `RideStatusSchedulerTest` (unitÃ¡rio, `Clock` fixo + repo mockado): promoÃ§Ã£o,
  limite `== now()`, caronas futuras intactas, idempotÃªncia.
- `RideStatusSchedulerIT` (integraÃ§Ã£o): "avanÃ§a o relÃ³gio" movendo
  `departure_date` para o passado e disparando `promoteDueRides()`
  manualmente (o job fica com intervalo enorme nos testes para nÃ£o
  interferir) â†’ verifica `IN_PROGRESS`, POST 409, PATCH 409 e idempotÃªncia.

| `KC_PORT_DEV` / `KC_PORT_HOMOLOG` | `8180` | `9180` | porta do Keycloak |
| `AMI_DEV` / `AMI_HOMOLOG` | vazio (Ubuntu 24.04) | idem | AMI customizada |

### Mudar o tipo de mÃ¡quina (exemplo)


MudanÃ§as de porta/regiÃ£o valem automaticamente no prÃ³ximo deploy (os
workflows leem o arquivo no job `config`); para portas, rerode o bootstrap

## 6) CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`)

Trilhas **paralelas** em todo PR / push (`main`, `develop`):

1. **unit-tests** â€” matriz *dinÃ¢mica*: os mÃ³dulos sÃ£o lidos do `pom.xml` em
   runtime; **mÃ³dulos novos entram na matriz automaticamente** e rodam em
   paralelo (um job por mÃ³dulo, `fail-fast: false`).
2. **verify** â€” pipeline da issue: checkout â†’ setup JDK 21 â†’ cache Maven â†’
   `mvn clean verify` (unitÃ¡rios + integraÃ§Ã£o Testcontainers + JaCoCo â‰¥ 80%) â†’
   upload do relatÃ³rio JaCoCo e dos relatÃ³rios de teste.
3. **docker-image** â€” build da imagem (BuildKit + cache GHA) para garantir que
   o CD continua publicÃ¡vel.

OtimizaÃ§Ãµes: `concurrency` cancela execuÃ§Ãµes obsoletas do mesmo ref;
`mvn -T 1C` paraleliza o build por nÃºcleos; cache Maven via `setup-java`.

> Ative **branch protection** em `main`/`develop` exigindo o status `CI` para
> merge: alteraÃ§Ã£o quebrada nem chega a disparar o CD.

## 7) Smoke tests (`scripts/smoke-test.sh`)

Validam exatamente o que a issue pede:

| Check | RequisiÃ§Ã£o |
|---|---|
| `health` | `GET /actuator/health` â†’ 200 e `{"status":"UP"}` |
| `realm` | `GET /realms/raiji` no Keycloak â†’ 200 |
| `token` | `POST /realms/raiji/protocol/openid-connect/token` (usuÃ¡rio de teste) â†’ 200 |
| `me` | `GET /api/me` com Bearer token â†’ 200 |

No CD, os 4 checks rodam como **matriz paralela** (4 jobs simultÃ¢neos, um por
check â€” o check `me` obtÃ©m o prÃ³prio token, entÃ£o nÃ£o hÃ¡ dependÃªncia).
**Falha em qualquer check bloqueia o release** e dispara rollback automÃ¡tico.

ExecuÃ§Ã£o manual:

```bash

BASE_URL=http://<HOST>:9000 ./scripts/smoke-test.sh --serial
./scripts/smoke-test.sh --check health --retries 18 --retry-delay 10
```

## 8) ProteÃ§Ãµes de release â€” versÃ£o quebrada nunca fica no ar

Camadas de proteÃ§Ã£o (valem **igualmente para dev e homolog**):

| # | Camada | Onde | O que impede |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Branch protection + CI verde | `ci.yml` no PR | cÃ³digo quebrado de chegar na `main`/`develop` |
| 2 | Testes unitÃ¡rios antes do build | job `tests` do `deploy.yml` | build de imagem a partir de cÃ³digo que nÃ£o compila/passa |
| 3 | **Health-gate na instÃ¢ncia** | `deploy-remote.sh` | novo container assumir o trÃ¡fego doente |
| 4 | **Self-rollback local** | `deploy-remote.sh` | versÃ£o nova quebrada continuar rodando |
| 5 | **Smoke paralelo bloqueia release** | job `smoke` â†’ `release` | release declarado com API/Keycloak/auth quebrados |
| 6 | **Rollback automÃ¡tico do workflow** | job `rollback` do `deploy.yml` | permanecer na versÃ£o ruim apÃ³s falha de smoke |
| 7 | **Guardian (erros inesperados pÃ³s-deploy)** | `guardian.yml` + `guardian.sh` | erro que sÃ³ aparece DEPOIS (crash, OOM, dependÃªncia) â€” detecta em â‰¤10 min, reverte e alerta |

### Comportamento quando NÃƒO existe versÃ£o anterior (1Âº deploy)

O requisito "*nÃ£o deixe subir atÃ© que tudo suba corretamente*" Ã© garantido assim:

* O health-gate falhou e **nÃ£o hÃ¡** versÃ£o anterior â†’ o `deploy-remote.sh`
  **para o container do app**: nada quebrado Ã© servido; o workflow falha e o
  release nÃ£o Ã© declarado. O ambiente sÃ³ volta a responder quando um deploy
  verde for publicado.
* O `rollback.sh` (automÃ¡tico ou manual), sem tag `<env>-previous` no ECR,
  tambÃ©m para o app e falha com mensagem clara â€” nÃ£o hÃ¡ para onde voltar.
* O Guardian, sem histÃ³rico, nÃ£o tenta rollback: apenas **abre uma Issue**
  de alerta.

### Guardian â€” `guardian.yml` (a cada 10 min + manual)

Para cada ambiente (jobs paralelos, serializados com o deploy pelo mesmo
concurrency group):

1. Smoke completo (4 checagens em paralelo, com retries).
2. Falhou â†’ aguarda `GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY` (60 s) e **reconfirma** (evita
   falso positivo de rede).
3. Falha confirmada + existe `<env>-previous` â†’ **rollback automÃ¡tico**
   (retag + redeploy + smoke).
4. IrrecuperÃ¡vel â†’ **Issue `[Guardian] Ambiente <env> indisponÃ­vel`**
   (sem duplicar: sÃ³ cria se nÃ£o houver Issue aberta com o mesmo tÃ­tulo).

## 9) Rollback

### AutomÃ¡tico (workflow de deploy e Guardian)

1. **Retag da imagem anterior** no ECR: `<env>-previous` â†’ `<env>-current`
   (`scripts/aws/ecr-retag.sh`, sem re-upload de camadas).
2. **Redeploy**: SSH na EC2 â†’ `compose pull app` + `up -d --no-deps app` + health-gate.
3. **Smoke completo** (paralelo) para confirmar a recuperaÃ§Ã£o.

A tag `<env>-previous` Ã© preservada *antes* de cada deploy (job `build-push`),
e a instÃ¢ncia guarda a versÃ£o anterior em `.deploy-state` (self-rollback local).

### Manual (testado ao menos uma vez â€” critÃ©rio de aceite)

* **Via GitHub:** Actions â†’ **Rollback (manual)** â†’ *Run workflow* â†’ ambiente.
* **Via linha de comando** (mÃ¡quina com aws cli + ssh):

```bash
export ENVIRONMENT=homolog EC2_HOST=<IP> EC2_USER=ubuntu BASE_PORT=9000
export SSH_PRIVATE_KEY="$(cat ~/.ssh/raiji-homolog-pem)"
./scripts/aws/rollback.sh
```

### Manual "na mÃ£o" (emergÃªncia, direto na instÃ¢ncia)

```bash
ssh -i raiji-<env>-pem ubuntu@<IP>
cd /opt/raiji/<env>
cat .deploy-state.previous                 # tag anterior
sed -i 's/^IMAGE_TAG=.*/IMAGE_TAG=<tag-anterior>/' .env
docker compose -p raiji-<env> -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.aws.yml up -d --no-deps app
```

## 11) LimitaÃ§Ãµes do ambiente experimental

* **Custo/Free tier:** a conta AWS nova tem 750 h/mÃªs de `t2.micro` por 12
  meses, porÃ©m o stack (Keycloak 26 + Spring Boot + Kong + Postgres) precisa de
  **~2 GB de RAM** â†’ usamos `t3.small` (~US$ 15/mÃªs por ambiente, fora do free
  tier). MitigaÃ§Ã£o: rodar os dois ambientes na **mesma instÃ¢ncia** `t3.medium`
  (projetos compose separados, portas 8000/9000) â€” basta apontar as duas
  `AWS_EC2_HOST_*` para o mesmo IP.
* **Sem HTTPS/domÃ­nio:** o acesso Ã© por `http://IP:porta`. Para HTTPS, aponte
  um domÃ­nio + ALB/CloudFront com ACM (fora do escopo da S1-03).
* **InstÃ¢ncia Ãºnica por ambiente:** sem HA. O `bootstrap-aws.sh` aloca e
  associa um **Elastic IP** por ambiente, entÃ£o o host nÃ£o muda em
  stop/start (a variable do GitHub continua vÃ¡lida).
* **Banco na prÃ³pria instÃ¢ncia** (container + volume): aceitÃ¡vel para
  homologaÃ§Ã£o; em produÃ§Ã£o usar RDS.
* **SSH aberto (porta 22) para 0.0.0.0/0** no bootstrap â€” restrinja o CIDR do
  security group para os IPs do GitHub Actions ou use SSM Session Manager.
* **Guardian:** schedules do GitHub podem atrasar alguns minutos em horÃ¡rios
  de pico; o intervalo efetivo de detecÃ§Ã£o Ã© ~10-15 min.
* **Smoke `me`** depende do usuÃ¡rio `teste` do realm; troque a senha padrÃ£o em
  homolog e reflita em `SMOKE_PASSWORD_HOMOLOG`.

===== ./.github/workflows/ci.yml =====
# =============================================================================
# CI â€” roda em TODO Pull Request e em push na main/develop.
# Trilhas paralelas (fail-fast: false -> uma nÃ£o cancela a outra):
#   1. unit-tests    -> matriz DINÃ‚MICA por mÃ³dulo (mÃ³dulos novos entram sozinhos)
#   2. verify        -> pipeline da issue: checkout -> JDK 21 -> cache Maven ->
#                       mvn clean verify (unitÃ¡rios + integraÃ§Ã£o + cobertura) ->
#                       upload do relatÃ³rio JaCoCo
#   3. docker-image  -> garante que a imagem do deploy continua buildando
# =============================================================================
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  MAVEN_ARGS: "-B -ntp -T 1C"

jobs:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Detecta os mÃ³dulos lendo o pom.xml raiz -> a matriz cresce automaticamente
  # quando um mÃ³dulo novo for criado (testes futuros rodam em paralelo sem
  # precisar editar este workflow).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  detect-modules:
    name: Detectar mÃ³dulos (matriz dinÃ¢mica)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      modules: ${{ steps.list.outputs.modules }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Listar mÃ³dulos do pom.xml
        id: list
        run: |
          MODULES="$(sed -n 's:.*<module>\(.*\)</module>.*:\1:p' pom.xml | jq -R . | jq -sc .)"
          echo "modules=$MODULES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "MÃ³dulos detectados: $MODULES"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Testes unitÃ¡rios em PARALELO (um job por mÃ³dulo) â€” feedback rÃ¡pido.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  unit-tests:
    name: UnitÃ¡rios Â· ${{ matrix.module }}
    needs: detect-modules
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        module: ${{ fromJSON(needs.detect-modules.outputs.modules) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup JDK 21 + cache Maven
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"
          cache: maven

      - name: Compilar dependÃªncias do mÃ³dulo (sem testes)
        run: mvn ${{ env.MAVEN_ARGS }} -pl ${{ matrix.module }} -am install -DskipTests -Djacoco.skip=true

      - name: Testes unitÃ¡rios do mÃ³dulo (${{ matrix.module }})
        run: mvn ${{ env.MAVEN_ARGS }} -pl ${{ matrix.module }} surefire:test -Djacoco.skip=true

      - name: Upload relatÃ³rios surefire (${{ matrix.module }})
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: surefire-${{ matrix.module }}
          path: ${{ matrix.module }}/target/surefire-reports/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipeline exigido pela issue: build + testes + cobertura (gate do PR).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  verify:
    name: Build + testes + cobertura (mvn clean verify)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup JDK 21 + cache Maven
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"
          cache: maven

      - name: mvn clean verify (unitÃ¡rios + integraÃ§Ã£o + JaCoCo >= 80%)
        run: mvn ${{ env.MAVEN_ARGS }} clean verify

      - name: Upload relatÃ³rio JaCoCo
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jacoco-report
          path: |
            **/target/site/jacoco/
            **/target/site/jacoco-aggregate/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload relatÃ³rios de teste (surefire + failsafe)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-reports
          path: |
            **/target/surefire-reports/*.xml
            **/target/failsafe-reports/*.xml
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build da imagem Docker (paralelo) â€” o que o CD publica no ECR.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  docker-image:
    name: Imagem Docker (build de verificaÃ§Ã£o)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Dockerfile.app (sem push)
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile.app
          push: false
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=ci
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=ci

===== ./.github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml =====
# =============================================================================
# CD DEV â€” push na branch `develop` atualiza o ambiente de DESENVOLVIMENTO (dev)
# na AWS. RegiÃ£o/portas definidos em infra/aws/aws-config.env.
# Segredos/variÃ¡veis: ver docs/CD-CHECKLIST.md e docs/DEPLOY.md.
# =============================================================================
name: Deploy DEV (develop -> AWS dev)

on:
  push:
    branches: [develop]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

===== ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml =====
# =============================================================================
# Deploy reutilizÃ¡vel â€” AWS (ECR + EC2 + docker compose).
# Chamado por deploy-dev.yml (develop) e deploy-homolog.yml (main).
#
# CONFIGURAÃ‡ÃƒO FÃCIL: regiÃ£o e portas vÃªm de infra/aws/aws-config.env
# (job `config`). Para mudar o TIPO DE MÃQUINA, edite INSTANCE_TYPE_* no
# mesmo arquivo e rerode scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh (resize automÃ¡tico).
#
# Fluxo (proteÃ§Ã£o de release â€” versÃ£o quebrada nunca fica no ar):
#   config -> tests (unitÃ¡rios)
#     -> build-push (ECR: <env>-<sha> + <env>-current; preserva <env>-previous)
#     -> deploy (SSH + deploy-remote.sh: health-gate + self-rollback;
#                SEM versÃ£o anterior -> app Ã© PARADO, nada quebrado Ã© servido)
#     -> smoke (MATRIZ PARALELA health/realm/token/me â€” falha BLOQUEIA release)
#     -> release (gate final + URL pÃºblica)
#     -> rollback (automÃ¡tico: retag <env>-previous + redeploy + smoke)
# =============================================================================
name: Deploy (reutilizÃ¡vel Â· AWS)

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: "Ambiente alvo: dev | homolog"
        required: true
        type: string
      ec2-host:
        description: "Host/IP pÃºblico da EC2 do ambiente (variÃ¡vel, nÃ£o segredo)"
        required: true
        type: string
      ec2-user:
        description: "UsuÃ¡rio SSH da EC2"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ubuntu
    secrets:
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:
        required: true
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:
        required: true
      SSH_PRIVATE_KEY:
        required: true
      DB_PASSWORD:
        required: true
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET:
        required: true
      SMOKE_USERNAME:
        required: false
      SMOKE_PASSWORD:
        required: false
      # --- Opcionais: funcionalidades da aplicaÃ§Ã£o (vazio = desligado) --------
      INFO_SIMPLES_KEY:
        required: false
      INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_CPF:
        required: false
      INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_SENHA:
        required: false
      RESEND_API_KEY:
        required: false
      RESEND_FROM:
        required: false
      STRIPE_API_KEY:
        required: false
      STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET:
        required: false
      RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:
        required: false
      DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET:
        required: false
      RAIJI_PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT:
        required: false
      RAIJI_TIME_ZONE:
        required: false

concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ inputs.environment }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  ECR_REPOSITORY: raiji-app
  IMAGE_TAG: ${{ inputs.environment }}-${{ github.sha }}

jobs:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LÃª infra/aws/aws-config.env â€” fonte Ãºnica da configuraÃ§Ã£o AWS (regiÃ£o,
  # portas). Trocou o arquivo, trocou o deploy: nenhum valor fica hardcoded.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  config:
    name: Config AWS (aws-config.env)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      aws-region: ${{ steps.cfg.outputs.aws-region }}
      base-port: ${{ steps.cfg.outputs.base-port }}
      kc-port: ${{ steps.cfg.outputs.kc-port }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Ler infra/aws/aws-config.env
        id: cfg
        env:
          ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
        run: |
          [[ -f infra/aws/aws-config.env ]] || { echo "::error::infra/aws/aws-config.env nÃ£o encontrado"; exit 1; }
          set -a; . infra/aws/aws-config.env; set +a
          SUFFIX="$(echo "$ENVIRONMENT" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"
          bp_var="BASE_PORT_$SUFFIX"; kp_var="KC_PORT_$SUFFIX"
          BASE_PORT_VALUE="${!bp_var:?BASE_PORT_$SUFFIX nÃ£o definido em infra/aws/aws-config.env}"
          KC_PORT_VALUE="${!kp_var:-$((BASE_PORT_VALUE + 180))}"
          {
            echo "aws-region=${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}"
            echo "base-port=$BASE_PORT_VALUE"
            echo "kc-port=$KC_PORT_VALUE"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Porta de entrada: testes unitÃ¡rios rÃ¡pidos (integraÃ§Ã£o/cobertura ficam no CI).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  tests:
    name: Testes rÃ¡pidos (unitÃ¡rios)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup JDK 21 + cache Maven
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"
          cache: maven

      - name: mvn test (paralelo por threads do Maven)
        run: mvn -B -ntp -T 1C test -Djacoco.skip=true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build + push da imagem no ECR. Antes de sobrescrever a tag <env>-current,
  # a imagem em produÃ§Ã£o Ã© preservada como <env>-previous (base do rollback).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build-push:
    name: Build & push ECR (${{ inputs.environment }})
    needs: [config, tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    outputs:
      registry: ${{ steps.ecr.outputs.registry }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validar credenciais AWS
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
        run: |
          missing=0
          [[ -n "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ]] || {
            echo "::error::Secret AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID estÃ¡ vazio. Configure em Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions (repositÃ³rio)."
            missing=1
          }
          [[ -n "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" ]] || {
            echo "::error::Secret AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY estÃ¡ vazio. Configure em Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions (repositÃ³rio)."
            missing=1
          }
          exit "$missing"

      - name: Credenciais AWS
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ needs.config.outputs.aws-region }}

      - name: Login no ECR
        id: ecr
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Preservar imagem atual como '<env>-previous' (rollback)
        env:
          REGISTRY: ${{ steps.ecr.outputs.registry }}
          AWS_REGION_NAME: ${{ needs.config.outputs.aws-region }}
          ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
        run: |
          ./scripts/aws/ecr-retag.sh \
            "$REGISTRY/$ECR_REPOSITORY" "${ENVIRONMENT}-current" "${ENVIRONMENT}-previous" \
            --region "$AWS_REGION_NAME" --if-missing=skip

      - name: Setup Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build & push (tags <env>-<sha> e <env>-current)
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile.app
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ steps.ecr.outputs.registry }}/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
            ${{ steps.ecr.outputs.registry }}/${{ env.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ inputs.environment }}-current
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=app-${{ inputs.environment }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=app-${{ inputs.environment }}

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Deploy na EC2: sincroniza arquivos, grava .env (variÃ¡veis do provedor) e
  # recria o stack. O script remoto faz health-gate + self-rollback local;
  # sem versÃ£o anterior, PARA o app (nÃ£o serve versÃ£o quebrada).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  deploy:
    name: Deploy EC2 (${{ inputs.environment }})
    needs: [build-push, config]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validar segredos do ambiente
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}
          KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET }}
        run: |
          missing=0
          for name in AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY SSH_PRIVATE_KEY DB_PASSWORD KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET; do
            if [[ -z "${!name}" ]]; then
              echo "::error::Segredo $name estÃ¡ vazio. Veja docs/CD-CHECKLIST.md (seÃ§Ã£o 'GitHub')."
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          exit "$missing"

      - name: Credenciais AWS
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ needs.config.outputs.aws-region }}

      - name: Deploy via SSH (scripts/aws/deploy.sh)
        env:
          ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
          EC2_HOST: ${{ inputs.ec2-host }}
          EC2_USER: ${{ inputs.ec2-user }}
          SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          AWS_REGION_NAME: ${{ needs.config.outputs.aws-region }}
          BASE_PORT: ${{ needs.config.outputs.base-port }}
          KC_PORT: ${{ needs.config.outputs.kc-port }}
          DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}
          KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          # Funcionalidades opcionais (vazio = recurso desligado)
          INFO_SIMPLES_KEY: ${{ secrets.INFO_SIMPLES_KEY }}
          INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_CPF: ${{ secrets.INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_CPF }}
          INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_SENHA: ${{ secrets.INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_SENHA }}
          RESEND_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
          RESEND_FROM: ${{ secrets.RESEND_FROM }}
          STRIPE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_API_KEY }}
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
          RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: ${{ secrets.RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS }}
          DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET }}
          RAIJI_PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT: ${{ secrets.RAIJI_PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT }}
          RAIJI_TIME_ZONE: ${{ secrets.RAIJI_TIME_ZONE }}
        run: ./scripts/aws/deploy.sh

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Smoke tests da issue â€” MATRIZ PARALELA (4 jobs simultÃ¢neos, fail-fast:false):
  #   health -> GET  /actuator/health  == {"status":"UP"}
  #   realm  -> GET  /realms/raiji     == 200
  #   token  -> POST /realms/raiji/protocol/openid-connect/token == 200
  #   me     -> GET  /api/me com token == 200
  # Qualquer falha BLOQUEIA o release (job `release` exige smoke verde) e
  # dispara o rollback automÃ¡tico.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  smoke:
    name: Smoke Â· ${{ matrix.check }}
    needs: [deploy, config]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    env:
      BASE_URL: http://${{ inputs.ec2-host }}:${{ needs.config.outputs.base-port }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        check: [health, realm, token, me]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Smoke check '${{ matrix.check }}' em ${{ env.BASE_URL }}
        env:
          BASE_URL: ${{ env.BASE_URL }}
          SMOKE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SMOKE_USERNAME || 'teste' }}
          SMOKE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SMOKE_PASSWORD || 'teste123' }}
        run: ./scripts/smoke-test.sh --check "${{ matrix.check }}" --retries 18 --retry-delay 10

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Release gate: sÃ³ roda com TUDO verde; publica a URL acessÃ­vel no sumÃ¡rio.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  release:
    name: Release (${{ inputs.environment }}) âœ…
    needs: [build-push, deploy, smoke, config]
    if: success()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - name: Publicar URL do ambiente
        run: |
          {
            echo "## âœ… Release ${{ inputs.environment }} publicado"
            echo ""
            echo "| Item | Valor |"
            echo "|---|---|"
            echo "| URL (Kong) | http://${{ inputs.ec2-host }}:${{ needs.config.outputs.base-port }} |"
            echo "| Health | http://${{ inputs.ec2-host }}:${{ needs.config.outputs.base-port }}/actuator/health |"
            echo "| Imagem | ${IMAGE_TAG} |"
            echo "| Smoke tests | health âœ” realm âœ” token âœ” me âœ” (paralelos) |"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Rollback AUTOMÃTICO: se o deploy/smoke falharem e EXISTIR versÃ£o anterior,
  # retaga <env>-previous -> <env>-current e refaz o deploy. Sem anterior
  # (1Âº deploy), o rollback.sh para o app e o ambiente fica offline atÃ© uma
  # versÃ£o correta ser publicada.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  rollback:
    name: Rollback automÃ¡tico (${{ inputs.environment }})
    needs: [deploy, smoke, release, config]
    if: failure() && needs.deploy.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    env:
      BASE_URL: http://${{ inputs.ec2-host }}:${{ needs.config.outputs.base-port }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Credenciais AWS
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ needs.config.outputs.aws-region }}

      - name: Rollback (retag da imagem anterior + redeploy + smoke)
        env:
          ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.environment }}
          EC2_HOST: ${{ inputs.ec2-host }}
          EC2_USER: ${{ inputs.ec2-user }}
          SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          AWS_REGION_NAME: ${{ needs.config.outputs.aws-region }}
          BASE_PORT: ${{ needs.config.outputs.base-port }}
          BASE_URL: ${{ env.BASE_URL }}
          SMOKE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SMOKE_USERNAME || 'teste' }}
          SMOKE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SMOKE_PASSWORD || 'teste123' }}
        run: ./scripts/aws/rollback.sh --auto

===== ./.github/workflows/guardian.yml =====
# =============================================================================
# Guardian â€” smoke contÃ­nuo pÃ³s-deploy ("erros inesperados fora do deploy").
# A cada execuÃ§Ã£o (cron */10 + manual), para CADA ambiente em paralelo:
#   1) smoke completo (4 checagens em paralelo)
#   2) falhou? reconfirma apÃ³s GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY (evita falso positivo)
#   3) falha confirmada + existe <env>-previous -> ROLLBACK AUTOMÃTICO
#   4) sem histÃ³rico ou rollback falhou -> abre ISSUE de alerta no repositÃ³rio
# Cada ambiente usa o MESMO concurrency group do deploy (deploy-dev /
# deploy-homolog): o Guardian nunca concorre com um deploy em andamento.
# =============================================================================
name: Guardian (smoke contÃ­nuo + rollback automÃ¡tico)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/10 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: "Ambiente a inspecionar"
        required: false
        default: "all"
        type: choice
        options: [all, dev, homolog]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  guard-dev:
    name: Guardian Â· dev
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.environment == 'all' || inputs.environment == 'dev')
      && vars.AWS_EC2_HOST_DEV != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: dev
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-dev
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:

===== ./keycloak/event-listener/src/main/java/com/raiji/keycloak/events/RabbitEventPublisher.java =====
package com.raiji.keycloak.events;

import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

import com.rabbitmq.client.AMQP;
import com.rabbitmq.client.BuiltinExchangeType;
import com.rabbitmq.client.Channel;
import com.rabbitmq.client.Connection;
import com.rabbitmq.client.ConnectionFactory;
import org.jboss.logging.Logger;

/**
 * Publica mensagens numa exchange topic do RabbitMQ.
 *
 * <p>O envio roda numa Ãºnica thread de fundo: a requisiÃ§Ã£o do Keycloak nÃ£o espera
 * o RabbitMQ, e a ordem dos eventos Ã© preservada. A conexÃ£o Ã© aberta sob demanda
 * (o Keycloak sobe mesmo com o RabbitMQ fora do ar) e refeita apÃ³s falhas.
 * Cada mensagem Ã© persistente e confirmada pelo broker (publisher confirms).
 */
final class RabbitEventPublisher implements AutoCloseable {

    private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(RabbitEventPublisher.class);
    private static final long CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000;

    private final ConnectionFactory factory;
    private final String exchange;
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(r -> {
        Thread t = new Thread(r, "raiji-rabbitmq-publisher");
        t.setDaemon(true);
        return t;
    });

    private Connection connection;
    private Channel channel;

    RabbitEventPublisher(String uri, String exchange) {
        this.factory = new ConnectionFactory();
        try {
            factory.setUri(uri);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("RABBITMQ_URI invÃ¡lida", e);
        }
        factory.setConnectionTimeout(5_000);
        factory.setAutomaticRecoveryEnabled(false); // reconexÃ£o feita aqui, sob demanda
        this.exchange = exchange;
    }

    void publishAsync(String routingKey, byte[] body) {
        executor.execute(() -> publish(routingKey, body));
    }

    private void publish(String routingKey, byte[] body) {
        AMQP.BasicProperties props = new AMQP.BasicProperties.Builder()
                .contentType("application/json")
                .deliveryMode(2) // persistente
                .build();
        try {
            Channel ch = channel();
            ch.basicPublish(exchange, routingKey, props, body);
            ch.waitForConfirmsOrDie(CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS);
            LOG.debugf("evento publicado: %s", routingKey);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Sem outbox: se o broker estiver fora do ar o evento Ã© perdido (e logado).
            LOG.errorf(e, "falha ao publicar evento %s no RabbitMQ: %s", routingKey, new String(body));
            closeQuietly();
        }
    }

    private Channel channel() throws Exception {
        if (channel != null && channel.isOpen()) {
            return channel;
        }
        if (connection == null || !connection.isOpen()) {
            connection = factory.newConnection("keycloak-raiji-events");
        }
        channel = connection.createChannel();
        channel.confirmSelect();
        channel.exchangeDeclare(exchange, BuiltinExchangeType.TOPIC, true);
        return channel;
    }

    private void closeQuietly() {
        try {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.abort();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // nada a fazer
        }
        connection = null;
        channel = null;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        executor.shutdown();
        try {
            executor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
        closeQuietly();
    }
}

===== ./keycloak/event-listener/src/main/java/com/raiji/keycloak/events/RaijiEventListenerProviderFactory.java =====
package com.raiji.keycloak.events;

import org.jboss.logging.Logger;
import org.keycloak.Config;
import org.keycloak.events.EventListenerProvider;
import org.keycloak.events.EventListenerProviderFactory;
import org.keycloak.models.KeycloakSession;
import org.keycloak.models.KeycloakSessionFactory;

/**
 * Registra o listener "raiji-rabbitmq". Para ativar num realm:
 * Realm settings â†’ Events â†’ Event listeners (ou "eventsListeners" no realm JSON).
 *
 * <p>VariÃ¡veis de ambiente:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@code RABBITMQ_URI} (default amqp://raiji:raiji123@rabbitmq:5672)</li>
 *   <li>{@code RABBITMQ_USERS_EXCHANGE} (default raiji.users)</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class RaijiEventListenerProviderFactory implements EventListenerProviderFactory {

    public static final String ID = "raiji-rabbitmq";
    private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(RaijiEventListenerProviderFactory.class);

    private RabbitEventPublisher publisher;

    @Override
    public void init(Config.Scope config) {
        String uri = env("RABBITMQ_URI", "amqp://raiji:raiji123@rabbitmq:5672");
        String exchange = env("RABBITMQ_USERS_EXCHANGE", "raiji.users");
        publisher = new RabbitEventPublisher(uri, exchange);
        LOG.infof("raiji-rabbitmq: publicando eventos de usuÃ¡rio na exchange '%s'", exchange);
    }

    @Override
    public EventListenerProvider create(KeycloakSession session) {
        return new RaijiEventListenerProvider(session, publisher);
    }

    @Override
    public void postInit(KeycloakSessionFactory factory) {
        // nada
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        if (publisher != null) {
            publisher.close();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return ID;
    }

    private static String env(String name, String fallback) {
        String value = System.getenv(name);
        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? fallback : value;
    }
}

===== ./keycloak/event-listener/src/main/java/com/raiji/keycloak/events/RaijiEventListenerProvider.java =====
package com.raiji.keycloak.events;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.jboss.logging.Logger;
import org.keycloak.events.Event;
import org.keycloak.events.EventListenerProvider;
import org.keycloak.events.EventType;
import org.keycloak.events.admin.AdminEvent;
import org.keycloak.events.admin.OperationType;
import org.keycloak.events.admin.ResourceType;
import org.keycloak.models.AbstractKeycloakTransaction;
import org.keycloak.models.KeycloakSession;
import org.keycloak.models.RealmModel;
import org.keycloak.util.JsonSerialization;

/**
 * Traduz eventos do Keycloak em mensagens de ciclo de vida do usuÃ¡rio:
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@code user.created}: auto-cadastro (REGISTER) ou criaÃ§Ã£o pelo admin</li>
 *   <li>{@code user.deleted}: exclusÃ£o pelo admin ou pela prÃ³pria conta (DELETE_ACCOUNT)</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>A mensagem sÃ³ Ã© enviada depois que a transaÃ§Ã£o do Keycloak Ã© confirmada:
 * se a operaÃ§Ã£o falhar (rollback), nada Ã© publicado.
 */
final class RaijiEventListenerProvider implements EventListenerProvider {

    private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(RaijiEventListenerProvider.class);
    private static final Pattern USER_PATH = Pattern.compile("^users/([^/]+)$");

    static final String USER_CREATED = "user.created";
    static final String USER_DELETED = "user.deleted";

    private final KeycloakSession session;
    private final RabbitEventPublisher publisher;

    RaijiEventListenerProvider(KeycloakSession session, RabbitEventPublisher publisher) {
        this.session = session;
        this.publisher = publisher;
    }

    @Override
    public void onEvent(Event event) {
        if (event.getType() == EventType.REGISTER) {
            enqueue(USER_CREATED, event.getUserId(), event.getRealmId());
        } else if (event.getType() == EventType.DELETE_ACCOUNT) {
            enqueue(USER_DELETED, event.getUserId(), event.getRealmId());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onEvent(AdminEvent event, boolean includeRepresentation) {
        if (event.getResourceType() != ResourceType.USER || event.getResourcePath() == null) {
            return;
        }
        Matcher m = USER_PATH.matcher(event.getResourcePath());
        if (!m.matches()) {
            return; // ex.: users/{id}/role-mappings â€” nÃ£o Ã© criaÃ§Ã£o/exclusÃ£o do usuÃ¡rio
        }
        String userId = m.group(1);
        if (event.getOperationType() == OperationType.CREATE) {
            enqueue(USER_CREATED, userId, event.getRealmId());
        } else if (event.getOperationType() == OperationType.DELETE) {
            enqueue(USER_DELETED, userId, event.getRealmId());
        }
    }

    private void enqueue(String type, String userId, String realmId) {
        if (userId == null || userId.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }
        Map<String, Object> payload = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        payload.put("type", type);
        payload.put("userId", userId);
        payload.put("realm", realmName(realmId));
        payload.put("occurredAt", Instant.now().toString());

        final byte[] body;
        try {
            body = JsonSerialization.writeValueAsBytes(payload);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            LOG.errorf(e, "falha ao serializar evento %s", type);
            return;
        }

        session.getTransactionManager().enlistAfterCompletion(new AbstractKeycloakTransaction() {
            @Override
            protected void commitImpl() {
                publisher.publishAsync(type, body);
            }

            @Override
            protected void rollbackImpl() {
                // operaÃ§Ã£o desfeita: nÃ£o publica
            }
        });
    }

    private String realmName(String realmId) {
        RealmModel realm = realmId == null ? null : session.realms().getRealm(realmId);
        return realm != null ? realm.getName() : realmId;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        // nada: o publisher Ã© compartilhado e fechado pela factory
    }
}

_format_version: "3.0"

# ============================================================================
# Kong â€” configuraÃ§Ã£o declarativa (DB-less) do Raiji
# Toda a entrada pÃºblica do sistema passa pelo proxy em :8000
#
# ESTE ARQUIVO Ã‰ UM TEMPLATE. O container `kong-init` (kong/render-config.sh)
# busca a chave pÃºblica do realm no Keycloak e gera o kong.yml final,
# substituindo:
#   __KC_ISSUER__      -> ${PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/realms/raiji  (claim "iss")
#   __KC_PUBLIC_KEY__  -> chave RSA pÃºblica do realm (PEM)
# ============================================================================

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Consumer que representa o Keycloak: o plugin jwt localiza a chave de
# validaÃ§Ã£o pelo claim "iss" do token e confere a assinatura RS256.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
consumers:
  - username: keycloak-raiji
    jwt_secrets:
      - key: "__KC_ISSUER__"
        algorithm: RS256
        rsa_public_key: |
          -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
__KC_PUBLIC_KEY__
          -----END PUBLIC KEY-----

services:

  - name: raiji-app

    read_timeout: 60000

              cookie_names: []
              run_on_preflight: false # OPTIONS (CORS) passa sem token

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # sem passar pelo monolito. /chat/conversations -> /conversations

          # origem. O chat nÃ£o trata CORS: o Kong responde o preflight e os cabeÃ§alhos.

              exposed_headers: [Content-Length]

              claims_to_verify:
                - exp
              header_names:

              uri_param_names: []
              cookie_names: []
              run_on_preflight: false

===== ./kong/render-config.sh =====
#!/bin/sh
# =============================================================================
# render-config.sh â€” executado pelo container `kong-init` (alpine/busybox)
#
# 1. Espera o realm do Keycloak responder (rede interna do compose).
# 2. LÃª a chave RSA pÃºblica do realm.
# 3. Gera /out/kong.yml a partir de /kong/kong.yml.tmpl.
#
# VariÃ¡veis:
#   PUBLIC_BASE_URL  URL pÃºblica do Kong (= KC_HOSTNAME do Keycloak). ObrigatÃ³ria.
#   KC_INTERNAL_URL  URL interna do Keycloak   (default http://keycloak:8080)
#   KC_REALM         realm                     (default raiji)
#   TEMPLATE / OUT   caminhos de entrada/saÃ­da (default /kong/kong.yml.tmpl, /out/kong.yml)
# =============================================================================
set -eu

PUBLIC_BASE_URL="${PUBLIC_BASE_URL:?PUBLIC_BASE_URL obrigatÃ³rio}"
KC_INTERNAL_URL="${KC_INTERNAL_URL:-http://keycloak:8080}"
KC_REALM="${KC_REALM:-raiji}"
TEMPLATE="${TEMPLATE:-/kong/kong.yml.tmpl}"
OUT="${OUT:-/out/kong.yml}"
MAX_TRIES="${MAX_TRIES:-180}"

ISSUER="${PUBLIC_BASE_URL%/}/realms/${KC_REALM}"
REALM_URL="${KC_INTERNAL_URL%/}/realms/${KC_REALM}"

echo "[kong-init] aguardando realm em ${REALM_URL} ..."
tries=0
JSON=""
while :; do
  JSON="$(wget -qO- "$REALM_URL" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$JSON" in *'"public_key"'*) break ;; esac
  tries=$((tries + 1))
  if [ "$tries" -ge "$MAX_TRIES" ]; then
    echo "[kong-init] ERRO: Keycloak nÃ£o respondeu apÃ³s ${MAX_TRIES} tentativas" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 5
done

KEY="$(printf '%s' "$JSON" | sed -n 's/.*"public_key":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"
if [ -z "$KEY" ]; then
  echo "[kong-init] ERRO: public_key nÃ£o encontrada na resposta do realm" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# PEM: linhas de 64 caracteres, indentadas para o bloco YAML do template.
KEY_FILE="$(mktemp)"
printf '%s\n' "$KEY" | fold -w 64 | sed 's/^/          /' > "$KEY_FILE"

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
awk -v iss="$ISSUER" -v keyfile="$KEY_FILE" '
  { sub(/\r$/, "") }   # tolera template com CRLF (checkout no Windows)
  /^__KC_PUBLIC_KEY__$/ { while ((getline line < keyfile) > 0) print line; next }
  { gsub(/__KC_ISSUER__/, iss); print }
' "$TEMPLATE" > "$OUT.tmp"
mv "$OUT.tmp" "$OUT"
chmod 644 "$OUT"
rm -f "$KEY_FILE"

echo "[kong-init] kong.yml gerado (issuer=${ISSUER})"

===== ./raiji-app/src/main/java/com/raiji/RaijiApplication.java =====
package com.raiji;

import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationPropertiesScan;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.EnableScheduling;

@SpringBootApplication
@ConfigurationPropertiesScan
@EnableScheduling
public class RaijiApplication {

    public static void main(String[] args) {

===== ./raiji-app/src/main/java/com/raiji/web/ApiErrorHandler.java =====
package com.raiji.web;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/**
 * Devolve ao app o MOTIVO dos erros de negÃ³cio (ResponseStatusException), que
 * sÃ£o mensagens escritas para o usuÃ¡rio â€” ex.: "Para ser motorista, envie sua CNH...".
 * O Spring Boot, por padrÃ£o, omite esse texto.
 *
 * SÃ³ trata ResponseStatusException: erros inesperados (500) continuam com a
 * resposta genÃ©rica do Spring, sem expor detalhes internos.
 */
@RestControllerAdvice
public class ApiErrorHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(ResponseStatusException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handle(ResponseStatusException ex, HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpStatus status = HttpStatus.resolve(ex.getStatusCode().value());
        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        body.put("timestamp", Instant.now().toString());
        body.put("status", ex.getStatusCode().value());
        body.put("error", status != null ? status.getReasonPhrase() : "Error");
        body.put("message", ex.getReason());
        body.put("path", request.getRequestURI());
        return ResponseEntity.status(ex.getStatusCode()).headers(ex.getHeaders()).body(body);
    }
}

===== ./raiji-app/src/main/java/com/raiji/web/MeController.java =====
package com.raiji.web;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api")
public class MeController {

    @GetMapping("/me")
    public Map<String, Object> me(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        Map<String, Object> realmAccess = jwt.getClaimAsMap("realm_access");

        Map<String, Object> resposta = new HashMap<>();
        resposta.put("sub", jwt.getSubject());
        resposta.put("email", jwt.getClaimAsString("email"));
        resposta.put("name", jwt.getClaimAsString("name"));
        resposta.put("realmRoles", realmAccess == null
                ? List.of()
                : realmAccess.getOrDefault("roles", List.of()));

        // Atributos dos protocol mappers do Keycloak (podem ser null).
        resposta.put("cnhNumber",      jwt.getClaimAsString("cnh_number"));
        resposta.put("cnhCategory",    jwt.getClaimAsString("cnh_category"));
        resposta.put("cnhValidity",    jwt.getClaimAsString("cnh_validity"));
        resposta.put("driverVerified", jwt.getClaimAsString("driver_verified"));

        return resposta;
    }

    @GetMapping("/admin/ping")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('admin')")
    public Map<String, String> adminPing() {
        return Map.of("message", "Voce tem a role admin do realm raiji");
    }
}

        List<String> falhas = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Endpoint e : endpoints) {

            int status = resposta.getStatusCode();
            if (status >= 200 && status < 300) sucesso++;
            else falhas.add("%s %s â†’ HTTP %d".formatted(e.metodo(), e.rota(), status));

            saida.append("[%d] %s %s%n".formatted(n++, e.metodo(), e.rota()));

                .formatted(endpoints.size(), sucesso, falhas.size()));

        System.out.println(saida);
        Files.writeString(Path.of("target", "api-catalog.txt"), saida, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        assertThat(falhas).as("endpoints que nÃ£o responderam com sucesso (2xx)").isEmpty();
    }

    private static String corpoResumido(Response resposta) {
        String corpo = resposta.getBody().asString()
                .replaceAll("(\"(?:access_token|refresh_token|id_token)\":\")[^\"]*\"",
                        "$1***mascarado***\"");
        return corpo.length() <= LIMITE_CORPO ? corpo : corpo.substring(0, LIMITE_CORPO) + " â€¦(truncado)";
    }
}

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.hasSize;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.notNullValue;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

/**
 * S2-01 / RF18 â€” DeclaraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem na solicitaÃ§Ã£o de vaga.
 *
 * Cobre os critÃ©rios de aceite:
 *  - solicitaÃ§Ã£o SEM baggage            -> 400
 *  - solicitaÃ§Ã£o com baggage VAZIO      -> 400
 *  - quantity <= 0                      -> 400
 *  - dimensÃµes <= 0                     -> 400
 *  - type fora do enum                  -> 400
 *  - bagagem persiste e Ã© recuperada no detalhe da solicitaÃ§Ã£o
 *  - motorista vÃª a bagagem ANTES de aceitar/recusar
 */
@DisplayName("Testes de integraÃ§Ã£o â€” declaraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem (S2-01/RF18)")
class BaggageApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO =
            DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    private record UserSetup(String token, String sub) {}

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Setup (mesmo padrÃ£o de RideRequestApiIT)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private UserSetup criarUsuarioComRole(String prefixo, String role) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);

        if (role != null) {
            atribuirRoleRealm(userId, role);
        }

        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        String sub = given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("sub");

        return new UserSetup(token, sub);
    }

    private DriverSetup criarMotorista() {
        UserSetup user = criarUsuarioComRole("baggage-driver", "DRIVER");

        String plate = "B" + String.format(
                "%06d",
                ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000)
        );

        String vehicleId = given()
                .auth().oauth2(user.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "plate", plate,
                        "type", "CARRO",
                        "model", "Honda Civic",
                        "color", "Preto",
                        "year", 2023,
                        "passengerSeats", 4,
                        "cargoVolumeLiters", 400
                ))
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");

        return new DriverSetup(
                user.token(),
                UUID.fromString(vehicleId),
                user.sub()
        );
    }

    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver) {

        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");

        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");

        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now()
                .plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", 3);

        return given()

                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("S2-01: bagagem persiste e Ã© retornada na solicitaÃ§Ã£o")
    void bagagemPersisteEhRetornada() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver);

        given()
                .auth().oauth2(passenger.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payload("Maria Silva", List.of(itemValido())))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .body("id", notNullValue())
                .body("status", equalTo("PENDING"))
                .body("baggage", hasSize(1))
                .body("baggage[0].type", equalTo("mala"))
                .body("baggage[0].quantity", equalTo(1))
                .body("baggage[0].lengthCm", equalTo(60))
                .body("baggage[0].widthCm", equalTo(40))
                .body("baggage[0].heightCm", equalTo(30))
                .body("baggage[0].description", equalTo("Mala de bordo"));

        // persistÃªncia real: tabela baggage com FK para ride_passengers
        Integer total = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baggage b "
                        + "JOIN ride_passengers rp ON b.ride_passenger_id = rp.id "
                        + "WHERE rp.ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals(1, total);

        Map<String, Object> linha = jdbcTemplate.queryForMap(
                "SELECT b.type, b.quantity, b.length_cm, b.width_cm, b.height_cm, b.description "
                        + "FROM baggage b "
                        + "JOIN ride_passengers rp ON b.ride_passenger_id = rp.id "
                        + "WHERE rp.ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                rideId);
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals("MALA", linha.get("type"));
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals(1, linha.get("quantity"));
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals(60, linha.get("length_cm"));
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals(40, linha.get("width_cm"));
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals(30, linha.get("height_cm"));
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals("Mala de bordo", linha.get("description"));
    }

@DisplayName("Testes de integraÃ§Ã£o â€” trava de capacidade de assentos e carga (RN03/RN12)")
class CapacityLockApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO =
            DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private RidePassengerService ridePassengerService;

    private record UserSetup(String token, String sub) {}

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    // ===== fixtures =====

    private UserSetup criarUsuarioComRole(String prefixo, String role) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);

        if (role != null) {
            atribuirRoleRealm(userId, role);
        }

        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        String sub = given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("sub");

        return new UserSetup(token, sub);
    }

    private DriverSetup criarMotorista(Integer cargoVolumeLiters) {
        UserSetup user = criarUsuarioComRole("capacity-driver", "DRIVER");

        String plate = "R" + String.format(
                "%06d",
                ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000)
        );

        Map<String, Object> vehicle = new HashMap<>();
        vehicle.put("plate", plate);
        vehicle.put("type", "CARRO");
        vehicle.put("model", "Toyota Corolla");
        vehicle.put("color", "Prata");
        vehicle.put("year", 2024);
        vehicle.put("passengerSeats", 4);
        if (cargoVolumeLiters != null) {
            vehicle.put("cargoVolumeLiters", cargoVolumeLiters);
        }

        String vehicleId = given()
                .auth().oauth2(user.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(vehicle)
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");

        return new DriverSetup(
                user.token(),
                UUID.fromString(vehicleId),
                user.sub()
        );
    }

    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver, int totalSeats,
                               Map<String, Object> cargoDetails) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", driver.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", "Fortaleza");
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now()
                .plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", totalSeats);
        if (cargoDetails != null) {
            body.put("cargoDetails", cargoDetails);
        }

        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private UserSetup criarPassageiro() {
        return criarUsuarioComRole("capacity-passenger", "PASSENGER");
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> itemBagagem(
            String weightKg, int quantity,
            int lengthCm, int widthCm, int heightCm) {
        Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
        item.put("type", "mala");
        item.put("quantity", quantity);
        item.put("lengthCm", lengthCm);
        item.put("widthCm", widthCm);
        item.put("heightCm", heightCm);
        if (weightKg != null) {
            item.put("weightKg", weightKg);
        }
        item.put("description", "Mala de bordo");
        return item;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> payloadSolicitacao(
            String nome, Map<String, Object> item) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("passengerName", nome);
        payload.put("baggage", List.of(item));
        return payload;
    }

    private String solicitarVaga(String token, String rideId, String nome,
                                 Map<String, Object> item) {
        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao(nome, item))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private void solicitarEsperando400(String token, String rideId,
                                       String nome, Map<String, Object> item) {
        given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao(nome, item))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(400);
    }

    private Response decidir(String token, String rideId, String requestId,
                             String decision, String reason) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("decision", decision);
        payload.put("reason", reason);
        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payload)
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId
                        + "/requests/" + requestId));
    }

    // ===== helpers de banco =====

    private int vagasDisponiveis(String rideId) {
        Integer vagas = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT available_seats FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        return vagas == null ? -1 : vagas;
    }

    private String statusNoBanco(String requestId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT status FROM ride_passengers WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                String.class, requestId);
    }

    // ===== critÃ©rios de aceite (issue #10) =====

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN03: duas confirmaÃ§Ãµes simultÃ¢neas nÃ£o estouram a lotaÃ§Ã£o (1Ã— 200, 1Ã— 409)")
    void confirmacoesSimultaneasNaoEstouramLotacao() throws Exception {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista(400);
        UserSetup pax1 = criarPassageiro();
        UserSetup pax2 = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 2, null);
        String req1 = solicitarVaga(pax1.token(), rideId, "Pax Um",
                itemBagagem(null, 1, 40, 30, 20));
        String req2 = solicitarVaga(pax2.token(), rideId, "Pax Dois",
                itemBagagem(null, 1, 40, 30, 20));

        // sÃ³ 1 vaga livre â€” os dois aceites correm simultaneamente por ela
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET available_seats = 1 WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                rideId);

        int threads = 2;
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads);
        CyclicBarrier largada = new CyclicBarrier(threads);
        List<Future<Integer>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        for (String requestId : List.of(req1, req2)) {
            futures.add(pool.submit(() -> {
                largada.await(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS); // largada simultÃ¢nea
                try {
                    ridePassengerService.decide(
                            UUID.fromString(rideId),
                            UUID.fromString(requestId),
                            driver.sub(),
                            RideDecision.ACCEPT,
                            null);
                    return 200;
                } catch (ResponseStatusException ex) {
                    return ex.getStatusCode().value();
                }
            }));
        }

        pool.shutdown();
        Assertions.assertTrue(pool.awaitTermination(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS),
                "as decisÃµes concorrentes devem terminar");

        List<Integer> codes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Future<Integer> f : futures) {
            codes.add(f.get());
        }

        Assertions.assertEquals(1,
                codes.stream().filter(c -> c == 200).count(),
                "exatamente uma confirmaÃ§Ã£o pode passar");
        Assertions.assertEquals(1,
                codes.stream().filter(c -> c == 409).count(),
                "a outra decisÃ£o deve receber 409 (sem vagas)");

        Integer vagas = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT available_seats FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        Assertions.assertEquals(0, vagas.intValue(),
                "vagas nunca podem ficar negativas");

        Integer confirmados = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ride_passengers "
                        + "WHERE ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid) AND status = 'CONFIRMED'",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        Assertions.assertEquals(1, confirmados.intValue(),
                "apenas uma reserva pode ficar CONFIRMED");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN12: peso exatamente no limite Ã© aceito (CONFIRMED)")
    void pesoNoLimiteExatoEhAceito() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista(400);
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();

        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria",

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN12: peso 1 acima do limite retorna 400 e mantÃ©m PENDING")
    void pesoAcimaDoLimiteRetorna400() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista(400);
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 2, Map.of("maxWeightKg", 20));
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria",

                "vagas nÃ£o mudam quando a capacidade de carga reprova");
    }

        Assertions.assertEquals("PENDING", statusNoBanco(req2));
    }

    @Test

        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 2, null);
