                itemBagagem("0", 1, 40, 30, 20));       // zero => @Positive
        solicitarEsperando400(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria",
                itemBagagem("-1.5", 1, 40, 30, 20));    // negativo => @Positive
        solicitarEsperando400(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria",
                itemBagagem("1.234", 1, 40, 30, 20));   // 3 casas => @Digits

        // sem weightKg => 201 (campo opcional â€” contrato S2-01 retrocompatÃ­vel)
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria",
                itemBagagem(null, 1, 40, 30, 20));
        Assertions.assertNotNull(requestId);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF18: weightKg declarado Ã© ecoado no POST e na visÃ£o do motorista")
    void weightKgEhExpostoNasRespostas() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista(400);
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 2, null);

        given()
                .auth().oauth2(passenger.token())

        given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("[0].baggage[0].weightKg", equalTo(12.5f));
    }

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.containsString;

/**
 * Carona com mapa: busca pelo caminho (PostGIS real), preÃ§o do trecho, "aceitar todos",
 * bagagem opcional/editÃ¡vel, ciclo de vida e notificaÃ§Ãµes.
 */
@DisplayName("Caronas com mapa: busca pelo caminho, trecho, aceitar todos, bagagem e ciclo de vida")
class CaronaMapaFluxoApiIT extends FluxoTestSupport {

    private List<Map<String, Object>> buscar(String token, double[] origem, double[] destino, String kind) {
        var req = given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .queryParam("originLat", origem[0]).queryParam("originLng", origem[1])
                .queryParam("radiusMeters", 5000).queryParam("kind", kind);
        if (destino != null) req = req.queryParam("destinationLat", destino[0]).queryParam("destinationLng", destino[1]);
        return req.when().get(app("/api/rides/search")).then().statusCode(200).extract().jsonPath().getList("$");
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static Map<String, Object> resultado(List<Map<String, Object>> lista, String rideId) {
        return lista.stream().filter(r -> rideId.equals(((Map<String, Object>) r.get("ride")).get("id")))
                .findFirst().orElse(null);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("busca: perto de mim, de A para B, no meio do caminho (preÃ§o proporcional); sentido contrÃ¡rio e longe nÃ£o acham")
    void buscaPeloCaminho() {
        Motorista m = motorista("mapa-mot", 4, null);
        String rideId = publicarOk(m, carona(m, "PASSENGER", 3, 100.0, agora().plusDays(1)));
        Conta ana = conta("mapa-ana");

        // perto de mim (sÃ³ origem)
        assertThat(resultado(buscar(ana.token(), SE, null, "SEAT"), rideId)).isNotNull();

        // de A para B: viagem inteira, preÃ§o cheio
        Map<String, Object> inteira = resultado(buscar(ana.token(), SE, CAMPINAS, "SEAT"), rideId);
        assertThat(inteira).isNotNull();
        assertThat(inteira.get("fullRoute")).isEqualTo(true);
        assertThat(new BigDecimal(inteira.get("suggestedPrice").toString())).isEqualByComparingTo("100.00");

        // no meio do caminho: JundiaÃ­ -> Campinas paga sÃ³ o trecho
        Map<String, Object> trecho = resultado(buscar(ana.token(), JUNDIAI, CAMPINAS, "SEAT"), rideId);
        assertThat(trecho).isNotNull();
        assertThat(trecho.get("fullRoute")).isEqualTo(false);
        BigDecimal precoTrecho = new BigDecimal(trecho.get("suggestedPrice").toString());
        assertThat(precoTrecho).isGreaterThan(BigDecimal.ZERO).isLessThan(new BigDecimal("100"));

        // sentido contrÃ¡rio (Campinas -> SÃ©) e longe (Rio) nÃ£o acham
        assertThat(resultado(buscar(ana.token(), CAMPINAS, SE, "SEAT"), rideId)).isNull();
        assertThat(resultado(buscar(ana.token(), RIO, null, "SEAT"), rideId)).isNull();
        // a prÃ³pria carona nÃ£o aparece para o motorista; encomendas nÃ£o acham carona sÃ³ de passageiros
        assertThat(resultado(buscar(m.token(), SE, CAMPINAS, "SEAT"), rideId)).isNull();
        assertThat(resultado(buscar(ana.token(), SE, CAMPINAS, "PACKAGE"), rideId)).isNull();

        // detalhe traz a rota para o mapa
        given().auth().oauth2(ana.token()).when().get(app("/api/rides/" + rideId)).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("ride.meetingPoint", equalTo("Em frente Ã  catedral"))
                .body("ride.routeDistanceMeters", notNullValue())
                .body("route", hasSize(3));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("bagagem: editar depois do aceite â€” aumentar espera o motorista; diminuir vale na hora")
    void bagagemEditavel() {
        Motorista m = motorista("bag-mot", 4, 400);
        String rideId = publicarOk(m, carona(m, "PASSENGER", 3, 40.0, agora().plusDays(1)));
        Conta dani = conta("bag-dani");
        String pedido = pedirVaga(dani.token(), rideId, Map.of("passengerName", "Dani")).statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT"))
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + pedido)).then().statusCode(200);

        String url = app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + pedido + "/baggage");
        // aumenta: fica pendente, a bagagem em vigor continua vazia; o motorista Ã© avisado
        given().auth().oauth2(dani.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("baggage", List.of(bagagem("mala", 70, 45, 30, 15))))
                .when().put(url).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("baggage", hasSize(0)).body("pendingBaggage", hasSize(1));
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(m.token(), "DRIVER"), "BAGGAGE_CHANGE_REQUEST")).isTrue();

        // motorista aprova
        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT"))
                .when().patch(url).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("baggage", hasSize(1)).body("pendingBaggage", hasSize(0));

        // diminui: vale na hora
        given().auth().oauth2(dani.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("baggage", List.of(bagagem("mochila", 40, 30, 20, 5))))
                .when().put(url).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("baggage[0].type", equalTo("mochila")).body("pendingBaggage", hasSize(0));

        // outra pessoa nÃ£o edita
        given().auth().oauth2(conta("bag-outra").token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("baggage", List.of())).when().put(url).then().statusCode(403);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("ciclo: iniciar cedo demais 409; iniciar recusa pendentes; finalizar conclui as reservas")
    void cicloDeVida() {
        Motorista m = motorista("ciclo-mot", 4, null);
        String longe = publicarOk(m, carona(m, "PASSENGER", 3, 30.0, agora().plusDays(2)));
        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).when().post(app("/api/rides/" + longe + "/start"))
                .then().statusCode(409).body("message", containsString("60 minutos"));

        // "agora": sai em 30 min
        String rideId = publicarOk(m, carona(m, "PASSENGER", 3, 30.0, agora().plusMinutes(30)));
        Conta eva = conta("ciclo-eva");
        Conta fabi = conta("ciclo-fabi");
        String pedidoEva = pedirVaga(eva.token(), rideId, Map.of("passengerName", "Eva")).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        pedirVaga(fabi.token(), rideId, Map.of("passengerName", "Fabi")).statusCode(201);
        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT"))
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + pedidoEva)).then().statusCode(200);

        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/start"))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("IN_PROGRESS")).body("startedAt", notNullValue());
        // Fabi (pendente) foi recusada e avisada
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(fabi.token(), "PASSENGER"), "RIDE_REQUEST_REJECTED")).isTrue();

        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/finish"))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("COMPLETED"));

        List<Map<String, Object>> minhas = given().auth().oauth2(eva.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/bookings/mine")).then().statusCode(200).extract().jsonPath().getList("$");
        assertThat(minhas).anySatisfy(b -> {
            assertThat(((Map<?, ?>) b.get("booking")).get("status")).isEqualTo("COMPLETED");
            assertThat(((Map<?, ?>) b.get("ride")).get("id")).isEqualTo(rideId);
        });
    }

===== ./raiji-app/src/test/java/com/raiji/it/DriverVerificationApiIT.java =====
package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.containsString;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.hasItem;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.is;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.not;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Map;

import io.restassured.response.ValidatableResponse;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

/**
 * VerificaÃ§Ã£o da CNH ponta a ponta (API real + Keycloak real), com a
 * Infosimples FALSA ({@link FakeInfosimples}) e o armazenamento em memÃ³ria.
 */
@DisplayName("VerificaÃ§Ã£o da CNH para virar motorista (Infosimples simulada)")
class DriverVerificationApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final byte[] FOTO = "foto-de-cnh".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

    private record Conta(String username, String token, String sub) {}

    private Conta novaConta(String prefixo) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        criarUsuario(username);
        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);
        String sub = given().auth().oauth2(token).when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200).extract().path("sub");
        return new Conta(username, token, sub);
    }

    private ValidatableResponse enviar(Conta conta, byte[] foto, String mime, String codigo) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(conta.token())
                .multiPart("image", "cnh.png", foto, mime)
                .multiPart("securityCode", codigo)
                .when().post(app("/api/users/me/driver/cnh"))
                .then();
    }

    /** Envia e espera a verificaÃ§Ã£o (em segundo plano) terminar */
    private Map<String, Object> verificar(Conta conta, byte[] foto, String codigo) {
        enviar(conta, foto, "image/png", codigo).statusCode(202).body("status", equalTo("PROCESSING"));
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            Map<String, Object> status = given().auth().oauth2(conta.token())
                    .when().get(app("/api/users/me/driver/cnh"))
                    .then().statusCode(200).extract().as(Map.class);
            if (!"PROCESSING".equals(status.get("status"))) return status;
            try {
                Thread.sleep(100);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
        }
        throw new AssertionError("a verificaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o terminou");
    }

    private void semFotoGuardada(Conta conta) {
        assertThat(InMemoryCnhImageStorage.FILES.keySet())
                .noneMatch(key -> key.startsWith("cnh/" + conta.sub() + "/"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CNH vÃ¡lida: APPROVED, a conta vira motorista (e passageira), a foto Ã© apagada")
    void aprovada() {
        Conta conta = novaConta("cnh-ok");

        Map<String, Object> status = verificar(conta, FOTO, FakeInfosimples.CNH_VALIDA);

        assertThat(status).containsEntry("status", "APPROVED").containsEntry("categoria", "B");
        assertThat(status.get("validade")).isNotNull();
        assertThat(status).doesNotContainKeys("cpf", "registro");
        semFotoGuardada(conta);

        String novoToken = obterToken(conta.username(), SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);
        given().auth().oauth2(novoToken).when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("driver", is(true))
                .body("passenger", is(true))
                .body("realmRoles", hasItem("DRIVER"));

        // E-mail de aprovaÃ§Ã£o enviado (Resend FALSO) para o e-mail da conta, uma vez por pedido
        String email = conta.username() + "@raiji.com";
        java.util.List<Map<String, String>> enviados = FakeResend.EMAILS.stream()
                .filter(e -> e.get("body").contains("\"to\":[\"" + email + "\"]"))
                .toList();
        assertThat(enviados).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(enviados.get(0).get("path")).isEqualTo("/emails");
        assertThat(enviados.get(0).get("auth")).isEqualTo("Bearer " + FakeResend.API_KEY);
        assertThat(enviados.get(0).get("idempotencyKey")).startsWith("driver-approved-");
        assertThat(enviados.get(0).get("body"))
                .contains("Seu cadastro de motorista no Raiji foi aprovado")
                .contains("OlÃ¡, Usuario!");

        // Chegou na Infosimples (falsa) com o token falso e sem login gov.br configurado
        assertThat(FakeInfosimples.CALLS).anySatisfy(call -> {
            assertThat(call).containsEntry("_path", "/api/v2/consultas/senatran/validar-cnh")
                    .containsEntry("token", FakeInfosimples.TOKEN)
                    .containsEntry("codigo_seguranca", FakeInfosimples.CNH_VALIDA)
                    .containsEntry("cpf", "12345678909")
                    .doesNotContainKeys("login_cpf", "login_senha");
        });
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CNH nÃ£o encontrada no SENATRAN: REJECTED com motivo; nÃ£o vira motorista")
    void naoEncontrada() {
        Conta conta = novaConta("cnh-612");

        Map<String, Object> status = verificar(conta, FOTO, FakeInfosimples.CNH_NAO_ENCONTRADA);

        assertThat(status).containsEntry("status", "REJECTED");
        assertThat((String) status.get("reason")).contains("NÃ£o encontramos");
        semFotoGuardada(conta);
        assertThat(FakeResend.EMAILS)
                .as("rejeitado nÃ£o recebe e-mail de aprovaÃ§Ã£o")
                .noneMatch(e -> e.get("body").contains(conta.username() + "@raiji.com"));
        given().auth().oauth2(obterToken(conta.username(), SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS))
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().body("driver", is(false)).body("realmRoles", not(hasItem("DRIVER")));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CNH suspensa: REJECTED mostrando a situaÃ§Ã£o")

        assertThat((String) status.get("reason")).contains("suspensa");
    }

    @Test

    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("SENATRAN fora do ar: ERROR (pode tentar de novo depois)")
    void indisponivel() {

    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("foto ilegÃ­vel: REJECTED sem consultar o SENATRAN")
    void fotoIlegivel() {
        String codigoUnico = "66666666666";

        Map<String, Object> status = verificar(novaConta("cnh-ileg"),
                "ILEGIVEL".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), codigoUnico);

        assertThat(status).containsEntry("status", "REJECTED");
        assertThat((String) status.get("reason")).contains("foto nÃ­tida");
        assertThat(FakeInfosimples.CALLS).noneMatch(call -> codigoUnico.equals(call.get("codigo_seguranca")));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("validaÃ§Ã£o do envio: sem foto 400, formato 415, cÃ³digo invÃ¡lido 400, sem token 401")
    void validacoesDoEnvio() {
        Conta conta = novaConta("cnh-val");

        given().auth().oauth2(conta.token()).multiPart("securityCode", FakeInfosimples.CNH_VALIDA)
                .when().post(app("/api/users/me/driver/cnh")).then().statusCode(400);
        enviar(conta, FOTO, "application/pdf", FakeInfosimples.CNH_VALIDA).statusCode(415);
        enviar(conta, FOTO, "image/png", "abc").statusCode(400);
        given().multiPart("image", "cnh.png", FOTO, "image/png").multiPart("securityCode", "11111111111")
                .when().post(app("/api/users/me/driver/cnh")).then().statusCode(401);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("sem nunca ter enviado: status NONE")
    void nunca() {
        given().auth().oauth2(novaConta("cnh-none").token())
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me/driver/cnh"))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("NONE"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("POST /driver sem CNH verificada -> 409; com CNH aprovada volta a ser motorista sem reenviar")
    void reativarMotorista() {
        Conta conta = novaConta("cnh-reat");

        given().auth().oauth2(conta.token()).when().post(app("/api/users/me/driver"))
                .then().statusCode(409).body("message", containsString("CNH"));

        assertThat(verificar(conta, FOTO, FakeInfosimples.CNH_VALIDA)).containsEntry("status", "APPROVED");

        given().auth().oauth2(conta.token()).when().delete(app("/api/users/me/driver"))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("driver", is(false)).body("passenger", is(true));
        given().auth().oauth2(conta.token()).when().post(app("/api/users/me/driver"))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("driver", is(true));
    }

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;

/** Empresas (CNPJ na Receita falsa, vÃ¡rios gestores) e propostas de frete (direta e pÃºblica). */
@DisplayName("Empresas e frete: CNPJ, membros, proposta direta e pedido pÃºblico com ofertas")
class EmpresaFreteFluxoApiIT extends FluxoTestSupport {

    private ValidatableResponse cadastrar(Conta c, String cnpj) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(c.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("cnpj", cnpj))
                .when().post(app("/api/companies")).then();
    }

    private String empresa(Conta dono) {
        return cadastrar(dono, FakeBrasilApi.cnpj("12")).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
    }

    private Map<String, Object> frete(String alvoSub, Double valor) {
        Map<String, Object> b = new HashMap<>();
        if (alvoSub != null) b.put("targetDriverSub", alvoSub);
        if (valor != null) b.put("offeredPrice", valor);
        b.put("origin", Map.of("city", "SÃ£o Paulo", "state", "SP", "latitude", SE[0], "longitude", SE[1],
                "address", "Rua da Loja, 100"));
        b.put("destination", Map.of("city", "Campinas", "state", "SP", "latitude", CAMPINAS[0],
                "longitude", CAMPINAS[1], "address", "Av. Cliente, 200"));
        b.put("desiredDate", agora().plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        b.put("pkg", EncomendaFluxoApiIT.pacote("MEDIUM", 10));
        b.put("notes", "Retirar no balcÃ£o");
        return b;
    }

    private ValidatableResponse criarFrete(Conta membro, String companyId, Map<String, Object> body) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(membro.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/companies/" + companyId + "/freight-requests")).then();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("cadastro pelo CNPJ: invÃ¡lido 400, inexistente 404, Receita fora 503, baixado 422, ativo 201, repetido 409, MEI")
    void cadastroCnpj() {
        Conta dono = conta("cnpj-dono");
        cadastrar(dono, "11.111.111/1111-11").statusCode(400).body("message", containsString("CNPJ invÃ¡lido"));
        cadastrar(dono, FakeBrasilApi.cnpj("98")).statusCode(404);
        cadastrar(dono, FakeBrasilApi.cnpj("97")).statusCode(503);
        cadastrar(dono, FakeBrasilApi.cnpj("99")).statusCode(422).body("message", containsString("BAIXADA"));

        String cnpj = FakeBrasilApi.cnpj("12");
        String formatado = cnpj.substring(0, 2) + "." + cnpj.substring(2, 5) + "." + cnpj.substring(5, 8) + "/"
                + cnpj.substring(8, 12) + "-" + cnpj.substring(12);
        cadastrar(dono, formatado).statusCode(201)
                .body("myRole", equalTo("OWNER")).body("kind", equalTo("EMPRESA"))
                .body("cnpjFormatted", equalTo(formatado));
        cadastrar(conta("cnpj-outro"), cnpj).statusCode(409);

        given().auth().oauth2(dono.token()).when().get(app("/api/companies/cnpj/" + FakeBrasilApi.cnpj("96")))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("kind", equalTo("MEI")).body("active", equalTo(true));
    }

    @Test

    @Test
    @DisplayName("proposta direta: motorista vÃª (sem telefone de quem recebe), aceita com o veÃ­culo -> viagem exclusiva + encomenda")
    void propostaDireta() {
        Conta dono = conta("dir-dono");
        String companyId = empresa(dono);
        Motorista m = motorista("dir-mot", 4, 500);

        // para quem nÃ£o Ã© motorista => 400
        criarFrete(dono, companyId, frete(conta("dir-nao").sub(), 80.0)).statusCode(400);
        // direta sem valor => 400
        criarFrete(dono, companyId, frete(m.sub(), null)).statusCode(400);

        String freteId = criarFrete(dono, companyId, frete(m.sub(), 80.0)).statusCode(201)
                .body("direct", equalTo(true)).body("status", equalTo("OPEN")).extract().path("id");
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(m.token(), "DRIVER"), "FREIGHT_PROPOSAL")).isTrue();

        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).when().get(app("/api/freight-requests/for-me")).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("id", hasItem(freteId))
                .body("find { it.id == '" + freteId + "' }.recipientPhone", nullValue());

        String rideId = given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("vehicleId", m.vehicleId()))
                .when().post(app("/api/freight-requests/" + freteId + "/accept")).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("ACCEPTED")).extract().path("rideId");
        assertThat(rideId).as("o motorista nÃ£o recebe ids internos na visÃ£o dele").isNull();
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(dono.token(), "COMPANY"), "FREIGHT_ACCEPTED")).isTrue();

        // a empresa vÃª a encomenda (com os cÃ³digos) e a viagem criada
        Map<String, Object> detalhe = given().auth().oauth2(dono.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/freight-requests/" + freteId)).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("rideId", notNullValue()).body("deliveryId", notNullValue()).extract().as(Map.class);
        String deliveryId = (String) detalhe.get("deliveryId");
        String codigo = given().auth().oauth2(dono.token()).when().get(app("/api/deliveries/" + deliveryId))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED")).body("price", equalTo(80.0f))
                .body("companyId", equalTo(companyId)).extract().path("pickupCode");

        // viagem exclusiva: estÃ¡ nas viagens do motorista, mas nÃ£o aparece na busca
        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).when().get(app("/api/rides/mine")).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("find { it.id == '" + detalhe.get("rideId") + "' }.visibility", equalTo("PRIVATE"));
        given().auth().oauth2(conta("dir-busca").token())
                .queryParam("originLat", SE[0]).queryParam("originLng", SE[1]).queryParam("kind", "PACKAGE")
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/search")).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("ride.id", not(hasItem(detalhe.get("rideId"))));

        // daqui em diante Ã© o fluxo normal da encomenda
        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("code", codigo))
                .when().post(app("/api/deliveries/" + deliveryId + "/pickup")).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("IN_TRANSIT"));
    }

        List<Map<String, Object>> ofertas = given().auth().oauth2(joana.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/freight-requests/" + freteId + "/offers")).then().statusCode(200)

        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(caro.token(), "DRIVER"), "FREIGHT_OFFER_DECLINED")).isTrue();

        given().auth().oauth2(motorista("pub-tarde", 4, null).token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("price", 10, "vehicleId", barato.vehicleId()))

                .then().statusCode(404);
    }

===== ./raiji-app/src/test/java/com/raiji/it/EncomendaFluxoApiIT.java =====
package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.containsString;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.matchesPattern;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.notNullValue;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import io.restassured.response.ValidatableResponse;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

/** Encomenda como espaÃ§o de carga numa carona: pedido, aceite com capacidade, coleta e entrega com cÃ³digos. */
@DisplayName("Encomendas em caronas: pedido, capacidade, cÃ³digo de coleta e palavra-chave de entrega")
class EncomendaFluxoApiIT extends FluxoTestSupport {

    private String caronaMista(Motorista m, double maxKg) {
        Map<String, Object> body = carona(m, "MIXED", 2, 40.0, agora().plusDays(1));
        body.put("cargoDetails", Map.of("maxWeightKg", maxKg));
        body.put("pricePerPackage", 20);
        return publicarOk(m, body);
    }

    static Map<String, Object> pacote(String tamanho, double kg) {
        Map<String, Object> p = new HashMap<>();
        p.put("size", tamanho);
        p.put("description", "Documentos e livros");
        p.put("weightKg", kg);
        p.put("fragile", false);
        p.put("recipientName", "Rita DestinatÃ¡ria");
        p.put("recipientPhone", "(19) 99999-0000");
        return p;
    }

    private ValidatableResponse enviar(String token, String rideId, Map<String, Object> pacote) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(token).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("pkg", pacote))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/deliveries")).then();
    }

    private ValidatableResponse decidir(Motorista m, String rideId, String id, String decisao) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("decision", decisao);
        if ("REJECT".equals(decisao)) body.put("reason", "NÃ£o cabe");
        return given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(body)
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/deliveries/" + id)).then();
    }

    private ValidatableResponse codigo(Motorista m, String id, String acao, String code) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("code", code))
                .when().post(app("/api/deliveries/" + id + "/" + acao)).then();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("fluxo completo: pedido -> aceite -> coleta com cÃ³digo -> entrega com palavra-chave")
    void fluxoCompleto() {
        Motorista m = motorista("enc-mot", 4, 400);
        String rideId = caronaMista(m, 20);
        Conta rem = conta("enc-rem");

        var criado = enviar(rem.token(), rideId, pacote("SMALL", 3)).statusCode(201)
                .body("status", equalTo("PENDING"))
                .body("pickupCode", matchesPattern("\\d{4}"))
                .body("deliveryKeyword", matchesPattern("[A-Z]+-\\d{2}"))
                .body("price", equalTo(20.0f))
                .body("platformFee", equalTo(0.30f))
                .body("lengthCm", equalTo(30))   // medidas padrÃ£o do tamanho SMALL
                .extract();
        String id = criado.path("id");
        String codigoColeta = criado.path("pickupCode");
        String palavra = criado.path("deliveryKeyword");
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(m.token(), "DRIVER"), "DELIVERY_REQUEST")).isTrue();

        // o motorista NÃƒO vÃª os cÃ³digos
        List<Map<String, Object>> doMotorista = given().auth().oauth2(m.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/deliveries")).then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().jsonPath().getList("$");
        assertThat(doMotorista).allSatisfy(d -> {
            assertThat(d.get("pickupCode")).isNull();
            assertThat(d.get("deliveryKeyword")).isNull();
        });

        decidir(m, rideId, id, "ACCEPT").statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"));
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(rem.token(), "PASSENGER"), "DELIVERY_ACCEPTED")).isTrue();

        codigo(m, id, "pickup", "0000".equals(codigoColeta) ? "1111" : "0000").statusCode(400);
        codigo(m, id, "pickup", codigoColeta).statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("IN_TRANSIT"));
        codigo(m, id, "deliver", "XYZ-00").statusCode(400).body("message", containsString("Palavra-chave"));
        // aceita minÃºsculas e sem hÃ­fen
        codigo(m, id, "deliver", palavra.toLowerCase().replace("-", " ")).statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("DELIVERED")).body("deliveredAt", notNullValue());
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(rem.token(), "PASSENGER"), "DELIVERY_DELIVERED")).isTrue();

        // remetente vÃª nas suas encomendas, com a carona
        List<Map<String, Object>> minhas = given().auth().oauth2(rem.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/deliveries/mine")).then().statusCode(200).extract().jsonPath().getList("$");
        assertThat(minhas).anySatisfy(d -> assertThat(d.get("id")).isEqualTo(id));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("capacidade: o aceite confere o peso total da carona (bagagens + encomendas)")
    void capacidade() {
        Motorista m = motorista("cap-mot", 4, 400);
        String rideId = caronaMista(m, 10);
        String a = enviar(conta("cap-a").token(), rideId, pacote("SMALL", 4)).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        String b = enviar(conta("cap-b").token(), rideId, pacote("MEDIUM", 8)).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        decidir(m, rideId, a, "ACCEPT").statusCode(200);
        decidir(m, rideId, b, "ACCEPT").statusCode(400).body("message", containsString("excede"));
        decidir(m, rideId, b, "REJECT").statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"));

        // peso acima do mÃ¡ximo do tamanho
        enviar(conta("cap-c").token(), rideId, pacote("ENVELOPE", 3)).statusCode(400)
                .body("message", containsString("tamanho maior"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("regras: carona sÃ³ de passageiros nÃ£o leva encomenda; 5 cÃ³digos errados bloqueiam; cancelar antes da coleta")
    void regras() {
        Motorista m = motorista("regra-mot", 4, null);
        String soPassageiros = publicarOk(m, carona(m, "PASSENGER", 2, 30.0, agora().plusDays(1)));
        enviar(conta("regra-x").token(), soPassageiros, pacote("SMALL", 1)).statusCode(409);

        String rideId = caronaMista(m, 30);
        Conta rem = conta("regra-rem");
        String id = enviar(rem.token(), rideId, pacote("SMALL", 1)).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        decidir(m, rideId, id, "ACCEPT").statusCode(200);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) codigo(m, id, "pickup", "abcd").statusCode(400);
        codigo(m, id, "pickup", "abcd").statusCode(429);

        String outra = enviar(rem.token(), rideId, pacote("SMALL", 1)).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        given().auth().oauth2(rem.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("reason", "Desisti"))
                .when().post(app("/api/deliveries/" + outra + "/cancel")).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"));
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(m.token(), "DRIVER"), "DELIVERY_CANCELLED")).isTrue();

        // outra pessoa nÃ£o vÃª
        given().auth().oauth2(conta("regra-curioso").token()).when().get(app("/api/deliveries/" + outra))
                .then().statusCode(404);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("viagem cancelada: encomenda aceita e nÃ£o coletada Ã© cancelada e o remetente avisado")
    void viagemCancelada() {
        Motorista m = motorista("vc-mot", 4, null);
        String rideId = caronaMista(m, 30);
        Conta rem = conta("vc-rem");
        String id = enviar(rem.token(), rideId, pacote("SMALL", 2)).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        decidir(m, rideId, id, "ACCEPT").statusCode(200);
        given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of())
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/cancel")).then().statusCode(200);
        given().auth().oauth2(rem.token()).when().get(app("/api/deliveries/" + id)).then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED")).body("cancellationReason", notNullValue());
        assertThat(temKind(notificacoes(rem.token(), "PASSENGER"), "DELIVERY_CANCELLED")).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("busca de encomenda acha carona MIXED/CARGO com preÃ§o por encomenda")
    void buscaParaEncomenda() {
        Motorista m = motorista("be-mot", 4, null);
        String rideId = caronaMista(m, 30);
        List<Map<String, Object>> achados = given().auth().oauth2(conta("be-x").token())
                .queryParam("originLat", SE[0]).queryParam("originLng", SE[1])
                .queryParam("destinationLat", CAMPINAS[0]).queryParam("destinationLng", CAMPINAS[1])
                .queryParam("kind", "PACKAGE")
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/search")).then().statusCode(200).extract().jsonPath().getList("ride");
        assertThat(achados).anySatisfy(r -> {

            assertThat(r.get("pricePerPackage")).isNotNull();
        });
    }

===== ./raiji-app/src/test/java/com/raiji/it/FakeBrasilApi.java =====
package com.raiji.it;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

/**
 * BrasilAPI FALSA (consulta de CNPJ) para os testes de integraÃ§Ã£o: nenhum teste
 * consulta a API real. O cenÃ¡rio sai dos 2 primeiros dÃ­gitos do CNPJ:
 * <pre>
 * 99...  situaÃ§Ã£o BAIXADA          98...  404 (nÃ£o existe na Receita)
 * 97...  500 (fora do ar)          96...  ATIVA, MEI
 * outros ATIVA, empresa
 * </pre>
 * Use {@link #cnpj(String)} para gerar um CNPJ vÃ¡lido (dÃ­gitos verificadores) e Ãºnico.
 */
public final class FakeBrasilApi {

    public static final List<String> CONSULTAS = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private static HttpServer server;

    private FakeBrasilApi() {
    }

    public static synchronized String start() {
        if (server == null) {
            try {
                server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(e);
            }
            server.createContext("/api/cnpj/v1/", exchange -> {
                String cnpj = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath().substring("/api/cnpj/v1/".length());
                CONSULTAS.add(cnpj);
                int status;
                String body;
                if (cnpj.startsWith("98")) {
                    status = 404;
                    body = "{\"message\":\"CNPJ " + cnpj + " nÃ£o encontrado.\"}";
                } else if (cnpj.startsWith("97")) {
                    status = 500;
                    body = "{\"message\":\"erro\"}";
                } else {
                    status = 200;
                    String situacao = cnpj.startsWith("99") ? "BAIXADA" : "ATIVA";
                    boolean mei = cnpj.startsWith("96");
                    body = """
                            {"cnpj":"%s","razao_social":"EMPRESA TESTE %s LTDA","nome_fantasia":"%s",
                             "descricao_situacao_cadastral":"%s","opcao_pelo_mei":%s,
                             "cnae_fiscal_descricao":"Transporte rodoviÃ¡rio de carga","municipio":"SAO PAULO","uf":"SP"}
                            """.formatted(cnpj, cnpj.substring(0, 4), mei ? "" : "Loja Teste " + cnpj.substring(0, 4),
                            situacao, mei);
                }
                byte[] bytes = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Content-Type", "application/json");
                exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
                try (OutputStream os = exchange.getResponseBody()) {
                    os.write(bytes);
                }
            });
            server.start();
        }
        return "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort();
    }

    /** CNPJ vÃ¡lido e aleatÃ³rio comeÃ§ando com {@code prefixo} (2 dÃ­gitos). */
    public static String cnpj(String prefixo) {
        StringBuilder base = new StringBuilder(prefixo);
        while (base.length() < 8) base.append(ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(10));
        base.append("0001");
        int[] w1 = {5, 4, 3, 2, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2};
        int[] w2 = {6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2};
        base.append(dv(base.toString(), w1));
        base.append(dv(base.toString(), w2));
        return base.toString();
    }

    private static int dv(String d, int[] w) {
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < w.length; i++) sum += (d.charAt(i) - '0') * w[i];
        int r = sum % 11;
        return r < 2 ? 0 : 11 - r;
    }
}

package com.raiji.it;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

/**
 * Infosimples FALSA para os testes de integraÃ§Ã£o (servidor HTTP local).
 * Configurada para TODOS os testes em {@link RaijiTestSupport}: nenhum teste
 * chama a API de verdade (sem custo, sem token real, sem gastar o limite do gov.br).
 *
 * <p>O cenÃ¡rio Ã© escolhido pelo cÃ³digo de seguranÃ§a enviado:
 * <pre>
 * 11111111111  CNH vÃ¡lida (categoria B, vence em 3 anos)  -> APPROVED
 * 22222222222  612: CNH nÃ£o encontrada no SENATRAN       -> REJECTED
 * 33333333333  situaÃ§Ã£o "suspensa"                        -> REJECTED
 * 44444444444  615: fonte indisponÃ­vel                    -> ERROR
 * 55555555555  nome no SENATRAN diferente da conta        -> REJECTED
 * </pre>
 * Imagem com o conteÃºdo "ILEGIVEL" -> OCR 611 (nÃ£o deu para ler).
 * O nome devolvido ("USUARIO TESTE DA SILVA") bate com o dos usuÃ¡rios de teste ("Usuario Teste").
 */
public final class FakeInfosimples {

    public static final String TOKEN = "token-falso-de-teste";
    public static final String CNH_VALIDA = "11111111111";
    public static final String CNH_NAO_ENCONTRADA = "22222222222";
    public static final String CNH_SUSPENSA = "33333333333";
    public static final String FONTE_INDISPONIVEL = "44444444444";
    public static final String NOME_DIFERENTE = "55555555555";

    /** Chamadas recebidas (caminho + parÃ¢metros), para os testes conferirem */
    public static final List<Map<String, String>> CALLS = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

    private static HttpServer server;

    private FakeInfosimples() {
    }

    public static synchronized String start() {
        if (server == null) {
            try {
                server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(e);
            }
            server.createContext("/", exchange -> {
                Map<String, String> form = parse(new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
                Map<String, String> call = new HashMap<>(form);
                call.put("_path", path);
                call.remove("image_base64");
                CALLS.add(call);

                String body = TOKEN.equals(form.get("token"))
                        ? (path.endsWith("/ocr/cnh") ? ocr(form) : validar(form))
                        : "{\"code\":601,\"code_message\":\"token invÃ¡lido\",\"data\":[],\"errors\":[]}";
                byte[] out = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Content-Type", "application/json");
                exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, out.length);
                try (OutputStream os = exchange.getResponseBody()) {
                    os.write(out);
                }
            });
            server.start();
        }
        return "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort();
    }

    private static String ocr(Map<String, String> form) {
        String image = new String(Base64.getDecoder().decode(form.getOrDefault("image_base64", "")), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (image.contains("ILEGIVEL")) {
            return "{\"code\":611,\"code_message\":\"dados incompletos\",\"header\":{\"billable\":true},\"data\":[],\"errors\":[]}";
        }
        return """
                {"code":200,"code_message":"ok","header":{"billable":true},"data":[{"tipo":"cnh_frente","campos":{
                  "nome":{"valor":"USUARIO TESTE DA SILVA","score":0.95},
                  "cpf":{"valor":"123.456.789-09","score":0.95},
                  "registro":{"valor":"01234567890","score":0.95},
                  "categoria":{"valor":"B","score":0.9}}}],"errors":[]}""";
    }

    private static String validar(Map<String, String> form) {
        String codigo = form.getOrDefault("codigo_seguranca", "");
        String validade = LocalDate.now().plusYears(3).format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy"));
        return switch (codigo) {
            case CNH_NAO_ENCONTRADA -> erro(612, true);
            case FONTE_INDISPONIVEL -> erro(615, false);
            case CNH_SUSPENSA -> cnh("suspensa", validade, "USUARIO TESTE DA SILVA");
            case NOME_DIFERENTE -> cnh("vÃ¡lida", validade, "FULANO DE TAL");
            default -> cnh("vÃ¡lida", validade, "USUARIO TESTE DA SILVA");
        };
    }

    private static String cnh(String situacao, String validade, String nome) {
        return """
                {"code":200,"code_message":"ok","header":{"billable":true},"data":[{
                  "categoria":"B","situacao":"%s","validade_data":"%s","nome":"%s",
                  "nome_condutor_identico_ao_informado":true}],"errors":[]}""".formatted(situacao, validade, nome);
    }

    private static String erro(int code, boolean billable) {
        return "{\"code\":%d,\"code_message\":\"erro simulado\",\"header\":{\"billable\":%s},\"data\":[],\"errors\":[]}"
                .formatted(code, billable);
    }

    private static Map<String, String> parse(String body) {
        Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
        for (String pair : body.split("&")) {
            if (pair.isEmpty()) continue;
            String[] kv = pair.split("=", 2);
            map.put(URLDecoder.decode(kv[0], StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                    kv.length > 1 ? URLDecoder.decode(kv[1], StandardCharsets.UTF_8) : "");
        }
        return map;
    }
}

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import io.restassured.response.ValidatableResponse;

/** Apoio dos testes de fluxo (caronas com mapa, encomendas, empresas, frete). */
abstract class FluxoTestSupport extends RaijiTestSupport {

    static final ZoneId BRASIL = ZoneId.of("America/Sao_Paulo");
    static final DateTimeFormatter ISO = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    // PraÃ§a da SÃ© (SP) -> JundiaÃ­ -> Campinas
    static final double[] SE = {-23.5503, -46.6340};
    static final double[] JUNDIAI = {-23.1857, -46.8978};
    static final double[] CAMPINAS = {-22.9056, -47.0608};
    static final double[] RIO = {-22.9068, -43.1729};

    record Conta(String token, String sub, String username) {}

    record Motorista(String token, String sub, String vehicleId) {}

    Conta conta(String prefixo) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);
        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);
        return new Conta(token, userId, username);
    }

    Motorista motorista(String prefixo, int vagas, Integer porteMalasLitros) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);
        atribuirRoleRealm(userId, "DRIVER");
        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);
        Map<String, Object> v = new HashMap<>();
        v.put("plate", "F" + String.format("%06d", ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(1_000_000)));
        v.put("type", "CARRO");
        v.put("model", "Fiat Argo");
        v.put("color", "Branco");
        v.put("year", 2023);
        v.put("passengerSeats", vagas);
        if (porteMalasLitros != null) v.put("cargoVolumeLiters", porteMalasLitros);
        String vehicleId = given().auth().oauth2(token).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(v)
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles")).then().statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        return new Motorista(token, userId, vehicleId);
    }

    static LocalDateTime agora() {
        return LocalDateTime.now(BRASIL);
    }

    static Map<String, Object> lugar(double[] p, String endereco) {
        Map<String, Object> m = new HashMap<>();
        m.put("latitude", p[0]);
        m.put("longitude", p[1]);
        m.put("address", endereco);
        return m;
    }

    static List<Map<String, Object>> rotaSeJundiaiCampinas() {
        return List.of(
                Map.of("latitude", SE[0], "longitude", SE[1]),
                Map.of("latitude", JUNDIAI[0], "longitude", JUNDIAI[1]),
                Map.of("latitude", CAMPINAS[0], "longitude", CAMPINAS[1]));
    }

    /** Carona SÃ© -> Campinas (passando por JundiaÃ­). */
    Map<String, Object> carona(Motorista m, String tipo, int vagas, Double preco, LocalDateTime saida) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", m.vehicleId());
        body.put("type", tipo);
        body.put("originCity", "SÃ£o Paulo");
        body.put("originState", "SP");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Campinas");
        body.put("destinationState", "SP");
        body.put("departureDate", saida.format(ISO));
        if (preco != null) body.put("pricePerPassenger", preco);
        body.put("totalSeats", vagas);
        body.put("origin", lugar(SE, "PraÃ§a da SÃ©"));
        body.put("destination", lugar(CAMPINAS, "RodoviÃ¡ria de Campinas"));
        body.put("route", rotaSeJundiaiCampinas());
        body.put("meetingPoint", "Em frente Ã  catedral");
        return body;
    }

    ValidatableResponse publicar(Motorista m, Map<String, Object> body) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(m.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides")).then();
    }

    String publicarOk(Motorista m, Map<String, Object> body) {
        return publicar(m, body).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
    }

    ValidatableResponse pedirVaga(String token, String rideId, Map<String, Object> body) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(token).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests")).then();
    }

    static Map<String, Object> bagagem(String tipo, int c, int l, int a, double kg) {
        return Map.of("type", tipo, "quantity", 1, "lengthCm", c, "widthCm", l, "heightCm", a, "weightKg", kg);
    }

    List<Map<String, Object>> notificacoes(String token, String audience) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(token).queryParam("audience", audience)
                .when().get(app("/api/notifications")).then().statusCode(200).extract().jsonPath().getList("$");
    }

    static boolean temKind(List<Map<String, Object>> lista, String kind) {
        return lista.stream().anyMatch(n -> kind.equals(n.get("kind")));
    }
}

===== ./raiji-app/src/test/java/com/raiji/it/InMemoryCnhImageStorage.java =====
package com.raiji.it;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

import com.raiji.users.driververification.CnhImageStorage;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Primary;

/** Armazenamento da foto da CNH em memÃ³ria para os testes (sem S3/RustFS). */
public class InMemoryCnhImageStorage implements CnhImageStorage {

    public static final Map<String, byte[]> FILES = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    @Override
    public void put(String key, byte[] content, String contentType) {
        FILES.put(key, content);
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] get(String key) {
        byte[] content = FILES.get(key);
        if (content == null) throw new IllegalStateException("arquivo nÃ£o encontrado: " + key);
        return content;
    }

    @Override
    public void delete(String key) {
        FILES.remove(key);
    }

    @TestConfiguration
    public static class Config {
        @Bean
        @Primary
        CnhImageStorage inMemoryCnhImageStorage() {
            return new InMemoryCnhImageStorage();
        }
    }
}

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;

import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.hasItem;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.is;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.notNullValue;

@DisplayName("Teste E2E (Â§6.1) â€” jornada completa do usuÃ¡rio")
class JornadaCompletaE2EIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-023: cadastro â†’ login â†’ identidade â†’ 1Âº acesso â†’ perfil â†’ role no token")
    void jornadaCompleta() {
        String usuario = "e2e-" + System.currentTimeMillis();

        passo(1, "cadastro do usuÃ¡rio (Admin REST, HTTP 201)");
        criarUsuario(usuario);

        passo(2, "login (password grant) â†’ access_token");
        String token = obterToken(usuario, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        passo(3, "GET /api/me â†’ identidade do usuÃ¡rio autenticado");
        given().auth().oauth2(token).when().get(app("/api/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("sub", notNullValue())
                .body("email", equalTo(usuario + "@raiji.com"));

        passo(4, "GET /api/users/me â†’ 1Âº acesso, perfil ainda nÃ£o configurado (RN20)");
        given().auth().oauth2(token).when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("profileConfigured", is(false));

        passo(5, "POST /api/users/me/profile â†’ PASSENGER + PF (RN01/RF34)");

                .body("{\"role\":\"PASSENGER\",\"userType\":\"PF\"}")

                .body("passenger", is(true))

                .body("realmRoles", hasItem("PF"));
    }

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import dasniko.testcontainers.keycloak.KeycloakContainer;
import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import io.restassured.common.mapper.TypeRef;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.server.LocalServerPort;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.testcontainers.containers.PostgreSQLContainer;
import org.testcontainers.utility.DockerImageName;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
@Import(InMemoryCnhImageStorage.Config.class)
public abstract class RaijiTestSupport {

    protected static final String REALM = "raiji";
    protected static final String CLIENTE_API = "raiji-api";
    protected static final String USUARIO_TESTE = "teste";
    protected static final String SENHA_TESTE = "teste123";
    protected static final String SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS = "Raiji@It123";

    // Mesma imagem do postgres/Dockerfile.postgres: a migration V13 exige PostGIS
    static final PostgreSQLContainer<?> POSTGRES =
            new PostgreSQLContainer<>(DockerImageName.parse("postgis/postgis:17-3.6-alpine")
                    .asCompatibleSubstituteFor("postgres"))
                    .withDatabaseName("raiji_app")
                    .withUsername("raiji")
                    .withPassword("raiji123");

    // VERSÃƒO ATUALIZADA PARA 26.0 (Alinhada com docker-compose.yml e Dockerfile.keycloak)
    static final KeycloakContainer KEYCLOAK =
            new KeycloakContainer("quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0.5")
                    .withAdminUsername("admin")
                    .withAdminPassword("admin")
                    .withEnv("KEYCLOAK_ADMIN", "admin")
                    .withEnv("KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin")
                    .withEnv("KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
                    .withEnv("KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin")
                    .withFeaturesDisabled("organization") 
                    .withRealmImportFile("raiji-realm.json");

    // O bloco static garante que os containers subam e tenham suas portas mapeadas
    // ANTES de qualquer contexto do Spring Boot tentar ler as propriedades dinÃ¢micas.
    static {
        POSTGRES.start();
        KEYCLOAK.start();
    }

    @LocalServerPort
    protected int porta;

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void registrarPropriedades(DynamicPropertyRegistry registro) {
        // NÃ£o Ã© mais necessÃ¡rio chamar .start() aqui, pois o bloco static jÃ¡ cuidou disso.
        registro.add("spring.datasource.url", POSTGRES::getJdbcUrl);
        registro.add("spring.datasource.username", POSTGRES::getUsername);
        registro.add("spring.datasource.password", POSTGRES::getPassword);

    protected String app(String caminho) { return "http://localhost:" + porta + caminho; }
    protected static String kc(String caminho) { return KEYCLOAK.getAuthServerUrl() + caminho; }
    protected static String urlToken() { return kc("/realms/" + REALM + "/protocol/openid-connect/token"); }
    protected static String urlAdmin() { return kc("/admin/realms/" + REALM); }

    protected static String obterToken(String usuario, String senha) {
        return given()
                .contentType(ContentType.URLENC)
                .formParam("grant_type", "password")
                .formParam("client_id", CLIENTE_API)
                .formParam("username", usuario)
                .formParam("password", senha)
                .when().post(urlToken())
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("access_token");
    }

    protected static String tokenAdmin() {
        return given()
                .contentType(ContentType.URLENC)
                .formParam("grant_type", "password")
                .formParam("client_id", "admin-cli")
                .formParam("username", KEYCLOAK.getAdminUsername())
                .formParam("password", KEYCLOAK.getAdminPassword())
                .when().post(kc("/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("access_token");
    }

    protected static String criarUsuario(String username) {
        String admin = tokenAdmin();

        String location = given()
                .auth().oauth2(admin)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "username", username,
                        "enabled", true,
                        "email", username + "@raiji.com",
                        "emailVerified", true,
                        "firstName", "Usuario",
                        "lastName", "Teste"))
                .when().post(urlAdmin() + "/users")
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().header("Location");

        String userId = location.substring(location.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);

        given()
                .auth().oauth2(admin)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("type", "password", "value", SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS, "temporary", false))
                .when().put(urlAdmin() + "/users/" + userId + "/reset-password")
                .then().statusCode(204);

        return userId;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    protected static void atribuirRoleRealm(String userId, String role) {
        String admin = tokenAdmin();

        Map<String, Object> roleRep = given()
                .auth().oauth2(admin)
                .when().get(urlAdmin() + "/roles/" + role)
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().as(Map.class);

        given()
                .auth().oauth2(admin)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(List.of(roleRep))
                .when().post(urlAdmin() + "/users/" + userId + "/role-mappings/realm")
                .then().statusCode(204);
    }

    private static void habilitarServiceAccountAdmin() {
        String admin = tokenAdmin();

        given().contentType(ContentType.URLENC)
                .formParam("grant_type", "client_credentials")
                .formParam("client_id", "raiji-admin")
                .formParam("client_secret", "raiji-admin-secret")
                .when().post(urlToken())
                .then().statusCode(200);

        String serviceAccountId = given().auth().oauth2(admin)
                .queryParam("username", "service-account-raiji-admin")
                .queryParam("exact", true)
                .when().get(urlAdmin() + "/users")
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("[0].id");

        String realmManagementId = given().auth().oauth2(admin)
                .queryParam("clientId", "realm-management")
                .when().get(urlAdmin() + "/clients")
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("[0].id");

        List<Map<String, Object>> roles = given().auth().oauth2(admin)
                .when().get(urlAdmin() + "/clients/" + realmManagementId + "/roles")
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().as(new TypeRef<>() {});

        List<Map<String, Object>> desejadas = roles.stream()
                .filter(r -> List.of("manage-users", "view-users", "query-users")
                        .contains(r.get("name")))
                .toList();

        given().auth().oauth2(admin)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(desejadas)
                .when().post(urlAdmin() + "/users/" + serviceAccountId
                        + "/role-mappings/clients/" + realmManagementId)
                .then().statusCode(204);
    }

    protected static String adulterarAssinatura(String token) {
        char[] caracteres = token.toCharArray();
        int i = caracteres.length - 3;
        caracteres[i] = (caracteres[i] == 'X') ? 'Y' : 'X';
        return new String(caracteres);
    }
}

/**

 *   â†’ passageiro cancela â†’ vaga liberada.

 *   <li><b>Fluxo feliz</b> (CT-E2E-01): cadastro do motorista e do passageiro,
 *       perfil DRIVER + veÃ­culo, publicaÃ§Ã£o de carona paga, busca, solicitaÃ§Ã£o

 *       carona lotada â†’ 409 (CT-E2E-03); cancelamento apÃ³s o inÃ­cio da

 * Nenhum {@code Thread.sleep}: esperas com <b>Awaitility</b> sobre chamadas
 * reais de API. O Stripe Ã© substituÃ­do por um gateway FAKE (@Primary), como
 * em {@code StripeRefundApiIT} â€” determinÃ­stico e sem rede.
 */
@DisplayName("S2-07 â€” Testes E2E do fluxo de reservas")
@TestPropertySource(properties = {
        // Stripe "configurado" para o fake ser acionado; nenhuma chamada real ocorre
        "raiji.stripe.api-key=sk_test_E2E_FAKE_KEY"

@Import(ReservaE2EIT.FakeStripeConfig.class)
class ReservaE2EIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private FakeStripeGateway stripeGateway;

    @Autowired
    private RideStatusScheduler scheduler;

    // ===== gateway Stripe FAKE (registrÃ¡vel e determinÃ­stico) =====

    @TestConfiguration
    static class FakeStripeConfig {
        @Bean
        @Primary
        FakeStripeGateway fakeStripeGateway() {
            return new FakeStripeGateway();
        }
    }

    static class FakeStripeGateway implements StripeRefundGateway {
        final List<String> calls = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

        @Override
        public String createRefund(String paymentIntentId, long amountCents) {
            calls.add(paymentIntentId + ":" + amountCents);
            return "re_E2E_" + paymentIntentId;
        }
    }

    @BeforeEach
    void limparGateway() {
        stripeGateway.calls.clear();
    }

    // ===== fixtures (jornada REAL: cadastro â†’ perfil â†’ role no token) =====

    private record Usuario(String username, String token, String sub) {}

    private record Motorista(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    /**
     * Cadastra o usuÃ¡rio no Keycloak, define o perfil via API (RN01/RF34 â€”
     * sincroniza a role no realm) e refaz o login para o token jÃ¡ sair com a
     * role â€” exatamente a jornada de um usuÃ¡rio real.
     */
    private Usuario cadastrarAtor(String prefixo, String role, String userType) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();

        criarUsuario(username); // cadastro no Keycloak (Admin REST, 201)

        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        // 1Âº acesso provisiona o perfil (RN20) e define o papel (RF34)
        given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200);

        // Tipo da conta (PF/PJ); toda conta jÃ¡ Ã© passageira
        given().auth().oauth2(token).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("role", "PASSENGER", "userType", userType))
                .when().post(app("/api/users/me/profile"))
                .then().statusCode(200);

        // Motorista: como no app â€” envia a CNH e espera a aprovaÃ§Ã£o
        // (Infosimples FALSA, ver FakeInfosimples: nenhuma chamada real)
        if ("DRIVER".equals(role)) {
            given().auth().oauth2(token)
                    .multiPart("image", "cnh.png", "foto".getBytes(), "image/png")
                    .multiPart("securityCode", FakeInfosimples.CNH_VALIDA)
                    .when().post(app("/api/users/me/driver/cnh"))
                    .then().statusCode(202);
            String status = "PROCESSING";
            for (int i = 0; i < 100 && "PROCESSING".equals(status); i++) {
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(100);
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                }
                status = given().auth().oauth2(token).when().get(app("/api/users/me/driver/cnh"))
                        .then().statusCode(200).extract().path("status");
            }
            org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat(status).isEqualTo("APPROVED");
        }

        // re-login: novo token jÃ¡ carrega a role sincronizada
        String tokenComRole = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);
        String sub = given().auth().oauth2(tokenComRole)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("sub");

        return new Usuario(username, tokenComRole, sub);
    }

    private Motorista cadastrarMotorista() {
        Usuario usuario = cadastrarAtor("e2e-motorista", "DRIVER", "PF");
        String plate = "E" + String.format("%06d",
                Long.valueOf(System.nanoTime() % 1_000_000L).intValue());
        String vehicleId = given().auth().oauth2(usuario.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "plate", plate, "type", "CARRO", "model", "Chevrolet Onix",
                        "color", "Prata", "year", 2024, "passengerSeats", 4,
                        "cargoVolumeLiters", 400))
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
        return new Motorista(usuario.token(), UUID.fromString(vehicleId), usuario.sub());
    }

    private Usuario cadastrarPassageiro() {
        return cadastrarAtor("e2e-passageiro", "PASSENGER", "PF");
    }

    /** Publica carona paga (price != null) ou gratuita (price == null). */
    private String publicarCarona(Motorista motorista, int totalSeats, String price) {
        // cidades Ãºnicas por execuÃ§Ã£o: a busca por origem/destino fica determinÃ­stica
        String sufixo = Long.toString(System.nanoTime(), 36);
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", motorista.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", "Fortaleza-" + sufixo);
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral-" + sufixo);
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now().plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", totalSeats);
        if (price != null) {
            body.put("pricePerPassenger", price);
        }
        return given().auth().oauth2(motorista.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .body("status", equalTo("PLANNED"))
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> itemBagagem(String tipo, int quantidade) {
        Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
        item.put("type", tipo);
        item.put("quantity", quantidade);
        item.put("lengthCm", 60);
        item.put("widthCm", 40);
        item.put("heightCm", 30);
        item.put("weightKg", 15.5);
        item.put("description", "Mala de bordo");
        return item;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> payloadSolicitacao(String nome) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("passengerName", nome);
        payload.put("baggage", List.of(
                itemBagagem("mala", 1),
                itemBagagem("mochila", 1)));
        return payload;
    }

    private String solicitarVaga(String tokenPassageiro, String rideId, String nome) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(tokenPassageiro)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(payloadSolicitacao(nome))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .body("status", equalTo("PENDING"))
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> solicitacoesDoMotorista(String token, String rideId) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().jsonPath().getList("");
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<Map<String, Object>> buscarCaronas(String token, String origem, Integer minSeats) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .queryParam("originCity", origem)
                .queryParam("minSeats", minSeats)
                .when().get(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().jsonPath().getList("content");
    }

    private String origemDaCarona(String rideId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT origin_city FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                String.class, rideId);
    }

    private String statusDaReserva(String requestId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT status FROM ride_passengers WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                String.class, requestId);
    }

    private Integer vagasDisponiveis(String rideId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT available_seats FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> auditoriaDaReserva(String requestId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForList(
                "SELECT action, details FROM audit_log "
                        + "WHERE entity_type = 'RIDE_PASSENGER' "
                        + "AND entity_id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                requestId);
    }

    private int contarNotificacoes(String sub, String rideId, String trecho) {
        Integer total = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications "
                        + "WHERE recipient_sub = ? AND ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid) "
                        + "AND message LIKE ?",
                Integer.class, sub, rideId, "%" + trecho + "%");
        return total == null ? 0 : total;
    }

    // =====================================================================
    // CT-E2E-01 Â· FLUXO FELIZ

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-E2E-01: motorista publica carona paga â†’ passageiro solicita com bagagem â†’ "
            + "motorista aceita â†’ passageiro cancela â†’ vaga liberada")
    void fluxoFelizReservaPontaAPonta() {
        passo(1, "cadastro do motorista e do passageiro no Keycloak");
        Motorista motorista = cadastrarMotorista();
        Usuario passageiro = cadastrarPassageiro();

        passo(2, "motorista cria o veÃ­culo da carona");
        UUID vehicleId = motorista.vehicleId();
        assertTrue(vehicleId != null && motorista.sub() != null,
                "motorista com veÃ­culo criado (201) e sub resolvido");

        passo(3, "motorista publica carona PAGA (R$ 50,00, 3 vagas)");
        String rideId = publicarCarona(motorista, 3, "50.00");

        passo(4, "passageiro BUSCA a carona publicada (busca pÃºblica autenticada)");
        String origem = origemDaCarona(rideId);
        List<Map<String, Object>> encontradas = await("carona aparece na busca")
                .atMost(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
                .pollInterval(Duration.ofMillis(300))
                .until(() -> buscarCaronas(passageiro.token(), origem, 3),
                        conteudo -> conteudo.stream()
                                .anyMatch(c -> rideId.equals(String.valueOf(c.get("id")))));
        Map<String, Object> carona = encontradas.stream()
                .filter(c -> rideId.equals(String.valueOf(c.get("id"))))
                .findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(0, new BigDecimal(String.valueOf(carona.get("pricePerPassenger")))
                .compareTo(new BigDecimal("50.00")),
                "carona paga com o preÃ§o publicado");
        assertEquals(3, ((Number) carona.get("availableSeats")).intValue(),
                "3 vagas disponÃ­veis na publicaÃ§Ã£o");

        passo(5, "passageiro SOLICITA vaga declarando a bagagem (S2-01/RF18)");
        String requestId = given().auth().oauth2(passageiro.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao("Ana Souza"))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .body("status", equalTo("PENDING"))
                .body("baggage[0].type", equalTo("mala"))
                .body("baggage[0].weightKg", equalTo(15.5f))
                .body("baggage[1].type", equalTo("mochila"))
                .extract().path("id");

        // motorista Ã© notificado da nova solicitaÃ§Ã£o (S1-06)
        assertEquals(1, contarNotificacoes(motorista.sub(), rideId, "Nova solicitaÃ§Ã£o"),
                "motorista notificado da solicitaÃ§Ã£o");

        passo(6, "motorista VISUALIZA a bagagem e ACEITA (S2-02), informando paymentIntentId");
        List<Map<String, Object>> paraDecidir = solicitacoesDoMotorista(motorista.token(), rideId);
        assertEquals(1, paraDecidir.size(), "motorista vÃª a solicitaÃ§Ã£o pendente");
        assertEquals("Ana Souza", paraDecidir.get(0).get("passengerName"));
        assertFalse(((List<?>) paraDecidir.get(0).get("baggage")).isEmpty(),
                "bagagem declarada visÃ­vel ANTES do aceite");

        given().auth().oauth2(motorista.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT", "paymentIntentId", "pi_E2E_feliz"))
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"))
                .body("confirmedAt", notNullValue());

        // vaga reservada: 3 â†’ 2
        await("vaga reservada refletida na busca")
                .atMost(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
                .pollInterval(Duration.ofMillis(300))
                .untilAsserted(() ->
                        assertTrue(buscarCaronas(passageiro.token(), origem, 2).stream()
                                        .anyMatch(c -> rideId.equals(String.valueOf(c.get("id")))),
                                "carona ainda aparece com 2 vagas"));
        assertEquals(2, vagasDisponiveis(rideId), "aceite decrementou availableSeats");

        // passageiro Ã© notificado do aceite (S2-02/RF19)
        assertEquals(1, contarNotificacoes(passageiro.sub(), rideId, "ACEITA"),
                "passageiro notificado do aceite");

        passo(7, "passageiro CANCELA a reserva (S2-04) â€” estorno do pago deve ocorrer");
        given().auth().oauth2(passageiro.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("reason", "Imprevisto pessoal"))
                .when().delete(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"))
                .body("seatReleased", equalTo(true))
                .body("cancellationReason", equalTo("Imprevisto pessoal"))
                .body("cancelledAt", notNullValue());

        assertEquals(List.of("pi_E2E_feliz:5000"), stripeGateway.calls,
                "estorno chamou o Stripe com 50.00 => 5000 centavos");

        List<Map<String, Object>> auditoria = auditoriaDaReserva(requestId);
        assertEquals(1, auditoria.size(), "um registro de auditoria do estorno");
        assertEquals("ESTORNO_SUCESSO", auditoria.get(0).get("action"));
        assertTrue(String.valueOf(auditoria.get(0).get("details")).contains("re_E2E_pi_E2E_feliz"),
                "auditoria contÃ©m o id do refund");

        passo(8, "vaga LIBERADA: busca volta a exibir 3 vagas e reserva segue CANCELLED");
        await("vaga liberada refletida na busca")
                .atMost(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
                .pollInterval(Duration.ofMillis(300))
                .untilAsserted(() ->
                        assertTrue(buscarCaronas(passageiro.token(), origem, 3).stream()
                                        .anyMatch(c -> rideId.equals(String.valueOf(c.get("id")))),
                                "carona volta a aparecer com 3 vagas"));
        assertEquals(3, vagasDisponiveis(rideId), "availableSeats restaurado");
        assertEquals("CANCELLED", statusDaReserva(requestId),
                "reserva permanece CANCELLED");
        assertEquals(1, contarNotificacoes(motorista.sub(), rideId, "CANCELADA"),
                "motorista notificado do cancelamento com vaga liberada");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-E2E-03: ACCEPT sem vaga disponÃ­vel retorna 409 e mantÃ©m a reserva PENDING")
    void aceiteEmCaronaLotadaRetorna409() {
        Motorista motorista = cadastrarMotorista();
        Usuario p1 = cadastrarPassageiro();
        Usuario p2 = cadastrarPassageiro();
        String rideId = publicarCarona(motorista, 2, "30.00");
        String origem = origemDaCarona(rideId);

        String req1 = solicitarVaga(p1.token(), rideId, "Primeiro Passageiro");
        String req2 = solicitarVaga(p2.token(), rideId, "Segundo Passageiro");

        given().auth().oauth2(motorista.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT"))
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + req1))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"));

        assertEquals(1, vagasDisponiveis(rideId),
                "primeiro aceite consumiu uma das duas vagas");

        // Simula a ÃšLTIMA vaga sendo ocupada entre as decisÃµes (mesma tÃ©cnica do
        // CapacityLockApiIT) â€” o aceite seguinte deve esbarrar na trava de assentos.
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET available_seats = 0 WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                rideId);

        // vaga esgotada: o segundo aceite NÃƒO pode confirmar (RN03)
        given().auth().oauth2(motorista.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT"))
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + req2))
                .then().statusCode(409);

        assertEquals("PENDING", statusDaReserva(req2),
                "segunda reserva permanece PENDING");
        assertEquals(0, vagasDisponiveis(rideId), "vaga Ãºnica consumida");

        await("carona lotada some da busca (availableSeats > 0 Ã© regra fixa)")
                .atMost(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
                .pollInterval(Duration.ofMillis(300))
                .untilAsserted(() ->
                        assertTrue(buscarCaronas(p1.token(), origem, 1).stream()
                                        .noneMatch(c -> rideId.equals(String.valueOf(c.get("id")))),
                                "carona sem vagas nÃ£o aparece na busca"));
    }

    // =====================================================================
    // CT-E2E-04 Â· ERRO: cancelamento apÃ³s o inÃ­cio da viagem â†’ 409 (RN06)
