    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-E2E-04: cancelamento APÃ“S o inÃ­cio da viagem (departure passada + "
            + "scheduler) retorna 409 e a vaga NÃƒO Ã© liberada")
    void cancelamentoAposInicioRetorna409() {
        Motorista motorista = cadastrarMotorista();
        Usuario passageiro = cadastrarPassageiro();
        String rideId = publicarCarona(motorista, 3, "40.00");
        String origem = origemDaCarona(rideId);

        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passageiro.token(), rideId, "Bruno Costa");
        given().auth().oauth2(motorista.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT", "paymentIntentId", "pi_E2E_tarde"))
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"));

        // "avanÃ§a o relÃ³gio": partida passa a estar no passado e o job da S2-06
        // promove a carona PLANNED -> IN_PROGRESS (mesma tÃ©cnica do
        // RideStatusSchedulerIT, sem Thread.sleep)
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET departure_date = ? WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                LocalDateTime.now().minusMinutes(2), rideId);
        scheduler.promoteDueRides();

        // a viagem em curso SAI da busca (regra fixa: somente PLANNED Ã© listada)
        await("carona em andamento sai da busca")
                .atMost(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
                .pollInterval(Duration.ofMillis(300))
                .untilAsserted(() ->
                        assertTrue(buscarCaronas(passageiro.token(), origem, 1).stream()
                                        .noneMatch(c -> rideId.equals(String.valueOf(c.get("id")))),
                                "carona iniciada nÃ£o Ã© mais listada"));

        // passageiro tenta cancelar DEPOIS do inÃ­cio â†’ 409
        given().auth().oauth2(passageiro.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("reason", "SÃ³ lembrando depois do horÃ¡rio"))
                .when().delete(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(409);

        assertEquals("CONFIRMED", statusDaReserva(requestId),
                "reserva segue CONFIRMED apÃ³s o inÃ­cio");
        assertEquals(2, vagasDisponiveis(rideId),
                "vaga NÃƒO Ã© liberada apÃ³s o inÃ­cio da viagem");
        assertTrue(stripeGateway.calls.isEmpty(),
                "nenhum estorno: o cancelamento foi recusado");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-E2E-05: cancelamento de reserva em carona GRATUITA nÃ£o chama o Stripe")
    void estornoEmCaronaGratuitaNaoChamaStripe() {
        Motorista motorista = cadastrarMotorista();
        Usuario passageiro = cadastrarPassageiro();
        String rideId = publicarCarona(motorista, 3, null); // gratuita

        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passageiro.token(), rideId, "Carla Dias");
        given().auth().oauth2(motorista.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT")) // sem paymentIntentId
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"));

        given().auth().oauth2(passageiro.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of("reason", "Mudei de planos"))
                .when().delete(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"))
                .body("seatReleased", equalTo(true));

        assertTrue(stripeGateway.calls.isEmpty(),
                "carona gratuita NÃƒO pode chamar o Stripe");
        assertTrue(auditoriaDaReserva(requestId).isEmpty(),
                "sem registro de estorno na auditoria");
        assertEquals(3, vagasDisponiveis(rideId), "vaga liberada normalmente");
    }

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.notNullValue;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.nullValue;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

@DisplayName("Testes de API (Â§5) â€” publicaÃ§Ã£o de caronas (RF03 / RN02, RN03, RN08, RN10)")
class RideApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId) {}

    private DriverSetup criarMotoristaComVeiculo(int seats) {
        String usuario = "ride-it-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(usuario);
        atribuirRoleRealm(userId, "DRIVER");
        String token = obterToken(usuario, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        String placa = "R" + String.format("%06d", ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000));

        String vehicleIdStr = given().auth().oauth2(token).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "plate", placa,
                        "type", "CARRO",
                        "model", "Toyota Corolla",
                        "color", "Prata",
                        "year", 2024,
                        "passengerSeats", seats,
                        "cargoVolumeLiters", 400))
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");

        return new DriverSetup(token, UUID.fromString(vehicleIdStr));
    }

    private Map<String, Object> ridePayload(UUID vehicleId, BigDecimal price) {
        Map<String, Object> m = new HashMap<>();
        m.put("vehicleId", vehicleId.toString());
        m.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        m.put("originCity", "Fortaleza");
        m.put("originState", "ce");
        m.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");
        m.put("destinationState", "ce");
        m.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now().plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        if (price != null) m.put("pricePerPassenger", price);
        m.put("totalSeats", 2);
        return m;
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-030: POST /api/rides carona paga â†’ 201 + PLANNED + availableSeats = totalSeats")
    void ct030_caronaPaga() {
        DriverSetup ds = criarMotoristaComVeiculo(4);

        given().auth().oauth2(ds.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(ridePayload(ds.vehicleId(), new BigDecimal("50.00")))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .body("id", notNullValue())
                .body("status", equalTo("PLANNED"))
                .body("availableSeats", equalTo(2))
                .body("totalSeats", equalTo(2))
                .body("pricePerPassenger", notNullValue())
                .body("originState", equalTo("CE"))
                .body("destinationState", equalTo("CE"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-034 (RN03): totalSeats > assentos do veÃ­culo â†’ 400")

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.notNullValue;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import io.restassured.response.Response;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

/**
 * S2-04 / RF09 + RN06 â€” cancelamento de reserva e liberaÃ§Ã£o de vaga.
 *
 * <p>Cobre TODOS os critÃ©rios de aceite da issue #11:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>DELETE em reserva CONFIRMED libera a vaga na hora (availableSeats++).</li>
 *   <li>DELETE em reserva PENDING nÃ£o altera availableSeats.</li>
 *   <li>Reserva muda para CANCELLED com cancellationReason e data (cancelled_at).</li>
 *   <li>Motorista Ã© notificado.</li>
 *   <li>Cancelamento apÃ³s inÃ­cio da viagem (status != PLANNED) retorna 409.</li>
 *   <li>Passageiro tentando cancelar reserva de outro retorna 403.</li>
 *   <li>Reserva jÃ¡ cancelada retorna 409.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
@DisplayName("Testes de integraÃ§Ã£o â€” cancelamento de reserva e liberaÃ§Ã£o de vaga (S2-04/RF09)")
class RideCancelApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO =
            DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    private record UserSetup(String token, String sub) {}

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    // ===== fixtures (mesmo padrÃ£o de RideDecisionApiIT) =====

    private UserSetup criarUsuarioComRole(String prefixo, String role) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);

        if (role != null) {
            atribuirRoleRealm(userId, role);
        }

        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        String sub = given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("sub");

        return new UserSetup(token, sub);
    }

    private DriverSetup criarMotorista() {
        UserSetup user = criarUsuarioComRole("cancel-driver", "DRIVER");

        String plate = "C" + String.format(
                "%06d",
                ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000)
        );

        String vehicleId = given()
                .auth().oauth2(user.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "plate", plate,
                        "type", "CARRO",
                        "model", "Toyota Corolla",
                        "color", "Prata",
                        "year", 2024,
                        "passengerSeats", 4,
                        "cargoVolumeLiters", 400
                ))
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");

        return new DriverSetup(
                user.token(),
                UUID.fromString(vehicleId),
                user.sub()
        );
    }

    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver, int totalSeats) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", driver.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", "Fortaleza");
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now()
                .plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", totalSeats);

        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private UserSetup criarPassageiro() {
        return criarUsuarioComRole("cancel-passenger", "PASSENGER");
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> itemBagagem() {
        Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
        item.put("type", "mala");
        item.put("quantity", 1);
        item.put("lengthCm", 60);
        item.put("widthCm", 40);
        item.put("heightCm", 30);
        item.put("description", "Mala de bordo");
        return item;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> payloadSolicitacao(String nome) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("passengerName", nome);
        payload.put("baggage", List.of(itemBagagem()));
        return payload;
    }

    private String solicitarVaga(String token, String rideId, String nome) {
        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao(nome))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    /** Motorista aceita a solicitaÃ§Ã£o (ACCEPT) => CONFIRMED + availableSeats--. */
    private void aceitar(String driverToken, String rideId, String requestId) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("decision", "ACCEPT");
        given()
                .auth().oauth2(driverToken)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payload)
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId
                        + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"));
    }

    private Response cancelar(String token, String rideId, String requestId,
                              String reason) {
        var spec = given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON);
        if (reason != null) {
            spec = spec.body(Map.of("reason", reason));
        }
        return spec.when().delete(app("/api/rides/" + rideId
                + "/requests/" + requestId));
    }

    // ===== helpers de banco =====

    private int vagasDisponiveis(String rideId) {
        Integer vagas = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT available_seats FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        return vagas == null ? -1 : vagas;
    }

    private Map<String, Object> solicitacaoNoBanco(String requestId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForMap(
                "SELECT status, confirmed_at, cancellation_reason, cancelled_at "
                        + "FROM ride_passengers WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                requestId);
    }

    private int notificacoesDo(String rideId, String recipientSub) {
        Integer total = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications "
                        + "WHERE ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid) AND recipient_sub = ?",
                Integer.class, rideId, recipientSub);
        return total == null ? 0 : total;
    }

    // ===== critÃ©rios de aceite (issue #11) =====

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF09: DELETE em reserva CONFIRMED libera a vaga na hora (availableSeats++)")
    void deleteEmConfirmadaLiberaVaga() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");
        aceitar(driver.token(), rideId, requestId);

        int vagasAposAccept = vagasDisponiveis(rideId);

        cancelar(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "Imprevisto pessoal")
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("id", equalTo(requestId))
                .body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"))
                .body("seatReleased", equalTo(true))
                .body("cancelledAt", notNullValue())
                .body("cancellationReason", equalTo("Imprevisto pessoal"));

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                vagasAposAccept + 1, vagasDisponiveis(rideId),
                "a vaga deve ser liberada imediatamente no cancelamento de CONFIRMED");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF09: DELETE em reserva PENDING NÃƒO altera availableSeats")
    void deleteEmPendingNaoAlteraVagas() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        int vagasAntes = vagasDisponiveis(rideId);

        cancelar(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "Desisti da viagem")
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"))
                .body("seatReleased", equalTo(false));

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                vagasAntes, vagasDisponiveis(rideId),
                "cancelar PENDING nÃ£o mexe no contador de vagas");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF09: reserva muda para CANCELLED com cancellationReason e data (cancelled_at)")
    void reservaMudaParaCancelledComReasonEData() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");
        aceitar(driver.token(), rideId, requestId);

        cancelar(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "Imprevisto pessoal")
                .then().statusCode(200);

        Map<String, Object> row = solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId);
        Assertions.assertEquals("CANCELLED", row.get("status").toString());
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "Imprevisto pessoal", row.get("cancellation_reason").toString());
        Assertions.assertNotNull(row.get("cancelled_at"),
                "a data do cancelamento deve ser persistida");
    }

    @Test

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN06: cancelamento apÃ³s inÃ­cio da viagem (status != PLANNED) retorna 409")
    void cancelamentoAposInicioRetorna409() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");
        aceitar(driver.token(), rideId, requestId);

        // simula o scheduler (S2-06): viagem iniciada
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS' WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                rideId);

        cancelar(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "tarde demais")
                .then().statusCode(409);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "CONFIRMED", solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId).get("status").toString(),
                "a reserva nÃ£o pode ser cancelada apÃ³s o inÃ­cio da viagem");
    }

                        + "/requests/" + requestId));
    }

    // ===== helpers de banco =====

    private int vagasDisponiveis(String rideId) {
        Integer vagas = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT available_seats FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        return vagas == null ? -1 : vagas;
    }

    private Map<String, Object> solicitacaoNoBanco(String requestId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForMap(
                "SELECT status, confirmed_at, cancellation_reason "
                        + "FROM ride_passengers WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                requestId);
    }

    private int notificacoesDo(String rideId, String recipientSub) {
        Integer total = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications "
                        + "WHERE ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid) AND recipient_sub = ?",
                Integer.class, rideId, recipientSub);
        return total == null ? 0 : total;
    }

    @Test

                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("id", equalTo(requestId))
                .body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"))
                .body("confirmedAt", notNullValue());

        Map<String, Object> row = solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId);
        Assertions.assertEquals("CONFIRMED", row.get("status").toString());
        Assertions.assertNotNull(row.get("confirmed_at"));
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                vagasAntes - 1, vagasDisponiveis(rideId));
    }

    @Test

    void rejectCancelaComMotivoPreservaVagasENotifica() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();

        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))

                .body("$", hasSize(1))

                .body("[0].status", equalTo("PENDING"))

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "REJECT",
                "A bagagem excede a capacidade do veÃ­culo.")
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("id", equalTo(requestId))
                .body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"))
                .body("confirmedAt", nullValue());

        Map<String, Object> row = solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId);

                "A bagagem excede a capacidade do veÃ­culo.",
                row.get("cancellation_reason").toString());
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                vagasAntes, vagasDisponiveis(rideId),
                "vagas devem permanecer intactas no REJECT");
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                1, notificacoesDo(rideId, passenger.sub()),
                "passageiro deve receber 1 notificaÃ§Ã£o de recusa");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: decision fora do enum, nula ou ausente retorna 400")
    void decisionInvalidaRetorna400() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        // valor fora do enum => erro de desserializaÃ§Ã£o => 400
        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "MAYBE", null)
                .then().statusCode(400);

        // decision explicitamente nulo => @NotNull => 400
        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, null, null)
                .then().statusCode(400);

        // decision ausente no payload => @NotNull => 400
        Map<String, Object> semDecision = new HashMap<>();
        semDecision.put("reason", "motivo qualquer");
        given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(semDecision)
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId
                        + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(400);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "PENDING", solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId).get("status").toString());
    }

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.within;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.containsString;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import io.restassured.response.ValidatableResponse;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

/**
 * IntenÃ§Ãµes de carona "na hora" contra a API real e um PostGIS de verdade
 * (os testes unitÃ¡rios usam mock do banco: as consultas geogrÃ¡ficas nÃ£o rodavam).
 */
@DisplayName("IntenÃ§Ãµes de carona (busca por proximidade, PostGIS real)")
class RideIntentApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    // PraÃ§a da SÃ© (SP) e pontos de referÃªncia
    private static final double SE_LAT = -23.5503, SE_LNG = -46.6340;
    private static final double PAULISTA_LAT = -23.5614, PAULISTA_LNG = -46.6559;   // ~2,5 km da SÃ©
    private static final double CAMPINAS_LAT = -22.9056, CAMPINAS_LNG = -47.0608;   // ~85 km

    private record Conta(String token, String sub) {}

    private Conta conta(String prefixo, boolean motorista) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);
        if (motorista) atribuirRoleRealm(userId, "DRIVER");
        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);
        String sub = given().auth().oauth2(token).when().get(app("/api/users/me")).then().extract().path("sub");
        return new Conta(token, sub);
    }

    private Map<String, Object> pedido(String tipo, String modo, double lat, double lng, OffsetDateTime desiredAt) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("type", tipo);
        body.put("mode", modo);
        body.put("originCity", "SÃ£o Paulo");
        body.put("originState", "SP");
        body.put("originLatitude", lat);
        body.put("originLongitude", lng);
        if ("ROUTE".equals(modo)) {
            body.put("destinationCity", "Campinas");
            body.put("destinationState", "SP");
            body.put("destinationLatitude", CAMPINAS_LAT);
            body.put("destinationLongitude", CAMPINAS_LNG);
        }
        if (desiredAt != null) body.put("desiredAt", desiredAt.toString());
        return body;
    }

    private ValidatableResponse criar(Conta conta, Map<String, Object> body) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(conta.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/ride-intents")).then();
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> perto(Conta quem, String tipo, String modo, double lat, double lng, double raio) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(quem.token())
                .queryParam("type", tipo).queryParam("mode", modo)
                .queryParam("latitude", lat).queryParam("longitude", lng).queryParam("radiusMeters", raio)
                .when().get(app("/api/ride-intents/nearby"))
                .then().statusCode(200).extract().jsonPath().getList("$");
    }

    private static boolean contem(List<Map<String, Object>> lista, String id) {
        return lista.stream().anyMatch(i -> id.equals(i.get("id")));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("passageira pede carona; outra pessoa a 2,5 km acha (local aproximado + distÃ¢ncia); a 85 km nÃ£o")
    void buscaPorProximidade() {
        Conta ana = conta("intent-ana", false);
        Conta bia = conta("intent-bia", false);
        String id = criar(ana, pedido("PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, null))
                .statusCode(201).extract().path("id");

        List<Map<String, Object>> achados = perto(bia, "PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", PAULISTA_LAT, PAULISTA_LNG, 5000);
        assertThat(contem(achados, id)).isTrue();
        Map<String, Object> encontrado = achados.stream().filter(i -> id.equals(i.get("id"))).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertThat(((Number) encontrado.get("originLatitude")).doubleValue()).isCloseTo(-23.55, within(1e-4));  // arredondado (~1 km)
        assertThat(((Number) encontrado.get("originLongitude")).doubleValue()).isCloseTo(-46.63, within(1e-4));
        assertThat(((Number) encontrado.get("distanceMeters")).doubleValue()).isBetween(2000.0, 3000.0);

        assertThat(contem(perto(bia, "PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", CAMPINAS_LAT, CAMPINAS_LNG, 5000), id)).isFalse();
        assertThat(contem(perto(ana, "PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, 5000), id))
                .as("a prÃ³pria intenÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o aparece na busca").isFalse();

        // Nas PRÃ“PRIAS intenÃ§Ãµes o local Ã© exato
        List<Map<String, Object>> minhas = given().auth().oauth2(ana.token()).when().get(app("/api/ride-intents/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200).extract().jsonPath().getList("$");
        Map<String, Object> minha = minhas.stream().filter(i -> id.equals(i.get("id"))).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertThat(((Number) minha.get("originLatitude")).doubleValue()).isCloseTo(SE_LAT, within(1e-4));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("correÃ§Ã£o: intenÃ§Ã£o cujo horÃ¡rio desejado jÃ¡ passou continua na busca enquanto nÃ£o expira")
    void horarioPassadoAindaAtivo() throws InterruptedException {
        Conta ana = conta("intent-horario", false);
        Conta bia = conta("intent-busca", false);
        String id = criar(ana, pedido("PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, OffsetDateTime.now().plusSeconds(2)))
                .statusCode(201).extract().path("id");

        Thread.sleep(3000); // o horÃ¡rio desejado passou; a intenÃ§Ã£o ainda vale por ~60 min

        assertThat(contem(perto(bia, "PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, 5000), id)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("correÃ§Ã£o: 'estou disponÃ­vel como motorista' exige DRIVER (CNH verificada) â€” sem ela, 403")
    void ofertaDeMotoristaExigeDriver() {
        criar(conta("intent-sem-cnh", false), pedido("DRIVER_OFFER", "FREE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, null))
                .statusCode(403).body("message", containsString("CNH"));

        Conta motorista = conta("intent-motorista", true);
        String id = criar(motorista, pedido("DRIVER_OFFER", "FREE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, null))
                .statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        assertThat(contem(perto(conta("intent-passageira", false), "DRIVER_OFFER", "FREE", PAULISTA_LAT, PAULISTA_LNG, 5000), id))
                .isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("correÃ§Ã£o: dado invÃ¡lido responde 400 (antes 500), no formato JSON com message")
    void dadosInvalidos() {
        Conta ana = conta("intent-invalida", false);

        criar(ana, pedido("PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", 999, SE_LNG, null))
                .statusCode(400).body("status", equalTo(400)).body("message", containsString("Latitude"));
        criar(ana, pedido("PASSENGER_REQUEST", "FREE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, null))
                .statusCode(400).body("message", containsString("FREE"));
        given().auth().oauth2(ana.token())
                .queryParam("type", "PASSENGER_REQUEST").queryParam("mode", "ROUTE")
                .queryParam("latitude", SE_LAT).queryParam("longitude", SE_LNG).queryParam("radiusMeters", 500_000)
                .when().get(app("/api/ride-intents/nearby"))
                .then().statusCode(400).body("message", containsString("100 km"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("cancelar: de outra pessoa 404 (nÃ£o revela); a prÃ³pria 204; de novo 409; some da busca")
    void cancelamento() {
        Conta ana = conta("intent-cancela", false);
        Conta bia = conta("intent-outra", false);
        String id = criar(ana, pedido("PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, null)).statusCode(201).extract().path("id");

        given().auth().oauth2(bia.token()).when().delete(app("/api/ride-intents/" + id)).then().statusCode(404);
        given().auth().oauth2(ana.token()).when().delete(app("/api/ride-intents/" + id)).then().statusCode(204);
        given().auth().oauth2(ana.token()).when().delete(app("/api/ride-intents/" + id))
                .then().statusCode(409).body("message", containsString("ativas"));

        assertThat(contem(perto(bia, "PASSENGER_REQUEST", "ROUTE", SE_LAT, SE_LNG, 5000), id)).isFalse();
    }
}

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.notNullValue;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.hasSize;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

@DisplayName("Testes de integraÃ§Ã£o â€” solicitaÃ§Ãµes de carona (RF06)")
class RideRequestApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO =
            DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    private record UserSetup(String token, String sub) {}

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    private UserSetup criarUsuarioComRole(String prefixo, String role) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);

        if (role != null) {
            atribuirRoleRealm(userId, role);
        }

        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        String sub = given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("sub");

        return new UserSetup(token, sub);
    }

    private DriverSetup criarMotorista() {
        UserSetup user = criarUsuarioComRole("request-driver", "DRIVER");

        String plate = "R" + String.format(
                "%06d",
                ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000)
        );

        String vehicleId = given()
                .auth().oauth2(user.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "plate", plate,
                        "type", "CARRO",
                        "model", "Toyota Corolla",
                        "color", "Prata",
                        "year", 2024,
                        "passengerSeats", 4,
                        "cargoVolumeLiters", 400
                ))
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");

        return new DriverSetup(
                user.token(),
                UUID.fromString(vehicleId),
                user.sub()
        );
    }

    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", driver.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", "Fortaleza");
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now()
                .plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", 2);

        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private UserSetup criarPassageiro() {
        return criarUsuarioComRole("request-passenger", "PASSENGER");
    }

    private void solicitar(String token, String rideId, String nome) {
        given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao(nome))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201);
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> itemBagagem() {
        Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
        item.put("type", "mala");
        item.put("quantity", 1);
        item.put("lengthCm", 60);
        item.put("widthCm", 40);
        item.put("heightCm", 30);
        item.put("description", "Mala de bordo");
        return item;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> payloadSolicitacao(String nome) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("passengerName", nome);
        payload.put("baggage", List.of(itemBagagem()));
        return payload;
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF06: passageiro solicita vaga e recebe PENDING")
    void passageiroSolicitaVaga() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver);

        given()
                .auth().oauth2(passenger.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao("Maria Silva"))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .body("id", notNullValue())
                .body("rideId", equalTo(rideId))
                .body("passengerSub", equalTo(passenger.sub()))
                .body("passengerName", equalTo("Maria Silva"))
                .body("status", equalTo("PENDING"))
                .body("joinedAt", notNullValue());

        Integer notifications = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications " +
                        "WHERE ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid) AND recipient_sub = ?",
                Integer.class,
                rideId,
                driver.sub()

    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver,
                               String originCity,
                               String destinationCity,
                               BigDecimal price,
                               int totalSeats,
                               LocalDateTime departure) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", driver.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", originCity);
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", destinationCity);
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", departure.format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", totalSeats);

        if (price != null) {
            body.put("pricePerPassenger", price);
        }

        return given().auth().oauth2(driver.token()).contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private void marcarSemVagas(String rideId) {
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET available_seats = 0 WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                rideId);
    }

    private void marcarExcluida(String rideId) {
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                rideId);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-040: sem filtros retorna paginaÃ§Ã£o e somente caronas PLANNED com vagas")
    void ct040_semFiltros() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotoristaComVeiculo(4);
        String rideId = criarCarona(
                driver,
                "SemFiltro-" + System.nanoTime(),
                "Destino",
                new BigDecimal("10.00"),
                2,
                LocalDateTime.now().plusDays(1));

        // Sem filtro, o banco compartilhado pelas ITs tem muitas caronas: percorre as
        // pÃ¡ginas atÃ© achar a criada aqui, conferindo as regras fixas em todas elas.
        boolean encontrada = false;
        int totalPages = 1;
        for (int page = 0; page < totalPages && !encontrada; page++) {
            io.restassured.response.ValidatableResponse resposta = given().auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                    .queryParam("size", 50)
                    .queryParam("page", page)
                    .when().get(app("/api/rides"))
                    .then().statusCode(200)
                    .body("page", equalTo(page))
                    .body("size", equalTo(50))
                    .body("totalElements", greaterThanOrEqualTo(1))
                    .body("totalPages", greaterThanOrEqualTo(1))
                    .body("content.status", everyItem(equalTo("PLANNED")))
                    .body("content.availableSeats", everyItem(greaterThanOrEqualTo(1)));
            totalPages = resposta.extract().path("totalPages");
            java.util.List<String> ids = resposta.extract().path("content.id");
            encontrada = ids.contains(rideId);
        }
        org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat(encontrada)
                .as("a carona criada aparece na busca sem filtros")
                .isTrue();
    }

===== ./raiji-app/src/test/java/com/raiji/it/RideStatusSchedulerIT.java =====
package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import com.raiji.rides.scheduler.RideStatusScheduler;
import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

/**
 * S2-06 / RF10 + RN05 â€” teste de integraÃ§Ã£o do status automÃ¡tico.
 *
 * <p>"AvanÃ§ar o relÃ³gio" Ã© simulado de forma determinÃ­stica movendo o
 * {@code departure_date} da carona para o passado via banco (equivalente a
 * {@code now() > departureDate}) e disparando o {@link RideStatusScheduler}
 * manualmente (o job cron fica com intervalo enorme nos testes â€” ver
 * {@code RaijiTestSupport}). O limite exato {@code departureDate == now()} Ã©
 * coberto no teste unitÃ¡rio com {@code Clock} fixo.
 *
 * <p>CritÃ©rios de aceite: apÃ³s a partida o status vira {@code IN_PROGRESS}, o
 * POST de solicitaÃ§Ã£o retorna 409, o PATCH de aceite retorna 409, caronas
 * futuras nÃ£o sÃ£o afetadas e o scheduler Ã© idempotente.
 */
@DisplayName("Testes de integraÃ§Ã£o â€” bloqueio no horÃ¡rio de saÃ­da e status automÃ¡tico (S2-06/RF10)")
class RideStatusSchedulerIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO =
            DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private RideStatusScheduler scheduler;

    private record UserSetup(String token, String sub) {}

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    // ===== fixtures =====

    private UserSetup criarUsuarioComRole(String prefixo, String role) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);
        if (role != null) {
            atribuirRoleRealm(userId, role);
        }
        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);
        String sub = given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200).extract().path("sub");
        return new UserSetup(token, sub);
    }

    private DriverSetup criarMotorista() {
        UserSetup user = criarUsuarioComRole("sched-driver", "DRIVER");
        String plate = "S" + String.format(
                "%06d", ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000));
        String vehicleId = given().auth().oauth2(user.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "plate", plate, "type", "CARRO", "model", "Fiat Toro",
                        "color", "Branco", "year", 2024, "passengerSeats", 4,
                        "cargoVolumeLiters", 400))
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        return new DriverSetup(user.token(), UUID.fromString(vehicleId), user.sub());
    }

    private UserSetup criarPassageiro() {
        return criarUsuarioComRole("sched-passenger", "PASSENGER");
    }

    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver, int totalSeats) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", driver.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", "Fortaleza");
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now().plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", totalSeats);
        return given().auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> payloadSolicitacao(String nome) {
        Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
        item.put("type", "mala");
        item.put("quantity", 1);
        item.put("lengthCm", 60);
        item.put("widthCm", 40);
        item.put("heightCm", 30);
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("passengerName", nome);
        payload.put("baggage", List.of(item));
        return payload;
    }

    private String solicitarVaga(String token, String rideId, String nome) {
        return given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(payloadSolicitacao(nome))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
    }

    // ===== helpers de banco =====

    private void moverPartidaParaOPassado(String rideId) {
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET departure_date = ? WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                LocalDateTime.now().minusMinutes(2), rideId);
    }

    private String statusDaCarona(String rideId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT status FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                String.class, rideId);
    }

    // ===== critÃ©rios de aceite (issue #13) =====

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN05: apÃ³s departureDate o scheduler muda PLANNED -> IN_PROGRESS")
    void schedulerPromoveCaronaVencida() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        Assertions.assertEquals("PLANNED", statusDaCarona(rideId));

        moverPartidaParaOPassado(rideId);          // "avanÃ§a o relÃ³gio"
        scheduler.promoteDueRides();               // dispara o job manualmente

        Assertions.assertEquals("IN_PROGRESS", statusDaCarona(rideId),
                "a carona vencida deve ser promovida automaticamente");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF10: apÃ³s a partida, POST de solicitaÃ§Ã£o retorna 409")
    void postRetorna409AposPartida() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);

        moverPartidaParaOPassado(rideId);
        scheduler.promoteDueRides();

        given().auth().oauth2(passenger.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(payloadSolicitacao("Maria"))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(409);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF10: apÃ³s a partida, PATCH de aceite retorna 409 (carona nÃ£o PLANNED)")
    void patchAcceptRetorna409AposPartida() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria");

        moverPartidaParaOPassado(rideId);
        scheduler.promoteDueRides(); // agora IN_PROGRESS

        given().auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("decision", "ACCEPT"))
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(409);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN05: caronas futuras NÃƒO sÃ£o afetadas pelo scheduler")
    void caronasFuturasNaoSaoAfetadas() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3); // departure = now + 1 dia

        scheduler.promoteDueRides();

        Assertions.assertEquals("PLANNED", statusDaCarona(rideId),
                "carona futura permanece PLANNED");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN05: scheduler Ã© idempotente (2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o mantÃ©m IN_PROGRESS)")
    void schedulerEhIdempotente() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);

        moverPartidaParaOPassado(rideId);
        scheduler.promoteDueRides();
        Assertions.assertEquals("IN_PROGRESS", statusDaCarona(rideId));

        scheduler.promoteDueRides(); // roda de novo
        Assertions.assertEquals("IN_PROGRESS", statusDaCarona(rideId),
                "estado estÃ¡vel â€” sem duplo processamento");
    }
}

===== ./raiji-app/src/test/java/com/raiji/it/StripeRefundApiIT.java =====
package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeRefundGateway;
import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Primary;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.test.context.TestPropertySource;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” estorno automÃ¡tico no cancelamento de caronas pagas.
 *
 * <p>Usa um {@link StripeRefundGateway} FAKE (@Primary) â€” determinÃ­stico, sem
 * rede e sem chave real â€” para validar o fluxo de ponta a ponta:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>carona paga cancelada =&gt; chama o "Stripe" e registra ESTORNO_SUCESSO
 *       com o id do refund;</li>
 *   <li>carona gratuita =&gt; NÃƒO chama o Stripe;</li>
 *   <li>falha no Stripe =&gt; NÃƒO impede o cancelamento e registra
 *       ESTORNO_FALHOU.</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>A propriedade {@code raiji.stripe.api-key} Ã© definida com um valor
 * {@code sk_test_*} fictÃ­cio apenas para marcar o Stripe como "configurado";
 * nenhuma chamada real ocorre (o gateway Ã© fake). Para um teste contra o
 * sandbox real, ver {@code StripeSandboxRefundIT} (habilitado sÃ³ com
 * {@code STRIPE_TEST_API_KEY}).
 */
@DisplayName("Testes de integraÃ§Ã£o â€” estorno automÃ¡tico de caronas pagas (S2-05/RN04)")
@TestPropertySource(properties = {
        "raiji.stripe.api-key=sk_test_IT_FAKE_KEY"
})
@Import(StripeRefundApiIT.FakeStripeConfig.class)
class StripeRefundApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO =
            DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private FakeStripeGateway fakeGateway;

    // ----- gateway fake (controllÃ¡vel: sucesso/falha + registro de chamadas) -----

    @TestConfiguration
    static class FakeStripeConfig {
        @Bean
        @Primary
        FakeStripeGateway fakeStripeGateway() {
            return new FakeStripeGateway();
        }
    }

    static class FakeStripeGateway implements StripeRefundGateway {
        final List<String> calls = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
        volatile boolean fail = false;

        void reset() {
            calls.clear();
            fail = false;
        }

        @Override
        public String createRefund(String paymentIntentId, long amountCents) {
            calls.add(paymentIntentId + ":" + amountCents);
            if (fail) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Erro simulado no sandbox Stripe");
            }
            return "re_IT_" + paymentIntentId;
        }
    }

    @BeforeEach
    void resetGateway() {
        fakeGateway.reset();
    }

    // ===== fixtures =====

    private record UserSetup(String token, String sub) {}

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    private UserSetup criarUsuarioComRole(String prefixo, String role) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);
        if (role != null) {
            atribuirRoleRealm(userId, role);
        }
        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);
        String sub = given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200).extract().path("sub");
        return new UserSetup(token, sub);
    }

    private DriverSetup criarMotorista() {
        UserSetup user = criarUsuarioComRole("refund-driver", "DRIVER");
        String plate = "P" + String.format(
                "%06d", ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000));
        String vehicleId = given().auth().oauth2(user.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "plate", plate, "type", "CARRO", "model", "Honda Civic",
                        "color", "Preto", "year", 2023, "passengerSeats", 4,
                        "cargoVolumeLiters", 400))
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
        return new DriverSetup(user.token(), UUID.fromString(vehicleId), user.sub());
    }

    private UserSetup criarPassageiro() {
        return criarUsuarioComRole("refund-passenger", "PASSENGER");
    }

    /** Carona com preÃ§o (paga) ou gratuita (price == null). */
    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver, int totalSeats, String price) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", driver.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", "Fortaleza");
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now().plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", totalSeats);
        if (price != null) {
            body.put("pricePerPassenger", price);
        }
        return given().auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> itemBagagem() {
        Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
        item.put("type", "mala");
        item.put("quantity", 1);
        item.put("lengthCm", 60);
        item.put("widthCm", 40);
        item.put("heightCm", 30);
        return item;
    }

    private String solicitarVaga(String token, String rideId, String nome) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("passengerName", nome);
        payload.put("baggage", List.of(itemBagagem()));
        return given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(payload)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201).extract().path("id");
    }

    /** ACCEPT informando o paymentIntentId (integraÃ§Ã£o de pagamento futura). */
    private void aceitar(String driverToken, String rideId, String requestId,
                         String paymentIntentId) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("decision", "ACCEPT");
        if (paymentIntentId != null) {
            payload.put("paymentIntentId", paymentIntentId);
        }
        given().auth().oauth2(driverToken)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(payload)
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"));
    }

    private void cancelar(String token, String rideId, String requestId, String reason) {
        given().auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON).body(Map.of("reason", reason))
                .when().delete(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(200).body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"));
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> auditoriaDaReserva(String requestId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForList(
                "SELECT action, details FROM audit_log "
                        + "WHERE entity_type = 'RIDE_PASSENGER' "
                        + "AND entity_id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                requestId);
    }

    // ===== critÃ©rios de aceite (issue #12) =====

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN04: carona PAGA cancelada gera refund e audita ESTORNO_SUCESSO com o id")
    void caronaPagaCanceladaGeraRefund() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3, "50.00");
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");
        aceitar(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "pi_IT_pago_1");

        fakeGateway.reset();
        cancelar(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "Imprevisto pessoal");

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                List.of("pi_IT_pago_1:5000"), fakeGateway.calls,
                "deve estornar o valor exato (50.00 => 5000 centavos)");

        List<Map<String, Object>> audit = auditoriaDaReserva(requestId);
        Assertions.assertEquals(1, audit.size());
        Assertions.assertEquals("ESTORNO_SUCESSO", audit.get(0).get("action"));
        Assertions.assertTrue(
                String.valueOf(audit.get(0).get("details")).contains("re_IT_pi_IT_pago_1"),
                "a auditoria deve conter o id do refund");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN04: carona GRATUITA nÃ£o chama o Stripe")
    void caronaGratuitaNaoChamaStripe() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3, null); // gratuita
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "JoÃ£o Souza");
        aceitar(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, null);

        fakeGateway.reset();
        cancelar(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "Desisti");

        Assertions.assertTrue(fakeGateway.calls.isEmpty(),
                "carona gratuita nÃ£o pode chamar o Stripe");
        Assertions.assertTrue(auditoriaDaReserva(requestId).isEmpty(),
                "sem estorno => sem registro de estorno na auditoria");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN04: falha no Stripe NÃƒO impede o cancelamento e audita ESTORNO_FALHOU")
    void falhaNoStripeNaoImpedeCancelamento() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3, "25.00");
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");
        aceitar(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "pi_IT_falha");

        fakeGateway.reset();
        fakeGateway.fail = true; // sandbox fora do ar / cartÃ£o invÃ¡lido

        // o cancelamento continua retornando 200 e a vaga Ã© liberada
        cancelar(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "Imprevisto");

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                List.of("pi_IT_falha:2500"), fakeGateway.calls,
                "a chamada foi tentada");

        List<Map<String, Object>> audit = auditoriaDaReserva(requestId);
        Assertions.assertEquals(1, audit.size());
        Assertions.assertEquals("ESTORNO_FALHOU", audit.get(0).get("action"));

        String status = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT status FROM ride_passengers WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                String.class, requestId);
        Assertions.assertEquals("CANCELLED", status,
                "a reserva Ã© cancelada mesmo com falha no estorno");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN04: reserva paga SEM paymentIntentId nÃ£o estorna (nada a reembolsar)")
    void pagaSemPaymentIntentNaoEstorna() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3, "30.00");
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");
        aceitar(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, null); // sem paymentIntent

        fakeGateway.reset();
        cancelar(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "Imprevisto");

        Assertions.assertTrue(fakeGateway.calls.isEmpty());
        Assertions.assertTrue(auditoriaDaReserva(requestId).isEmpty());
    }
}

package com.raiji.it;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import com.raiji.rides.config.StripeProperties;
import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeRefundGatewayImpl;
import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeRefundResult;
import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeService;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.condition.EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” integraÃ§Ã£o REAL com o sandbox do Stripe, habilitada SOMENTE
 * quando {@code STRIPE_TEST_API_KEY} (uma chave {@code sk_test_*}) estÃ¡ presente
 * no ambiente. Sem a chave, o teste Ã© ignorado â€” assim o build/CI continua verde
 * e NUNCA expÃµe credenciais (a chave vem de variÃ¡vel de ambiente, jamais do repo).
 *
 * <p>NÃ£o faz cobranÃ§a real: tenta estornar um PaymentIntent inexistente e
 * verifica que o {@link StripeService} trata a falha graciosamente (resultado
 * {@code ok=false}, sem propagar exceÃ§Ã£o), exercitando o SDK de verdade.
 */
@EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable(named = "STRIPE_TEST_API_KEY", matches = ".+")
@DisplayName("Stripe sandbox (sk_test_*) â€” integraÃ§Ã£o real opcional (S2-05/RN04)")
class StripeSandboxRefundIT {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("refund de PaymentIntent inexistente falha graciosamente (sem exceÃ§Ã£o)")
    void refundInexistenteFalhaGraciosamente() {
        String key = System.getenv("STRIPE_TEST_API_KEY");
        assertTrue(key.startsWith("sk_test_"),
                "use uma chave de TESTE (sk_test_*), nunca de produÃ§Ã£o");

        StripeProperties props = new StripeProperties(key, null);
        StripeService service =
                new StripeService(props, new StripeRefundGatewayImpl(props));

        StripeRefundResult result =
                service.refund("pi_inexistente_" + System.nanoTime(), 100L);

        assertFalse(result.ok(), "PaymentIntent inexistente deve falhar");
        assertNotNull(result.error(), "o erro deve ser capturado e retornado");
    }
}

===== ./raiji-app/src/test/java/com/raiji/security/KeycloakAuthoritiesConverterTest.java =====
package com.raiji.security;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;

@DisplayName("Testes unitÃ¡rios (Â§4) â€” conversÃ£o das roles do JWT em authorities")
class KeycloakAuthoritiesConverterTest {

    private final KeycloakAuthoritiesConverter conversor =
            new KeycloakAuthoritiesConverter("raiji-api");

    private static Jwt jwt(Map<String, Object> claims) {
        return Jwt.withTokenValue("t").header("alg", "RS256")
                .claims(c -> c.putAll(claims)).build();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-U06: realm roles ganham o prefixo ROLE_")
    void realmRoles() {
        var authorities = conversor.convert(jwt(
                Map.of("sub", "user1", "realm_access", Map.of("roles", List.of("DRIVER", "admin")))));

        assertThat(authorities).extracting(GrantedAuthority::getAuthority)
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder("ROLE_DRIVER", "ROLE_admin");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-U07: client roles do client raiji-api sÃ£o extraÃ­das (de outros clients, nÃ£o)")
    void clientRoles() {
        var jwt = jwt(Map.of("sub", "user1", "resource_access", Map.of(
                "raiji-api", Map.of("roles", List.of("API_ROLE")),
                "outro-client", Map.of("roles", List.of("IGNORADA")))));

        assertThat(conversor.convert(jwt)).extracting(GrantedAuthority::getAuthority)
                .containsExactly("ROLE_API_ROLE");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CT-U08: token sem claims de roles â†’ authorities vazias")
    void semClaimsDeRoles() {
        // O Spring Security 6+ exige que o Jwt tenha pelo menos um claim.
        // Adicionamos "sub" para satisfazer a validaÃ§Ã£o, mas sem as chaves de roles.
        assertThat(conversor.convert(jwt(Map.of("sub", "usuario-teste")))).isEmpty();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-common/src/main/java/com/raiji/common/base/AuditableEntity.java =====
package com.raiji.common.base;

import java.time.Instant;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityListeners;
import jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass;
import jakarta.persistence.Version;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.CreatedBy;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.CreatedDate;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.LastModifiedBy;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.LastModifiedDate;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.support.AuditingEntityListener;

@MappedSuperclass
@EntityListeners(AuditingEntityListener.class)
public abstract class AuditableEntity {

    @CreatedBy
    @Column(name = "created_by", updatable = false, length = 64)
    private String createdBy;

    @CreatedDate
    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private Instant createdAt;

    @LastModifiedBy
    @Column(name = "updated_by", length = 64)
    private String updatedBy;

    @LastModifiedDate
    @Column(name = "updated_at")
    private Instant updatedAt;

    @Column(name = "deleted_at")
    private Instant deletedAt;

    @Version
    private Long version;

    public void softDelete() { this.deletedAt = Instant.now(); }
    public boolean isDeleted() { return deletedAt != null; }
    public void restore() { this.deletedAt = null; }

    public String getCreatedBy() { return createdBy; }
    public void setCreatedBy(String createdBy) { this.createdBy = createdBy; }
    public Instant getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public void setCreatedAt(Instant createdAt) { this.createdAt = createdAt; }
    public String getUpdatedBy() { return updatedBy; }
    public void setUpdatedBy(String updatedBy) { this.updatedBy = updatedBy; }
    public Instant getUpdatedAt() { return updatedAt; }
    public void setUpdatedAt(Instant updatedAt) { this.updatedAt = updatedAt; }
    public Instant getDeletedAt() { return deletedAt; }
    public void setDeletedAt(Instant deletedAt) { this.deletedAt = deletedAt; }
    public Long getVersion() { return version; }
    public void setVersion(Long version) { this.version = version; }
}

    @Column(name = "cargo_max_height_cm", precision = 8, scale = 2)
    private BigDecimal maxHeightCm;

    public void setMaxHeightCm(BigDecimal v) { this.maxHeightCm = v; }
    public String getObservation() { return observation; }

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/Delivery.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.base.AuditableEntity;
import com.raiji.common.enums.DeliveryStatus;
import com.raiji.deliveries.service.IllegalDeliveryStateException;
import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Embedded;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Point;


/**
 * Encomenda que viaja numa carona (pedido de espaÃ§o de carga).
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "deliveries")
public class Delivery extends AuditableEntity {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)
    private UUID id;

    @Column(name = "tracking_code", nullable = false, unique = true, length = 20)
    private String trackingCode;

    @Column(name = "ride_id")
    private UUID rideId;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "mode", length = 20)
    private DeliveryMode mode;

    @Column(name = "origin_city",length = 100)
    private String originCity;

    @Column(name = "origin_state", length = 2)
    private String originState;

    @Column(name = "origin_address", length = 255)
    private String originAddress;

    @Column(name = "destination_city",length = 100)
    private String destinationCity;

    @Column(name = "destination_state", length = 2)
    private String destinationState;

    @Column(name = "destination_address", length = 255)
    private String destinationAddress;

    @Column(name = "distance_km", precision = 10, scale = 2)
    private BigDecimal distanceKm;

    @Column(name = "quoted_price_cents")
    private Long quotedPriceCents;

    @Column(name = "sender_sub", nullable = false, length = 64)
    private String senderSub;

    @Column(name = "sender_name", length = 150)
    private String senderName;

    @Column(name = "company_id")
    private UUID companyId;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(nullable = false, length = 20)
    private DeliveryStatus status = DeliveryStatus.PENDING;

    @Embedded
    private PackageDetails pkg = new PackageDetails();

    @Column(name = "pickup_location", columnDefinition = "geography(Point,4326)")
    private Point pickupLocation;

    @Column(name = "pickup_address", length = 255)
    private String pickupAddress;

    @Column(name = "dropoff_location", columnDefinition = "geography(Point,4326)")
    private Point dropoffLocation;

    @Column(name = "dropoff_address", length = 255)
    private String dropoffAddress;

    @Column(name = "full_route", nullable = false)
    private boolean fullRoute = true;

    @Column(precision = 10, scale = 2)
    private BigDecimal price;

    @Column(name = "platform_fee_percent", nullable = false, precision = 5, scale = 2)
    private BigDecimal platformFeePercent = BigDecimal.ZERO;

    @Column(name = "pickup_code", nullable = false, length = 4)
    private String pickupCode;

    @Column(name = "delivery_keyword", nullable = false, length = 12)
    private String deliveryKeyword;

    @Column(name = "failed_code_attempts", nullable = false)
    private int failedCodeAttempts;

    @Column(name = "freight_request_id")
    private UUID freightRequestId;

    @Column(name = "payment_intent_id", length = 100)
    private String paymentIntentId;

    @Column(name = "requested_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant requestedAt = Instant.now();

    @Column(name = "confirmed_at")
    private Instant confirmedAt;

    @Column(name = "picked_up_at")
    private Instant pickedUpAt;

    @Column(name = "delivered_at")
    private Instant deliveredAt;

    @Column(name = "cancelled_at")
    private Instant cancelledAt;

    @Column(name = "cancellation_reason", columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String cancellationReason;

    @Column(name = "driver_sub", length = 64)
    private String driverSub;

    @Column(name = "vehicle_id")
    private UUID vehicleId;

    @Column(name = "accepted_at")
    private Instant acceptedAt;

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // TransiÃ§Ãµes de estado
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * PENDING -> CONFIRMED
     */
    public void confirm() {
        requireStatus(
                DeliveryStatus.PENDING,
                "SÃ³ uma encomenda pendente pode ser aceita."
        );

        status = DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED;
        confirmedAt = Instant.now();
    }

    /**
     * CONFIRMED -> IN_TRANSIT
     */
    public void pickUp() {
        requireStatus(
                DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED,
                "SÃ³ uma encomenda aceita pode ser coletada."
        );

        status = DeliveryStatus.IN_TRANSIT;
        pickedUpAt = Instant.now();
        failedCodeAttempts = 0;
    }

    /**
     * IN_TRANSIT -> DELIVERED
     */
    public void deliver() {
        requireStatus(
                DeliveryStatus.IN_TRANSIT,
                "SÃ³ uma encomenda em trÃ¢nsito pode ser entregue."
        );

        status = DeliveryStatus.DELIVERED;
        deliveredAt = Instant.now();
    }

    /**
     * PENDING/CONFIRMED/IN_TRANSIT -> CANCELLED.
     *
     * A regra de negÃ³cio do serviÃ§o pode restringir o cancelamento
     * somente aos estados anteriores Ã  coleta.
     */
    public void cancel(String reason) {
        if (status != DeliveryStatus.PENDING
                && status != DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED
                && status != DeliveryStatus.IN_TRANSIT) {

            throw new IllegalDeliveryStateException(
                    "NÃ£o Ã© possÃ­vel cancelar uma encomenda com status " + status + "."
            );
        }

        status = DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED;
        cancelledAt = Instant.now();
        cancellationReason = reason;
    }

    private void requireStatus(DeliveryStatus expected, String message) {
        if (status != expected) {
            throw new IllegalDeliveryStateException(
                    message + " Status atual: " + status + "."
            );
        }
    }

    public boolean active() {
        return status == DeliveryStatus.PENDING
                || status == DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED
                || status == DeliveryStatus.IN_TRANSIT;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Getters e setters
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    public UUID getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public String getTrackingCode() {
        return trackingCode;
    }

    public void setTrackingCode(String trackingCode) {
        this.trackingCode = trackingCode;
    }

    public UUID getRideId() {
        return rideId;
    }

    public void setRideId(UUID v) {
        this.rideId = v;
    }

    public String getSenderSub() {
        return senderSub;
    }

    public void setSenderSub(String v) {
        this.senderSub = v;
    }

    public String getSenderName() {
        return senderName;
    }

    public void setSenderName(String v) {
        this.senderName = v;
    }

    public UUID getCompanyId() {
        return companyId;
    }

    public void setCompanyId(UUID v) {
        this.companyId = v;
    }

    public DeliveryStatus getStatus() {
        return status;
    }

    public PackageDetails getPkg() {
        return pkg;
    }

    public void setPkg(PackageDetails v) {
        this.pkg = v;
    }

    public Point getPickupLocation() {
        return pickupLocation;
    }

    public void setPickupLocation(Point v) {
        this.pickupLocation = v;
    }

    public String getPickupAddress() {
        return pickupAddress;
    }

    public void setPickupAddress(String v) {
        this.pickupAddress = v;

        return dropoffLocation;

package com.raiji.deliveries;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.enums.DeliveryStatus;
import jakarta.persistence.*;

@Entity
@Table(name = "delivery_status_history")
public class DeliveryStatusHistory {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)
    private UUID id;

    @Column(name = "delivery_id", nullable = false)
    private UUID deliveryId;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "from_status", length = 20)
    private DeliveryStatus fromStatus;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "to_status", nullable = false, length = 20)
    private DeliveryStatus toStatus;

    @Column(name = "changed_by", length = 64)
    private String changedBy;

    @Column(length = 300)
    private String reason;

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false)
    private Instant createdAt = Instant.now();

    protected DeliveryStatusHistory() {
    }

    public DeliveryStatusHistory(
            UUID deliveryId,
            DeliveryStatus fromStatus,
            DeliveryStatus toStatus,
            String changedBy,
            String reason
    ) {
        this.deliveryId = deliveryId;
        this.fromStatus = fromStatus;
        this.toStatus = toStatus;
        this.changedBy = changedBy;
        this.reason = reason;
        this.createdAt = Instant.now();
    }

    public UUID getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public UUID getDeliveryId() {
        return deliveryId;
    }

    public DeliveryStatus getFromStatus() {
        return fromStatus;
    }

    public DeliveryStatus getToStatus() {
        return toStatus;
    }

    public String getChangedBy() {
        return changedBy;
    }

    public String getReason() {
        return reason;
    }

    public Instant getCreatedAt() {
        return createdAt;
    }
}
===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/dto/AvailableDeliveryResponse.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.dto;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.deliveries.Delivery;

public record AvailableDeliveryResponse(
        UUID id,
        String trackingCode,
        String status,
        String mode,
        String originCity,
        String originState,
        String originAddress,
        String destinationCity,
        String destinationState,
        String destinationAddress,
        String description,
        BigDecimal weightKg,
        Integer lengthCm,
        Integer widthCm,
        Integer heightCm,
        String recipientName,
        Instant requestedAt,
        List<RideMatch> compatibleRides
) {
    public record RideMatch(
            UUID id,
            String originCity,
            String originState,
            String destinationCity,
            String destinationState,
            LocalDateTime departureDate
    ) {}

    public static AvailableDeliveryResponse of(
            Delivery delivery,
            List<RideMatch> compatibleRides) {

        return new AvailableDeliveryResponse(
                delivery.getId(),
                delivery.getTrackingCode(),
                delivery.getStatus().name(),
                delivery.getMode() != null ? delivery.getMode().name() : null,
                delivery.getOriginCity(),
                delivery.getOriginState(),
                delivery.getOriginAddress(),
                delivery.getDestinationCity(),
                delivery.getDestinationState(),
                delivery.getDestinationAddress(),

/**
 * Encomenda.
 * O trackingCode Ã© pÃºblico para os participantes da encomenda.
 * pickupCode e deliveryKeyword sÃ³ aparecem para quem envia
 * (e membros da empresa); o motorista recebe null e digita o que ouvir.

public record DeliveryResponse(
        UUID id,
        UUID rideId,
        DeliveryStatus status,
        String trackingCode,
        String senderSub,
        String senderName,
        UUID companyId,
        PackageSize size,

        Instant cancelledAt,
