    /** Resumo da carona em que a encomenda viaja. */
    public record RideSummary(UUID id, String driverSub, String driverName, String originCity, String originState,
                              String destinationCity, String destinationState, LocalDateTime departureDate,
                              String status, String meetingPoint) {
        public static RideSummary of(Ride r) {
            return r == null ? null : new RideSummary(r.getId(), r.getDriverSub(), r.getDriverName(),
                    r.getOriginCity(), r.getOriginState(), r.getDestinationCity(), r.getDestinationState(),
                    r.getDepartureDate(), r.getStatus().name(), r.getMeetingPoint());
        }
    }

    public static DeliveryResponse of(Delivery d, Ride ride, boolean showCodes) {
        PackageDetails p = d.getPkg();
        PriceBreakdown price = PriceBreakdown.of(d.getPrice(), d.getPlatformFeePercent());

        return new DeliveryResponse(
                d.getId(),
                d.getRideId(),
                d.getStatus(),
                d.getTrackingCode(),
                d.getSenderSub(),
                d.getSenderName(),
                d.getCompanyId(),
                p.getSize(),
                p.getDescription(),
                p.getWeightKg(),
                p.getLengthCm(),
                p.getWidthCm(),
                p.getHeightCm(),
                p.isFragile(),
                p.getDeclaredValue(),
                p.getRecipientName(),
                p.getRecipientPhone(),
                GeoSupport.latitude(d.getPickupLocation()),
                GeoSupport.longitude(d.getPickupLocation()),
                d.getPickupAddress(),
                GeoSupport.latitude(d.getDropoffLocation()),
                GeoSupport.longitude(d.getDropoffLocation()),
                d.getDropoffAddress(),
                d.isFullRoute(),
                price.price(),
                price.platformFee(),
                price.driverReceives(),
                showCodes ? d.getPickupCode() : null,
                showCodes ? d.getDeliveryKeyword() : null,
                d.getRequestedAt(),
                d.getConfirmedAt(),
                d.getPickedUpAt(),
                d.getDeliveredAt(),
                d.getCancelledAt(),
                d.getCancellationReason(),
                RideSummary.of(ride)
        );
    }

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/freight/FreightController.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.freight;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.AcceptDirectRequest;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.CreateFreightRequest;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.CreateOfferRequest;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.DeclineRequest;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.FreightResponse;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.OfferResponse;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseStatus;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

/**
 * Empresa (qualquer membro):
 *   POST   /api/companies/{companyId}/freight-requests          direta (targetDriverSub + offeredPrice) ou pÃºblica
 *   GET    /api/companies/{companyId}/freight-requests
 *   GET    /api/freight-requests/{id}/offers
 *   POST   /api/freight-requests/{id}/offers/{offerId}/accept   escolhe a oferta (fecha o frete)
 *   POST   /api/freight-requests/{id}/cancel
 * Motorista:
 *   GET    /api/freight-requests/for-me                         propostas diretas para mim
 *   GET    /api/freight-requests/nearby?lat&lng&radiusMeters    pedidos pÃºblicos perto
 *   POST   /api/freight-requests/{id}/accept   { vehicleId }    aceita a proposta direta
 *   POST   /api/freight-requests/{id}/decline  { reason }       recusa a proposta direta
 *   POST   /api/freight-requests/{id}/offers   { price, vehicleId, message }
 *   DELETE /api/freight-requests/{id}/offers/{offerId}          retira a oferta
 *   GET    /api/freight-offers/mine
 * Ambos: GET /api/freight-requests/{id}
 */
@RestController
@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
public class FreightController {

    private final FreightService service;

    public FreightController(FreightService service) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @PostMapping("/api/companies/{companyId}/freight-requests")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public FreightResponse create(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID companyId,
                                  @Valid @RequestBody CreateFreightRequest body) {
        return service.create(companyId, jwt.getSubject(), body);
    }

    @GetMapping("/api/companies/{companyId}/freight-requests")
    public List<FreightResponse> listForCompany(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID companyId) {
        return service.listForCompany(companyId, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @GetMapping("/api/freight-requests/for-me")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public List<FreightResponse> forMe(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return service.forMe(jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @GetMapping("/api/freight-requests/nearby")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public List<FreightResponse> nearby(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @RequestParam double lat,
                                        @RequestParam double lng,
                                        @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20000") double radiusMeters) {
        return service.nearby(jwt.getSubject(), lat, lng, radiusMeters);
    }

    @GetMapping("/api/freight-requests/{id}")
    public FreightResponse get(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id) {
        return service.get(id, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @PostMapping("/api/freight-requests/{id}/cancel")
    public FreightResponse cancel(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id) {
        return service.cancel(id, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @GetMapping("/api/freight-requests/{id}/offers")
    public List<OfferResponse> offers(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id) {
        return service.offersFor(id, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @PostMapping("/api/freight-requests/{id}/offers/{offerId}/accept")
    public FreightResponse acceptOffer(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id,
                                       @PathVariable UUID offerId) {
        return service.acceptOffer(id, offerId, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @PostMapping("/api/freight-requests/{id}/accept")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public FreightResponse acceptDirect(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id,
                                        @Valid @RequestBody AcceptDirectRequest body) {
        return service.acceptDirect(id, jwt.getSubject(), jwt.getClaimAsString("name"), body.vehicleId());
    }

    @PostMapping("/api/freight-requests/{id}/decline")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public FreightResponse declineDirect(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id,
                                         @Valid @RequestBody(required = false) DeclineRequest body) {
        return service.declineDirect(id, jwt.getSubject(), body == null ? null : body.reason());
    }

    @PostMapping("/api/freight-requests/{id}/offers")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public OfferResponse offer(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id,
                               @Valid @RequestBody CreateOfferRequest body) {
        return service.offer(id, jwt.getSubject(), jwt.getClaimAsString("name"), body);
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/api/freight-requests/{id}/offers/{offerId}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public void withdraw(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id, @PathVariable UUID offerId) {
        service.withdrawOffer(id, offerId, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @GetMapping("/api/freight-offers/mine")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public List<OfferResponse> myOffers(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return service.myOffers(jwt.getSubject());
    }
}

package com.raiji.deliveries.freight;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.deliveries.PackageDetails;
import com.raiji.deliveries.PackageSize;
import com.raiji.deliveries.dto.PackageRequest;
import com.raiji.rides.geo.GeoSupport;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.DecimalMax;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.DecimalMin;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Digits;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

/** Contratos HTTP das propostas de frete. */
public final class FreightDtos {

    private FreightDtos() {
    }

    /** Cidade + ponto no mapa. */
    public record FreightPlace(
            @NotBlank @Size(max = 100) String city,
            @NotBlank @Pattern(regexp = "[A-Za-z]{2}", message = "UF com 2 letras") String state,
            @NotNull @DecimalMin("-90") @DecimalMax("90") Double latitude,
            @NotNull @DecimalMin("-180") @DecimalMax("180") Double longitude,
            @Size(max = 255) String address) {}

    /**
     * Nova proposta. Com {@code targetDriverSub} = direta (offeredPrice obrigatÃ³rio);
     * sem = pÃºblica (offeredPrice opcional, sÃ³ de referÃªncia).
     */
    public record CreateFreightRequest(
            @Size(max = 64) String targetDriverSub,
            @DecimalMin("0") @Digits(integer = 8, fraction = 2) BigDecimal offeredPrice,
            @NotNull @Valid FreightPlace origin,
            @NotNull @Valid FreightPlace destination,
            @NotNull LocalDateTime desiredDate,
            @NotNull @Valid PackageRequest pkg,
            @Size(max = 500) String notes) {}

    public record CreateOfferRequest(
            @NotNull @DecimalMin("0") @Digits(integer = 8, fraction = 2) BigDecimal price,
            @NotNull UUID vehicleId,
            @Size(max = 500) String message) {}

    public record AcceptDirectRequest(@NotNull UUID vehicleId) {}

    public record DeclineRequest(@Size(max = 500) String reason) {}

    public record OfferResponse(UUID id, UUID requestId, String driverSub, String driverName, UUID vehicleId,
                                BigDecimal price, String message, OfferStatus status, Instant createdAt) {
        static OfferResponse of(FreightOffer o) {
            return new OfferResponse(o.getId(), o.getRequestId(), o.getDriverSub(), o.getDriverName(),
                    o.getVehicleId(), o.getPrice(), o.getMessage(), o.getStatus(), o.getCreatedAt());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Proposta. Nome e telefone de quem recebe sÃ³ aparecem para a empresa (o motorista
     * vÃª na encomenda, depois de fechado o frete).
     */
    public record FreightResponse(
            UUID id, UUID companyId, String companyName, boolean direct, String targetDriverSub, FreightStatus status,
            String originCity, String originState, Double originLatitude, Double originLongitude, String originAddress,
            String destinationCity, String destinationState, Double destinationLatitude, Double destinationLongitude,
            String destinationAddress, LocalDateTime desiredDate,
            PackageSize size, String description, BigDecimal weightKg, int lengthCm, int widthCm, int heightCm,
            boolean fragile, BigDecimal declaredValue, String recipientName, String recipientPhone,
            BigDecimal offeredPrice, String notes, long pendingOffers, OfferResponse myOffer,
            UUID rideId, UUID deliveryId, String declineReason, Instant createdAt, Instant closedAt) {

        static FreightResponse of(FreightRequest f, String companyName, boolean companyView,
                                  long pendingOffers, OfferResponse myOffer) {
            PackageDetails p = f.getPkg();
            return new FreightResponse(f.getId(), f.getCompanyId(), companyName, f.direct(),
                    companyView ? f.getTargetDriverSub() : null, f.getStatus(),
                    f.getOriginCity(), f.getOriginState(), GeoSupport.latitude(f.getOriginLocation()),
                    GeoSupport.longitude(f.getOriginLocation()), f.getOriginAddress(),
                    f.getDestinationCity(), f.getDestinationState(), GeoSupport.latitude(f.getDestinationLocation()),
                    GeoSupport.longitude(f.getDestinationLocation()), f.getDestinationAddress(), f.getDesiredDate(),
                    p.getSize(), p.getDescription(), p.getWeightKg(), p.getLengthCm(), p.getWidthCm(), p.getHeightCm(),
                    p.isFragile(), p.getDeclaredValue(),
                    companyView ? p.getRecipientName() : null, companyView ? p.getRecipientPhone() : null,
                    f.getOfferedPrice(), f.getNotes(), pendingOffers, myOffer,
                    companyView ? f.getRideId() : null, companyView ? f.getDeliveryId() : null,
                    f.getDeclineReason(), f.getCreatedAt(), f.getClosedAt());
        }
    }
}

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/freight/FreightOffer.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.freight;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.base.AuditableEntity;
import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

/** Oferta de um motorista para um pedido de frete pÃºblico. */
@Entity
@Table(name = "freight_offers")
public class FreightOffer extends AuditableEntity {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)
    private UUID id;

    @Column(name = "request_id", nullable = false)
    private UUID requestId;

    @Column(name = "driver_sub", nullable = false, length = 64)
    private String driverSub;

    @Column(name = "driver_name", length = 150)
    private String driverName;

    @Column(name = "vehicle_id", nullable = false)
    private UUID vehicleId;

    @Column(nullable = false, precision = 10, scale = 2)
    private BigDecimal price;

    @Column(length = 500)
    private String message;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(nullable = false, length = 20)
    private OfferStatus status = OfferStatus.PENDING;

    public UUID getId() { return id; }

/**
 * Proposta de frete de uma empresa:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>direta</b> ({@code targetDriverSub} preenchido): para um motorista, com valor; ele aceita ou recusa;</li>
 *   <li><b>pÃºblica</b>: "preciso levar X para Y"; motoristas oferecem um valor e a empresa escolhe.</li>
 * </ul>
 * Fechado o frete, vira uma viagem EXCLUSIVA do motorista com a encomenda jÃ¡ aceita.
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "freight_requests")
public class FreightRequest extends AuditableEntity {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)
    private UUID id;

    @Column(name = "company_id", nullable = false)
    private UUID companyId;

    @Column(name = "created_by_sub", nullable = false, length = 64)
    private String createdBySub;

    @Column(name = "target_driver_sub", length = 64)
    private String targetDriverSub;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(nullable = false, length = 20)
    private FreightStatus status = FreightStatus.OPEN;

    @Column(name = "origin_city", nullable = false, length = 100)
    private String originCity;
    @Column(name = "origin_state", nullable = false, length = 2)
    private String originState;
    @Column(name = "origin_location", nullable = false, columnDefinition = "geography(Point,4326)")
    private Point originLocation;
    @Column(name = "origin_address", length = 255)
    private String originAddress;

    @Column(name = "destination_city", nullable = false, length = 100)
    private String destinationCity;
    @Column(name = "destination_state", nullable = false, length = 2)
    private String destinationState;
    @Column(name = "destination_location", nullable = false, columnDefinition = "geography(Point,4326)")
    private Point destinationLocation;
    @Column(name = "destination_address", length = 255)
    private String destinationAddress;

    /** Quando a empresa quer que o motorista saia (hora de BrasÃ­lia). */
    @Column(name = "desired_date", nullable = false)
    private LocalDateTime desiredDate;

    @Embedded
    private PackageDetails pkg = new PackageDetails();

    @Column(name = "offered_price", precision = 10, scale = 2)
    private BigDecimal offeredPrice;

    @Column(length = 500)

    @Column(name = "accepted_offer_id")

    private UUID rideId;

    private UUID deliveryId;
    @Column(name = "decline_reason", length = 500)
    private String declineReason;
    @Column(name = "closed_at")
    private Instant closedAt;

    public boolean direct() {
        return targetDriverSub != null;
    }

    public UUID getId() { return id; }

package com.raiji.deliveries.freight;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

import jakarta.persistence.LockModeType;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Lock;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

public interface FreightRequestRepository extends JpaRepository<FreightRequest, UUID> {

    @Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
    @Query("select f from FreightRequest f where f.id = :id")
    Optional<FreightRequest> findByIdForUpdate(@Param("id") UUID id);

    List<FreightRequest> findByCompanyIdAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByCreatedAtDesc(UUID companyId);

    List<FreightRequest> findByTargetDriverSubAndStatusAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByDesiredDateAsc(
            String targetDriverSub, FreightStatus status);

    /** Pedidos pÃºblicos em aberto com a origem perto do motorista. */
    @Query(value = """
            SELECT f.* FROM freight_requests f
            WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.status = 'OPEN' AND f.target_driver_sub IS NULL
              AND f.desired_date > :now
              AND ST_DWithin(f.origin_location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:lng, :lat), 4326)::geography, :radius)
            ORDER BY f.desired_date
            LIMIT 50
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    List<FreightRequest> findOpenNearby(@Param("lat") double latitude, @Param("lng") double longitude,
                                        @Param("radius") double radiusMeters, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now);
}

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/freight/FreightService.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.freight;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.embeddable.CargoDetails;
import com.raiji.deliveries.Delivery;
import com.raiji.deliveries.DeliveryStatusHistory;
import com.raiji.deliveries.PackageDetails;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.CreateFreightRequest;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.CreateOfferRequest;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.FreightPlace;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.FreightResponse;
import com.raiji.deliveries.freight.FreightDtos.OfferResponse;
import com.raiji.deliveries.repository.DeliveryRepository;
import com.raiji.deliveries.repository.DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository;
import com.raiji.deliveries.service.DeliveryCodes;
import com.raiji.deliveries.service.DeliveryNotifier;
import com.raiji.deliveries.service.Packages;
import com.raiji.common.enums.DeliveryStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.geo.GeoSupport;
import com.raiji.rides.geo.Place;
import com.raiji.rides.service.RideService;
import com.raiji.users.company.Company;
import com.raiji.users.company.CompanyMembership;
import com.raiji.users.keycloak.KeycloakAdminService;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/**
 * Propostas de frete de empresas. Qualquer membro ativo da empresa cria, cancela
 * e escolhe ofertas (e aprova o pagamento). Ao fechar, o motorista ganha uma
 * viagem EXCLUSIVA (fora da busca) jÃ¡ com a encomenda aceita â€” daÃ­ em diante Ã© o
 * fluxo normal da encomenda (cÃ³digo de coleta, palavra-chave de entrega).
 */
@Service
public class FreightService {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(FreightService.class);

    static final int MIN_LEAD_MINUTES = 30;

    private final FreightRequestRepository requests;
    private final FreightOfferRepository offers;
    private final DeliveryRepository deliveries;
    private final DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository history;
    private final RideService rideService;
    private final CompanyMembership membership;
    private final KeycloakAdminService keycloak;
    private final DeliveryNotifier notifier;
    private final Clock clock;

    public FreightService(FreightRequestRepository requests, FreightOfferRepository offers,
                          DeliveryRepository deliveries,
                          DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository history,
                          RideService rideService, CompanyMembership membership,
                          KeycloakAdminService keycloak, DeliveryNotifier notifier, Clock clock) {
        this.requests = requests;
        this.offers = offers;
        this.deliveries = deliveries;
        this.history = history;
        this.rideService = rideService;
        this.membership = membership;
        this.keycloak = keycloak;
        this.notifier = notifier;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ empresa

    @Transactional
    public FreightResponse create(UUID companyId, String memberSub, CreateFreightRequest body) {
        Company company = membership.requireActiveMember(companyId, memberSub);
        LocalDateTime agora = LocalDateTime.now(clock);
        if (body.desiredDate().isBefore(agora.plusMinutes(MIN_LEAD_MINUTES))) {
            throw bad("A data desejada precisa ser daqui a pelo menos " + MIN_LEAD_MINUTES + " minutos.");
        }
        if (body.desiredDate().isAfter(agora.plusMonths(3))) {
            throw bad("A data desejada nÃ£o pode passar de 3 meses.");
        }
        String alvo = body.targetDriverSub() == null || body.targetDriverSub().isBlank()
                ? null : body.targetDriverSub().trim();
        if (alvo != null) {
            if (body.offeredPrice() == null) {
                throw bad("Na proposta direta, informe o valor oferecido ao motorista.");
            }
            if (membership.isActiveMember(companyId, alvo)) {
                throw bad("O motorista nÃ£o pode ser membro da prÃ³pria empresa.");
            }
            exigirMotorista(alvo);
        }

        FreightRequest f = new FreightRequest();
        f.setCompanyId(companyId);
        f.setCreatedBySub(memberSub);
        f.setTargetDriverSub(alvo);
        aplicarLugar(f, body.origin(), true);
        aplicarLugar(f, body.destination(), false);
        f.setDesiredDate(body.desiredDate());
        f.setPkg(Packages.from(body.pkg()));
        f.setOfferedPrice(body.offeredPrice());
        f.setNotes(body.notes() == null || body.notes().isBlank() ? null : body.notes().trim());
        f = requests.save(f);

        if (alvo != null) {
            notifier.driver(alvo, "FREIGHT_PROPOSAL", null, f.getId(),
                    company.displayName() + " propÃ´s um frete de " + f.getOriginCity() + " para "
                            + f.getDestinationCity() + " por R$ " + f.getOfferedPrice().toPlainString() + ".");
        }
        return view(f, company.displayName(), true, null);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<FreightResponse> listForCompany(UUID companyId, String memberSub) {
        Company company = membership.requireActiveMember(companyId, memberSub);
        return requests.findByCompanyIdAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByCreatedAtDesc(companyId).stream()
                .map(f -> view(f, company.displayName(), true, null)).toList();
    }

    /** Detalhe: membro da empresa vÃª tudo; motorista (alvo ou de pedido pÃºblico aberto) vÃª o essencial. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public FreightResponse get(UUID id, String viewerSub) {
        FreightRequest f = requests.findById(id).filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrado);
        String nome = membership.displayName(f.getCompanyId());
        if (membership.isActiveMember(f.getCompanyId(), viewerSub)) {
            return view(f, nome, true, null);
        }
        boolean alvo = viewerSub.equals(f.getTargetDriverSub());
        boolean publicoAberto = !f.direct() && f.getStatus() == FreightStatus.OPEN;
        boolean ofertou = offers.findByRequestIdAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByPriceAsc(id).stream()
                .anyMatch(o -> o.getDriverSub().equals(viewerSub));
        if (!alvo && !publicoAberto && !ofertou) {
            throw naoEncontrado();
        }
        return view(f, nome, false, viewerSub);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<OfferResponse> offersFor(UUID id, String memberSub) {
        FreightRequest f = requests.findById(id).filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrado);
        membership.requireActiveMember(f.getCompanyId(), memberSub);
        return offers.findByRequestIdAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByPriceAsc(id).stream()
                .map(OfferResponse::of).toList();
    }

    @Transactional
    public FreightResponse cancel(UUID id, String memberSub) {
        FreightRequest f = requests.findByIdForUpdate(id).filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrado);
        Company company = membership.requireActiveMember(f.getCompanyId(), memberSub);
        exigirAberto(f);
        f.setStatus(FreightStatus.CANCELLED);
        f.setClosedAt(Instant.now(clock));
        for (FreightOffer o : offers.findByRequestIdAndStatus(id, OfferStatus.PENDING)) {
            o.setStatus(OfferStatus.DECLINED);
            offers.save(o);
            notifier.driver(o.getDriverSub(), "FREIGHT_OFFER_DECLINED", null, f.getId(),
                    company.displayName() + " cancelou o pedido de frete para " + f.getDestinationCity() + ".");
        }
        if (f.direct()) {
            notifier.driver(f.getTargetDriverSub(), "FREIGHT_CANCELLED", null, f.getId(),
                    company.displayName() + " cancelou a proposta de frete.");
        }
        return view(requests.save(f), company.displayName(), true, null);
    }

    /** A empresa escolhe uma oferta: fecha o frete; as outras ofertas sÃ£o recusadas. */
    @Transactional
    public FreightResponse acceptOffer(UUID id, UUID offerId, String memberSub) {
        FreightRequest f = requests.findByIdForUpdate(id).filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrado);
        Company company = membership.requireActiveMember(f.getCompanyId(), memberSub);
        exigirAberto(f);
        FreightOffer offer = offers.findById(offerId)
                .filter(o -> o.getRequestId().equals(id) && o.getStatus() == OfferStatus.PENDING)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Oferta nÃ£o encontrada."));

        fechar(f, company, offer.getDriverSub(), offer.getDriverName(), offer.getVehicleId(),
                offer.getPrice(), memberSub);
        offer.setStatus(OfferStatus.ACCEPTED);
        offers.save(offer);
        f.setAcceptedOfferId(offer.getId());
        notifier.driver(offer.getDriverSub(), "FREIGHT_OFFER_ACCEPTED", f.getRideId(), f.getId(),
                company.displayName() + " aceitou sua oferta de R$ " + offer.getPrice().toPlainString()
                        + ". A viagem jÃ¡ estÃ¡ nas suas viagens.");
        for (FreightOffer o : offers.findByRequestIdAndStatus(id, OfferStatus.PENDING)) {
            o.setStatus(OfferStatus.DECLINED);
            offers.save(o);
            notifier.driver(o.getDriverSub(), "FREIGHT_OFFER_DECLINED", null, f.getId(),
                    company.displayName() + " escolheu outra oferta para o frete atÃ© " + f.getDestinationCity() + ".");
        }
        return view(requests.save(f), company.displayName(), true, null);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ motorista

    /** Propostas diretas para mim, em aberto. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<FreightResponse> forMe(String driverSub) {
        return requests.findByTargetDriverSubAndStatusAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByDesiredDateAsc(
                        driverSub, FreightStatus.OPEN)
                .stream().map(f -> view(f, membership.displayName(f.getCompanyId()), false, driverSub)).toList();
    }

    /** Pedidos pÃºblicos com a origem perto de mim. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<FreightResponse> nearby(String driverSub, double lat, double lng, double radiusMeters) {
        GeoSupport.validate(lat, lng);
        if (radiusMeters <= 0 || radiusMeters > 100_000) {
            throw bad("O raio deve ser maior que zero e no mÃ¡ximo 100 km.");
        }
        List<UUID> minhasEmpresas = membership.companyIdsOf(driverSub);
        return requests.findOpenNearby(lat, lng, radiusMeters, LocalDateTime.now(clock)).stream()
                .filter(f -> !minhasEmpresas.contains(f.getCompanyId()))
                .map(f -> view(f, membership.displayName(f.getCompanyId()), false, driverSub)).toList();
    }

    /** Aceitar a proposta direta (escolhendo o veÃ­culo): vira viagem exclusiva + encomenda aceita. */
    @Transactional
    public FreightResponse acceptDirect(UUID id, String driverSub, String driverName, UUID vehicleId) {
        FreightRequest f = requests.findByIdForUpdate(id).filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrado);
        if (!driverSub.equals(f.getTargetDriverSub())) {
            throw naoEncontrado();
        }
        exigirAberto(f);
        Company company = companyOf(f);
        fechar(f, company, driverSub, driverName, vehicleId, f.getOfferedPrice(), f.getCreatedBySub());
        notifier.company(f.getCompanyId(), "FREIGHT_ACCEPTED", f.getRideId(), f.getId(),
                (driverName == null ? "O motorista" : driverName) + " aceitou o frete para " + f.getDestinationCity() + ".");
        return view(requests.save(f), company.displayName(), false, driverSub);
    }

    @Transactional
    public FreightResponse declineDirect(UUID id, String driverSub, String reason) {
        FreightRequest f = requests.findByIdForUpdate(id).filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrado);
        if (!driverSub.equals(f.getTargetDriverSub())) {
            throw naoEncontrado();
        }
        exigirAberto(f);
        f.setStatus(FreightStatus.DECLINED);
        f.setDeclineReason(reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? null : reason.trim());
        f.setClosedAt(Instant.now(clock));
        notifier.company(f.getCompanyId(), "FREIGHT_DECLINED", null, f.getId(),
                "O motorista recusou o frete para " + f.getDestinationCity() + "."
                        + (f.getDeclineReason() == null ? "" : " Motivo: " + f.getDeclineReason()));
        return view(requests.save(f), membership.displayName(f.getCompanyId()), false, driverSub);
    }

    /** Oferecer-se para um pedido pÃºblico. */
    @Transactional
    public OfferResponse offer(UUID id, String driverSub, String driverName, CreateOfferRequest body) {
        FreightRequest f = requests.findByIdForUpdate(id).filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrado);
        if (f.direct()) {
            throw naoEncontrado();
        }
        exigirAberto(f);
        if (membership.isActiveMember(f.getCompanyId(), driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "VocÃª nÃ£o pode se oferecer para um frete da sua empresa.");
        }
        if (offers.existsByRequestIdAndDriverSubAndStatus(id, driverSub, OfferStatus.PENDING)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "VocÃª jÃ¡ tem uma oferta para este frete.");
        }
        FreightOffer o = new FreightOffer();
        o.setRequestId(id);
        o.setDriverSub(driverSub);
        o.setDriverName(driverName);
        o.setVehicleId(vehicleId(body.vehicleId()));
        o.setPrice(body.price());
        o.setMessage(body.message() == null || body.message().isBlank() ? null : body.message().trim());
        o = offers.save(o);
        notifier.company(f.getCompanyId(), "FREIGHT_OFFER", null, f.getId(),
                (driverName == null ? "Um motorista" : driverName) + " ofereceu R$ " + body.price().toPlainString()
                        + " para o frete atÃ© " + f.getDestinationCity() + ".");
        return OfferResponse.of(o);
    }

    @Transactional
    public void withdrawOffer(UUID id, UUID offerId, String driverSub) {
        FreightOffer o = offers.findById(offerId)
                .filter(x -> x.getRequestId().equals(id) && x.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)
                        && x.getStatus() == OfferStatus.PENDING)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Oferta nÃ£o encontrada."));
        o.setStatus(OfferStatus.WITHDRAWN);
        offers.save(o);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<OfferResponse> myOffers(String driverSub) {
        return offers.findByDriverSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByCreatedAtDesc(driverSub,
                        List.of(OfferStatus.PENDING, OfferStatus.ACCEPTED, OfferStatus.DECLINED)).stream()
                .map(OfferResponse::of).toList();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ apoio

    /** Fecha o frete: viagem exclusiva do motorista + encomenda jÃ¡ aceita (em nome da empresa). */
    private void fechar(FreightRequest f, Company company, String driverSub, String driverName, UUID vehicleId,
                        BigDecimal price, String senderSub) {
        if (!f.getDesiredDate().isAfter(LocalDateTime.now(clock))) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "A data do frete jÃ¡ passou.");
        }
        PackageDetails pkg = f.getPkg();
        CargoDetails cargo = new CargoDetails();
        cargo.setMaxWeightKg(pkg.getWeightKg());
        cargo.setMaxLengthCm(BigDecimal.valueOf(pkg.getLengthCm()));
        cargo.setMaxWidthCm(BigDecimal.valueOf(pkg.getWidthCm()));
        cargo.setMaxHeightCm(BigDecimal.valueOf(pkg.getHeightCm()));
        cargo.setObservation("Frete para " + company.displayName());

        Place origem = new Place(f.getOriginLocation().getY(), f.getOriginLocation().getX(), f.getOriginAddress());
        Place destino = new Place(f.getDestinationLocation().getY(), f.getDestinationLocation().getX(), f.getDestinationAddress());
        Ride ride = rideService.createPrivateCargoRide(driverSub, driverName, vehicleId,
                f.getOriginCity(), f.getOriginState(), origem, f.getDestinationCity(), f.getDestinationState(), destino,
                f.getDesiredDate(), cargo);

        Delivery d = new Delivery();
        d.setRideId(ride.getId());
        d.setSenderSub(senderSub);
        d.setSenderName(company.displayName());
        d.setCompanyId(company.getId());
        d.setPkg(pkg.copy());
        d.setPickupLocation(ride.getOriginLocation());
        d.setPickupAddress(f.getOriginAddress());
        d.setDropoffLocation(ride.getDestinationLocation());
        d.setDropoffAddress(f.getDestinationAddress());
        d.setFullRoute(true);
        d.setPrice(price);
        d.setPlatformFeePercent(ride.getPlatformFeePercent());
        d.setTrackingCode(DeliveryCodes.trackingCode());
        d.setPickupCode(DeliveryCodes.pickupCode());
        d.setDeliveryKeyword(DeliveryCodes.keyword());
        d.setFreightRequestId(f.getId());

        d.confirm();
        d = deliveries.save(d);

        history.save(new DeliveryStatusHistory(
                d.getId(),
                DeliveryStatus.PENDING,
                DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED,
                senderSub,
                "Frete confirmado automaticamente."
        ));

        f.setStatus(FreightStatus.ACCEPTED);
        f.setRideId(ride.getId());
        f.setDeliveryId(d.getId());
        f.setClosedAt(Instant.now(clock));
        log.info("Frete {} fechado: viagem {} encomenda {}", f.getId(), ride.getId(), d.getId());
    }

    private FreightResponse view(FreightRequest f, String companyName, boolean companyView, String driverSub) {
        long pendentes = offers.countByRequestIdAndStatus(f.getId(), OfferStatus.PENDING);
        OfferResponse minha = driverSub == null ? null
                : offers.findByRequestIdAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByPriceAsc(f.getId()).stream()
                .filter(o -> o.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub) && o.getStatus() != OfferStatus.WITHDRAWN)
                .findFirst().map(OfferResponse::of).orElse(null);
        return FreightResponse.of(f, companyName, companyView, pendentes, minha);
    }

    private void aplicarLugar(FreightRequest f, FreightPlace p, boolean origem) {
        if (origem) {
            f.setOriginCity(p.city().trim());
            f.setOriginState(p.state().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
            f.setOriginLocation(GeoSupport.point(p.latitude(), p.longitude()));
            f.setOriginAddress(p.address());
        } else {
            f.setDestinationCity(p.city().trim());
            f.setDestinationState(p.state().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
            f.setDestinationLocation(GeoSupport.point(p.latitude(), p.longitude()));
            f.setDestinationAddress(p.address());
        }
    }

    private void exigirMotorista(String sub) {
        List<String> roles;
        try {
            roles = keycloak.effectiveRealmRoles(sub);
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            throw bad("Motorista nÃ£o encontrado.");
        }
        if (roles == null || !roles.contains("DRIVER")) {
            throw bad("Esta pessoa nÃ£o Ã© motorista verificado no Raiji.");
        }
    }

    private static UUID vehicleId(UUID id) {
        if (id == null) throw bad("Escolha o veÃ­culo.");
        return id;
    }

    private Company companyOf(FreightRequest f) {
        // o motorista nÃ£o Ã© membro: carrega a empresa sem checar participaÃ§Ã£o
        return membership.company(f.getCompanyId());
    }

    private static void exigirAberto(FreightRequest f) {
        if (f.getStatus() != FreightStatus.OPEN) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Este frete nÃ£o estÃ¡ mais em aberto.");
        }
    }

    private static ResponseStatusException bad(String msg) {
        return new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, msg);
    }

    private ResponseStatusException naoEncontrado() {
        return new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Frete nÃ£o encontrado.");
    }
}

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/service/DeliveryCodes.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.service;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * CÃ³digos da encomenda:
 * - coleta: 4 dÃ­gitos que o remetente mostra ao motorista;
 * - entrega: palavra-chave que o destinatÃ¡rio informa ao motorista;
 * - rastreamento: cÃ³digo pÃºblico para identificar a encomenda.
 */
public final class DeliveryCodes {

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private static final List<String> WORDS = List.of(
            "SOL", "LUA", "MAR", "RIO", "CEU", "FLOR", "MEL", "PAZ", "LUZ", "SAL",
            "COCO", "CAJU", "MANGA", "UVA", "PERA", "NUVEM", "ONDA", "PEDRA", "FOLHA", "VENTO",
            "IPE", "ARARA", "TATU", "BOTO", "SABIA", "CAQUI", "AREIA", "BRISA", "CORAL", "LAGO"
    );

    /**
     * Erros seguidos permitidos antes de bloquear a confirmaÃ§Ã£o.
     */
    public static final int MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS = 5;

    private DeliveryCodes() {
    }

    /**
     * CÃ³digo de coleta com quatro dÃ­gitos.
     */
    public static String pickupCode() {
        return String.format("%04d", RANDOM.nextInt(10_000));
    }

    /**
     * Palavra-chave de entrega.
     */
    public static String keyword() {
        return WORDS.get(RANDOM.nextInt(WORDS.size()))
                + "-"
                + String.format("%02d", RANDOM.nextInt(100));
    }

    /**
     * CÃ³digo de rastreamento:
     * R + 19 caracteres hexadecimais = 20 caracteres.
     */
    public static String trackingCode() {
        return "R" + UUID.randomUUID()
                .toString()
                .replace("-", "")
                .substring(0, 19)
                .toUpperCase();
    }

    /**
     * Compara ignorando maiÃºsculas, espaÃ§os e hÃ­fen.
     */
    public static boolean matches(String expected, String typed) {
        if (expected == null || typed == null) {
            return false;
        }

        return normalize(expected).equals(normalize(typed));
    }

    private static String normalize(String s) {
        return s.toUpperCase().replaceAll("[^A-Z0-9]", "");
    }
}

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/service/DeliveryNotifier.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.service;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.notification.NotificationRequested;
import com.raiji.deliveries.Delivery;
import com.raiji.users.company.CompanyMembership;
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/** Avisos das encomendas e dos fretes (remetente, membros da empresa, motorista). */
@Component
public class DeliveryNotifier {

    private final CompanyMembership membership;
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher events;

    public DeliveryNotifier(CompanyMembership membership, ApplicationEventPublisher events) {
        this.membership = membership;
        this.events = events;
    }

    /** Avisa quem enviou e, se for de empresa, todos os membros (na caixa "empresa"). */
    public void sender(Delivery d, String kind, String message) {
        if (d.getCompanyId() != null) {
            company(d.getCompanyId(), kind, d.getRideId(), d.getId(), message);
        }
        if (d.getCompanyId() == null || !membership.isActiveMember(d.getCompanyId(), d.getSenderSub())) {
            send(d.getSenderSub(), "PASSENGER", kind, d.getRideId(), d.getId(), message);
        }
    }

    public void company(UUID companyId, String kind, UUID rideId, UUID refId, String message) {
        membership.activeMemberSubs(companyId).stream().filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct()
                .forEach(sub -> send(sub, "COMPANY", kind, rideId, refId, message));
    }

    public void driver(String driverSub, String kind, UUID rideId, UUID refId, String message) {
        send(driverSub, "DRIVER", kind, rideId, refId, message);
    }

    private void send(String sub, String audience, String kind, UUID rideId, UUID refId, String message) {
        events.publishEvent(new NotificationRequested(sub, audience, kind, rideId, refId, message));
    }
}

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/service/DeliveryRideBookings.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.enums.DeliveryStatus;
import com.raiji.deliveries.Delivery;
import com.raiji.deliveries.DeliveryStatusHistory;
import com.raiji.deliveries.repository.DeliveryRepository;
import com.raiji.deliveries.repository.DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository;
import com.raiji.rides.cargo.CargoLoad;
import com.raiji.rides.cargo.RidePackageBookings;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

/** O mÃ³dulo de encomendas responde ao de caronas: carga ocupada e o que fazer em cada momento da viagem. */
@Component
public class DeliveryRideBookings implements RidePackageBookings {

    private final DeliveryRepository deliveries;
    private final DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository history;
    private final DeliveryNotifier notifier;

    public DeliveryRideBookings(DeliveryRepository deliveries,
                                DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository history,
                                DeliveryNotifier notifier) {
        this.deliveries = deliveries;
        this.history = history;
        this.notifier = notifier;
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CargoLoad confirmedLoad(UUID rideId) {
        CargoLoad total = CargoLoad.NONE;
        for (Delivery d : deliveries.findByRideIdAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId,
                List.of(DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED, DeliveryStatus.IN_TRANSIT))) {
            total = total.plus(Packages.load(d.getPkg()));
        }
        return total;
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional
    public void rejectPending(UUID rideId, String reason) {
        closeAll(rideId, List.of(DeliveryStatus.PENDING), reason, "DELIVERY_REJECTED");
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional
    public void cancelNotPickedUp(UUID rideId, String reason) {
        closeAll(rideId, List.of(DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED), reason, "DELIVERY_CANCELLED");
    }

    @Override
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public boolean hasActive(UUID rideId) {
        return !deliveries.findByRideIdAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId,
                List.of(DeliveryStatus.PENDING, DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED, DeliveryStatus.IN_TRANSIT)).isEmpty();
    }

    private void closeAll(UUID rideId, List<DeliveryStatus> statuses, String reason, String kind) {
        for (Delivery d : deliveries.findByRideIdAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId, statuses)) {
            DeliveryStatus previous = d.getStatus();

            d.cancel(reason);
            d = deliveries.save(d);

            history.save(new DeliveryStatusHistory(
                    d.getId(),
                    previous,
                    DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED,
                    null,
                    reason
            ));

            notifier.sender(d, kind, "Sua encomenda nÃ£o vai nesta carona. Motivo: " + reason);
        }
    }
}

package com.raiji.deliveries.service;

import com.raiji.common.enums.DeliveryStatus;
import com.raiji.common.enums.RideStatus;
import com.raiji.common.enums.RideType;
import com.raiji.deliveries.Delivery;
import com.raiji.deliveries.DeliveryStatusHistory;
import com.raiji.deliveries.PackageDetails;
import com.raiji.deliveries.dto.*;
import com.raiji.deliveries.repository.DeliveryRepository;
import com.raiji.deliveries.repository.DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository;
import com.raiji.rides.cargo.CargoCapacityService;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.RideVisibility;
import com.raiji.rides.geo.GeoSupport;
import com.raiji.rides.geo.Place;
import com.raiji.rides.pricing.SegmentPricing;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideRepository;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideRouteMatch;
import com.raiji.users.company.CompanyMembership;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import com.raiji.deliveries.DeliveryMode;
import com.raiji.rides.cargo.CargoLoad;
import com.raiji.users.domain.Vehicle;
import com.raiji.users.repository.VehicleRepository;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Encomendas como espaÃ§o de carga numa carona.
 *
 * PENDING -> CONFIRMED -> IN_TRANSIT -> DELIVERED
 * Recusa/cancelamento -> CANCELLED.
 */
@Service
public class DeliveryService {

    static final double MAX_DETOUR_METERS = 5_000;

    private final DeliveryRepository deliveries;
    private final DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository history;
    private final RideRepository rides;
    private final CargoCapacityService capacity;
    private final CompanyMembership membership;
    private final DeliveryNotifier notifier;
    private final Clock clock;
    private final TrackingCodeGenerator trackingCodeGenerator;
    private final VehicleRepository vehicles;


    public DeliveryService(
            DeliveryRepository deliveries,
            DeliveryStatusHistoryRepository history,
            RideRepository rides,
            CargoCapacityService capacity,
            CompanyMembership membership,
            DeliveryNotifier notifier,
            Clock clock,
            TrackingCodeGenerator trackingCodeGenerator,
            VehicleRepository vehicles) {

        this.deliveries = deliveries;
        this.history = history;
        this.rides = rides;
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.membership = membership;
        this.notifier = notifier;
        this.clock = clock;
        this.trackingCodeGenerator = trackingCodeGenerator;
        this.vehicles = vehicles;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Solicitar encomenda
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    @Transactional
    public DeliveryResponse request(
            UUID rideId,
            String senderSub,
            String tokenName,
            DeliveryCreateRequest body) {

        Ride ride = rides.findById(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null
                        && r.getVisibility() == RideVisibility.PUBLIC)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."));

        if (ride.getDriverSub().equals(senderSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o pode enviar encomenda na sua prÃ³pria carona.");
        }

        if (!ride.carriesPackages()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta carona nÃ£o leva encomendas.");
        }

        if (!ride.openForBookings()
                || !ride.getDepartureDate().isAfter(LocalDateTime.now(clock))) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta carona nÃ£o estÃ¡ aceitando encomendas.");
        }

        if (body.companyId() != null) {
            membership.requireActiveMember(body.companyId(), senderSub);
        }

        PackageDetails pkg = Packages.from(body.pkg());

        capacity.assertItemDimensions(
                ride,
                pkg.getLengthCm(),
                pkg.getWidthCm(),
                pkg.getHeightCm());

        capacity.assertFits(ride, Packages.load(pkg), null);

        Delivery d = new Delivery();

        d.setTrackingCode(DeliveryCodes.trackingCode());
        d.setRideId(rideId);
        d.setSenderSub(senderSub);
        d.setSenderName(nome(body.senderName(), tokenName));
        d.setCompanyId(body.companyId());
        d.setPkg(pkg);
        d.setPlatformFeePercent(ride.getPlatformFeePercent());

        aplicarTrecho(ride, d, body.pickup(), body.dropoff());

        d.setPickupCode(DeliveryCodes.pickupCode());
        d.setDeliveryKeyword(DeliveryCodes.keyword());

        // Salva primeiro para obter o ID da encomenda.
        d = deliveries.save(d);

        // HistÃ³rico inicial: null -> PENDING.
        registrarHistorico(
                d,
                null,
                senderSub,
                "Encomenda solicitada.");

        notifier.driver(
                ride.getDriverSub(),
                "DELIVERY_REQUEST",
                ride.getId(),
                d.getId(),
                "Novo pedido de encomenda (" + pkg.getSize()
                        + ", " + pkg.getWeightKg().stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString()
                        + " kg) na sua carona para "
                        + ride.getDestinationCity() + ".");

        return DeliveryResponse.of(d, ride, true);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Listar encomendas da carona
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * VisÃ£o do motorista: encomendas da carona, sem os cÃ³digos.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<DeliveryResponse> listForDriver(UUID rideId, String driverSub) {
        Ride ride = rideDoMotorista(rideId, driverSub, false);

        return deliveries.findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId)
                .stream()
                .map(d -> DeliveryResponse.of(d, ride, false))
                .toList();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Aceitar ou recusar
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    @Transactional
    public DeliveryResponse decide(
            UUID rideId,
            UUID deliveryId,
            String driverSub,
            boolean accept,
            String reason) {

        Ride ride = rideDoMotorista(rideId, driverSub, true);

        if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "A viagem jÃ¡ comeÃ§ou.");
        }

        Delivery d = daCarona(rideId, deliveryId);

        if (d.getStatus() != DeliveryStatus.PENDING) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Este pedido jÃ¡ foi decidido.");
        }

        DeliveryStatus statusAnterior = d.getStatus();
        String motivoHistorico;

        if (accept) {
            capacity.assertFits(ride, Packages.load(d.getPkg()), null);

            d.setDriverSub(driverSub);
            d.setRideId(ride.getId());

            d.confirm();

            motivoHistorico = "Encomenda aceita pelo motorista.";

            notifier.sender(
                    d,
                    "DELIVERY_ACCEPTED",
                    ride.getDriverName()
                            + " aceitou levar sua encomenda para "
                            + d.getPkg().getRecipientName()
                            + ". Na coleta, mostre o cÃ³digo "
                            + d.getPickupCode() + ".");

        } else {
            if (reason == null || reason.isBlank()) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Informe o motivo da recusa.");
            }

            motivoHistorico = reason.trim();

            d.cancel(motivoHistorico);

            notifier.sender(
                    d,
                    "DELIVERY_REJECTED",
                    ride.getDriverName()
                            + " nÃ£o pode levar sua encomenda. Motivo: "
                            + motivoHistorico);
        }

        d = deliveries.save(d);

        registrarHistorico(
                d,
                statusAnterior,
                driverSub,
                motivoHistorico);

        return DeliveryResponse.of(d, ride, false);
    }
    @Transactional
    public DeliveryAcceptanceResponse accept(
            UUID deliveryId,
            String driverSub,
            DeliveryAcceptanceRequest body) {

        Delivery delivery = deliveries.findByIdForUpdate(deliveryId)
                .filter(d -> d.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);

        if (delivery.getStatus() != DeliveryStatus.PENDING) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta encomenda nÃ£o estÃ¡ mais disponÃ­vel.");
        }

        if (delivery.getSenderSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o pode aceitar sua prÃ³pria encomenda.");
        }

        Ride ride = null;
        Vehicle vehicle;
        DeliveryMode mode;

        if (body.rideId() != null) {
            // Modalidade ON_ROUTE.
            ride = rideDoMotorista(body.rideId(), driverSub, true);

            if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED
                    || !ride.getDepartureDate().isAfter(LocalDateTime.now(clock))) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                        "A carona jÃ¡ comeÃ§ou ou nÃ£o estÃ¡ mais disponÃ­vel.");
            }

            if (!ride.carriesPackages()) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                        "Esta carona nÃ£o estÃ¡ habilitada para transportar encomendas.");
            }

            if (!sameText(delivery.getOriginCity(), ride.getOriginCity())
                    || !sameText(delivery.getOriginState(), ride.getOriginState())
                    || !sameText(delivery.getDestinationCity(), ride.getDestinationCity())
                    || !sameText(delivery.getDestinationState(), ride.getDestinationState())) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                        "A origem e o destino da encomenda nÃ£o correspondem Ã  rota da carona.");
            }

            vehicle = veiculoDoMotorista(ride.getVehicleId(), driverSub);

            if (body.vehicleId() != null && !body.vehicleId().equals(vehicle.getId())) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                        "O veÃ­culo informado nÃ£o Ã© o veÃ­culo utilizado pela carona.");
            }

            try {
                capacity.assertItemDimensions(
                        ride,
                        delivery.getPkg().getLengthCm(),
                        delivery.getPkg().getWidthCm(),
                        delivery.getPkg().getHeightCm());

                capacity.assertFits(
                        ride,
                        Packages.load(delivery.getPkg()),
                        null);
            } catch (ResponseStatusException exception) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                        exception.getReason() == null
                                ? "A encomenda excede a capacidade disponÃ­vel da carona."
                                : exception.getReason(),
                        exception);
            }

            mode = DeliveryMode.ON_ROUTE;

        } else {
            // Modalidade EXCLUSIVE.
            if (body.vehicleId() == null) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Informe o veÃ­culo para realizar o frete exclusivo.");
            }

            vehicle = veiculoDoMotorista(body.vehicleId(), driverSub);

            Integer availableVolume = vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters();

            if (availableVolume == null || availableVolume <= 0) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                        "O veÃ­culo nÃ£o possui capacidade de carga cadastrada.");
            }

            CargoLoad packageLoad = Packages.load(delivery.getPkg());

            if (packageLoad.volumeLiters().compareTo(
                    java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(availableVolume)) > 0) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                        "O volume da encomenda ("
                                + packageLoad.volumeLiters().stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString()
                                + " L) excede a capacidade do veÃ­culo ("
                                + availableVolume + " L).");
            }

            mode = DeliveryMode.EXCLUSIVE;
        }

        DeliveryStatus previousStatus = delivery.getStatus();

        delivery.setDriverSub(driverSub);
        delivery.setVehicleId(vehicle.getId());
        delivery.setRideId(ride == null ? null : ride.getId());
        delivery.setMode(mode);
        delivery.setAcceptedAt(clock.instant());

        delivery.confirm();

        delivery = deliveries.save(delivery);

        registrarHistorico(
                delivery,
                previousStatus,
                driverSub,
                mode == DeliveryMode.ON_ROUTE
                        ? "Encomenda aceita para transporte junto a uma carona."
                        : "Encomenda aceita para frete exclusivo.");

        notifier.sender(
                delivery,
                "DELIVERY_ACCEPTED",
                "Seu pedido foi aceito pelo motorista."
                        + (mode == DeliveryMode.EXCLUSIVE
                        ? " O transporte serÃ¡ realizado como frete exclusivo."
                        : " O transporte serÃ¡ realizado junto a uma carona."));

        return DeliveryAcceptanceResponse.of(delivery);
    }

    @Transactional
    public DeliveryAcceptanceResponse decline(
            UUID deliveryId,
            String driverSub,
            String reason) {

        Delivery delivery = deliveries.findByIdForUpdate(deliveryId)
                .filter(d -> d.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);

        if (delivery.getStatus() != DeliveryStatus.PENDING) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta encomenda nÃ£o estÃ¡ mais disponÃ­vel.");
        }

        if (reason == null || reason.isBlank()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Informe o motivo da recusa.");
        }

        String normalizedReason = reason.trim();

        registrarHistorico(
                delivery,
                DeliveryStatus.PENDING,
                driverSub,
                "Pedido recusado pelo motorista: " + normalizedReason);

        notifier.sender(
                delivery,
                "DELIVERY_REJECTED",
                "Um motorista recusou sua encomenda. Motivo: " + normalizedReason);

        return DeliveryAcceptanceResponse.of(delivery);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Coletar encomenda
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * O motorista informa o cÃ³digo de coleta.
     *
     * noRollbackFor preserva tentativas erradas de cÃ³digo.
     */
    @Transactional(noRollbackFor = ResponseStatusException.class)
    public DeliveryResponse pickUp(
            UUID deliveryId,
            String driverSub,
            String code) {

        Delivery d = deliveries.findById(deliveryId)
                .filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);

        Ride ride = null;

        if (d.getRideId() != null) {
            // Encomenda vinculada a uma carona.
            ride = rideDoMotorista(d.getRideId(), driverSub, false);

            if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED
                    && ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                        "Esta viagem nÃ£o estÃ¡ ativa.");
            }

        } else {
            // Encomenda de frete exclusivo.
            if (d.getDriverSub() == null
                    || !d.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                        "Esta encomenda nÃ£o pertence a este motorista.");
            }
        }

        if (d.getStatus() != DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta encomenda nÃ£o estÃ¡ aguardando coleta.");
        }

        conferirCodigo(
                d,
                d.getPickupCode(),
                code,
                "CÃ³digo de coleta incorreto.");

        DeliveryStatus statusAnterior = d.getStatus();

        d.pickUp();

        d = deliveries.save(d);

        registrarHistorico(
                d,
                statusAnterior,
                driverSub,
                "Coleta confirmada pelo motorista.");

        notifier.sender(
                d,
                "DELIVERY_PICKED_UP",
                "Sua encomenda foi coletada pelo motorista e estÃ¡ a caminho.");

        return DeliveryResponse.of(d, ride, false);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Entregar encomenda
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * O motorista informa a palavra-chave do destinatÃ¡rio.
     */
    @Transactional(noRollbackFor = ResponseStatusException.class)
    public DeliveryResponse deliver(
            UUID deliveryId,
            String driverSub,
            String keyword) {

        Delivery d = deliveries.findById(deliveryId)
                .filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);

        Ride ride = null;

        if (d.getRideId() != null) {
            // Encomenda vinculada a uma carona.
            ride = rideDoMotorista(d.getRideId(), driverSub, false);

        } else {
            // Encomenda de frete exclusivo.
            if (d.getDriverSub() == null
                    || !d.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                        "Esta encomenda nÃ£o pertence a este motorista.");
            }
        }

        if (d.getStatus() != DeliveryStatus.IN_TRANSIT) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta encomenda nÃ£o estÃ¡ em trÃ¢nsito.");
        }

        conferirCodigo(
                d,
                d.getDeliveryKeyword(),
                keyword,
                "Palavra-chave incorreta.");

        DeliveryStatus statusAnterior = d.getStatus();

        d.deliver();

        d = deliveries.save(d);

        registrarHistorico(
                d,
                statusAnterior,
                driverSub,
                "Entrega confirmada pelo motorista.");

        notifier.sender(
                d,
                "DELIVERY_DELIVERED",
                "Sua encomenda foi entregue para "
                        + d.getPkg().getRecipientName() + ".");

        return DeliveryResponse.of(d, ride, false);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Cancelar encomenda
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Cancelar antes da coleta:
     * remetente, membro ativo da empresa ou motorista.
     */
    @Transactional
    public DeliveryResponse cancel(
            UUID deliveryId,
            String actorSub,
            String reason) {

        Delivery d = deliveries.findById(deliveryId)
                .filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);

        Ride ride = null;

        boolean motorista;

        if (d.getRideId() != null) {
            ride = rides.findById(d.getRideId())
                    .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);

            motorista = ride.getDriverSub().equals(actorSub);

        } else {
            motorista = d.getDriverSub() != null
                    && d.getDriverSub().equals(actorSub);
        }

        boolean remetente = podeVerComoRemetente(d, actorSub);

        if (!remetente && !motorista) {
            throw naoEncontrada();
        }

        if (d.getStatus() != DeliveryStatus.PENDING
                && d.getStatus() != DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "SÃ³ dÃ¡ para cancelar antes da coleta (status atual: "
                            + d.getStatus() + ").");
        }

        String motivo = reason == null || reason.isBlank()
                ? null
                : reason.trim();

        DeliveryStatus statusAnterior = d.getStatus();

        d.cancel(motivo);

        d = deliveries.save(d);

        registrarHistorico(
                d,
                statusAnterior,
                actorSub,
                motivo != null ? motivo : "Encomenda cancelada.");

        if (motorista && !remetente) {
            notifier.sender(
                    d, "DELIVERY_CANCELLED",
                    "O motorista cancelou o transporte da sua encomenda."
                            + (motivo == null ? "" : " Motivo: " + motivo));
        } else if (remetente) {
            String motoristaSub = d.getDriverSub() != null
                    ? d.getDriverSub()
                    : (ride != null ? ride.getDriverSub() : null);

            if (motoristaSub != null) {
                notifier.driver(
                        motoristaSub,
                        "DELIVERY_CANCELLED",
                        d.getRideId(),
                        d.getId(),
                        "Uma encomenda do seu transporte foi cancelada pelo remetente."
                                + (motivo == null ? "" : " Motivo: " + motivo));
            }
        }

        return DeliveryResponse.of(d, ride, remetente);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Consultar encomenda
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public DeliveryResponse get(UUID deliveryId, String viewerSub) {
        Delivery d = deliveries.findById(deliveryId)
                .filter(x -> x.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);

        // Entregas independentes: somente o remetente.
        if (d.getRideId() == null) {
            if (!d.getSenderSub().equals(viewerSub)) {
                throw naoEncontrada();
            }

            return DeliveryResponse.of(d, null, true);
        }

        // Entregas vinculadas a caronas: mantÃ©m as regras antigas.
        Ride ride = rides.findById(d.getRideId()).orElse(null);

        boolean remetente = podeVerComoRemetente(d, viewerSub);
        boolean motorista = ride != null
                && ride.getDriverSub().equals(viewerSub);

        if (!remetente && !motorista) {
            throw naoEncontrada();
        }

        return DeliveryResponse.of(d, ride, remetente);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Minhas encomendas
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Minhas encomendas como remetente, incluindo as empresas.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<DeliveryResponse> mine(String senderSub) {
        List<UUID> empresas = membership.companyIdsOf(senderSub);

        List<Delivery> lista = deliveries.findMine(
                senderSub,
                empresas.isEmpty()
                        ? List.of(new UUID(0, 0))
                        : empresas);

        Map<UUID, Ride> porId = ridesDe(lista);

        return lista.stream()
                .map(d -> DeliveryResponse.of(
                        d,
                        porId.get(d.getRideId()),
                        true))
                .toList();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Encomendas transportadas pelo motorista
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Encomendas que eu levo como motorista.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<DeliveryResponse> driving(String driverSub) {
        List<UUID> minhas = rides
                .findByDriverSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByDepartureDateAsc(
                        driverSub,
                        List.of(
                                RideStatus.PLANNED,
                                RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
                                RideStatus.COMPLETED))
                .stream()
                .map(Ride::getId)
                .toList();

        if (minhas.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        }

        List<Delivery> lista = deliveries.findByRideIds(minhas);
        Map<UUID, Ride> porId = ridesDe(lista);

        return lista.stream()
                .map(d -> DeliveryResponse.of(
                        d,
                        porId.get(d.getRideId()),
                        false))
                .toList();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
