    /**
     * Registra uma alteraÃ§Ã£o de status.
     */
    private void registrarHistorico(
            Delivery delivery,
            DeliveryStatus statusAnterior,
            String actorSub,
            String reason) {

        history.save(
                new DeliveryStatusHistory(
                        delivery.getId(),
                        statusAnterior,
                        delivery.getStatus(),
                        actorSub,
                        reason));
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Apoio
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Remetente: quem enviou ou membro ativo da empresa.
     */
    boolean podeVerComoRemetente(Delivery d, String sub) {
        return d.getSenderSub().equals(sub)
                || (d.getCompanyId() != null
                && membership.isActiveMember(d.getCompanyId(), sub));
    }

    private void conferirCodigo(
            Delivery d,
            String esperado,
            String digitado,
            String mensagemErro) {

        if (d.getFailedCodeAttempts()
                >= DeliveryCodes.MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS) {

            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
                    "Muitas tentativas erradas. Fale com o remetente pelo chat ou com o suporte.");
        }

        if (!DeliveryCodes.matches(esperado, digitado)) {
            d.setFailedCodeAttempts(
                    d.getFailedCodeAttempts() + 1);

            deliveries.saveAndFlush(d);

            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    mensagemErro);
        }
    }

    private void aplicarTrecho(
            Ride ride,
            Delivery d,
            Place pickup,
            Place dropoff) {

        d.setFullRoute(true);
        d.setPrice(ride.getPricePerPackage());

        if (pickup == null && dropoff == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (ride.getRoute() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Esta carona nÃ£o tem rota no mapa: a coleta e a entrega sÃ£o na origem e no destino.");
        }

        double pLat = pickup != null
                ? pickup.latitude()
                : ride.getOriginLocation().getY();

        double pLng = pickup != null
                ? pickup.longitude()
                : ride.getOriginLocation().getX();

        double dLat = dropoff != null
                ? dropoff.latitude()
                : ride.getDestinationLocation().getY();

        double dLng = dropoff != null
                ? dropoff.longitude()
                : ride.getDestinationLocation().getX();

        RideRouteMatch m = rides.locateOnRoute(
                        ride.getId(),
                        pLat,
                        pLng,
                        dLat,
                        dLng)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Rota da carona indisponÃ­vel."));

        if (m.getPickupDistance() > MAX_DETOUR_METERS
                || m.getDropoffDistance() > MAX_DETOUR_METERS) {

            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "A coleta ou a entrega fica longe demais do caminho desta carona (mÃ¡ximo 5 km).");
        }

        if (m.getDropoffFraction() <= m.getPickupFraction()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "A entrega precisa vir depois da coleta, no sentido da viagem.");
        }

        double fraction = SegmentPricing.fraction(
                m.getPickupFraction(),
                m.getDropoffFraction());

        d.setFullRoute(SegmentPricing.isFullRoute(fraction));
        d.setPrice(SegmentPricing.price(
                ride.getPricePerPackage(),
                fraction));

        if (pickup != null) {
            d.setPickupLocation(
                    GeoSupport.point(
                            pickup.latitude(),
                            pickup.longitude()));

            d.setPickupAddress(pickup.address());
        }

        if (dropoff != null) {
            d.setDropoffLocation(
                    GeoSupport.point(
                            dropoff.latitude(),
                            dropoff.longitude()));

            d.setDropoffAddress(dropoff.address());
        }
    }

    private Ride rideDoMotorista(
            UUID rideId,
            String driverSub,
            boolean lock) {

        Ride ride = (lock
                ? rides.findByIdForUpdate(rideId)
                : rides.findById(rideId))
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."));

        if (!ride.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "Esta carona Ã© de outro motorista.");
        }

        return ride;
    }

    private Delivery daCarona(
            UUID rideId,
            UUID deliveryId) {

        return deliveries.findById(deliveryId)
                .filter(d -> d.getDeletedAt() == null
                        && d.getRideId().equals(rideId))
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);
    }

    private Map<UUID, Ride> ridesDe(List<Delivery> lista) {
        return rides.findAllById(
                        lista.stream()
                                .map(Delivery::getRideId)
                                .distinct()
                                .toList())
                .stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                        Ride::getId,
                        Function.identity()));
    }

    private static String nome(
            String informado,
            String doToken) {

        String n = informado != null && !informado.isBlank()
                ? informado
                : doToken;

        return n == null ? null : n.trim();
    }

    private ResponseStatusException naoEncontrada() {
        return new ResponseStatusException(
                HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                "Encomenda nÃ£o encontrada.");
    }
    private Vehicle veiculoDoMotorista(UUID vehicleId, String driverSub) {

        Vehicle vehicle = vehicles.findByIdForUpdate(vehicleId)
                .filter(v -> v.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "VeÃ­culo nÃ£o encontrado."));

        if (!vehicle.getOwnerSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "Este veÃ­culo pertence a outro motorista.");
        }

        if (!vehicle.isActive()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "O veÃ­culo estÃ¡ inativo.");
        }

        return vehicle;
    }
    // ---------------------------------------------------------
// Criar entrega independente de carona
// ---------------------------------------------------------
    @Transactional
    public DeliverySummaryResponse create(
            String senderSub,
            String tokenName,
            DeliveryRequest body) {

        String originCity = body.originCity().trim();
        String originState = body.originState().trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String originAddress = body.originAddress().trim();

        String destinationCity = body.destinationCity().trim();
        String destinationState = body.destinationState().trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String destinationAddress = body.destinationAddress().trim();

        // Impede uma entrega com origem e destino iguais.
        if (originCity.equalsIgnoreCase(destinationCity)
                && originState.equals(destinationState)
                && originAddress.equalsIgnoreCase(destinationAddress)) {

            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "A origem e o destino da entrega nÃ£o podem ser iguais.");
        }

        PackageDetails pkg = new PackageDetails();

        pkg.setSize(null);
        pkg.setDescription(body.description());
        pkg.setWeightKg(body.weightKg());
        pkg.setLengthCm(body.lengthCm());
        pkg.setWidthCm(body.widthCm());
        pkg.setHeightCm(body.heightCm());
        pkg.setFragile(false);
        pkg.setDeclaredValue(null);
        pkg.setRecipientName(body.recipientName());
        pkg.setRecipientPhone(body.recipientContact());

        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.setTrackingCode(trackingCodeGenerator.generate());
        delivery.setRequestedAt(clock.instant());

        // Entrega independente: ainda nÃ£o possui carona.
        delivery.setRideId(null);
        delivery.setMode(body.mode());

        delivery.setOriginCity(originCity);
        delivery.setOriginState(originState);
        delivery.setOriginAddress(originAddress);

        delivery.setDestinationCity(destinationCity);
        delivery.setDestinationState(destinationState);
        delivery.setDestinationAddress(destinationAddress);

        delivery.setPickupAddress(originAddress);
        delivery.setDropoffAddress(destinationAddress);

        delivery.setSenderSub(senderSub);
        delivery.setSenderName(nome(null, tokenName));
        delivery.setPkg(pkg);

        delivery.setPickupCode(DeliveryCodes.pickupCode());
        delivery.setDeliveryKeyword(DeliveryCodes.keyword());

        delivery.setPlatformFeePercent(java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO);
        delivery.setFullRoute(true);

        // CotaÃ§Ã£o serÃ¡ preenchida pela integraÃ§Ã£o de distÃ¢ncia e preÃ§o.
        delivery.setDistanceKm(null);
        delivery.setQuotedPriceCents(null);

        delivery = deliveries.save(delivery);

        registrarHistorico(
                delivery,
                null,
                senderSub,
                "Entrega independente solicitada.");

        return DeliverySummaryResponse.of(delivery);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<DeliverySummaryResponse> mine(
            String senderSub,
            Pageable pageable) {

        return deliveries
                .findBySenderSubAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByRequestedAtDesc(
                        senderSub,
                        pageable)
                .map(DeliverySummaryResponse::of);
    }
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<AvailableDeliveryResponse> available(String driverSub) {

        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(clock);

        List<Ride> driverRides = rides
                .findByDriverSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByDepartureDateAsc(
                        driverSub,
                        List.of(RideStatus.PLANNED))
                .stream()
                .filter(Ride::openForBookings)
                .filter(ride -> ride.getType() == RideType.CARGO
                        || ride.getType() == RideType.MIXED)
                .filter(ride -> ride.getDepartureDate() != null
                        && ride.getDepartureDate().isAfter(now))
                .toList();

        if (driverRides.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        }

        List<Delivery> pendingDeliveries = deliveries
                .findByStatusAndRideIdIsNullAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByRequestedAtDesc(
                        DeliveryStatus.PENDING);

        return pendingDeliveries.stream()
                .map(delivery -> {
                    List<AvailableDeliveryResponse.RideMatch> matches =
                            driverRides.stream()
                                    .filter(ride -> matchesRoute(delivery, ride))
                                    .filter(ride -> fitsCapacity(delivery, ride))
                                    .map(ride -> new AvailableDeliveryResponse.RideMatch(
                                            ride.getId(),
                                            ride.getOriginCity(),
                                            ride.getOriginState(),
                                            ride.getDestinationCity(),
                                            ride.getDestinationState(),
                                            ride.getDepartureDate()))
                                    .toList();

                    return matches.isEmpty()
                            ? null
                            : AvailableDeliveryResponse.of(delivery, matches);
                })
                .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
                .toList();
    }

    private boolean matchesRoute(Delivery delivery, Ride ride) {
        return sameText(delivery.getOriginCity(), ride.getOriginCity())
                && sameText(delivery.getOriginState(), ride.getOriginState())
                && sameText(delivery.getDestinationCity(), ride.getDestinationCity())
                && sameText(delivery.getDestinationState(), ride.getDestinationState());
    }

    private boolean sameText(String first, String second) {
        return first != null
                && second != null
                && first.trim().equalsIgnoreCase(second.trim());
    }

    private boolean fitsCapacity(Delivery delivery, Ride ride) {
        PackageDetails pkg = delivery.getPkg();

        try {
            capacity.assertItemDimensions(
                    ride,
                    pkg.getLengthCm(),
                    pkg.getWidthCm(),
                    pkg.getHeightCm());

            capacity.assertFits(ride, Packages.load(pkg), null);

            return true;
        } catch (ResponseStatusException exception) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/service/Packages.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.service;

import com.raiji.deliveries.PackageDetails;
import com.raiji.deliveries.PackageSize;
import com.raiji.deliveries.dto.PackageRequest;
import com.raiji.rides.cargo.CargoLoad;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/** Monta e confere os dados do pacote. */
public final class Packages {

    private Packages() {
    }

    public static PackageDetails from(PackageRequest r) {
        PackageSize size = r.size();
        if (r.weightKg().compareTo(size.maxWeightKg) > 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "O peso passa do mÃ¡ximo para o tamanho " + size + " (" + size.maxWeightKg.toPlainString()
                            + " kg). Escolha um tamanho maior.");
        }
        PackageDetails p = new PackageDetails();
        p.setSize(size);
        p.setDescription(r.description().trim());
        p.setWeightKg(r.weightKg());
        p.setLengthCm(r.lengthCm() != null ? r.lengthCm() : size.lengthCm);
        p.setWidthCm(r.widthCm() != null ? r.widthCm() : size.widthCm);
        p.setHeightCm(r.heightCm() != null ? r.heightCm() : size.heightCm);
        p.setFragile(r.fragile());
        p.setDeclaredValue(r.declaredValue());
        p.setRecipientName(r.recipientName().trim());
        p.setRecipientPhone(r.recipientPhone().trim());
        return p;
    }

    public static CargoLoad load(PackageDetails p) {
        return CargoLoad.of(p.getLengthCm(), p.getWidthCm(), p.getHeightCm(), 1, p.getWeightKg());
    }
}

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/main/java/com/raiji/deliveries/service/TrackingCodeGenerator.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.service;

import java.security.SecureRandom;

import com.raiji.deliveries.repository.DeliveryRepository;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TrackingCodeGenerator {

    private static final String ALPHABET =
            "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";

    private static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 100;

    private final SecureRandom random = new SecureRandom();
    private final DeliveryRepository deliveries;

    public TrackingCodeGenerator(DeliveryRepository deliveries) {
        this.deliveries = deliveries;
    }

    public String generate() {
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
            String code = generateCandidate();

            if (!deliveries.existsByTrackingCode(code)) {
                return code;
            }
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel gerar um cÃ³digo de rastreamento Ãºnico."
        );
    }

    private String generateCandidate() {
        return "RM-" + randomPart(6) + "-" + randomPart(2);
    }

    private String randomPart(int length) {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(length);

        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            result.append(ALPHABET.charAt(
                    random.nextInt(ALPHABET.length())
            ));
        }

        return result.toString();
    }
}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deliveries (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    tracking_code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    access_key VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    ride_id UUID,
    sender_id UUID NOT NULL,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150),
    recipient_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    recipient_phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    recipient_document VARCHAR(14),
    zip_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
    street VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    neighborhood VARCHAR(100),
    city VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    state VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
    complement VARCHAR(100),
    delivered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    created_by VARCHAR(64),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
    updated_by VARCHAR(64),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    version BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT chk_access_key_length CHECK (length(access_key) = 6)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    delivery_id UUID NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    weight_kg NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    fragile BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    created_by VARCHAR(64),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
    updated_by VARCHAR(64),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
    version BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT chk_quantity_positive CHECK (quantity > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_deliveries_tracking ON deliveries(tracking_code);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_deliveries_status ON deliveries(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_items_delivery ON items(delivery_id);

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/test/java/com/raiji/deliveries/domain/DeliveryStatusHistoryTest.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.domain;

import com.raiji.common.enums.DeliveryStatus;
import com.raiji.deliveries.DeliveryStatusHistory;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class DeliveryStatusHistoryTest {

    @Test
    void deveCriarHistoricoComTodosOsCampos() {
        UUID deliveryId = UUID.randomUUID();
        Instant antes = Instant.now();

        DeliveryStatusHistory history = new DeliveryStatusHistory(
                deliveryId,
                DeliveryStatus.PENDING,
                DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED,
                "usuario-123",
                "Entrega confirmada"
        );

        Instant depois = Instant.now();

        assertNull(history.getId());
        assertEquals(deliveryId, history.getDeliveryId());
        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.PENDING, history.getFromStatus());
        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.CONFIRMED, history.getToStatus());
        assertEquals("usuario-123", history.getChangedBy());
        assertEquals("Entrega confirmada", history.getReason());

        assertNotNull(history.getCreatedAt());
        assertFalse(history.getCreatedAt().isBefore(antes));
        assertFalse(history.getCreatedAt().isAfter(depois));
    }

    @Test
    void deveCriarHistoricoInicialSemStatusAnterior() {
        UUID deliveryId = UUID.randomUUID();

        DeliveryStatusHistory history = new DeliveryStatusHistory(
                deliveryId,
                null,
                DeliveryStatus.PENDING,
                "sistema",
                "Entrega criada"
        );

        assertNull(history.getId());
        assertEquals(deliveryId, history.getDeliveryId());
        assertNull(history.getFromStatus());
        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.PENDING, history.getToStatus());
        assertEquals("sistema", history.getChangedBy());
        assertEquals("Entrega criada", history.getReason());
        assertNotNull(history.getCreatedAt());
    }

    @Test
    void devePermitirCamposOpcionaisNulos() {
        UUID deliveryId = UUID.randomUUID();

        DeliveryStatusHistory history = new DeliveryStatusHistory(
                deliveryId,
                DeliveryStatus.PENDING,
                DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED,
                null,
                null
        );

        assertEquals(deliveryId, history.getDeliveryId());
        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.PENDING, history.getFromStatus());
        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED, history.getToStatus());
        assertNull(history.getChangedBy());
        assertNull(history.getReason());
        assertNotNull(history.getCreatedAt());
    }
}

package com.raiji.deliveries.domain;

import com.raiji.common.enums.DeliveryStatus;
import com.raiji.deliveries.Delivery;
import com.raiji.deliveries.service.IllegalDeliveryStateException;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class DeliveryTest {

    @Test
    void deveIniciarComoPendenteEAtiva() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.PENDING, delivery.getStatus());
        assertTrue(delivery.active());
        assertNotNull(delivery.getRequestedAt());
    }

    @Test
    void deveConsiderarEntregaAtivaNosStatusPermitidos() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        assertTrue(delivery.active());

        delivery.confirm();
        assertTrue(delivery.active());

        delivery.pickUp();
        assertTrue(delivery.active());
    }

    @Test
    void deveConsiderarEntregaInativaQuandoEntregue() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.confirm();
        delivery.pickUp();
        delivery.deliver();

        assertFalse(delivery.active());
    }

    @Test
    void deveConsiderarEntregaInativaQuandoCancelada() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.cancel("Cancelamento solicitado");

        assertFalse(delivery.active());
    }

    @Test
    void deveCancelarEntregaPendente() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.cancel("Motivo");

        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED, delivery.getStatus());
        assertEquals("Motivo", delivery.getCancellationReason());
        assertNotNull(delivery.getCancelledAt());
    }

    @Test
    void deveCancelarEntregaConfirmada() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.confirm();
        delivery.cancel("Motivo");

        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED, delivery.getStatus());
    }

    @Test
    void deveCancelarEntregaEmTransito() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.confirm();
        delivery.pickUp();
        delivery.cancel("Motivo");

        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED, delivery.getStatus());
    }

    @Test
    void naoDeveCancelarEntregaEntregue() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.confirm();
        delivery.pickUp();
        delivery.deliver();

        assertThrows(
                IllegalDeliveryStateException.class,
                () -> delivery.cancel("Motivo")
        );
    }

    @Test
    void naoDeveCancelarEntregaJaCancelada() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.cancel("Primeiro cancelamento");

        assertThrows(
                IllegalDeliveryStateException.class,
                () -> delivery.cancel("Segundo cancelamento")
        );
    }

    @Test
    void naoDeveConfirmarEntregaQueNaoEstejaPendente() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.confirm();

        assertThrows(
                IllegalDeliveryStateException.class,
                delivery::confirm
        );
    }

    @Test
    void naoDeveRetirarEntregaQueNaoEstejaConfirmada() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        assertThrows(
                IllegalDeliveryStateException.class,
                delivery::pickUp
        );
    }

    @Test
    void naoDeveEntregarEncomendaQueNaoEstejaEmTransito() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        assertThrows(
                IllegalDeliveryStateException.class,
                delivery::deliver
        );
    }

    @Test
    void deveAtualizarPaymentIntentId() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();

        delivery.setPaymentIntentId("pi_teste_123");

        assertEquals("pi_teste_123", delivery.getPaymentIntentId());
    }

    @Test
    void deveAtualizarFreightRequestId() {
        Delivery delivery = new Delivery();
        UUID freightId = UUID.randomUUID();

        delivery.setFreightRequestId(freightId);

        assertEquals(freightId, delivery.getFreightRequestId());
    }
}

    @Test
    void createComDadosValidosDeveCriarEntregaPendente() {
        String senderSub = "remetente-123";
        String tokenName = "Alan";

        Instant agora = Instant.parse("2026-11-18T12:00:00Z");

        DeliveryRequest request = new DeliveryRequest(
                DeliveryMode.ON_ROUTE,
                "Fortaleza",
                "CE",
                "Terminal RodoviÃ¡rio, box 12",
                "Sobral",
                "CE",
                "Rua das Flores, 100",
                "Maria Souza",
                "+5585999990000",
                "Caixa com livros",
                new BigDecimal("4.50"),
                40,
                30,
                25
        );

        when(clock.instant()).thenReturn(agora);
        when(trackingCodeGenerator.generate()).thenReturn("RM-ABC234-56");

        when(deliveries.save(any(Delivery.class)))
                .thenAnswer(invocation -> invocation.getArgument(0));

        DeliverySummaryResponse response =
                service.create(senderSub, tokenName, request);

        ArgumentCaptor<Delivery> captor =
                ArgumentCaptor.forClass(Delivery.class);

        verify(deliveries).save(captor.capture());

        Delivery saved = captor.getValue();

        assertNotNull(response);
        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.PENDING, response.status());
        assertEquals("RM-ABC234-56", response.trackingCode());

        assertEquals(senderSub, saved.getSenderSub());
        assertEquals("RM-ABC234-56", saved.getTrackingCode());
        assertNull(saved.getRideId());

        assertEquals("Fortaleza", saved.getOriginCity());
        assertEquals("Sobral", saved.getDestinationCity());

        assertEquals(DeliveryStatus.PENDING, saved.getStatus());
        assertEquals(agora, saved.getRequestedAt());

        assertEquals("Caixa com livros", saved.getPkg().getDescription());
        assertEquals(new BigDecimal("4.50"), saved.getPkg().getWeightKg());
        assertEquals(40, saved.getPkg().getLengthCm());
        assertEquals(30, saved.getPkg().getWidthCm());
        assertEquals(25, saved.getPkg().getHeightCm());

        verify(trackingCodeGenerator).generate();
    }

    @Test
    void availableComCaronaCompativelDeveRetornarEntrega() {
        String driverSub = "motorista-123";
        UUID rideId = UUID.randomUUID();

        LocalDateTime partida = LocalDateTime.of(2026, 12, 10, 10, 0);
        Instant agora = Instant.parse("2026-11-18T12:00:00Z");

        Ride ride = mock(Ride.class);
        Delivery delivery = criarEntregaIndependente();

        // ConfiguraÃ§Ã£o do relÃ³gio
        when(clock.instant()).thenReturn(agora);
        when(clock.getZone()).thenReturn(ZoneOffset.UTC);

        // ConfiguraÃ§Ã£o da carona
        when(rides.findByDriverSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByDepartureDateAsc(
                eq(driverSub), eq(List.of(RideStatus.PLANNED))
        )).thenReturn(List.of(ride));

        when(ride.openForBookings()).thenReturn(true);
        when(ride.getType()).thenReturn(RideType.CARGO);
        when(ride.getDepartureDate()).thenReturn(partida);
        when(ride.getOriginCity()).thenReturn("Fortaleza");
        when(ride.getOriginState()).thenReturn("CE");
        when(ride.getDestinationCity()).thenReturn("Sobral");
        when(ride.getDestinationState()).thenReturn("CE");
        when(ride.getId()).thenReturn(rideId);

        // ConfiguraÃ§Ã£o do pacote
        PackageDetails pkg = prepararPacoteParaCapacidade(delivery);

        when(pkg.getDescription()).thenReturn("Caixa de livros");
        when(pkg.getRecipientName()).thenReturn("Maria Souza");

        // Dados necessÃ¡rios para a resposta
        when(delivery.getId()).thenReturn(UUID.randomUUID());
        when(delivery.getTrackingCode()).thenReturn("RM-ABC234-56");
        when(delivery.getStatus()).thenReturn(DeliveryStatus.PENDING);
        when(delivery.getMode()).thenReturn(DeliveryMode.ON_ROUTE);
        when(delivery.getOriginAddress()).thenReturn("Rua A");
        when(delivery.getDestinationAddress()).thenReturn("Rua B");

        // Entrega disponÃ­vel
        when(deliveries
                .findByStatusAndRideIdIsNullAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByRequestedAtDesc(
                        DeliveryStatus.PENDING
                )).thenReturn(List.of(delivery));

        // ExecuÃ§Ã£o
        List<AvailableDeliveryResponse> resultado = service.available(driverSub);

        // VerificaÃ§Ãµes
        assertEquals(1, resultado.size());
        assertEquals("RM-ABC234-56", resultado.get(0).trackingCode());
        assertEquals(1, resultado.get(0).compatibleRides().size());
        assertEquals(rideId, resultado.get(0).compatibleRides().get(0).id());

        verify(capacity).assertItemDimensions(ride, 40, 30, 25);
        verify(capacity).assertFits(eq(ride), any(), isNull());
    }

===== ./raiji-deliveries/src/test/java/com/raiji/deliveries/service/TrackingCodeGeneratorTest.java =====
package com.raiji.deliveries.service;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import com.raiji.deliveries.repository.DeliveryRepository;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
class TrackingCodeGeneratorTest {

    @Mock
    private DeliveryRepository deliveries;

    private TrackingCodeGenerator generator;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        generator = new TrackingCodeGenerator(deliveries);
    }

    @Test
    void generateDeveRespeitarFormato() {
        when(deliveries.existsByTrackingCode(anyString()))
                .thenReturn(false);

        String code = generator.generate();

        assertTrue(Pattern.matches(
                "^RM-[ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789]{6}-[ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789]{2}$",
                code
        ));
    }

    @Test
    void generateDeveTentarNovamenteQuandoEncontrarColisao() {
        when(deliveries.existsByTrackingCode(anyString()))
                .thenReturn(true, false);

        String code = generator.generate();

        assertTrue(code.matches(
                "^RM-[ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789]{6}-[ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789]{2}$"
        ));

        verify(deliveries, times(2)).existsByTrackingCode(anyString());
    }

    @Test
    void generateDeveFalharDepoisDeCemColisoes() {
        when(deliveries.existsByTrackingCode(anyString()))
                .thenReturn(true);

        assertThrows(
                IllegalStateException.class,
                () -> generator.generate()
        );

        verify(deliveries, times(100))
                .existsByTrackingCode(anyString());
    }

    @Test
    void generateDeveProduzirDezMilCodigosUnicos() {
        when(deliveries.existsByTrackingCode(anyString()))
                .thenReturn(false);

        Set<String> codes = new HashSet<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < 10_000; i++) {
            codes.add(generator.generate());
        }

        assertEquals(10_000, codes.size());
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/cargo/CargoCapacityService.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.cargo;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.embeddable.CargoDetails;
import com.raiji.common.enums.RidePassengerStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Baggage;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.RidePassenger;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RidePassengerRepository;
import com.raiji.users.domain.Vehicle;
import com.raiji.users.repository.VehicleRepository;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/**
 * Trava de capacidade de carga da carona (RN12), compartilhada entre a bagagem
 * dos passageiros e as encomendas.
 *
 * <p>Ocupam espaÃ§o: a bagagem em vigor dos passageiros CONFIRMED e as encomendas
 * aceitas. Pedidos pendentes e alteraÃ§Ãµes esperando aprovaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o ocupam.
 * Limites (sÃ³ quando declarados): peso mÃ¡ximo da carona (cargoDetails.maxWeightKg)
 * e volume do porta-malas do veÃ­culo (cargoVolumeLiters).
 */
@Service
public class CargoCapacityService {

    private final RidePassengerRepository ridePassengerRepository;
    private final VehicleRepository vehicleRepository;
    private final List<RidePackageBookings> packageBookings;

    public CargoCapacityService(RidePassengerRepository ridePassengerRepository,
                                VehicleRepository vehicleRepository,
                                List<RidePackageBookings> packageBookings) {
        this.ridePassengerRepository = ridePassengerRepository;
        this.vehicleRepository = vehicleRepository;
        this.packageBookings = packageBookings;
    }

    /** Carga que jÃ¡ ocupa a carona, sem contar o pedido {@code excludeBookingId}. */
    public CargoLoad currentLoad(UUID rideId, UUID excludeBookingId) {
        CargoLoad total = CargoLoad.NONE;
        for (RidePassenger p : ridePassengerRepository.findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId)) {
            if (p.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED) continue;
            if (excludeBookingId != null && excludeBookingId.equals(p.getId())) continue;
            total = total.plus(loadOf(p.activeBaggage()));
        }
        for (RidePackageBookings packages : packageBookings) {
            total = total.plus(packages.confirmedLoad(rideId));
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static CargoLoad loadOf(List<Baggage> items) {
        CargoLoad total = CargoLoad.NONE;
        for (Baggage b : items) {
            total = total.plus(CargoLoad.of(b.getLengthCm(), b.getWidthCm(), b.getHeightCm(),
                    b.getQuantity(), b.getWeightKg()));
        }
        return total;
    }

    /**
     * Garante que {@code extra} cabe na carona alÃ©m do que jÃ¡ estÃ¡ ocupado
     * (sem contar {@code excludeBookingId}, que estÃ¡ sendo substituÃ­do). Excedeu => 400.
     */
    public void assertFits(Ride ride, CargoLoad extra, UUID excludeBookingId) {
        CargoLoad total = currentLoad(ride.getId(), excludeBookingId).plus(extra);

        CargoDetails cargo = ride.getCargoDetails();
        if (cargo != null && cargo.hasCargoCapacity()
                && total.weightKg().compareTo(cargo.getMaxWeightKg()) > 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Peso total das bagagens (" + plain(total.weightKg())
                            + " kg) excede o limite da carona (" + plain(cargo.getMaxWeightKg()) + " kg).");
        }

        Vehicle vehicle = vehicleRepository
                .findByIdAndOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull(ride.getVehicleId(), ride.getDriverSub())
                .orElse(null);
        if (vehicle != null && vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters() != null && vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters() > 0
                && total.volumeLiters().compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters())) > 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Volume total das bagagens (" + plain(total.volumeLiters())
                            + " L) excede a capacidade do veÃ­culo (" + vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters() + " L).");
        }
    }

    /** Um volume maior que as medidas mÃ¡ximas aceitas pela carona nÃ£o cabe, seja qual for o espaÃ§o livre. */
    public void assertItemDimensions(Ride ride, int lengthCm, int widthCm, int heightCm) {
        CargoDetails cargo = ride.getCargoDetails();
        if (cargo == null) return;
        if (exceeds(lengthCm, cargo.getMaxLengthCm()) || exceeds(widthCm, cargo.getMaxWidthCm())
                || exceeds(heightCm, cargo.getMaxHeightCm())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "O volume (" + lengthCm + "Ã—" + widthCm + "Ã—" + heightCm
                            + " cm) Ã© maior que as medidas aceitas nesta carona.");
        }
    }

    private static boolean exceeds(int value, BigDecimal max) {
        return max != null && max.signum() > 0 && BigDecimal.valueOf(value).compareTo(max) > 0;
    }

    private static String plain(BigDecimal v) {
        return v.stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/cargo/CargoLoad.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.cargo;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

/** Carga somada: peso (kg) e volume (litros). */
public record CargoLoad(BigDecimal weightKg, BigDecimal volumeLiters) {

    public static final CargoLoad NONE = new CargoLoad(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.ZERO);

    public CargoLoad plus(CargoLoad other) {
        return new CargoLoad(weightKg.add(other.weightKg), volumeLiters.add(other.volumeLiters));
    }

    /** Um volume de dimensÃµes em cm Ã— quantidade, com peso unitÃ¡rio opcional. */
    public static CargoLoad of(int lengthCm, int widthCm, int heightCm, int quantity, BigDecimal unitWeightKg) {
        BigDecimal liters = BigDecimal.valueOf((long) lengthCm * widthCm * heightCm)
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(1000), 3, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
                .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(quantity));
        BigDecimal weight = unitWeightKg == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO
                : unitWeightKg.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(quantity));
        return new CargoLoad(weight, liters);
    }

    /** true se nÃ£o for maior que a outra em nenhuma dimensÃ£o (peso e volume). */
    public boolean notGreaterThan(CargoLoad other) {
        return weightKg.compareTo(other.weightKg) <= 0 && volumeLiters.compareTo(other.volumeLiters) <= 0;
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.cargo;

import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Porta para as ENCOMENDAS que viajam numa carona (implementada pelo mÃ³dulo de
 * encomendas). O mÃ³dulo de caronas nÃ£o conhece encomendas: sÃ³ pergunta a carga
 * e avisa os momentos do ciclo de vida da viagem.
 */
public interface RidePackageBookings {

    /** Carga das encomendas aceitas (ainda nÃ£o entregues) na carona. */
    CargoLoad confirmedLoad(UUID rideId);

    /** Reservas encerradas / viagem iniciada: recusa os pedidos de envio pendentes. */
    void rejectPending(UUID rideId, String reason);

    /** Viagem cancelada pelo motorista: cancela as encomendas ainda nÃ£o coletadas. */
    void cancelNotPickedUp(UUID rideId, String reason);

    /** HÃ¡ encomendas ativas (pendentes, aceitas ou em trÃ¢nsito)? */
    boolean hasActive(UUID rideId);
}

package com.raiji.rides.config;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;

/**
 * ComissÃ£o da plataforma sobre caronas pagas ({@code raiji.pricing}).
 *
 * <p>O passageiro paga exatamente o preÃ§o anunciado pelo motorista; a comissÃ£o
 * Ã© descontada do valor que o motorista recebe. O percentual vigente Ã©
 * GRAVADO na carona quando ela Ã© publicada: mudar a configuraÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o altera
 * caronas jÃ¡ publicadas.
 *
 * @param platformFeePercent percentual da comissÃ£o (ex.: 1.5 = 1,5%); 0 desliga
 */
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "raiji.pricing")
public record RidePricingProperties(BigDecimal platformFeePercent) {

    public RidePricingProperties {
        if (platformFeePercent == null) {
            platformFeePercent = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }
        if (platformFeePercent.signum() < 0 || platformFeePercent.compareTo(new BigDecimal("100")) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "raiji.pricing.platform-fee-percent deve estar entre 0 e 100.");
        }
    }
}

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” configuraÃ§Ã£o do Stripe (modo sandbox/testes).
 *
 * <p>Prefixed em {@code raiji.stripe}. A chave de API vem de variÃ¡vel de
 * ambiente ({@code STRIPE_API_KEY}) e NUNCA Ã© commitada. Quando ausente ou
 * em branco, {@link #configured()} retorna {@code false} e o
 * {@code StripeService} nÃ£o faz nenhuma chamada real (devolve falha
 * controlada) â€” importante para ambientes sem credencial.
 *
 * @param apiKey        chave secreta (ex.: {@code sk_test_...})
 * @param webhookSecret segredo de verificaÃ§Ã£o de webhooks (futuro)
 */
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "raiji.stripe")
public record StripeProperties(
        String apiKey,
        String webhookSecret
) {

    /** {@code true} somente com uma chave secreta plausÃ­vel (sk_/rk_). */
    public boolean configured() {
        return apiKey != null
                && !apiKey.isBlank()
                && (apiKey.startsWith("sk_") || apiKey.startsWith("rk_"));
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.config;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.ZoneId;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

/**
 * RelÃ³gio injetÃ¡vel (testes trocam por um {@code Clock.fixed(...)}).
 *
 * <p>Os horÃ¡rios das caronas sÃ£o "hora de parede" no Brasil (o app envia
 * {@code 2026-11-20T08:00} querendo dizer 8h em BrasÃ­lia). Por isso o relÃ³gio
 * usa o fuso {@code raiji.time-zone} (padrÃ£o America/Sao_Paulo), e nÃ£o o do
 * servidor: no Docker o fuso Ã© UTC e "agora" ficaria 3h adiantado.
 */
@Configuration
public class TimeConfig {

    @Bean
    public Clock clock(@Value("${raiji.time-zone:America/Sao_Paulo}") String zone) {
        return Clock.system(ZoneId.of(zone));
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.domain;

import java.time.Instant;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;

import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Index;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” registro de auditoria.
 *
 * <p>Entidade enxuta e independente (nÃ£o estende {@code AuditableEntity}):
 * representa eventos imutÃ¡veis "quem/o-quÃª/quando". Usada para registrar os
 * estornos ({@code ESTORNO_SUCESSO} com o id do refund, {@code ESTORNO_FALHOU}
 * com o erro). O mapeamento espelha exatamente a migraÃ§Ã£o V12
 * (necessÃ¡rio para o {@code ddl-auto: validate}).
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "audit_log", indexes = {
        @Index(name = "idx_audit_entity", columnList = "entity_type, entity_id"),
        @Index(name = "idx_audit_action", columnList = "action"),
        @Index(name = "idx_audit_created", columnList = "created_at")
})
public class AuditLog {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)

    @Column(name = "entity_type", nullable = false, length = 50)

    @Column(name = "entity_id")

    @Column(name = "actor_sub", length = 64)

    private String details;

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false)

    public UUID getEntityId() { return entityId; }
    public void setEntityId(UUID v) { this.entityId = v; }
    public String getAction() { return action; }
    public void setAction(String v) { this.action = v; }
    public String getActorSub() { return actorSub; }
    public void setActorSub(String v) { this.actorSub = v; }
    public String getDetails() { return details; }
    public void setDetails(String v) { this.details = v; }
    public Instant getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
    public void setCreatedAt(Instant v) { this.createdAt = v; }
}

package com.raiji.rides.domain;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.base.AuditableEntity;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.FetchType;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Index;
import jakarta.persistence.JoinColumn;
import jakarta.persistence.ManyToOne;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

/**
 * S2-01 / RF18 â€” Item de bagagem declarado na solicitaÃ§Ã£o de vaga.
 *
 * <p>Tabela Ãºnica com coluna {@code type} VARCHAR (sem tabela separada por
 * tipo). Desde a S2-03 (RN12) o item pode declarar {@code weightKg}
 * (opcional); a soma de peso/volume das bagagens CONFIRMED Ã© travada no
 * aceite da solicitaÃ§Ã£o.
 */
@Entity
@Table(name = "baggage", indexes = {
        @Index(name = "idx_baggage_ride_passenger", columnList = "ride_passenger_id")
})
public class Baggage extends AuditableEntity {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)
    private UUID id;

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY, optional = false)
    @JoinColumn(name = "ride_passenger_id", nullable = false)
    private RidePassenger ridePassenger;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)

package com.raiji.rides.domain;

import java.util.Locale;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonCreator;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonValue;

/**
 * S2-01 / RF18 â€” Tipos de bagagem aceitos na declaraÃ§Ã£o.
 *
 * <p>O contrato da API usa cÃ³digos em minÃºsculas ({@code mochila}, {@code sacola},
 * {@code mala}, {@code caixa}); o banco armazena o {@code name()} do enum
 * (VARCHAR). Valor fora do enum na requisiÃ§Ã£o => erro de desserializaÃ§Ã£o => 400.
 */
public enum BaggageType {

    MOCHILA,
    SACOLA,
    MALA,
    CAIXA;

    @JsonValue
    public String getCode() {
        return name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    @JsonCreator
    public static BaggageType fromCode(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        for (BaggageType type : values()) {
            if (type.name().equalsIgnoreCase(code.trim())) {
                return type;
            }
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Tipo de bagagem invÃ¡lido: '" + code
                        + "'. Valores aceitos: mochila, sacola, mala, caixa."
        );
    }
}

/**
 * S2-02 / RF08 â€” decisÃ£o do motorista sobre uma solicitaÃ§Ã£o de vaga.
 *
 * <p>O contrato da API usa maiÃºsculas ({@code ACCEPT}, {@code REJECT});
 * a entrada aceita qualquer caixa. Valor fora do enum na requisiÃ§Ã£o
 * => erro de desserializaÃ§Ã£o => 400.

    ACCEPT,
    REJECT;

    @JsonCreator
    public static RideDecision from(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return null;

        for (RideDecision decision : values()) {
            if (decision.name().equalsIgnoreCase(value.trim())) {
                return decision;
            }
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "DecisÃ£o invÃ¡lida: '" + value
                        + "'. Valores aceitos: ACCEPT, REJECT."
        );
    }

    private List<Baggage> baggage = new ArrayList<>();

    /** Onde embarca (null = na origem da viagem). */
    @Column(name = "pickup_location", columnDefinition = "geography(Point,4326)")
    private Point pickupLocation;

    /** Onde desembarca (null = no destino da viagem). */
    @Column(name = "dropoff_location", columnDefinition = "geography(Point,4326)")
    private Point dropoffLocation;

    @Column(name = "pickup_address", length = 255)
    private String pickupAddress;

    @Column(name = "dropoff_address", length = 255)
    private String dropoffAddress;

    /** Viagem inteira (origem -> destino)? SÃ³ estes entram no "aceitar todos". */
    @Column(name = "full_route", nullable = false)
    private boolean fullRoute = true;

    /** PreÃ§o desta vaga (o da viagem ou o proporcional do trecho); null = gratuita. */
    @Column(name = "price", precision = 10, scale = 2)
    private BigDecimal price;

    @Column(name = "completed_at")
    private Instant completedAt;

    public void complete() {
        this.status = RidePassengerStatus.COMPLETED;
        this.completedAt = Instant.now();
    }

    /** Bagagem em vigor (sem a alteraÃ§Ã£o que espera aprovaÃ§Ã£o do motorista). */
    public List<Baggage> activeBaggage() {
        return baggage.stream().filter(b -> !b.isPendingApproval()).toList();
    }

    /** AlteraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem esperando o motorista aprovar (vazia se nÃ£o houver). */
    public List<Baggage> pendingBaggage() {
        return baggage.stream().filter(Baggage::isPendingApproval).toList();
    }

    public void confirm() {
        this.status = RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED;
        this.confirmedAt = Instant.now();
    }

    /**
     * S2-02 (REJECT) + S2-04 (RF09): marca a reserva como CANCELLED, guarda o
     * motivo e registra a data/hora do cancelamento. MÃ©todo Ãºnico reutilizado
     * pelos dois fluxos (observaÃ§Ã£o da issue S2-04: "reutilizar
     * RidePassenger.cancel(reason) jÃ¡ existente").
     */
    public void cancel(String reason) {
        this.status = RidePassengerStatus.CANCELLED;
        this.cancellationReason = reason;
        this.cancelledAt = Instant.now();
    }

    /** Adiciona um item de bagagem mantendo os dois lados do relacionamento. */
    public void addBaggage(Baggage item) {
        item.setRidePassenger(this);
        this.baggage.add(item);
    }

    public UUID getId() { return id; }
    public UUID getRideId() { return rideId; }
    public void setRideId(UUID v) { this.rideId = v; }
    public String getPassengerSub() { return passengerSub; }
    public void setPassengerSub(String v) { this.passengerSub = v; }
    public String getPassengerName() { return passengerName; }
    public void setPassengerName(String v) { this.passengerName = v; }
    public RidePassengerStatus getStatus() { return status; }
    public Instant getJoinedAt() { return joinedAt; }
    public Instant getConfirmedAt() { return confirmedAt; }
    public Instant getCancelledAt() { return cancelledAt; }
    public String getCancellationReason() { return cancellationReason; }
    public String getPaymentIntentId() { return paymentIntentId; }
    public void setPaymentIntentId(String v) { this.paymentIntentId = v; }
    public List<Baggage> getBaggage() { return baggage; }
    public Point getPickupLocation() { return pickupLocation; }
    public void setPickupLocation(Point v) { this.pickupLocation = v; }
    public Point getDropoffLocation() { return dropoffLocation; }
    public void setDropoffLocation(Point v) { this.dropoffLocation = v; }
    public String getPickupAddress() { return pickupAddress; }
    public void setPickupAddress(String v) { this.pickupAddress = v; }
    public String getDropoffAddress() { return dropoffAddress; }
    public void setDropoffAddress(String v) { this.dropoffAddress = v; }

    public void setFullRoute(boolean v) { this.fullRoute = v; }

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/dto/RideIntentResponse.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.dto;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.RideIntent;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.enums.RideIntentMode;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.enums.RideIntentStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.enums.RideIntentType;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Point;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * @param distanceMeters sÃ³ na busca (/nearby): distÃ¢ncia aproximada (em 100 m) entre o
 *                       ponto pesquisado e a origem da intenÃ§Ã£o; null nas prÃ³prias intenÃ§Ãµes
 */
public record RideIntentResponse(
        UUID id,
        String userSub,
        RideIntentType type,
        RideIntentMode mode,
        RideIntentStatus status,
        String originCity,
        String originState,
        Double originLatitude,
        Double originLongitude,
        String destinationCity,
        String destinationState,
        Double destinationLatitude,
        Double destinationLongitude,
        OffsetDateTime desiredAt,
        OffsetDateTime expiresAt,
        Double distanceMeters
) {
    /** 2 casas decimais (~1,1 km): suficiente para o mapa e a busca, sem revelar o endereÃ§o exato */
    private static final double APPROXIMATION_FACTOR = 100.0;
    private static final double EARTH_RADIUS_METERS = 6_371_000;

    /** VisÃ£o completa â€” para as intenÃ§Ãµes do prÃ³prio usuÃ¡rio */
    public static RideIntentResponse from(RideIntent intent) {
        return new RideIntentResponse(
                intent.getId(),
                intent.getUserSub(),
                intent.getType(),
                intent.getMode(),
                intent.getStatus(),
                intent.getOriginCity(),
                intent.getOriginState(),
                lat(intent.getOriginLocation()),
                lng(intent.getOriginLocation()),
                intent.getDestinationCity(),
                intent.getDestinationState(),
                lat(intent.getDestinationLocation()),
                lng(intent.getDestinationLocation()),
                intent.getDesiredAt(),
                intent.getExpiresAt(),
                null
        );
    }

    /**
     * VisÃ£o para OUTRAS pessoas (busca): coordenadas arredondadas (~1 km) e a distÃ¢ncia
     * atÃ© quem pesquisou. O ponto exato sÃ³ deve ser combinado depois do aceite.
     */
    public static RideIntentResponse approximate(RideIntent intent, double fromLatitude, double fromLongitude) {
        Point origin = intent.getOriginLocation();
        Double distance = origin == null ? null
                : Math.round(haversine(fromLatitude, fromLongitude, origin.getY(), origin.getX()) / 100.0) * 100.0;
        return new RideIntentResponse(
                intent.getId(),
                intent.getUserSub(),
                intent.getType(),
                intent.getMode(),
                intent.getStatus(),
                intent.getOriginCity(),
                intent.getOriginState(),
                round(lat(origin)),
                round(lng(origin)),
                intent.getDestinationCity(),
                intent.getDestinationState(),
                round(lat(intent.getDestinationLocation())),
                round(lng(intent.getDestinationLocation())),
                intent.getDesiredAt(),
                intent.getExpiresAt(),
                distance
        );
    }

    private static Double lat(Point p) {
        return p == null ? null : p.getY();
    }

    private static Double lng(Point p) {
        return p == null ? null : p.getX();
    }

    private static Double round(Double value) {
        return value == null ? null : Math.round(value * APPROXIMATION_FACTOR) / APPROXIMATION_FACTOR;
    }

    private static double haversine(double lat1, double lng1, double lat2, double lng2) {
        double dLat = Math.toRadians(lat2 - lat1);
        double dLng = Math.toRadians(lng2 - lng1);
        double a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2)
                + Math.cos(Math.toRadians(lat1)) * Math.cos(Math.toRadians(lat2))
                * Math.sin(dLng / 2) * Math.sin(dLng / 2);
        return 2 * EARTH_RADIUS_METERS * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(a));
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/geo/GeoSupport.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.geo;

import java.util.List;

import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Coordinate;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.GeometryFactory;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.LineString;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Point;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.PrecisionModel;

/** Pontos e rotas em WGS84 (SRID 4326, x = longitude, y = latitude). */
public final class GeoSupport {

    private static final GeometryFactory FACTORY = new GeometryFactory(new PrecisionModel(), 4326);
    private static final double EARTH_RADIUS_METERS = 6_371_008.8;

    /** Limite de pontos aceitos numa rota (Mapbox costuma mandar algumas centenas). */
    public static final int MAX_ROUTE_POINTS = 5_000;

    private GeoSupport() {
    }

    public static Point point(double latitude, double longitude) {
        validate(latitude, longitude);
        Point p = FACTORY.createPoint(new Coordinate(longitude, latitude));
        p.setSRID(4326);
        return p;
    }

    /** Rota a partir de [latitude, longitude]; sem rota, linha reta entre origem e destino. */
    public static LineString route(List<LatLng> points) {
        if (points == null || points.size() < 2) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("A rota precisa de pelo menos 2 pontos.");
        }
        if (points.size() > MAX_ROUTE_POINTS) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("A rota tem pontos demais (mÃ¡ximo " + MAX_ROUTE_POINTS + ").");
        }
        Coordinate[] coords = points.stream()
                .peek(p -> validate(p.latitude(), p.longitude()))
                .map(p -> new Coordinate(p.longitude(), p.latitude()))
                .toArray(Coordinate[]::new);
        LineString line = FACTORY.createLineString(coords);
        line.setSRID(4326);
        return line;
    }

    /** Comprimento aproximado da rota (soma das distÃ¢ncias de grande cÃ­rculo). */
    public static int lengthMeters(LineString line) {
        double total = 0;
        Coordinate[] c = line.getCoordinates();
        for (int i = 1; i < c.length; i++) {
            total += haversine(c[i - 1].y, c[i - 1].x, c[i].y, c[i].x);
        }
        return (int) Math.round(total);
    }

    public static double haversine(double lat1, double lng1, double lat2, double lng2) {
        double dLat = Math.toRadians(lat2 - lat1);
        double dLng = Math.toRadians(lng2 - lng1);
        double a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2)
                + Math.cos(Math.toRadians(lat1)) * Math.cos(Math.toRadians(lat2))
                * Math.sin(dLng / 2) * Math.sin(dLng / 2);
        return 2 * EARTH_RADIUS_METERS * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(a));
    }

    public static void validate(double latitude, double longitude) {
        if (Double.isNaN(latitude) || latitude < -90 || latitude > 90) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Latitude invÃ¡lida.");
        }
        if (Double.isNaN(longitude) || longitude < -180 || longitude > 180) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Longitude invÃ¡lida.");
        }
    }

    public static Double latitude(Point p) {
        return p == null ? null : p.getY();
    }

    public static Double longitude(Point p) {
        return p == null ? null : p.getX();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/pricing/PriceBreakdown.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.pricing;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

/**
 * Quanto do preÃ§o de uma vaga fica com a plataforma e quanto vai ao motorista.
 *
 * <p>O passageiro paga {@code price}. A comissÃ£o Ã© {@code price Ã— percent / 100},
 * arredondada ao centavo (meio para cima), e o motorista recebe o restante.
 * Carona gratuita ({@code price == null}) nÃ£o tem comissÃ£o: os trÃªs valores ficam nulos.
 */
public record PriceBreakdown(
        BigDecimal price,
        BigDecimal platformFeePercent,
        BigDecimal platformFee,
        BigDecimal driverReceives
) {

    public static PriceBreakdown of(BigDecimal price, BigDecimal platformFeePercent) {
        BigDecimal percent = platformFeePercent == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : platformFeePercent;
        if (price == null) {
            return new PriceBreakdown(null, percent, null, null);
        }
        BigDecimal normalizedPrice = price.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        BigDecimal fee = normalizedPrice.multiply(percent)
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        return new PriceBreakdown(normalizedPrice, percent, fee, normalizedPrice.subtract(fee));
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/pricing/SegmentPricing.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.pricing;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

/**
 * PreÃ§o sugerido de um TRECHO da viagem: proporcional Ã  parte da rota percorrida.
 *
 * <p>Ex.: viagem de R$ 100 e o passageiro vai de 25% a 75% da rota => R$ 50,00.
 * Trechos de 90% da rota ou mais pagam o preÃ§o cheio (e contam como "viagem inteira").
 * Carona gratuita continua gratuita.
 */
public final class SegmentPricing {

    /** A partir desta fraÃ§Ã£o da rota, o pedido Ã© tratado como a viagem inteira. */
    public static final double FULL_ROUTE_THRESHOLD = 0.9;

    private SegmentPricing() {
    }

    public static double fraction(Double pickupFraction, Double dropoffFraction) {
        double start = pickupFraction == null ? 0 : pickupFraction;
        double end = dropoffFraction == null ? 1 : dropoffFraction;
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, end - start));
    }

    public static boolean isFullRoute(double fraction) {
        return fraction >= FULL_ROUTE_THRESHOLD;
    }

    public static BigDecimal price(BigDecimal fullPrice, double fraction) {
        if (fullPrice == null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (isFullRoute(fraction)) {
            return fullPrice.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        }
        return fullPrice.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(fraction)).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
}

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

public interface RideIntentRepository extends JpaRepository<RideIntent, UUID> {

    @Query(value = """
        SELECT ri.*
        FROM ride_intents ri
        WHERE ri.status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND ri.expires_at > NOW()
          AND ri.type = :type
          AND ri.mode = :mode
          -- "Na hora": sem horÃ¡rio, ou horÃ¡rio atÃ© 60 min Ã  frente. Um horÃ¡rio que JÃ
          -- passou continua valendo enquanto a intenÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o expira (antes: BETWEEN NOW()
          -- e NOW()+60min, e a intenÃ§Ã£o sumia da busca logo depois do horÃ¡rio desejado).
          AND (
                ri.desired_at IS NULL
                OR ri.desired_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '60 minutes'
          )
          AND ri.origin_location IS NOT NULL
          AND ST_DWithin(
                ri.origin_location,
                ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:longitude, :latitude), 4326)::geography,
                :radiusMeters
          )
        ORDER BY ST_Distance(
            ri.origin_location,
            ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:longitude, :latitude), 4326)::geography
        )
        LIMIT 50
        """, nativeQuery = true)
    List<RideIntent> findNearby(
            @Param("type") String type,
            @Param("mode") String mode,

            @Param("longitude") double longitude,

    @Query(value = """
        SELECT ri.*
        FROM ride_intents ri
        WHERE ri.status = 'ACTIVE'
          AND ri.expires_at > NOW()
          AND ri.type = :type
          AND ri.mode = :mode
          AND ri.desired_at >= :startAt
          AND ri.desired_at < :endAt
          AND ri.origin_location IS NOT NULL
          AND ST_DWithin(

                ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:longitude, :latitude), 4326)::geography,
                :radiusMeters
          )
        ORDER BY ri.desired_at ASC,
                 ST_Distance(
                    ri.origin_location,

        """, nativeQuery = true)

package com.raiji.rides.repository;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.enums.RideStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import jakarta.persistence.LockModeType;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaSpecificationExecutor;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Lock;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

public interface RideRepository extends JpaRepository<Ride, UUID>, JpaSpecificationExecutor<Ride> {

    /**
     * S2-03 / RN03 â€” trava pessimista ({@code SELECT ... FOR UPDATE}) na linha
     * da carona: serializa decisÃµes concorrentes. Dois aceites simultÃ¢neos
     * sobre a Ãºltima vaga => um confirma e o outro, ao reler a carona apÃ³s o
     * commit do primeiro, recebe 409. EstratÃ©gia documentada em
     * docs/ARQUITETURA.md (o {@code @Version} herdado de AuditableEntity
     * permanece como rede de seguranÃ§a).
     */
    @Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
    @Query("select r from Ride r where r.id = :id")
    Optional<Ride> findByIdForUpdate(@Param("id") UUID id);

    /**
     * S2-06 / RF10 + RN05 â€” caronas PLANNED cujo {@code departureDate} jÃ¡ foi
     * atingido ({@code <= cutoff}). Usada pelo {@code RideStatusScheduler} para
     * promover a {@code IN_PROGRESS}. O filtro por {@code PLANNED} torna a
     * execuÃ§Ã£o idempotente (uma carona jÃ¡ promovida nÃ£o aparece de novo).
     */
    List<Ride> findByStatusAndDepartureDateLessThanEqualAndDeletedAtIsNull(
            RideStatus status, LocalDateTime cutoff);

    /**
     * Busca pelo CAMINHO da viagem (PostGIS): a rota passa a atÃ© {@code radius} metros
     * do embarque e, com destino, tambÃ©m do desembarque â€” e o desembarque vem DEPOIS do
     * embarque no sentido da viagem. Cobre "perto de mim" (sÃ³ origem), "de A para B"
     * e "pegar no meio do caminho" (A e B sÃ£o pontos da rota, nÃ£o sÃ³ as pontas).
     */
    @Query(value = """
            WITH o AS (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:oLng, :oLat), 4326) AS g),
                 d AS (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:dLng, :dLat), 4326) AS g)
            SELECT r.id AS "id",
                   ST_LineLocatePoint(r.route::geometry, o.g) AS "pickupFraction",
                   CASE WHEN :hasDest THEN ST_LineLocatePoint(r.route::geometry, d.g) END AS "dropoffFraction",
                   ST_Distance(r.route, o.g::geography) AS "pickupDistance",
                   CASE WHEN :hasDest THEN ST_Distance(r.route, d.g::geography) END AS "dropoffDistance"
            FROM rides r, o, d
            WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND r.status = 'PLANNED'
              AND r.bookings_closed = FALSE
              AND r.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
              AND r.route IS NOT NULL
              AND r.departure_date >= :fromDate
              AND r.departure_date < :toDate
              AND r.ride_type IN (:types)
              AND (:needSeat = FALSE OR r.available_seats > 0)
              AND r.driver_sub <> :requesterSub
              AND ST_DWithin(r.route, o.g::geography, :radius)
              AND (:hasDest = FALSE OR (
                    ST_DWithin(r.route, d.g::geography, :radius)
                    AND ST_LineLocatePoint(r.route::geometry, d.g) > ST_LineLocatePoint(r.route::geometry, o.g)))
            ORDER BY r.departure_date, "pickupDistance"
            LIMIT 50
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    List<RideRouteMatch> searchAlongRoute(
            @Param("oLat") double originLatitude,
            @Param("oLng") double originLongitude,
            @Param("hasDest") boolean hasDestination,
            @Param("dLat") double destinationLatitude,
            @Param("dLng") double destinationLongitude,
            @Param("radius") double radiusMeters,
            @Param("fromDate") LocalDateTime from,
            @Param("toDate") LocalDateTime to,
            @Param("types") List<String> rideTypes,
            @Param("needSeat") boolean needSeat,
            @Param("requesterSub") String requesterSub);

    /** Onde dois pontos caem na rota de UMA carona (para o preÃ§o do trecho de um pedido). */
    @Query(value = """
            WITH o AS (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:oLng, :oLat), 4326) AS g),
                 d AS (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(:dLng, :dLat), 4326) AS g)
            SELECT r.id AS "id",
                   ST_LineLocatePoint(r.route::geometry, o.g) AS "pickupFraction",
                   ST_LineLocatePoint(r.route::geometry, d.g) AS "dropoffFraction",
                   ST_Distance(r.route, o.g::geography) AS "pickupDistance",
                   ST_Distance(r.route, d.g::geography) AS "dropoffDistance"
            FROM rides r, o, d
            WHERE r.id = :rideId AND r.route IS NOT NULL
            """, nativeQuery = true)
    Optional<RideRouteMatch> locateOnRoute(
            @Param("rideId") UUID rideId,
            @Param("oLat") double pickupLatitude,
            @Param("oLng") double pickupLongitude,
            @Param("dLat") double dropoffLatitude,
            @Param("dLng") double dropoffLongitude);

    /** Caronas do motorista (as mais prÃ³ximas da partida primeiro). */
    List<Ride> findByDriverSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByDepartureDateAsc(
            String driverSub, List<RideStatus> statuses);

    /** O motorista tem carona em algum destes status? (ex.: PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS) */
    boolean existsByDriverSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNull(
            String driverSub, List<RideStatus> statuses);
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/repository/RideSpecification.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.repository;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import com.raiji.common.enums.RideStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideSearchFilter;
import jakarta.persistence.criteria.Predicate;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification;

/**
 * Specifications para busca de caronas (S1-05 / RF04).
 *
 * Regras fixas:
 * - status = PLANNED
 * - availableSeats > 0
 * - deleted_at IS NULL
 */
public final class RideSpecification {

    private RideSpecification() {
    }

    public static Specification<Ride> search(RideSearchFilter filter) {
        return (root, query, cb) -> {
            List<Predicate> predicates = new ArrayList<>();

            predicates.add(cb.equal(root.get("status"), RideStatus.PLANNED));
            predicates.add(cb.greaterThan(root.get("availableSeats"), 0));
            predicates.add(cb.isNull(root.get("deletedAt")));

            if (filter != null) {
                if (filter.originCity() != null && !filter.originCity().isBlank()) {
                    predicates.add(cb.like(
                            cb.lower(root.get("originCity")),
                            "%" + filter.originCity().trim().toLowerCase() + "%"));
                }

                if (filter.destinationCity() != null && !filter.destinationCity().isBlank()) {
                    predicates.add(cb.like(
                            cb.lower(root.get("destinationCity")),
                            "%" + filter.destinationCity().trim().toLowerCase() + "%"));
                }

                if (filter.departureFrom() != null) {
                    predicates.add(cb.greaterThanOrEqualTo(
                            root.get("departureDate"),
                            filter.departureFrom()));
                }

                if (filter.departureTo() != null) {
                    predicates.add(cb.lessThanOrEqualTo(
                            root.get("departureDate"),
                            filter.departureTo()));
                }

                if (filter.maxPrice() != null) {
                    predicates.add(cb.lessThanOrEqualTo(
                            root.get("pricePerPassenger"),
                            filter.maxPrice()));
                }

                if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(filter.freeOnly())) {
                    predicates.add(cb.isNull(root.get("pricePerPassenger")));
                }

                if (filter.minSeats() != null) {
                    predicates.add(cb.greaterThanOrEqualTo(
                            root.get("availableSeats"),
                            filter.minSeats()));
                }
            }

            return cb.and(predicates.toArray(new Predicate[0]));
        };
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/scheduler/RideStatusScheduler.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.scheduler;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;

import com.raiji.common.enums.RideStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideRepository;
import com.raiji.rides.service.RideLifecycleService;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

/**
 * S2-06 / RF10 + RN05 â€” ao atingir o {@code departureDate}, promove caronas
 * {@code PLANNED} para {@code IN_PROGRESS} (bloqueando novas solicitaÃ§Ãµes e
 * aceites, que passam a responder 409 no {@code RidePassengerService}).
 *
 * <p>Roda a cada 60 s (fixedDelay padrÃ£o de {@code 60000} ms, configurÃ¡vel por
 * {@code raiji.scheduler.*} â€” nos testes usamos um intervalo enorme para o job
 * nÃ£o interferir). Ã‰ <b>idempotente</b>: a consulta filtra {@code status =
 * PLANNED}, entÃ£o uma carona jÃ¡ promovida nunca Ã© processada de novo.
 *
 * <p>O {@link Clock} Ã© injetÃ¡vel para testes determinÃ­sticos do limite
 * {@code departureDate <= now()}.
 */
@Component
public class RideStatusScheduler {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(RideStatusScheduler.class);

    private final RideRepository rideRepository;
    private final Clock clock;
    private final RideLifecycleService lifecycle;

    public RideStatusScheduler(RideRepository rideRepository, Clock clock) {
        this(rideRepository, clock, null);
    }

    @org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
    public RideStatusScheduler(RideRepository rideRepository, Clock clock, RideLifecycleService lifecycle) {
        this.rideRepository = rideRepository;
        this.clock = clock;
        this.lifecycle = lifecycle;
    }

    /**
     * Promove caronas PLANNED cujo {@code departureDate <= now(clock)}.
     *
     * @return nÃºmero de caronas promovidas nesta execuÃ§Ã£o (0 = idempotente)
     */
    @Scheduled(
            initialDelayString = "${raiji.scheduler.initial-delay:5000}",
            fixedDelayString = "${raiji.scheduler.fixed-delay:60000}"
    )
    @Transactional
    public int promoteDueRides() {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(clock);

        List<Ride> due = rideRepository
                .findByStatusAndDepartureDateLessThanEqualAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                        RideStatus.PLANNED, now);

        if (due.isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (Ride ride : due) {
            if (lifecycle != null) {
                lifecycle.iniciar(ride);   // tambÃ©m recusa os pedidos pendentes
            } else {
                ride.setStatus(RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS);
            }
        }
        rideRepository.saveAll(due);

        log.info(
                "RideStatusScheduler: {} carona(s) PLANNED -> IN_PROGRESS (cutoff {})",
                due.size(), now);

        return due.size();
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.AuditLog;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.AuditLogRepository;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Propagation;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” escrita na trilha de auditoria ({@code audit_log}).
 *
 * <p>Usa {@code REQUIRES_NEW} para que o registro de auditoria sobreviva mesmo
 * que a transaÃ§Ã£o externa venha a falhar depois â€” a trilha Ã© "append-only" e
 * nÃ£o deve ser perdida. Em testes sem transaÃ§Ã£o ativa, abre uma prÃ³pria.
 */
@Service
public class AuditLogService {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(AuditLogService.class);

    private final AuditLogRepository auditLogRepository;

    public AuditLogService(AuditLogRepository auditLogRepository) {
        this.auditLogRepository = auditLogRepository;
    }

    @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW)
    public AuditLog record(String action,
                           String entityType,
                           UUID entityId,
                           String actorSub,
                           String details) {

        AuditLog entry = new AuditLog();
        entry.setAction(action);
        entry.setEntityType(entityType);
        entry.setEntityId(entityId);
        entry.setActorSub(actorSub);
        entry.setDetails(details);
        entry.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());

        AuditLog saved = auditLogRepository.save(entry);

        log.info("Audit [{}] {} {} por {}", action, entityType, entityId, actorSub);
        return saved;
    }
}

import java.time.Instant;

import com.raiji.common.notification.NotificationRequested;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.NotificationResponse;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.Notification;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.NotificationAudience;

import com.raiji.rides.event.RideDecisionEvent;
