import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;

@Service
public class NotificationService {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(NotificationService.class);

    private final NotificationRepository notificationRepository;

    public NotificationService(
            NotificationRepository notificationRepository
    ) {
        this.notificationRepository = notificationRepository;
    }

    /** Aviso genÃ©rico vindo de qualquer mÃ³dulo (encomendas, empresas, frete, ciclo da viagem). */
    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    public void handleNotificationRequested(NotificationRequested event) {
        save(event.recipientSub(), NotificationAudience.valueOf(event.audience()), event.kind(),
                event.rideId(), event.referenceId(), event.message());
    }

    private void save(String recipientSub, NotificationAudience audience, String kind,
                      UUID rideId, UUID referenceId, String message) {
        Notification notification = new Notification();
        notification.setRecipientSub(recipientSub);
        notification.setAudience(audience);
        notification.setKind(kind);
        notification.setRideId(rideId);
        notification.setReferenceId(referenceId);
        notification.setMessage(message.length() > 500 ? message.substring(0, 500) : message);
        notificationRepository.save(notification);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<NotificationResponse> list(String recipientSub, NotificationAudience audience) {
        return notificationRepository
                .findTop100ByRecipientSubAndAudienceAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByCreatedAtDesc(recipientSub, audience)
                .stream().map(NotificationResponse::from).toList();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long countUnread(String recipientSub, NotificationAudience audience) {
        return notificationRepository.countByRecipientSubAndAudienceAndReadAtIsNullAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                recipientSub, audience);
    }

    /** Marca como lidas as notificaÃ§Ãµes informadas (ou todas daquela caixa, se ids vazio). */
    @Transactional
    public int markRead(String recipientSub, NotificationAudience audience, List<UUID> ids) {
        return (ids == null || ids.isEmpty())
                ? notificationRepository.markAllRead(recipientSub, audience, Instant.now())
                : notificationRepository.markRead(recipientSub, ids, Instant.now());
    }

    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    public void handleRideRequestCreated(RideRequestCreatedEvent event) {

        String message = "Nova solicitaÃ§Ã£o de reserva de "
                + event.passengerName()
                + " para sua carona.";

        Notification notification = new Notification();
        notification.setRecipientSub(event.driverSub());
        notification.setAudience(NotificationAudience.DRIVER);
        notification.setKind("RIDE_REQUEST");
        notification.setRideId(event.rideId());
        notification.setMessage(message);

        notificationRepository.save(notification);

        log.info(
                "NotificaÃ§Ã£o criada para o motorista {} referente Ã  carona {}",
                event.driverSub(),
                event.rideId()
        );
    }

    /**
     * S2-02 / RF19: notifica o passageiro sobre a decisÃ£o do motorista
     * (aceite ou recusa com o motivo declarado).
     */
    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    public void handleRideDecision(RideDecisionEvent event) {

        String message = event.decision() == RideDecision.ACCEPT
                ? "Sua solicitaÃ§Ã£o de carona com " + event.driverName()
                        + " foi ACEITA."
                : "Sua solicitaÃ§Ã£o de carona com " + event.driverName()
                        + " foi RECUSADA. Motivo: " + event.reason();

        // coluna message VARCHAR(500) â€” defesa contra motivos longos
        if (message.length() > 500) {
            message = message.substring(0, 500);
        }

        Notification notification = new Notification();
        notification.setRecipientSub(event.passengerSub());
        notification.setAudience(NotificationAudience.PASSENGER);
        notification.setKind(event.decision() == RideDecision.ACCEPT ? "RIDE_REQUEST_ACCEPTED" : "RIDE_REQUEST_REJECTED");
        notification.setReferenceId(event.requestId());
        notification.setRideId(event.rideId());
        notification.setMessage(message);

        notificationRepository.save(notification);

        log.info(
                "NotificaÃ§Ã£o de decisÃ£o ({}) criada para o passageiro {} na carona {}",
                event.decision(),
                event.passengerSub(),
                event.rideId()
        );
    }

    /**
     * S2-04 / RF09: notifica o MOTORISTA quando uma reserva Ã© cancelada e a
     * vaga Ã© liberada (critÃ©rio de aceite "Motorista Ã© notificado").
     */
    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    public void handleRideCancelled(RideCancelledEvent event) {

        String message = "A reserva de " + event.passengerName()
                + " na sua carona foi CANCELADA"
                + (event.seatReleased() ? " e a vaga foi liberada." : ".")
                + (event.reason() != null && !event.reason().isBlank()
                        ? " Motivo: " + event.reason()
                        : "");

        // coluna message VARCHAR(500) â€” defesa contra motivos longos
        if (message.length() > 500) {
            message = message.substring(0, 500);
        }

        Notification notification = new Notification();
        notification.setRecipientSub(event.driverSub());
        notification.setAudience(NotificationAudience.DRIVER);
        notification.setKind("RIDE_BOOKING_CANCELLED");
        notification.setReferenceId(event.requestId());
        notification.setRideId(event.rideId());
        notification.setMessage(message);

        notificationRepository.save(notification);

        log.info(
                "NotificaÃ§Ã£o de cancelamento criada para o motorista {} na carona {} (vaga liberada: {})",
                event.driverSub(),
                event.rideId(),
                event.seatReleased()
        );
    }

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/service/RideIntentService.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.service;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.RideIntent;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.enums.RideIntentMode;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.enums.RideIntentStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.enums.RideIntentType;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideIntentRepository;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityNotFoundException;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Coordinate;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.GeometryFactory;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Point;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.PrecisionModel;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Service
public class RideIntentService {

    private static final int PASSENGER_EXPIRATION_MINUTES = 30;
    private static final int DRIVER_EXPIRATION_MINUTES = 60;
    private static final int FUTURE_EXPIRATION_TOLERANCE_MINUTES = 60;
    private static final int IMMEDIATE_WINDOW_MINUTES = 60;
    private static final double MAX_RADIUS_METERS = 100_000;
    private static final ZoneId BRAZIL = ZoneId.of("America/Sao_Paulo");

    private final RideIntentRepository repository;

    private final GeometryFactory geometryFactory =
            new GeometryFactory(new PrecisionModel(), 4326);

    public RideIntentService(RideIntentRepository repository) {
        this.repository = repository;
    }

    @Transactional
    public RideIntent create(
            String userSub,
            RideIntentType type,
            RideIntentMode mode,
            String originCity,
            String originState,
            double originLatitude,
            double originLongitude,
            String destinationCity,
            String destinationState,
            Double destinationLatitude,
            Double destinationLongitude,
            OffsetDateTime desiredAt
    ) {
        validateCreation(type, mode, originLatitude, originLongitude,
                destinationLatitude, destinationLongitude, desiredAt);

        RideIntent intent = new RideIntent();

        intent.setUserSub(userSub);
        intent.setType(type);
        intent.setMode(mode);
        intent.setStatus(RideIntentStatus.ACTIVE);

        intent.setOriginCity(originCity);
        intent.setOriginState(originState);
        intent.setOriginLocation(createPoint(originLatitude, originLongitude));

        if (mode == RideIntentMode.ROUTE) {
            intent.setDestinationCity(destinationCity);
            intent.setDestinationState(destinationState);
            intent.setDestinationLocation(
                    createPoint(destinationLatitude, destinationLongitude));
        }

        intent.setDesiredAt(desiredAt);

        int expirationMinutes = type == RideIntentType.PASSENGER_REQUEST
                ? PASSENGER_EXPIRATION_MINUTES
                : DRIVER_EXPIRATION_MINUTES;

        OffsetDateTime now = OffsetDateTime.now();

        if (desiredAt != null && desiredAt.isAfter(now)) {
            intent.setExpiresAt(desiredAt.plusMinutes(
                    FUTURE_EXPIRATION_TOLERANCE_MINUTES));
        } else {
            intent.setExpiresAt(now.plusMinutes(expirationMinutes));
        }

        return repository.save(intent);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<RideIntent> findNearby(
            String userSub,
            RideIntentType type,
            RideIntentMode mode,
            double latitude,
            double longitude,
            double radiusMeters
    ) {
        validateSearch(latitude, longitude, radiusMeters);

        return repository.findNearby(
                        type.name(), mode.name(),
                        latitude, longitude, radiusMeters)
                .stream()
                .filter(intent -> !intent.getUserSub().equals(userSub))
                .toList();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<RideIntent> findBoard(
            String userSub,
            RideIntentType type,
            RideIntentMode mode,
            double latitude,
            double longitude,
            double radiusMeters,
            LocalDate date
    ) {
        validateSearch(latitude, longitude, radiusMeters);

        // O "dia" do mural Ã© o dia no Brasil, nÃ£o o do servidor (UTC no Docker:
        // o "hoje" comeÃ§aria Ã s 21h de BrasÃ­lia)
        ZoneId zone = BRAZIL;
        if (date == null || date.isBefore(LocalDate.now(zone))) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "A data do mural deve ser hoje ou uma data futura.");
        }

        OffsetDateTime startAt = date.atStartOfDay(zone).toOffsetDateTime();
        OffsetDateTime endAt = date.plusDays(1)
                .atStartOfDay(zone).toOffsetDateTime();

        return repository.findBoard(
                        type.name(), mode.name(),
                        latitude, longitude, radiusMeters,
                        startAt, endAt)
                .stream()
                .filter(intent -> !intent.getUserSub().equals(userSub))
                .toList();
    }

    @Transactional
    public void cancel(String userSub, UUID intentId) {
        RideIntent intent = repository.findById(intentId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new EntityNotFoundException(
                        "IntenÃ§Ã£o de carona nÃ£o encontrada."));

        // IntenÃ§Ã£o de outra pessoa: responde como "nÃ£o encontrada" (404), para nÃ£o
        // confirmar a quem testa IDs que aquela intenÃ§Ã£o existe
        if (!intent.getUserSub().equals(userSub)) {
            throw new EntityNotFoundException("IntenÃ§Ã£o de carona nÃ£o encontrada.");
        }

        if (intent.getStatus() != RideIntentStatus.ACTIVE) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Somente intenÃ§Ãµes ativas podem ser canceladas.");
        }

        intent.setStatus(RideIntentStatus.CANCELLED);
        repository.save(intent);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<RideIntent> findMyIntents(String userSub) {
        return repository.findByUserSubAndStatus(
                        userSub, RideIntentStatus.ACTIVE)
                .stream()
                .filter(intent -> intent.getExpiresAt().isAfter(
                        OffsetDateTime.now()))
                .toList();
    }

    private Point createPoint(double latitude, double longitude) {
        Point point = geometryFactory.createPoint(
                new Coordinate(longitude, latitude));
        point.setSRID(4326);
        return point;
    }

    private void validateCreation(
            RideIntentType type,
            RideIntentMode mode,
            double originLatitude,
            double originLongitude,
            Double destinationLatitude,
            Double destinationLongitude,
            OffsetDateTime desiredAt
    ) {
        if (type == null || mode == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Tipo e modo da intenÃ§Ã£o sÃ£o obrigatÃ³rios.");
        }

        validateCoordinates(originLatitude, originLongitude);

        if (desiredAt != null && desiredAt.isBefore(OffsetDateTime.now())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "O horÃ¡rio desejado nÃ£o pode estar no passado.");
        }

        if (mode == RideIntentMode.FREE
                && type != RideIntentType.DRIVER_OFFER) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "O modo FREE Ã© permitido somente para motoristas.");
        }

        if (mode == RideIntentMode.ROUTE) {
            if (destinationLatitude == null
                    || destinationLongitude == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Destino Ã© obrigatÃ³rio no modo ROUTE.");
            }

            validateCoordinates(
                    destinationLatitude, destinationLongitude);
        }
    }

    private void validateSearch(
            double latitude,
            double longitude,
            double radiusMeters
    ) {
        validateCoordinates(latitude, longitude);

        if (radiusMeters <= 0 || radiusMeters > MAX_RADIUS_METERS) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "O raio deve ser maior que zero e no mÃ¡ximo 100 km.");
        }
    }

    private void validateCoordinates(double latitude, double longitude) {
        if (latitude < -90 || latitude > 90) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Latitude invÃ¡lida.");
        }

        if (longitude < -180 || longitude > 180) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Longitude invÃ¡lida.");
        }
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/service/RideLifecycleService.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.service;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.enums.RideStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.cargo.RidePackageBookings;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideRepository;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/**
 * Ciclo de vida da carona, pelo motorista:
 * <pre>
 * PLANNED --encerrar reservas--> PLANNED (sem pedidos novos; pendentes recusados)
 * PLANNED --iniciar (atÃ© 1h antes da partida)--> IN_PROGRESS (pendentes recusados)
 * PLANNED --(horÃ¡rio de partida, scheduler)--> IN_PROGRESS (pendentes recusados)
 * IN_PROGRESS --finalizar--> COMPLETED (reservas aceitas viram concluÃ­das)
 * PLANNED --cancelar--> CANCELLED (reservas canceladas com estorno; encomendas nÃ£o coletadas canceladas)
 * </pre>
 */
@Service
public class RideLifecycleService {

    /** O motorista pode iniciar a viagem atÃ© este tanto antes da partida. */
    static final int START_EARLY_MINUTES = 60;

    static final String MOTIVO_ENCERRADAS = "O motorista encerrou as reservas desta carona.";
    static final String MOTIVO_INICIADA = "A viagem jÃ¡ comeÃ§ou.";

    private final RideRepository rideRepository;
    private final RidePassengerService passengers;
    private final List<RidePackageBookings> packages;
    private final Clock clock;

    public RideLifecycleService(RideRepository rideRepository, RidePassengerService passengers,
                                List<RidePackageBookings> packages, Clock clock) {
        this.rideRepository = rideRepository;
        this.passengers = passengers;
        this.packages = packages;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    @Transactional
    public RideResponse closeBookings(UUID rideId, String driverSub) {
        Ride ride = rideDoMotorista(rideId, driverSub);
        exigirStatus(ride, RideStatus.PLANNED, "SÃ³ dÃ¡ para encerrar reservas antes da viagem comeÃ§ar.");
        ride.setBookingsClosed(true);
        rejeitarPendentes(ride, MOTIVO_ENCERRADAS);
        return RideResponse.from(rideRepository.save(ride));
    }

    @Transactional
    public RideResponse start(UUID rideId, String driverSub) {
        Ride ride = rideDoMotorista(rideId, driverSub);
        exigirStatus(ride, RideStatus.PLANNED, "Esta viagem nÃ£o pode ser iniciada (status " + ride.getStatus() + ").");
        LocalDateTime agora = LocalDateTime.now(clock);
        if (ride.getDepartureDate().isAfter(agora.plusMinutes(START_EARLY_MINUTES))) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "DÃ¡ para iniciar a viagem sÃ³ a partir de " + START_EARLY_MINUTES + " minutos antes da partida.");
        }
        iniciar(ride);
        return RideResponse.from(rideRepository.save(ride));
    }

    /** Usado tambÃ©m pelo scheduler no horÃ¡rio de partida. */
    public void iniciar(Ride ride) {
        ride.setStatus(RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS);
        ride.setStartedAt(Instant.now(clock));
        rejeitarPendentes(ride, MOTIVO_INICIADA);
    }

    @Transactional
    public RideResponse finish(UUID rideId, String driverSub) {
        Ride ride = rideDoMotorista(rideId, driverSub);
        exigirStatus(ride, RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS, "SÃ³ dÃ¡ para finalizar uma viagem em andamento.");
        ride.setStatus(RideStatus.COMPLETED);
        ride.setCompletedAt(Instant.now(clock));
        passengers.completeAllConfirmed(ride);
        return RideResponse.from(rideRepository.save(ride));
    }

    @Transactional
    public RideResponse cancel(UUID rideId, String driverSub, String reason) {
        Ride ride = rideDoMotorista(rideId, driverSub);
        exigirStatus(ride, RideStatus.PLANNED, "SÃ³ dÃ¡ para cancelar uma viagem que ainda nÃ£o comeÃ§ou.");
        String motivo = reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? "Viagem cancelada pelo motorista." : reason.trim();
        ride.setStatus(RideStatus.CANCELLED);
        ride.setCancelledAt(Instant.now(clock));
        ride.setCancellationReason(motivo);
        passengers.rejectAllPending(ride, motivo);
        passengers.cancelAllConfirmed(ride, motivo, driverSub);
        packages.forEach(p -> {
            p.rejectPending(ride.getId(), motivo);
            p.cancelNotPickedUp(ride.getId(), motivo);
        });
        return RideResponse.from(rideRepository.save(ride));
    }

    private void rejeitarPendentes(Ride ride, String motivo) {
        passengers.rejectAllPending(ride, motivo);
        packages.forEach(p -> p.rejectPending(ride.getId(), motivo));
    }

    private Ride rideDoMotorista(UUID rideId, String driverSub) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findByIdForUpdate(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."));
        if (!ride.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Esta carona Ã© de outro motorista.");
        }
        return ride;
    }

    private static void exigirStatus(Ride ride, RideStatus esperado, String mensagem) {
        if (ride.getStatus() != esperado) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, mensagem);
        }
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.service;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import com.raiji.common.enums.RidePassengerStatus;
import com.raiji.common.notification.NotificationRequested;
import com.raiji.rides.cargo.CargoCapacityService;
import com.raiji.rides.cargo.CargoLoad;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.AcceptAllResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.MyBookingResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.geo.GeoSupport;
import com.raiji.rides.geo.Place;
import com.raiji.rides.pricing.SegmentPricing;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideRouteMatch;
import com.raiji.common.enums.RideStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Baggage;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.RideDecision;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.RidePassenger;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.BaggageItemRequest;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideCancelResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideDecisionResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RidePassengerResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.event.RideCancelledEvent;
import com.raiji.rides.event.RideDecisionEvent;
import com.raiji.rides.event.RideRequestCreatedEvent;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RidePassengerRepository;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideRepository;

import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

@Service
public class RidePassengerService {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(RidePassengerService.class);

    private static final List<RidePassengerStatus> ACTIVE_STATUSES =
            List.of(
                    RidePassengerStatus.PENDING,
                    RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED
            );

    private final RideRepository rideRepository;
    private final RidePassengerRepository ridePassengerRepository;
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher eventPublisher;
    private final CargoCapacityService cargoCapacity;
    private final RideRefundService rideRefundService;
    private final Clock clock;

    /** DistÃ¢ncia mÃ¡xima (m) entre a rota e o embarque/desembarque pedido. */
    static final double MAX_DETOUR_METERS = 5_000;

    public RidePassengerService(
            RideRepository rideRepository,
            RidePassengerRepository ridePassengerRepository,
            ApplicationEventPublisher eventPublisher,
            CargoCapacityService cargoCapacity,
            RideRefundService rideRefundService,
            Clock clock
    ) {
        this.rideRepository = rideRepository;
        this.ridePassengerRepository = ridePassengerRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
        this.cargoCapacity = cargoCapacity;
        this.rideRefundService = rideRefundService;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    @Transactional
    public RidePassengerResponse request(
            UUID rideId,
            String passengerSub,
            String passengerName,
            List<BaggageItemRequest> baggage
    ) {
        return request(rideId, passengerSub, passengerName, baggage, null, null);
    }

    /**
     * Pedido de vaga. A bagagem Ã© OPCIONAL (vazia = sem bagagem; dÃ¡ para editar
     * depois). Com pickup/dropoff, a pessoa embarca/desce no meio do caminho e
     * paga o proporcional do trecho. Pedido + bagagem na MESMA transaÃ§Ã£o.
     */
    @Transactional
    public RidePassengerResponse request(
            UUID rideId,
            String passengerSub,
            String passengerName,
            List<BaggageItemRequest> baggage,
            Place pickup,
            Place dropoff
    ) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findById(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        // A mesma conta pode ser motorista e passageira â€” mas nÃ£o na mesma carona
        if (ride.getDriverSub().equals(passengerSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o pode pedir vaga na sua prÃ³pria carona."
            );
        }

        if (!ride.carriesPassengers()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta viagem leva sÃ³ encomendas (sem vagas para passageiros)."
            );
        }

        if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED || ride.isBookingsClosed()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta carona nÃ£o estÃ¡ disponÃ­vel para solicitaÃ§Ãµes."
            );
        }

        if (ride.getDepartureDate() == null
                || !ride.getDepartureDate().isAfter(LocalDateTime.now(clock))) {
            // S2-06 / RF10: bloqueia solicitaÃ§Ãµes a partir do horÃ¡rio de saÃ­da
            // (departureDate <= now => 409), mesmo antes do scheduler promover
            // a carona para IN_PROGRESS.
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "NÃ£o Ã© possÃ­vel solicitar uma carona com partida passada."
            );
        }

        boolean alreadyRequested =
                ridePassengerRepository
                        .existsByRideIdAndPassengerSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                                rideId,
                                passengerSub,
                                ACTIVE_STATUSES
                        );

        if (alreadyRequested) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "VocÃª jÃ¡ possui uma solicitaÃ§Ã£o ativa para esta carona."
            );
        }

        long activeRequests =
                ridePassengerRepository
                        .countByRideIdAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                                rideId,
                                ACTIVE_STATUSES
                        );

        if (ride.getAvailableSeats() == null
                || ride.getAvailableSeats() <= 0
                || activeRequests >= ride.getTotalSeats()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "NÃ£o hÃ¡ vagas disponÃ­veis nesta carona."
            );
        }

        RidePassenger passenger = new RidePassenger();
        passenger.setRideId(rideId);
        passenger.setPassengerSub(passengerSub);
        passenger.setPassengerName(passengerName.trim());
        aplicarTrecho(ride, passenger, pickup, dropoff);

        for (BaggageItemRequest item : baggage == null ? List.<BaggageItemRequest>of() : baggage) {
            cargoCapacity.assertItemDimensions(ride, item.lengthCm(), item.widthCm(), item.heightCm());
            passenger.addBaggage(toEntity(item, false));
        }

        // cascade ALL: solicitaÃ§Ã£o + bagagem persistidas juntas (mesma transaÃ§Ã£o)
        RidePassenger saved = ridePassengerRepository.save(passenger);

        eventPublisher.publishEvent(
                new RideRequestCreatedEvent(
                        ride.getId(),
                        ride.getDriverSub(),
                        ride.getDriverName(),
                        saved.getPassengerSub(),
                        saved.getPassengerName(),
                        saved.getJoinedAt()
                )
        );

        return RidePassengerResponse.from(saved);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<RidePassengerResponse> listForDriver(
            UUID rideId,
            String driverSub
    ) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findById(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        if (!ride.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o tem permissÃ£o para visualizar as solicitaÃ§Ãµes desta carona."
            );
        }

        return ridePassengerRepository
                .findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId)
                .stream()
                .map(RidePassengerResponse::from)
                .toList();
    }

    /**
     * S2-02 / RF08: o motorista aceita (ACCEPT) ou recusa (REJECT) a
     * solicitaÃ§Ã£o apÃ³s visualizar a bagagem declarada (S2-01).
     *
     * <p>ACCEPT => CONFIRMED + confirmedAt + decremento de availableSeats.
     * REJECT => CANCELLED + cancellationReason (vagas permanecem intactas).
     * Nos dois casos o passageiro Ã© notificado via RideDecisionEvent (RF19).
     */
    @Transactional
    public RideDecisionResponse decide(
            UUID rideId,
            UUID requestId,
            String driverSub,
            RideDecision decision,
            String reason
    ) {
        return decide(rideId, requestId, driverSub, decision, reason, null);
    }

    /**
     * S2-02 / RF08 (+ S2-05 / RN04): variante que tambÃ©m recebe o
     * {@code paymentIntentId} da carona paga. No ACCEPT, o id Ã© gravado na
     * reserva para viabilizar o estorno automÃ¡tico no cancelamento.
     */
    @Transactional
    public RideDecisionResponse decide(
            UUID rideId,
            UUID requestId,
            String driverSub,
            RideDecision decision,
            String reason,
            String paymentIntentId
    ) {
        if (decision == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "A decisÃ£o Ã© obrigatÃ³ria (ACCEPT ou REJECT)."
            );
        }

        if (decision == RideDecision.REJECT
                && (reason == null || reason.isBlank())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "O motivo (reason) Ã© obrigatÃ³rio ao recusar (REJECT)."
            );
        }

        // S2-03 / RN03: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE â€” serializa decisÃµes
        // concorrentes sobre a mesma carona (ver docs/ARQUITETURA.md).
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findByIdForUpdate(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        if (!ride.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o tem permissÃ£o para decidir solicitaÃ§Ãµes desta carona."
            );
        }

        // S2-06 / RF10: bloqueia o aceite/recusa quando a carona jÃ¡ nÃ£o estÃ¡
        // PLANNED (partida atingida / viagem em andamento) => 409.
        if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "NÃ£o Ã© possÃ­vel decidir solicitaÃ§Ãµes de uma carona que jÃ¡ iniciou."
            );
        }

        RidePassenger passenger = ridePassengerRepository.findById(requestId)
                .filter(p -> p.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .filter(p -> rideId.equals(p.getRideId()))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "SolicitaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        if (passenger.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.PENDING) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta solicitaÃ§Ã£o jÃ¡ foi decidida."
            );
        }

        Instant decidedAt;
        if (decision == RideDecision.ACCEPT) {
            if (ride.getAvailableSeats() == null
                    || ride.getAvailableSeats() <= 0) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                        "NÃ£o hÃ¡ vagas disponÃ­veis nesta carona."
                );
            }
            // S2-03 / RN12: trava de capacidade de carga (peso + volume)
            cargoCapacity.assertFits(ride,
                    CargoCapacityService.loadOf(passenger.activeBaggage()), passenger.getId());

            // S2-05 / RN04: vincula o PaymentIntent (carona paga) Ã  reserva
            // para permitir o estorno automÃ¡tico num cancelamento futuro.
            if (paymentIntentId != null && !paymentIntentId.isBlank()) {
                passenger.setPaymentIntentId(paymentIntentId.trim());
            }

            ride.setAvailableSeats(ride.getAvailableSeats() - 1);
            passenger.confirm();
            decidedAt = passenger.getConfirmedAt();
        } else {
            passenger.cancel(reason.trim());
            decidedAt = Instant.now();
        }

        rideRepository.save(ride);
        RidePassenger saved = ridePassengerRepository.save(passenger);

        eventPublisher.publishEvent(
                new RideDecisionEvent(
                        ride.getId(),
                        saved.getId(),
                        ride.getDriverSub(),
                        ride.getDriverName(),
                        saved.getPassengerSub(),
                        saved.getPassengerName(),
                        decision,
                        decision == RideDecision.REJECT ? reason.trim() : null,
                        decidedAt
                )
        );

        return RideDecisionResponse.from(saved);
    }

    /**
     * S2-04 / RF09 + RN06 â€” cancelamento de reserva ANTES da viagem.
     *
     * <p>Pode ser invocado pelo passageiro dono da reserva OU pelo motorista
     * dono da carona. Regras (critÃ©rios de aceite da issue #11):
     * <ul>
     *   <li><b>403</b> â€” o ator nÃ£o Ã© o passageiro da reserva nem o motorista
     *       da carona ("passageiro tentando cancelar reserva de outro").</li>
     *   <li><b>409</b> â€” reserva jÃ¡ CANCELLED ("reserva jÃ¡ cancelada").</li>
     *   <li><b>409</b> â€” reserva COMPLETED (nÃ£o Ã© PENDING/CONFIRMED).</li>
     *   <li><b>409</b> â€” carona nÃ£o estÃ¡ PLANNED ("apÃ³s inÃ­cio da viagem").</li>
     *   <li>CONFIRMED =&gt; {@code availableSeats++} na hora (libera a vaga);
     *       PENDING =&gt; vagas permanecem intactas.</li>
     * </ul>
     *
     * <p>Assim como o {@link #decide}, usa lock pessimista na carona
     * ({@code findByIdForUpdate}) para que a devoluÃ§Ã£o da vaga seja
     * consistente sob concorrÃªncia (S2-03 / RN03). Publica
     * {@link RideCancelledEvent} para notificar o motorista.
     */
    @Transactional
    public RideCancelResponse cancel(
            UUID rideId,
            UUID requestId,
            String actorSub,
            String reason
    ) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findByIdForUpdate(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        RidePassenger passenger = ridePassengerRepository.findById(requestId)
                .filter(p -> p.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .filter(p -> rideId.equals(p.getRideId()))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "SolicitaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        boolean donoDaReserva = passenger.getPassengerSub().equals(actorSub);
        boolean motoristaDaCarona = ride.getDriverSub().equals(actorSub);
        if (!donoDaReserva && !motoristaDaCarona) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o tem permissÃ£o para cancelar esta reserva."
            );
        }

        if (passenger.getStatus() == RidePassengerStatus.CANCELLED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta reserva jÃ¡ estÃ¡ cancelada."
            );
        }

        if (passenger.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.PENDING
                && passenger.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta reserva nÃ£o pode ser cancelada no status "
                            + passenger.getStatus() + "."
            );
        }

        if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "NÃ£o Ã© possÃ­vel cancelar a reserva apÃ³s o inÃ­cio da viagem."
            );
        }

        boolean seatReleased =
                passenger.getStatus() == RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED;

        passenger.cancel(reason == null ? null : reason.trim());

        if (seatReleased) {
            int atuais = ride.getAvailableSeats() == null
                    ? 0 : ride.getAvailableSeats();
            int total = ride.getTotalSeats() == null
                    ? atuais + 1 : ride.getTotalSeats();
            // nunca ultrapassa total_seats (CHECK chk_seats_consistency)
            ride.setAvailableSeats(Math.min(atuais + 1, total));
        }

        rideRepository.save(ride);
        RidePassenger saved = ridePassengerRepository.save(passenger);

        // S2-05 / RN04: estorno automÃ¡tico de carona paga (nunca impede o
        // cancelamento â€” falhas viram registro ESTORNO_FALHOU na auditoria).
        try {
            rideRefundService.refundIfApplicable(ride, saved, actorSub);
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            log.warn(
                    "Estorno nÃ£o processado para a reserva {}: {}",
                    saved.getId(), ex.getMessage());
        }

        eventPublisher.publishEvent(
                new RideCancelledEvent(
                        ride.getId(),
                        saved.getId(),
                        ride.getDriverSub(),
                        ride.getDriverName(),
                        saved.getPassengerSub(),
                        saved.getPassengerName(),
                        saved.getCancellationReason(),
                        saved.getCancelledAt(),
                        seatReleased
                )
        );

        return RideCancelResponse.from(saved, seatReleased);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ aceitar todos

    /**
     * "Aceitar todos": confirma, na ordem de chegada, os pedidos PENDENTES de
     * viagem inteira enquanto houver vaga e espaÃ§o para a bagagem. Pedidos de
     * trecho ficam para o motorista decidir um a um.
     */
    @Transactional
    public AcceptAllResponse acceptAll(UUID rideId, String driverSub) {
        Ride ride = rideDoMotoristaParaDecidir(rideId, driverSub);

        List<RidePassenger> pendentes = ridePassengerRepository.findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId).stream()
                .filter(p -> p.getStatus() == RidePassengerStatus.PENDING)
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(RidePassenger::getJoinedAt, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder())))
                .toList();

        List<UUID> aceitos = new ArrayList<>();
        List<AcceptAllResponse.Skipped> pulados = new ArrayList<>();
        for (RidePassenger p : pendentes) {
            if (!p.isFullRoute()) {
                pulados.add(new AcceptAllResponse.Skipped(p.getId(), "Pedido de trecho: decida individualmente."));
                continue;
            }
            if (ride.getAvailableSeats() == null || ride.getAvailableSeats() <= 0) {
                pulados.add(new AcceptAllResponse.Skipped(p.getId(), "NÃ£o hÃ¡ mais vagas."));
                continue;
            }
            try {
                cargoCapacity.assertFits(ride, CargoCapacityService.loadOf(p.activeBaggage()), p.getId());
            } catch (ResponseStatusException e) {
                pulados.add(new AcceptAllResponse.Skipped(p.getId(), e.getReason()));
                continue;
            }
            ride.setAvailableSeats(ride.getAvailableSeats() - 1);
            p.confirm();
            ridePassengerRepository.save(p);
            // salva a cada aceite: a prÃ³xima checagem de capacidade enxerga este passageiro
            ridePassengerRepository.flush();
            aceitos.add(p.getId());
            publicarDecisao(ride, p, RideDecision.ACCEPT, null, p.getConfirmedAt());
        }
        rideRepository.save(ride);
        return new AcceptAllResponse(aceitos, pulados, ride.getAvailableSeats());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- editar bagagem

    /**
     * O passageiro troca a bagagem (lista vazia = sem bagagem) atÃ© a viagem comeÃ§ar.
     * Pedido pendente: vale na hora. Pedido aceito: se a carga nÃ£o aumenta (peso,
     * volume e nÃºmero de volumes), vale na hora; se aumenta, fica esperando o
     * motorista aprovar e a vaga continua garantida com a bagagem anterior.
     */
    @Transactional
    public RidePassengerResponse updateBaggage(UUID rideId, UUID requestId, String passengerSub,
                                               List<BaggageItemRequest> items) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findByIdForUpdate(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."));
        RidePassenger passenger = pedidoDaCarona(rideId, requestId);
        if (!passenger.getPassengerSub().equals(passengerSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Este pedido Ã© de outra pessoa.");
        }
        if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "A viagem jÃ¡ comeÃ§ou: a bagagem nÃ£o pode mais mudar.");
        }
        if (passenger.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.PENDING
                && passenger.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Este pedido nÃ£o estÃ¡ mais ativo.");
        }
        for (BaggageItemRequest item : items) {
            cargoCapacity.assertItemDimensions(ride, item.lengthCm(), item.widthCm(), item.heightCm());
        }

        List<Baggage> novos = items.stream().map(i -> toEntity(i, false)).toList();
        boolean precisaAprovar = passenger.getStatus() == RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED
                && aumentaCarga(passenger.activeBaggage(), novos);

        if (precisaAprovar) {
            passenger.getBaggage().removeIf(Baggage::isPendingApproval);
            novos.forEach(b -> {
                b.setPendingApproval(true);
                passenger.addBaggage(b);
            });
            eventPublisher.publishEvent(new NotificationRequested(ride.getDriverSub(), "DRIVER",
                    "BAGGAGE_CHANGE_REQUEST", ride.getId(), passenger.getId(),
                    passenger.getPassengerName() + " quer levar mais bagagem na sua carona. Aprove ou recuse."));
        } else {
            passenger.getBaggage().clear();
            novos.forEach(passenger::addBaggage);
        }
        return RidePassengerResponse.from(ridePassengerRepository.save(passenger));
    }

    /** O motorista aprova (confere o espaÃ§o) ou recusa a bagagem nova de um passageiro aceito. */
    @Transactional
    public RidePassengerResponse decideBaggageChange(UUID rideId, UUID requestId, String driverSub, boolean approve) {
        Ride ride = rideDoMotoristaParaDecidir(rideId, driverSub);
        RidePassenger passenger = pedidoDaCarona(rideId, requestId);
        List<Baggage> pendentes = passenger.pendingBaggage();
        if (pendentes.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "NÃ£o hÃ¡ alteraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem esperando aprovaÃ§Ã£o.");
        }
        if (approve) {
            cargoCapacity.assertFits(ride, CargoCapacityService.loadOf(pendentes), passenger.getId());
            passenger.getBaggage().removeIf(b -> !b.isPendingApproval());
            passenger.getBaggage().forEach(b -> b.setPendingApproval(false));
        } else {
            passenger.getBaggage().removeIf(Baggage::isPendingApproval);
        }
        eventPublisher.publishEvent(new NotificationRequested(passenger.getPassengerSub(), "PASSENGER",
                approve ? "BAGGAGE_CHANGE_APPROVED" : "BAGGAGE_CHANGE_REJECTED", ride.getId(), passenger.getId(),
                approve ? "O motorista aprovou a sua bagagem nova."
                        : "O motorista nÃ£o aprovou a bagagem nova: vale a bagagem anterior."));
        return RidePassengerResponse.from(ridePassengerRepository.save(passenger));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- ciclo de vida

    /** Recusa todos os pedidos pendentes (reservas encerradas, viagem iniciada ou cancelada). */
    @Transactional
    public int rejectAllPending(Ride ride, String reason) {
        int total = 0;
        for (RidePassenger p : ridePassengerRepository.findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(ride.getId())) {
            if (p.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.PENDING) continue;
            p.cancel(reason);
            ridePassengerRepository.save(p);
            publicarDecisao(ride, p, RideDecision.REJECT, reason, Instant.now());
            total++;
        }
        return total;
    }

    /** Viagem cancelada pelo motorista: cancela as reservas aceitas (com estorno) e avisa. */
    @Transactional
    public int cancelAllConfirmed(Ride ride, String reason, String actorSub) {
        int total = 0;
        for (RidePassenger p : ridePassengerRepository.findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(ride.getId())) {
            if (p.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED) continue;
            p.cancel(reason);
            RidePassenger saved = ridePassengerRepository.save(p);
            try {
                rideRefundService.refundIfApplicable(ride, saved, actorSub);
            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
                log.warn("Estorno nÃ£o processado para a reserva {}: {}", saved.getId(), ex.getMessage());
            }
            eventPublisher.publishEvent(new NotificationRequested(p.getPassengerSub(), "PASSENGER",
                    "RIDE_CANCELLED", ride.getId(), p.getId(),
                    "A carona com " + ride.getDriverName() + " foi cancelada pelo motorista."
                            + (reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? "" : " Motivo: " + reason)));
            total++;
        }
        return total;
    }

    /** Viagem finalizada: as reservas aceitas viram concluÃ­das. */
    @Transactional
    public int completeAllConfirmed(Ride ride) {
        int total = 0;
        for (RidePassenger p : ridePassengerRepository.findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(ride.getId())) {
            if (p.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED) continue;
            p.complete();
            ridePassengerRepository.save(p);
            total++;
        }
        return total;
    }

    /** "Minhas viagens" do passageiro (ativas primeiro; depois o histÃ³rico). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<MyBookingResponse> myBookings(String passengerSub) {
        List<RidePassenger> pedidos = ridePassengerRepository.findByPassengerSub(passengerSub).stream()
                .filter(p -> p.getDeletedAt() == null).toList();
        Map<UUID, Ride> rides = rideRepository.findAllById(pedidos.stream().map(RidePassenger::getRideId).distinct().toList())
                .stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(Ride::getId, r -> r));
        return pedidos.stream()
                .filter(p -> rides.containsKey(p.getRideId()))
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing((RidePassenger p) -> rides.get(p.getRideId()).getDepartureDate()).reversed())
                .map(p -> new MyBookingResponse(RidePassengerResponse.from(p), RideResponse.from(rides.get(p.getRideId()))))
                .toList();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ apoio

    private Ride rideDoMotoristaParaDecidir(UUID rideId, String driverSub) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findByIdForUpdate(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."));
        if (!ride.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o tem permissÃ£o para decidir solicitaÃ§Ãµes desta carona.");
        }
        if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "NÃ£o Ã© possÃ­vel decidir solicitaÃ§Ãµes de uma carona que jÃ¡ iniciou.");
        }
        return ride;
    }

    private RidePassenger pedidoDaCarona(UUID rideId, UUID requestId) {
        return ridePassengerRepository.findById(requestId)
                .filter(p -> p.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .filter(p -> rideId.equals(p.getRideId()))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "SolicitaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o encontrada."));
    }

    private void publicarDecisao(Ride ride, RidePassenger p, RideDecision decision, String reason, Instant at) {
        eventPublisher.publishEvent(new RideDecisionEvent(ride.getId(), p.getId(), ride.getDriverSub(),
                ride.getDriverName(), p.getPassengerSub(), p.getPassengerName(), decision, reason, at));
    }

    /** Embarque/desembarque no meio do caminho: confere a rota e calcula o preÃ§o do trecho. */
    private void aplicarTrecho(Ride ride, RidePassenger passenger, Place pickup, Place dropoff) {
        passenger.setFullRoute(true);
        passenger.setPrice(ride.getPricePerPassenger());
        if (pickup == null && dropoff == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (ride.getRoute() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Esta carona nÃ£o tem rota no mapa: nÃ£o dÃ¡ para embarcar ou descer no meio do caminho.");
        }
        double pLat = pickup != null ? pickup.latitude() : ride.getOriginLocation().getY();
        double pLng = pickup != null ? pickup.longitude() : ride.getOriginLocation().getX();
        double dLat = dropoff != null ? dropoff.latitude() : ride.getDestinationLocation().getY();
        double dLng = dropoff != null ? dropoff.longitude() : ride.getDestinationLocation().getX();
        RideRouteMatch m = rideRepository.locateOnRoute(ride.getId(), pLat, pLng, dLat, dLng)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Rota da carona indisponÃ­vel."));
        if (m.getPickupDistance() > MAX_DETOUR_METERS || m.getDropoffDistance() > MAX_DETOUR_METERS) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "O embarque ou o desembarque fica longe demais do caminho desta carona (mÃ¡ximo 5 km).");
        }
        if (m.getDropoffFraction() <= m.getPickupFraction()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "O desembarque precisa vir depois do embarque, no sentido da viagem.");
        }
        double fraction = SegmentPricing.fraction(m.getPickupFraction(), m.getDropoffFraction());
        passenger.setFullRoute(SegmentPricing.isFullRoute(fraction));
        passenger.setPrice(SegmentPricing.price(ride.getPricePerPassenger(), fraction));
        if (pickup != null) {
            passenger.setPickupLocation(GeoSupport.point(pickup.latitude(), pickup.longitude()));
            passenger.setPickupAddress(pickup.address());
        }
        if (dropoff != null) {
            passenger.setDropoffLocation(GeoSupport.point(dropoff.latitude(), dropoff.longitude()));
            passenger.setDropoffAddress(dropoff.address());
        }
    }

    private static Baggage toEntity(BaggageItemRequest item, boolean pending) {
        Baggage b = new Baggage();
        b.setType(item.type());
        b.setQuantity(item.quantity());
        b.setLengthCm(item.lengthCm());
        b.setWidthCm(item.widthCm());
        b.setHeightCm(item.heightCm());
        b.setWeightKg(item.weightKg());
        b.setDescription(item.description());
        b.setPendingApproval(pending);
        return b;
    }

    /** A bagagem nova aumenta a carga? (mais peso, mais volume ou mais volumes) */
    static boolean aumentaCarga(List<Baggage> atual, List<Baggage> nova) {
        int qtdAtual = atual.stream().mapToInt(Baggage::getQuantity).sum();
        int qtdNova = nova.stream().mapToInt(Baggage::getQuantity).sum();
        CargoLoad cargaAtual = CargoCapacityService.loadOf(atual);
        CargoLoad cargaNova = CargoCapacityService.loadOf(nova);
        return qtdNova > qtdAtual || !cargaNova.notGreaterThan(cargaAtual);
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/service/RideRefundService.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.service;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.RidePassenger;
import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeRefundResult;
import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeService;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” orquestra o estorno automÃ¡tico no cancelamento de caronas
 * pagas e o respectivo registro de auditoria.
 *
 * <p>Regras (critÃ©rios de aceite da issue #12):
 * <ul>
 *   <li>carona <b>gratuita</b> ({@code pricePerPassenger == null}) =&gt; NÃƒO
 *       chama o Stripe;</li>
 *   <li>reserva sem {@code paymentIntentId} =&gt; nada a estornar;</li>
 *   <li>estorno ok =&gt; auditoria {@code ESTORNO_SUCESSO} com o id do refund;</li>
 *   <li>falha no Stripe =&gt; auditoria {@code ESTORNO_FALHOU}; o cancelamento
 *       segue (este mÃ©todo nunca lanÃ§a exceÃ§Ã£o).</li>
 * </ul>
 */
@Service
public class RideRefundService {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(RideRefundService.class);

    /** Tipo de entidade gravado na auditoria. */
    public static final String ENTITY_TYPE = "RIDE_PASSENGER";
    /** AÃ§Ã£o de auditoria quando o estorno Ã© criado com sucesso. */
    public static final String ACTION_SUCESSO = "ESTORNO_SUCESSO";
    /** AÃ§Ã£o de auditoria quando o estorno falha (nÃ£o impede o cancelamento). */
    public static final String ACTION_FALHOU = "ESTORNO_FALHOU";

    private final StripeService stripeService;
    private final AuditLogService auditLogService;

    public RideRefundService(StripeService stripeService,
                             AuditLogService auditLogService) {
        this.stripeService = stripeService;
        this.auditLogService = auditLogService;
    }

    /**
     * Estorna a reserva cancelada quando aplicÃ¡vel. Nunca lanÃ§a exceÃ§Ã£o.
     *
     * @return {@code true} se um estorno foi de fato tentado (pago + paymentIntent)
     */
    public boolean refundIfApplicable(Ride ride, RidePassenger passenger, String actorSub) {
        if (ride.getPricePerPassenger() == null) {
            // Carona gratuita => nÃ£o chama o Stripe (critÃ©rio de aceite).
            return false;
        }

        String paymentIntentId = passenger.getPaymentIntentId();
        if (paymentIntentId == null || paymentIntentId.isBlank()) {
            log.debug(
                    "Reserva {} sem paymentIntentId â€” nada a estornar.",
                    passenger.getId());
            return false;
        }

        long amountCents = toCents(ride.getPricePerPassenger());
        StripeRefundResult result = stripeService.refund(paymentIntentId, amountCents);

        if (result.ok()) {
            auditLogService.record(
                    ACTION_SUCESSO,
                    ENTITY_TYPE,
                    passenger.getId(),
                    actorSub,
                    "refundId=" + result.refundId()
                            + "; paymentIntentId=" + paymentIntentId
                            + "; amountCents=" + amountCents
                            + "; rideId=" + ride.getId());
        } else {
            auditLogService.record(
                    ACTION_FALHOU,
                    ENTITY_TYPE,
                    passenger.getId(),
                    actorSub,
                    "error=" + result.error()
                            + "; paymentIntentId=" + paymentIntentId
                            + "; amountCents=" + amountCents
                            + "; rideId=" + ride.getId());
        }

        return true;
    }

    /** Converte um valor monetÃ¡rio (ex.: 50.00) em centavos (5000). */
    static long toCents(BigDecimal amount) {
        return amount.movePointRight(2)
                .setScale(0, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
                .longValueExact();
    }
}

@Service
public class RideService {

    private final RideRepository rideRepository;
    private final VehicleRepository vehicleRepository;
    private final RidePricingProperties pricing;
    private final RideRulesProperties rules;
    private final Clock clock;

    /** DistÃ¢ncia mÃ¡xima (m) entre a rota e o embarque/desembarque na busca. */
    public static final double MAX_SEARCH_RADIUS_METERS = 50_000;

    public RideService(RideRepository rideRepository, VehicleRepository vehicleRepository,
                       RidePricingProperties pricing, RideRulesProperties rules, Clock clock) {
        this.rideRepository = rideRepository;
        this.vehicleRepository = vehicleRepository;
        this.pricing = pricing;
        this.rules = rules;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    /**
     * Publica a carona.
     *
     * @param driverIsBusiness o motorista tem conta PJ (CNPJ/MEI). SÃ³ importa com a
     *        regra {@code raiji.rules.intermunicipal-requires-business} ligada.
     */
    @Transactional
    public RideResponse create(RideRequest request, String driverSub, String driverName,
                               boolean driverIsBusiness) {
        validarDepartureDate(request.departureDate());
        validarCargoDetails(request);
        validarPreco(request.pricePerPassenger());
        validarVagas(request.type(), request.totalSeats());
        validarRegraIntermunicipal(request, driverIsBusiness);

        Vehicle vehicle = vehicleDoMotorista(request.vehicleId(), driverSub);
        validarTotalSeats(request.totalSeats(), vehicle);

        Ride ride = new Ride();
        ride.setType(request.type());
        ride.setDriverSub(driverSub);
        ride.setDriverName(driverName);
        ride.setVehicleId(vehicle.getId());
        ride.setOriginCity(request.originCity().trim());
        ride.setOriginState(request.originState().toUpperCase());
        ride.setDestinationCity(request.destinationCity().trim());
        ride.setDestinationState(request.destinationState().toUpperCase());
        ride.setDepartureDate(request.departureDate());
        ride.setPricePerPassenger(request.pricePerPassenger());
        ride.setPlatformFeePercent(pricing.platformFeePercent());
        ride.setTotalSeats(request.totalSeats());
        ride.setAvailableSeats(request.totalSeats());
        ride.setStatus(RideStatus.PLANNED);
        ride.setCargoDetails(request.cargoDetails());
        ride.setMeetingPoint(trimToNull(request.meetingPoint()));
        validarPreco(request.pricePerPackage());
        if (request.pricePerPackage() != null && request.type() == RideType.PASSENGER) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "pricePerPackage sÃ³ vale para viagens que levam encomendas (CARGO ou MIXED).");
        }
        ride.setPricePerPackage(request.pricePerPackage());
        aplicarLocalizacao(ride, request.origin(), request.destination(), request.route());

        return RideResponse.from(rideRepository.save(ride));
    }

    /**
     * Viagem EXCLUSIVA de carga, criada quando um motorista fecha um frete com uma

     */
    @Transactional
    public Ride createPrivateCargoRide(String driverSub, String driverName, UUID vehicleId,
                                       String originCity, String originState, Place origin,

        Vehicle vehicle = vehicleDoMotorista(vehicleId, driverSub);
        Ride ride = new Ride();
        ride.setType(RideType.CARGO);
        ride.setVisibility(RideVisibility.PRIVATE);
        ride.setDriverSub(driverSub);

        ride.setOriginCity(originCity.trim());
        ride.setOriginState(originState.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
        ride.setDestinationCity(destinationCity.trim());
        ride.setDestinationState(destinationState.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
        ride.setDepartureDate(departureDate);
        ride.setTotalSeats(0);
