        ride.setStatus(RideStatus.PLANNED);
        ride.setPlatformFeePercent(pricing.platformFeePercent());
        ride.setCargoDetails(cargoDetails);
        aplicarLocalizacao(ride, origin, destination, null);
        return rideRepository.save(ride);
    }

    /** Detalhe da carona; viagem exclusiva (PRIVATE) sÃ³ para o prÃ³prio motorista. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public RideDetailResponse get(UUID rideId, String requesterSub) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findById(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .filter(r -> r.getVisibility() == RideVisibility.PUBLIC || r.getDriverSub().equals(requesterSub))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."));
        List<LatLng> route = ride.getRoute() == null ? List.of()
                : java.util.Arrays.stream(ride.getRoute().getCoordinates())
                        .map(c -> new LatLng(c.y, c.x)).toList();
        return new RideDetailResponse(RideResponse.from(ride), route);
    }

    /** "Minhas viagens" do motorista. Sem status: as que ainda vÃ£o acontecer ou estÃ£o em andamento. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<RideResponse> mine(String driverSub, List<RideStatus> statuses) {
        List<RideStatus> filtro = statuses == null || statuses.isEmpty()
                ? List.of(RideStatus.PLANNED, RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS) : statuses;
        return rideRepository.findByDriverSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNullOrderByDepartureDateAsc(driverSub, filtro)
                .stream().map(RideResponse::from).toList();
    }

    /**
     * Busca pelo caminho: perto de mim (sÃ³ origem), de A para B, ou embarcando e
     * descendo no meio da rota. {@code kind} = SEAT (vaga) ou PACKAGE (encomenda).
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<RideSearchResult> searchAlongRoute(String requesterSub, LatLng origin, LatLng destination,
                                                   double radiusMeters, LocalDateTime from, LocalDateTime to,
                                                   SearchKind kind) {
        if (origin == null || origin.latitude() == null || origin.longitude() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Informe o ponto de embarque (latitude e longitude).");
        }
        GeoSupport.validate(origin.latitude(), origin.longitude());
        boolean hasDest = destination != null && destination.latitude() != null && destination.longitude() != null;
        if (hasDest) {
            GeoSupport.validate(destination.latitude(), destination.longitude());
        }
        if (radiusMeters <= 0 || radiusMeters > MAX_SEARCH_RADIUS_METERS) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "O raio deve ser maior que zero e no mÃ¡ximo 50 km.");
        }
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now(clock);
        LocalDateTime inicio = from == null || from.isBefore(now) ? now : from;
        LocalDateTime fim = to == null ? now.plusMonths(3) : to;
        if (!fim.isAfter(inicio)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "O fim do perÃ­odo deve ser depois do inÃ­cio.");
        }
        List<String> tipos = kind == SearchKind.PACKAGE
                ? List.of(RideType.CARGO.name(), RideType.MIXED.name())
                : List.of(RideType.PASSENGER.name(), RideType.MIXED.name());

        List<RideRouteMatch> matches = rideRepository.searchAlongRoute(
                origin.latitude(), origin.longitude(), hasDest,
                hasDest ? destination.latitude() : 0, hasDest ? destination.longitude() : 0,
                radiusMeters, inicio, fim, tipos, kind == SearchKind.SEAT, requesterSub == null ? "" : requesterSub);
        if (matches.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        Map<UUID, Ride> rides = rideRepository.findAllById(matches.stream().map(RideRouteMatch::getId).toList())
                .stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(Ride::getId, r -> r));
        Map<UUID, Vehicle> veiculos = vehicleRepository.findAllById(
                        rides.values().stream().map(Ride::getVehicleId).distinct().toList())
                .stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(Vehicle::getId, v -> v));
        List<RideSearchResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
        for (RideRouteMatch m : matches) {
            Ride ride = rides.get(m.getId());
            if (ride == null) continue;
            double fraction = SegmentPricing.fraction(m.getPickupFraction(), hasDest ? m.getDropoffFraction() : null);
            results.add(new RideSearchResult(
                    RideResponse.from(ride),
                    (int) Math.round(m.getPickupDistance()),
                    m.getDropoffDistance() == null ? null : (int) Math.round(m.getDropoffDistance()),
                    Math.round(fraction * 1000) / 1000.0,
                    SegmentPricing.isFullRoute(fraction),
                    SegmentPricing.price(ride.getPricePerPassenger(), fraction),
                    descreverVeiculo(veiculos.get(ride.getVehicleId())),
                    SegmentPricing.price(ride.getPricePerPackage(), fraction)));
        }
        return results;
    }

    public enum SearchKind { SEAT, PACKAGE }

    private static String descreverVeiculo(Vehicle v) {
        if (v == null) return null;
        return v.getColor() == null || v.getColor().isBlank() ? v.getModel() : v.getModel() + " Â· " + v.getColor();
    }

    private void aplicarLocalizacao(Ride ride, Place origin, Place destination, List<LatLng> route) {
        if (origin == null && destination == null) {
            if (route != null && !route.isEmpty()) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Para enviar a rota, informe tambÃ©m origin e destination.");
            }
            return; // contrato antigo: sÃ³ cidades (nÃ£o aparece na busca pelo caminho)
        }
        if (origin == null || destination == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Informe origin e destination juntos (coordenadas do mapa).");
        }
        try {
            ride.setOriginLocation(GeoSupport.point(origin.latitude(), origin.longitude()));
            ride.setDestinationLocation(GeoSupport.point(destination.latitude(), destination.longitude()));
            List<LatLng> caminho = route == null || route.size() < 2
                    ? List.of(new LatLng(origin.latitude(), origin.longitude()),
                              new LatLng(destination.latitude(), destination.longitude()))
                    : route;
            LineString linha = GeoSupport.route(caminho);
            ride.setRoute(linha);
            ride.setRouteDistanceMeters(GeoSupport.lengthMeters(linha));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, e.getMessage());
        }
        ride.setOriginAddress(trimToNull(origin.address()));
        ride.setDestinationAddress(trimToNull(destination.address()));
    }

    private static String trimToNull(String s) {
        return s == null || s.isBlank() ? null : s.trim();
    }

    /** SÃ³ encomendas (CARGO) = 0 vagas; com passageiros (PASSENGER/MIXED) = pelo menos 1. */
    private static void validarVagas(RideType type, Integer totalSeats) {
        int vagas = totalSeats == null ? 0 : totalSeats;
        if (type == RideType.CARGO && vagas != 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Viagem sÃ³ de encomendas (CARGO) nÃ£o tem vagas: use MIXED para levar passageiros tambÃ©m.");
        }
        if (type != RideType.CARGO && vagas < 1) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Viagem com passageiros precisa de pelo menos 1 vaga (totalSeats).");
        }
    }

    @Transactional
    public RideResponse updatePrice(UUID rideId, BigDecimal novoPreco, String driverSub) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findById(rideId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."));

        if (!ride.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Carona pertence a outro motorista.");
        }

        if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "SÃ³ Ã© possÃ­vel alterar o preÃ§o em caronas PLANNED (RN08).");
        }

        validarPreco(novoPreco);

        // A comissÃ£o continua a gravada na publicaÃ§Ã£o: mudar o preÃ§o nÃ£o muda a regra
        ride.setPricePerPassenger(novoPreco);
        return RideResponse.from(rideRepository.save(ride));
    }

    /** PrÃ©via para a tela de publicar: quanto fica com a plataforma e quanto o motorista recebe. */
    public PriceBreakdown previewPrice(BigDecimal price) {
        validarPreco(price);
        return PriceBreakdown.of(price, pricing.platformFeePercent());
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public RideSearchResponse search(RideSearchFilter filter, Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable sorted = withDefaultSort(pageable);
        Page<Ride> page = rideRepository.findAll(RideSpecification.search(filter), sorted);
        return RideSearchResponse.from(page);
    }

    private Pageable withDefaultSort(Pageable pageable) {
        if (pageable.getSort().isUnsorted()) {
            return PageRequest.of(
                    pageable.getPageNumber(),
                    pageable.getPageSize(),
                    Sort.by("departureDate").ascending());
        }
        return pageable;
    }

    private void validarDepartureDate(LocalDateTime departure) {
        LocalDateTime agora = LocalDateTime.now(clock);

        if (departure.isBefore(agora.plusMinutes(5))) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "departureDate deve estar pelo menos 5 minutos no futuro.");
        }

        if (departure.isAfter(agora.plusMonths(3))) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "departureDate nÃ£o pode exceder 3 meses (RN10).");
        }
    }

    private static void validarPreco(BigDecimal preco) {
        if (preco != null && preco.signum() < 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "pricePerPassenger nÃ£o pode ser negativo.");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Regra liga/desliga: carona entre cidades diferentes sÃ³ para conta PJ (CNPJ/MEI).
     * Desligada por padrÃ£o ({@code raiji.rules.intermunicipal-requires-business=false}).
     */
    private void validarRegraIntermunicipal(RideRequest request, boolean driverIsBusiness) {
        if (!rules.intermunicipalRequiresBusiness() || driverIsBusiness) {
            return;
        }
        if (isIntermunicipal(request.originCity(), request.originState(),
                request.destinationCity(), request.destinationState())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "Caronas entre cidades diferentes exigem conta PJ (CNPJ ou MEI).");
        }
    }

    static boolean isIntermunicipal(String originCity, String originState,
                                    String destinationCity, String destinationState) {
        return !normalizar(originState).equals(normalizar(destinationState))
                || !normalizar(originCity).equals(normalizar(destinationCity));
    }

    /** "SÃ£o Paulo " e "sao paulo" sÃ£o a mesma cidade. */
    private static String normalizar(String texto) {
        if (texto == null) {
            return "";
        }
        return Normalizer.normalize(texto.trim(), Normalizer.Form.NFD)
                .replaceAll("\\p{M}", "")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private void validarCargoDetails(RideRequest request) {
        boolean ehCarga = request.type() == RideType.CARGO
                || request.type() == RideType.MIXED;

        if (ehCarga && (request.cargoDetails() == null
                || !request.cargoDetails().hasCargoCapacity())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "cargoDetails com capacidade > 0 Ã© obrigatÃ³rio para type CARGO/MIXED.");
        }
    }

    private Vehicle vehicleDoMotorista(UUID vehicleId, String driverSub) {
        return vehicleRepository
                .findByIdAndOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull(vehicleId, driverSub)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                        "VeÃ­culo nÃ£o encontrado ou nÃ£o pertence ao motorista."));
    }

    private void validarTotalSeats(Integer totalSeats, Vehicle vehicle) {
        int maxSeats = vehicle.getPassengerSeats() != null
                ? vehicle.getPassengerSeats()
                : 4;

        if (totalSeats > maxSeats) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "totalSeats nÃ£o pode exceder os assentos do veÃ­culo (RN03).");
        }
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/service/stripe/StripeRefundGatewayImpl.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.service.stripe;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import com.raiji.rides.config.StripeProperties;
import com.stripe.exception.StripeException;
import com.stripe.model.Refund;
import com.stripe.net.RequestOptions;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” implementaÃ§Ã£o de produÃ§Ã£o do {@link StripeRefundGateway}
 * usando o SDK oficial {@code com.stripe:stripe-java}.
 *
 * <p>A chave Ã© passada por {@link RequestOptions} (nÃ£o alteramos o estado
 * global {@code Stripe.apiKey}), o que mantÃ©m a chamada isolada e thread-safe.
 * Em sandbox basta usar uma chave {@code sk_test_*} via {@code STRIPE_API_KEY}.
 */
@Component
public class StripeRefundGatewayImpl implements StripeRefundGateway {

    private final StripeProperties properties;

    public StripeRefundGatewayImpl(StripeProperties properties) {
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @Override
    public String createRefund(String paymentIntentId, long amountCents)
            throws StripeException {

        Map<String, Object> params = new HashMap<>();
        params.put("payment_intent", paymentIntentId);
        if (amountCents > 0) {
            params.put("amount", amountCents);
        }

        RequestOptions options = RequestOptions.builder()
                .setApiKey(properties.apiKey())
                .build();

        Refund refund = Refund.create(params, options);
        return refund.getId();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/service/stripe/StripeRefundGateway.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.service.stripe;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” "seam" (ponto de substituiÃ§Ã£o) para a chamada real ao
 * Stripe. A implementaÃ§Ã£o de produÃ§Ã£o ({@link StripeRefundGatewayImpl}) usa o
 * SDK {@code com.stripe}; nos testes injetamos um fake determinÃ­stico, sem
 * rede e sem chave real (o aceite da issue exige {@code sk_test_*} e "nÃ£o faz
 * chamadas reais de cobranÃ§a").
 */
public interface StripeRefundGateway {

    /**
     * Cria um estorno (total ou parcial) sobre um PaymentIntent.
     *
     * @param paymentIntentId identificador do pagamento ({@code pi_...})
     * @param amountCents     valor em centavos; {@code <= 0} => estorno total
     * @return ID do refund criado ({@code re_...})
     * @throws Exception qualquer falha do provedor (tratada pelo {@code StripeService})
     */
    String createRefund(String paymentIntentId, long amountCents) throws Exception;
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/service/stripe/StripeRefundResult.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.service.stripe;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” resultado de uma tentativa de estorno no Stripe.
 *
 * <p>Nunca propagamos exceÃ§Ã£o do Stripe para o fluxo de cancelamento: a
 * falha Ã© representada aqui ({@code ok=false} + {@code error}) e registrada
 * na auditoria como {@code ESTORNO_FALHOU}.
 *
 * @param ok       {@code true} se o refund foi criado com sucesso
 * @param refundId ID do refund no Stripe (ex.: {@code re_...}) quando ok
 * @param error    mensagem de erro quando {@code ok=false}
 */
public record StripeRefundResult(
        boolean ok,
        String refundId,
        String error
) {

    public static StripeRefundResult success(String refundId) {
        return new StripeRefundResult(true, refundId, null);
    }

    public static StripeRefundResult failure(String error) {
        return new StripeRefundResult(false, null, error);
    }
}

===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/service/stripe/StripeService.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.service.stripe;

import com.raiji.rides.config.StripeProperties;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” fachada de estorno do Stripe.
 *
 * <p>Contrato da issue: {@code refund(paymentIntentId, amountCents)}. Este
 * mÃ©todo <b>nunca propaga exceÃ§Ã£o</b> â€” qualquer falha (Stripe indisponÃ­vel,
 * chave invÃ¡lida, PaymentIntent inexistente) vira um {@link StripeRefundResult}
 * com {@code ok=false}, para que o cancelamento da reserva seja sempre
 * concluÃ­do (critÃ©rio: "Falha no Stripe nÃ£o impede cancelamento").
 */
@Service
public class StripeService {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(StripeService.class);

    private final StripeProperties properties;
    private final StripeRefundGateway gateway;

    public StripeService(StripeProperties properties, StripeRefundGateway gateway) {
        this.properties = properties;
        this.gateway = gateway;
    }

    /**
     * Estorna {@code amountCents} do pagamento {@code paymentIntentId}.
     *
     * @return resultado com {@code refundId} (sucesso) ou {@code error} (falha)
     */
    public StripeRefundResult refund(String paymentIntentId, long amountCents) {
        if (paymentIntentId == null || paymentIntentId.isBlank()) {
            return StripeRefundResult.failure("paymentIntentId ausente");
        }

        if (!properties.configured()) {
            // Sem chave (ex.: ambiente local/CI sem segredo) => nÃ£o chamamos a
            // API real; a falha Ã© controlada e registrada como ESTORNO_FALHOU.
            return StripeRefundResult.failure(
                    "Stripe nÃ£o configurado (raiji.stripe.api-key ausente)");
        }

        try {
            String refundId = gateway.createRefund(paymentIntentId, amountCents);
            log.info(
                    "Estorno Stripe criado: refund={} paymentIntent={} amountCents={}",
                    refundId, paymentIntentId, amountCents);
            return StripeRefundResult.success(refundId);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            String erro = e.getMessage() == null
                    ? e.getClass().getSimpleName()
                    : e.getMessage();
            log.error(
                    "Falha ao estornar no Stripe (paymentIntent={}): {}",
                    paymentIntentId, erro);
            return StripeRefundResult.failure(erro);
        }
    }
}

    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public RideResponse cancel(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id,
                               @RequestBody(required = false) CancelRideRequest body) {
        return lifecycle.cancel(id, jwt.getSubject(), body == null ? null : body.reason());
    }

    @GetMapping
    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
    public ResponseEntity<RideSearchResponse> search(
            @PageableDefault(size = 20, sort = "departureDate", direction = Sort.Direction.ASC)
            Pageable pageable,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String originCity,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String destinationCity,
            @RequestParam(required = false)
            @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime departureFrom,
            @RequestParam(required = false)
            @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME) LocalDateTime departureTo,
            @RequestParam(required = false) BigDecimal maxPrice,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Boolean freeOnly,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Integer minSeats) {

        RideSearchFilter filter = new RideSearchFilter(
                originCity,
                destinationCity,
                departureFrom,
                departureTo,
                maxPrice,
                freeOnly,
                minSeats);

        return ResponseEntity.ok(rideService.search(filter, pageable));
    }

    @PostMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public ResponseEntity<RideResponse> create(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            Authentication authentication,
            @Valid @RequestBody RideRequest request) {

        // Conta PJ: o tipo de conta PJ ou participar de uma empresa (CNPJ conferido na Receita)
        boolean business = authentication.getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(a -> "ROLE_PJ".equals(a.getAuthority()))
                || companyMembership.isMemberOfAnyCompany(jwt.getSubject());

        RideResponse response = rideService.create(
                request,
                jwt.getSubject(),
                jwt.getClaimAsString("name"),
                business);

        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(response);
    }

    /**
     * PrÃ©via para a tela de publicar: GET /api/rides/price-preview?price=50.00
     * responde quanto fica com a plataforma e quanto o motorista recebe por vaga.
     */
    @GetMapping("/price-preview")
    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
    public PriceBreakdown pricePreview(@RequestParam BigDecimal price) {
        return rideService.previewPrice(price);
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}/price")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public ResponseEntity<RideResponse> updatePrice(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @RequestBody PriceUpdateRequest request,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {

        RideResponse response = rideService.updatePrice(
                id,
                request.pricePerPassenger(),
                jwt.getSubject());

        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    public record PriceUpdateRequest(BigDecimal pricePerPassenger) {}
}

package com.raiji.rides.web;

import com.raiji.common.Roles;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.RideIntent;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.enums.RideIntentMode;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.enums.RideIntentType;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideIntentCreateRequest;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideIntentResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.service.RideIntentService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/ride-intents")
@PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('PASSENGER', 'DRIVER')")
public class RideIntentController {

    private final RideIntentService service;

    public RideIntentController(RideIntentService service){
        this.service = service;
    }


    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public RideIntentResponse create(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            Authentication authentication,
            @Valid @RequestBody RideIntentCreateRequest request
    ) {
        // Toda conta Ã© passageira; "estou disponÃ­vel como motorista" exige a role DRIVER,
        // que sÃ³ vem de uma CNH verificada.
        if (request.type() == RideIntentType.DRIVER_OFFER && !hasRole(authentication, Roles.DRIVER)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "Para se oferecer como motorista, verifique sua CNH (POST /api/users/me/driver/cnh).");
        }

        RideIntent intent = service.create(
                jwt.getSubject(),
                request.type(),
                request.mode(),
                request.originCity(),
                request.originState(),
                request.originLatitude(),
                request.originLongitude(),
                request.destinationCity(),
                request.destinationState(),
                request.destinationLatitude(),
                request.destinationLongitude(),
                request.desiredAt()
        );

        return RideIntentResponse.from(intent);
    }

    @GetMapping("/nearby")
    public List<RideIntentResponse> nearby(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            @RequestParam RideIntentType type,
            @RequestParam RideIntentMode mode,
            @RequestParam double latitude,
            @RequestParam double longitude,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "5000") double radiusMeters) {

        // IntenÃ§Ãµes de OUTRAS pessoas: local aproximado + distÃ¢ncia (privacidade â€”
        // nÃ£o expor o ponto exato de quem pediu carona a qualquer um num raio de atÃ© 100 km)
        return service.findNearby(
                        jwt.getSubject(),
                        type,
                        mode,
                        latitude,
                        longitude,
                        radiusMeters)
                .stream()
                .map(intent -> RideIntentResponse.approximate(intent, latitude, longitude))
                .toList();
    }

    private static boolean hasRole(Authentication authentication, String role) {
        return authentication != null && authentication.getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(a -> ("ROLE_" + role).equals(a.getAuthority()));
    }

    @GetMapping("/me")
    public List<RideIntentResponse> myIntents(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {

        return service.findMyIntents(jwt.getSubject())
                .stream()
                .map(RideIntentResponse::from)
                .toList();
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    public void cancel(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            @PathVariable UUID id) {

        service.cancel(jwt.getSubject(), id);
    }
}
===== ./raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/web/RideIntentExceptionHandler.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.web;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import jakarta.persistence.EntityNotFoundException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;

/**
 * Erros das intenÃ§Ãµes de carona, no MESMO formato JSON do resto da API
 * (timestamp, status, error, message, path â€” ver ApiErrorHandler no raiji-app).
 *
 * CorreÃ§Ã£o: antes tratava IllegalAccessException (exceÃ§Ã£o de reflexÃ£o do Java),
 * mas o serviÃ§o lanÃ§a IllegalArgumentException â€” dados invÃ¡lidos viravam 500.
 */
@RestControllerAdvice(assignableTypes = RideIntentController.class)
public class RideIntentExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(EntityNotFoundException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleNotFound(EntityNotFoundException exception, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, exception.getMessage(), request);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleBadRequest(IllegalArgumentException exception, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, exception.getMessage(), request);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalStateException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleConflict(IllegalStateException exception, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, exception.getMessage(), request);
    }

    private static ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> body(HttpStatus status, String message, HttpServletRequest request) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        body.put("timestamp", Instant.now().toString());
        body.put("status", status.value());
        body.put("error", status.getReasonPhrase());
        body.put("message", message);
        body.put("path", request.getRequestURI());
        return ResponseEntity.status(status).body(body);
    }
}

/**

 *

 * o PATCH /{requestId} Ã© exclusivo deste controller â€” sem colisÃ£o de rota.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/rides/{rideId}/requests")
public class RidePassengerController {

    private final RidePassengerService ridePassengerService;

    public RidePassengerController(
            RidePassengerService ridePassengerService
    ) {
        this.ridePassengerService = ridePassengerService;
    }

    /** "Aceitar todos" os pedidos pendentes de viagem inteira, enquanto houver vaga e espaÃ§o. */
    @PostMapping("/accept-all")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public AcceptAllResponse acceptAll(@PathVariable UUID rideId, @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return ridePassengerService.acceptAll(rideId, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @PutMapping("/{requestId}/baggage")
    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
    public RidePassengerResponse updateBaggage(@PathVariable UUID rideId, @PathVariable UUID requestId,
                                               @Valid @RequestBody BaggageUpdateRequest body,
                                               @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return ridePassengerService.updateBaggage(rideId, requestId, jwt.getSubject(), body.baggage());
    }

    public record BaggageDecisionRequest(@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull RideDecision decision) {}

    /** O motorista aprova (ACCEPT) ou recusa (REJECT) a bagagem nova. */
    @PatchMapping("/{requestId}/baggage")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public RidePassengerResponse decideBaggage(@PathVariable UUID rideId, @PathVariable UUID requestId,
                                               @Valid @RequestBody BaggageDecisionRequest body,
                                               @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return ridePassengerService.decideBaggageChange(rideId, requestId, jwt.getSubject(),
                body.decision() == RideDecision.ACCEPT);
    }

    /** 200 => {id, status, confirmedAt}. reason obrigatÃ³rio no REJECT. */
    @PatchMapping("/{requestId}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public RideDecisionResponse decide(
            @PathVariable UUID rideId,
            @PathVariable UUID requestId,
            @Valid @RequestBody RideDecisionRequest request,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt
    ) {
        return ridePassengerService.decide(
                rideId,
                requestId,
                jwt.getSubject(),
                request.decision(),
                request.reason(),
                request.paymentIntentId()
        );
    }

    /**
     * S2-04 / RF09 + RN06 â€” cancela a reserva e libera a vaga imediatamente.
     *
     * <p>Aceita o passageiro dono da reserva OU o motorista dono da carona; a

     * <p>200 =&gt; {@code {id, rideId, status=CANCELLED, cancelledAt,
     * cancellationReason, seatReleased}}.

    @DeleteMapping("/{requestId}")

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rides (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    ride_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    driver_id UUID NOT NULL,
    driver_name VARCHAR(150),
    vehicle_id UUID NOT NULL,

===== ./raiji-rides/src/test/java/com/raiji/rides/scheduler/RideStatusSchedulerTest.java =====
package com.raiji.rides.scheduler;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.enums.RideStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideRepository;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;

/**
 * S2-06 / RF10 + RN05 â€” testes unitÃ¡rios do {@link RideStatusScheduler} com
 * {@link Clock} mockado (fixo) e repositÃ³rio mockado.
 *
 * <p>Cobre: promoÃ§Ã£o de PLANNED vencidas, o limite exato
 * {@code departureDate == now()} (incluso), caronas futuras nÃ£o afetadas e
 * idempotÃªncia (2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o reprocessa).
 */
@DisplayName("RideStatusScheduler â€” status automÃ¡tico (S2-06/RN05)")
class RideStatusSchedulerTest {

    private RideRepository rideRepository;
    private RideStatusScheduler scheduler;

    /** RelÃ³gio fixo em 2026-06-01T10:00:00Z. */
    private LocalDateTime now;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        rideRepository = mock(RideRepository.class);

        Instant instant = LocalDateTime.of(2026, 6, 1, 10, 0, 0)
                .toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC);
        Clock fixed = Clock.fixed(instant, ZoneOffset.UTC);
        now = LocalDateTime.now(fixed); // == 2026-06-01T10:00

        scheduler = new RideStatusScheduler(rideRepository, fixed);
    }

    private Ride ride(LocalDateTime departure, RideStatus status) {
        Ride r = new Ride();
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(r, "id", UUID.randomUUID());
        r.setDepartureDate(departure);
        r.setStatus(status);
        return r;
    }

    private void stubConsulta(List<Ride> resultado) {
        when(rideRepository
                .findByStatusAndDepartureDateLessThanEqualAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                        RideStatus.PLANNED, now))
                .thenReturn(resultado);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("promove PLANNED com partida vencida e no limite exato (== now)")
    void devePromoverVencidasENoLimiteExato() {
        Ride vencida = ride(now.minusMinutes(1), RideStatus.PLANNED);
        Ride noLimite = ride(now, RideStatus.PLANNED); // departureDate == now
        stubConsulta(List.of(vencida, noLimite));

        int promovidas = scheduler.promoteDueRides();

        assertEquals(2, promovidas);
        assertEquals(RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS, vencida.getStatus());
        assertEquals(RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS, noLimite.getStatus(),
                "o limite exato departureDate == now() deve ser promovido (<=)");
        verify(rideRepository).saveAll(List.of(vencida, noLimite));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("usa cutoff = now(clock) na consulta (relÃ³gio injetÃ¡vel)")
    void deveUsarCutoffDoClock() {
        stubConsulta(List.of());

        scheduler.promoteDueRides();

        verify(rideRepository)
                .findByStatusAndDepartureDateLessThanEqualAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                        RideStatus.PLANNED, now);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("nada a promover => nÃ£o salva (caronas futuras nÃ£o sÃ£o afetadas)")
    void naoDevePromoverQuandoNadaVence() {
        stubConsulta(List.of());

        int promovidas = scheduler.promoteDueRides();

        assertEquals(0, promovidas);
        verify(rideRepository, never()).saveAll(any());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("idempotente: 2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o reprocessa carona jÃ¡ IN_PROGRESS")
    void deveSerIdempotente() {
        Ride vencida = ride(now.minusMinutes(5), RideStatus.PLANNED);
        when(rideRepository
                .findByStatusAndDepartureDateLessThanEqualAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                        RideStatus.PLANNED, now))
                .thenReturn(List.of(vencida))  // 1Âª execuÃ§Ã£o: ainda PLANNED
                .thenReturn(List.of());        // 2Âª: a consulta filtra PLANNED

        assertEquals(1, scheduler.promoteDueRides());
        assertEquals(RideStatus.IN_PROGRESS, vencida.getStatus());

        assertEquals(0, scheduler.promoteDueRides(),
                "nenhuma carona nova na 2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o");
        verify(rideRepository).saveAll(any());
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.Notification;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.NotificationAudience;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.RideDecision;
import com.raiji.rides.event.RideCancelledEvent;
import com.raiji.rides.event.RideDecisionEvent;
import com.raiji.rides.event.RideRequestCreatedEvent;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.NotificationRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;

/**
 * A mesma conta pode ser passageira e motorista: cada notificaÃ§Ã£o diz em
 * qual modo do app ela aparece.
 */
class NotificationServiceTest {

    private static final UUID RIDE = UUID.randomUUID();
    private static final String DRIVER = "driver-sub";
    private static final String PASSENGER = "passenger-sub";

    private NotificationRepository repository;
    private NotificationService service;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        repository = mock(NotificationRepository.class);
        service = new NotificationService(repository);
    }

    private Notification saved() {
        ArgumentCaptor<Notification> captor = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(Notification.class);
        verify(repository).save(captor.capture());
        return captor.getValue();
    }

    @Test
    void novaSolicitacaoVaiParaOModoMotorista() {
        service.handleRideRequestCreated(new RideRequestCreatedEvent(
                RIDE, DRIVER, "Carlos", PASSENGER, "Ana", Instant.now()));

        Notification n = saved();
        assertEquals(DRIVER, n.getRecipientSub());
        assertEquals(NotificationAudience.DRIVER, n.getAudience());
    }

    @Test
    void decisaoVaiParaOModoPassageiro() {
        service.handleRideDecision(new RideDecisionEvent(
                RIDE, UUID.randomUUID(), DRIVER, "Carlos", PASSENGER, "Ana",
                RideDecision.ACCEPT, null, Instant.now()));

        Notification n = saved();
        assertEquals(PASSENGER, n.getRecipientSub());
        assertEquals(NotificationAudience.PASSENGER, n.getAudience());
    }

    @Test
    void cancelamentoVaiParaOModoMotorista() {
        service.handleRideCancelled(new RideCancelledEvent(
                RIDE, UUID.randomUUID(), DRIVER, "Carlos", PASSENGER, "Ana",
                "imprevisto", Instant.now(), true));

        Notification n = saved();
        assertEquals(DRIVER, n.getRecipientSub());
        assertEquals(NotificationAudience.DRIVER, n.getAudience());
    }
}

        verify(eventPublisher).publishEvent(any(RideDecisionEvent.class));
    }

    private static Baggage bagagem(String pesoKg, int quantidade,
                                   int lengthCm, int widthCm, int heightCm) {
        Baggage b = new Baggage();
        b.setType(BaggageType.MALA);
        b.setQuantity(quantidade);
        b.setLengthCm(lengthCm);
        b.setWidthCm(widthCm);
        b.setHeightCm(heightCm);
        if (pesoKg != null) {
            b.setWeightKg(new BigDecimal(pesoKg));
        }
        return b;
    }

    private RidePassenger solicitacaoPendenteComBagagem(Baggage... itens) {
        RidePassenger passenger = solicitacaoPendente();
        for (Baggage b : itens) {
            passenger.addBaggage(b);
        }
        // em produÃ§Ã£o o candidato consta na listagem da carona (mesma
        // transaÃ§Ã£o); no teste unitÃ¡rio garantimos o mesmo comportamento
        when(passengerRepository.findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId))
                .thenReturn(List.of(passenger));
        return passenger;
    }

    private RidePassenger confirmadoComBagagem(Baggage... itens) {
        RidePassenger passenger = new RidePassenger();
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(passenger, "id", UUID.randomUUID());
        passenger.setRideId(rideId);
        passenger.setPassengerSub("confirmado-" + UUID.randomUUID());
        passenger.setPassengerName("Passageiro Confirmado");
        passenger.confirm();
        for (Baggage b : itens) {
            passenger.addBaggage(b);
        }
        return passenger;
    }

    @Test
    void deveCancelarReservaConfirmadaLiberandoVaga() {

        ride.setAvailableSeats(2);
        RidePassenger confirmada = solicitacaoConfirmada();

        RideCancelResponse response = service.cancel(
                rideId, confirmada.getId(), PASSENGER_SUB, "Imprevisto pessoal");

        assertEquals(RidePassengerStatus.CANCELLED, response.status());
        assertEquals("Imprevisto pessoal", response.cancellationReason());
        assertNotNull(response.cancelledAt(), "critÃ©rio de aceite: CANCELLED com data");
        assertTrue(response.seatReleased());

        // vaga liberada na hora: availableSeats++
        assertEquals(3, ride.getAvailableSeats());
        verify(rideRepository).save(ride);
        verify(passengerRepository).save(any(RidePassenger.class));
        verify(eventPublisher).publishEvent(any(RideCancelledEvent.class));
    }

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” testes unitÃ¡rios do {@link RideRefundService}.
 *
 * <p>Cobre os critÃ©rios de aceite: carona paga estorna + audita
 * (ESTORNO_SUCESSO com id do refund); falha do Stripe audita ESTORNO_FALHOU;
 * carona gratuita NÃƒO chama o Stripe; reserva sem paymentIntent nÃ£o estorna.
 */
@DisplayName("RideRefundService â€” estorno automÃ¡tico (RN04)")
class RideRefundServiceTest {

    private StripeService stripeService;
    private AuditLogService auditLogService;
    private RideRefundService service;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        stripeService = mock(StripeService.class);
        auditLogService = mock(AuditLogService.class);
        service = new RideRefundService(stripeService, auditLogService);
    }

    private Ride ride(String price) {
        Ride ride = new Ride();
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(ride, "id", UUID.randomUUID());
        ride.setPricePerPassenger(price == null ? null : new BigDecimal(price));
        return ride;
    }

    private RidePassenger reserva(String paymentIntentId) {
        RidePassenger p = new RidePassenger();
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(p, "id", UUID.randomUUID());
        p.setPaymentIntentId(paymentIntentId);
        return p;
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("carona paga + paymentIntent => estorna e audita ESTORNO_SUCESSO com refundId")
    void deveEstornarCaronaPaga() {
        Ride ride = ride("50.00");
        RidePassenger p = reserva("pi_1");
        when(stripeService.refund("pi_1", 5000L))
                .thenReturn(StripeRefundResult.success("re_1"));

        boolean tentou = service.refundIfApplicable(ride, p, "actor-sub");

        assertTrue(tentou);
        verify(stripeService).refund("pi_1", 5000L);

        ArgumentCaptor<String> action = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(String.class);
        ArgumentCaptor<String> details = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(String.class);
        verify(auditLogService).record(
                action.capture(),
                eq(RideRefundService.ENTITY_TYPE),
                eq(p.getId()),
                eq("actor-sub"),
                details.capture());

        assertEquals(RideRefundService.ACTION_SUCESSO, action.getValue());
        assertTrue(details.getValue().contains("re_1"),
                "a auditoria deve guardar o id do refund");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("falha no Stripe => audita ESTORNO_FALHOU (nÃ£o lanÃ§a)")
    void deveRegistrarEstornoFalhou() {
        Ride ride = ride("10.00");
        RidePassenger p = reserva("pi_2");
        when(stripeService.refund("pi_2", 1000L))
                .thenReturn(StripeRefundResult.failure("timeout de rede"));

        service.refundIfApplicable(ride, p, "actor-sub");

        ArgumentCaptor<String> action = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(String.class);
        ArgumentCaptor<String> details = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(String.class);
        verify(auditLogService).record(
                action.capture(), any(), any(), any(), details.capture());

        assertEquals(RideRefundService.ACTION_FALHOU, action.getValue());
        assertTrue(details.getValue().contains("timeout de rede"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("carona GRATUITA => nÃ£o chama o Stripe nem audita")
    void naoDeveEstornarCaronaGratuita() {
        Ride ride = ride(null);
        RidePassenger p = reserva("pi_3");

        boolean tentou = service.refundIfApplicable(ride, p, "actor-sub");

        assertFalse(tentou);
        verifyNoInteractions(stripeService);
        verifyNoInteractions(auditLogService);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("carona paga SEM paymentIntent => nada a estornar")
    void naoDeveEstornarSemPaymentIntent() {
        Ride ride = ride("20.00");
        RidePassenger p = reserva(null);

        boolean tentou = service.refundIfApplicable(ride, p, "actor-sub");

        assertFalse(tentou);
        verifyNoInteractions(stripeService);
        verifyNoInteractions(auditLogService);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("conversÃ£o R$ -> centavos (arredondamento HALF_UP)")
    void deveConverterReaisEmCentavos() {
        assertEquals(5000L, RideRefundService.toCents(new BigDecimal("50.00")));
        assertEquals(1050L, RideRefundService.toCents(new BigDecimal("10.50")));
        assertEquals(1L, RideRefundService.toCents(new BigDecimal("0.01")));
        assertEquals(0L, RideRefundService.toCents(new BigDecimal("0.00")));
        assertEquals(100L, RideRefundService.toCents(new BigDecimal("0.999")));
    }

package com.raiji.rides.service;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

import com.raiji.rides.config.StripeProperties;
import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeRefundGateway;
import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeRefundResult;
import com.raiji.rides.service.stripe.StripeService;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

/**
 * S2-05 / RN04 â€” testes unitÃ¡rios do {@link StripeService} com um gateway
 * fake (sem rede e sem chave real). Cobre: sucesso, falha capturada (nÃ£o
 * propaga), nÃ£o-configurado (nÃ£o chama a API) e paymentIntent ausente.
 */
@DisplayName("StripeService â€” estorno (RN04)")
class StripeServiceTest {

    private static StripeProperties props(String apiKey) {
        return new StripeProperties(apiKey, null);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("gateway OK => resultado de sucesso com refundId")
    void deveEstornarComSucesso() {
        StripeRefundGateway fake = (pi, cents) -> "re_FAKE_1";
        StripeService service = new StripeService(props("sk_test_123"), fake);

        StripeRefundResult r = service.refund("pi_1", 5000);

        assertTrue(r.ok());
        assertEquals("re_FAKE_1", r.refundId());
        assertNull(r.error());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("falha no gateway => resultado de falha, SEM propagar exceÃ§Ã£o")
    void deveCapturarFalhaSemPropagar() {
        StripeRefundGateway fake = (pi, cents) -> {
            throw new RuntimeException("card declined");
        };
        StripeService service = new StripeService(props("sk_test_123"), fake);

        StripeRefundResult r = service.refund("pi_1", 5000);

        assertFalse(r.ok());
        assertNull(r.refundId());
        assertTrue(r.error().contains("card declined"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Stripe nÃ£o configurado => falha controlada e NENHUMA chamada real")
    void naoDeveChamarGatewayQuandoNaoConfigurado() {
        AtomicInteger calls = new AtomicInteger();
        StripeRefundGateway fake = (pi, cents) -> {
            calls.incrementAndGet();
            return "re_X";
        };
        StripeService service = new StripeService(props(""), fake); // chave em branco

        StripeRefundResult r = service.refund("pi_1", 5000);

        assertFalse(r.ok());
        assertEquals(0, calls.get(), "nÃ£o pode chamar a API sem credencial");
        assertTrue(r.error().toLowerCase().contains("configur"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("paymentIntentId nulo/em branco => falha, sem chamar o gateway")
    void deveFalharQuandoPaymentIntentAusente() {
        AtomicInteger calls = new AtomicInteger();
        StripeRefundGateway fake = (pi, cents) -> {
            calls.incrementAndGet();
            return "re_X";
        };
        StripeService service = new StripeService(props("sk_test_123"), fake);

        assertFalse(service.refund(null, 100).ok());
        assertFalse(service.refund("   ", 100).ok());
        assertEquals(0, calls.get());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("o valor em centavos Ã© repassado ao gateway")
    void deveRepassarValorEmCentavos() {
        AtomicLong captured = new AtomicLong();
        StripeRefundGateway fake = (pi, cents) -> {
            captured.set(cents);
            return "re_1";
        };
        StripeService service = new StripeService(props("sk_test_123"), fake);

        service.refund("pi_1", 12345);

        assertEquals(12345L, captured.get());
    }
}

===== ./raiji-security/src/main/java/com/raiji/security/KeycloakAuthoritiesConverter.java =====
package com.raiji.security;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.core.convert.converter.Converter;
import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;

public final class KeycloakAuthoritiesConverter implements Converter<Jwt, Collection<GrantedAuthority>> {

    private static final String ROLE_PREFIX = "ROLE_";
    private final String apiClientId;

    public KeycloakAuthoritiesConverter(String apiClientId) {
        this.apiClientId = apiClientId;
    }

    @Override
    public Collection<GrantedAuthority> convert(Jwt jwt) {
        Set<GrantedAuthority> authorities = new HashSet<>();
        addRoles(authorities, jwt.getClaimAsMap("realm_access"));

        Map<String, Object> resourceAccess = jwt.getClaimAsMap("resource_access");
        if (resourceAccess != null && resourceAccess.get(apiClientId) instanceof Map<?, ?> clientAccess) {
            addRoles(authorities, castToMap(clientAccess));
        }
        return authorities;
    }

    private void addRoles(Set<GrantedAuthority> authorities, Map<String, Object> access) {
        if (access == null || !(access.get("roles") instanceof Collection<?> roles)) {
            return;
        }
        roles.stream()
             .map(String::valueOf)
             .map(role -> ROLE_PREFIX + role)
             .map(SimpleGrantedAuthority::new)
             .forEach(authorities::add);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Map<String, Object> castToMap(Map<?, ?> map) {
        return (Map<String, Object>) map;
    }
}

===== ./raiji-security/src/main/java/com/raiji/security/SecurityConfig.java =====
package com.raiji.security;

import java.util.List;

import com.raiji.common.Roles;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication.JwtAuthenticationConverter;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;
import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource;

@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
@EnableMethodSecurity
public class SecurityConfig {

    private static final String API_CLIENT_ID = "raiji-api";

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http,
                                                   JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter) throws Exception {
        http
            .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
            .cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource()))
            .sessionManagement(session -> session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                .requestMatchers("/api/public/**", "/actuator/health/**").permitAll()
                .requestMatchers("/api/admin/**").hasRole(Roles.ADMIN)
                .anyRequest().authenticated())
            .oauth2ResourceServer(oauth2 -> oauth2
                .jwt(jwt -> jwt.jwtAuthenticationConverter(jwtAuthenticationConverter)));
        return http.build();
    }

    @Bean
    public JwtAuthenticationConverter jwtAuthenticationConverter() {
        JwtAuthenticationConverter converter = new JwtAuthenticationConverter();
        converter.setJwtGrantedAuthoritiesConverter(new KeycloakAuthoritiesConverter(API_CLIENT_ID));
        return converter;
    }

    /**
     * Origens aceitas:
     * <ul>
     *   <li>app web em desenvolvimento: http://localhost:3000 (qualquer porta);</li>
     *   <li>app Android (Capacitor): http://localhost e https://localhost (SEM porta â€” o
     *       padrÃ£o antigo "http://localhost:*" exigia porta e o app recebia 403);</li>
     *   <li>app iOS (Capacitor): capacitor://localhost;</li>
     *   <li>extras por variÃ¡vel: RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (ex.: https://app.raijmobi.com.br).</li>
     * </ul>
     */
    @Bean
    public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
        CorsConfiguration config = new CorsConfiguration();
        List<String> origins = new java.util.ArrayList<>(List.of(
                "http://localhost", "http://localhost:[*]",
                "https://localhost", "https://localhost:[*]",
                "http://127.0.0.1:[*]", "capacitor://localhost"));
        String extras = System.getenv("RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS");
        if (extras != null && !extras.isBlank()) {
            for (String o : extras.split(",")) {
                if (!o.isBlank()) origins.add(o.trim());
            }
        }
        config.setAllowedOriginPatterns(origins);
        config.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"));
        config.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("*"));
        config.setAllowCredentials(true);

        UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", config);
        return source;
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/company/BrasilApiCnpjLookup.java =====
package com.raiji.users.company;

import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.client.JdkClientHttpRequestFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClientException;

/**
 * BrasilAPI: GET /api/cnpj/v1/{cnpj}. Espelho gratuito dos dados abertos da
 * Receita Federal (podem ter alguns dias de atraso em relaÃ§Ã£o Ã  Receita).
 */
@Component
public class BrasilApiCnpjLookup implements CnpjLookup {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BrasilApiCnpjLookup.class);

    private final RestClient restClient;

    public BrasilApiCnpjLookup(CompanyProperties properties) {
        JdkClientHttpRequestFactory factory = new JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(
                HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build());
        factory.setReadTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(properties.timeoutSeconds()));
        this.restClient = RestClient.builder()
                .baseUrl(properties.cnpjBaseUrl())
                .requestFactory(factory)
                .defaultHeader("User-Agent", "raiji-api")
                .build();
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<CnpjInfo> find(String cnpj) {
        try {
            Map<String, Object> body = restClient.get()
                    .uri("/api/cnpj/v1/{cnpj}", cnpj)
                    .retrieve()
                    .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
            if (body == null) {
                return Optional.empty();
            }
            return Optional.of(new CnpjInfo(
                    cnpj,
                    str(body.get("razao_social")),
                    str(body.get("nome_fantasia")),
                    str(body.get("descricao_situacao_cadastral")),
                    Boolean.TRUE.equals(body.get("opcao_pelo_mei")),
                    str(body.get("cnae_fiscal_descricao")),
                    str(body.get("municipio")),
                    str(body.get("uf"))));
        } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
            if (e.getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND || e.getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST) {
                return Optional.empty();
            }
            log.warn("BrasilAPI respondeu {} na consulta de CNPJ", e.getStatusCode());
            throw new CnpjLookupUnavailableException("Consulta de CNPJ indisponÃ­vel.", e);
        } catch (RestClientException e) {
            log.warn("BrasilAPI indisponÃ­vel: {}", e.getMessage());
            throw new CnpjLookupUnavailableException("Consulta de CNPJ indisponÃ­vel.", e);
        }
    }

    private static String str(Object o) {
        if (o == null) return null;
        String s = o.toString().trim();
        return s.isEmpty() ? null : s;
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/company/Cnpj.java =====
package com.raiji.users.company;

/** CNPJ: sÃ³ dÃ­gitos (aceita "12.345.678/0001-95") e dÃ­gitos verificadores. */
public final class Cnpj {

    private Cnpj() {
    }

    public static String normalize(String raw) {
        return raw == null ? "" : raw.replaceAll("\\D", "");
    }

    public static boolean isValid(String digits) {
        if (digits == null || !digits.matches("\\d{14}") || digits.chars().distinct().count() == 1) {
            return false;
        }
        int[] w1 = {5, 4, 3, 2, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2};
        int[] w2 = {6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2};
        return digit(digits, w1) == digits.charAt(12) - '0' && digit(digits, w2) == digits.charAt(13) - '0';
    }

    private static int digit(String d, int[] weights) {
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
            sum += (d.charAt(i) - '0') * weights[i];
        }
        int r = sum % 11;
        return r < 2 ? 0 : 11 - r;
    }

    /** 12345678000195 -> 12.345.678/0001-95 */
    public static String format(String d) {
        if (d == null || d.length() != 14) return d;
        return d.substring(0, 2) + "." + d.substring(2, 5) + "." + d.substring(5, 8) + "/"
                + d.substring(8, 12) + "-" + d.substring(12);
    }
}

/**
 * GET    /api/companies/cnpj/{cnpj}              prÃ©via na Receita (antes de cadastrar)
 * POST   /api/companies                          { cnpj } cadastra (quem cadastra vira dono)
 * GET    /api/companies/mine                     empresas de que participo
 * GET    /api/companies/{id}                     detalhe + membros (sÃ³ membros)
 * POST   /api/companies/{id}/members             { email, name } convida (qualquer membro)
 * DELETE /api/companies/{id}/members/{memberId}  remove (dono) / sair (eu mesmo)
 * GET    /api/companies/invites                  convites para o meu e-mail
 * POST   /api/companies/invites/{id}/accept|decline
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/companies")
@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
public class CompanyController {

    private final CompanyService service;

    public CompanyController(CompanyService service) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @GetMapping("/cnpj/{cnpj}")
    public CnpjPreview preview(@PathVariable String cnpj) {
        return service.preview(cnpj);
    }

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public CompanyResponse register(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @Valid @RequestBody RegisterCompanyRequest body) {
        return service.register(jwt, body.cnpj());
    }

    @GetMapping("/mine")
    public List<CompanyResponse> mine(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return service.mine(jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @GetMapping("/invites")
    public List<InviteResponse> invites(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return service.myInvites(jwt);
    }

    @PostMapping("/invites/{memberId}/accept")
    public CompanyResponse accept(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID memberId) {
        return service.acceptInvite(memberId, jwt);
    }

    @PostMapping("/invites/{memberId}/decline")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    public void decline(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID memberId) {
        service.declineInvite(memberId, jwt);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public CompanyDetailResponse get(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id) {
        return service.get(id, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/members")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    public MemberResponse invite(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id,
                                 @Valid @RequestBody InviteMemberRequest body) {
        return service.invite(id, jwt, body.email(), body.name());
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}/members/{memberId}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    public void remove(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt, @PathVariable UUID id, @PathVariable UUID memberId) {
        service.removeMember(id, memberId, jwt.getSubject());
    }
}

package com.raiji.users.company;

import java.time.Instant;

/** Contratos HTTP das empresas. */
public final class CompanyDtos {

    private CompanyDtos() {
    }

    public record RegisterCompanyRequest(@NotBlank(message = "Informe o CNPJ.") String cnpj) {}

    public record InviteMemberRequest(
            @NotBlank(message = "Informe o e-mail.") @Email(message = "E-mail invÃ¡lido.") @Size(max = 254) String email,
            @Size(max = 150) String name) {}

    public record CnpjPreview(String cnpj, String cnpjFormatted, String legalName, String tradeName,
                              CompanyKind kind, String registrationStatus, boolean active,
                              String mainActivity, String city, String state, boolean alreadyRegistered) {}

    public record CompanyResponse(UUID id, String cnpj, String cnpjFormatted, String legalName, String tradeName,
                                  String displayName, CompanyKind kind, String registrationStatus,
                                  String mainActivity, String city, String state, MemberRole myRole) {
        static CompanyResponse of(Company c, MemberRole myRole) {
            return new CompanyResponse(c.getId(), c.getCnpj(), Cnpj.format(c.getCnpj()), c.getLegalName(),
                    c.getTradeName(), c.displayName(), c.getKind(), c.getRegistrationStatus(), c.getMainActivity(),
                    c.getCity(), c.getState(), myRole);
        }
    }

    public record MemberResponse(UUID id, String email, String displayName, MemberRole role, MemberStatus status,
                                 Instant invitedAt, Instant joinedAt, boolean you) {
        static MemberResponse of(CompanyMember m, String viewerSub) {
            return new MemberResponse(m.getId(), m.getEmail(), m.getDisplayName(), m.getRole(), m.getStatus(),
                    m.getInvitedAt(), m.getJoinedAt(), viewerSub != null && viewerSub.equals(m.getUserSub()));
        }
    }

    public record CompanyDetailResponse(CompanyResponse company, List<MemberResponse> members) {}

    public record InviteResponse(UUID memberId, UUID companyId, String companyName, String cnpjFormatted,
                                 CompanyKind kind, Instant invitedAt) {}
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/company/CompanyMembership.java =====
package com.raiji.users.company;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/** Consultas de participaÃ§Ã£o em empresas, para os outros mÃ³dulos (encomendas, frete, caronas). */
@Service
public class CompanyMembership {

    private final CompanyRepository companies;
    private final CompanyMemberRepository members;

    public CompanyMembership(CompanyRepository companies, CompanyMemberRepository members) {
        this.companies = companies;
        this.members = members;
    }

    /** A empresa, se a pessoa for membro ativo; senÃ£o 404 (nÃ£o revela empresas alheias). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Company requireActiveMember(UUID companyId, String userSub) {
        Company company = companies.findById(companyId).filter(c -> c.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Empresa nÃ£o encontrada."));
        if (!members.existsByCompanyIdAndUserSubAndStatus(companyId, userSub, MemberStatus.ACTIVE)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Empresa nÃ£o encontrada.");
        }
        return company;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public boolean isActiveMember(UUID companyId, String userSub) {
        return members.existsByCompanyIdAndUserSubAndStatus(companyId, userSub, MemberStatus.ACTIVE);
    }

    /** Participa de alguma empresa (conta PJ na prÃ¡tica)? */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public boolean isMemberOfAnyCompany(String userSub) {
        return members.existsByUserSubAndStatus(userSub, MemberStatus.ACTIVE);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<UUID> companyIdsOf(String userSub) {
        return members.findByUserSubAndStatus(userSub, MemberStatus.ACTIVE).stream()
                .map(CompanyMember::getCompanyId).toList();
    }

    /** Subs dos membros ativos (para avisar todos sobre uma oferta, um aceite etc.). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<String> activeMemberSubs(UUID companyId) {
        return members.findByCompanyIdAndStatusIn(companyId, List.of(MemberStatus.ACTIVE)).stream()
                .map(CompanyMember::getUserSub).filter(s -> s != null).toList();
    }

    /** A empresa (sem checar participaÃ§Ã£o: uso interno, ex.: o motorista que fecha um frete). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Company company(UUID companyId) {
        return companies.findById(companyId).filter(c -> c.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Empresa nÃ£o encontrada."));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public String displayName(UUID companyId) {
        return companies.findById(companyId).map(Company::displayName).orElse("Empresa");
    }
}
