 * Empresas (PJ):
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Cadastro pelo CNPJ: consulta a Receita (BrasilAPI); sÃ³ CNPJ ATIVO. Quem cadastra vira OWNER.</li>
 *   <li>VÃ¡rios gestores: qualquer membro ativo convida por e-mail; a pessoa aceita no app
 *       entrando com aquele e-mail (verificado).</li>
 *   <li>Qualquer membro ativo cria pedidos e aprova pagamentos; o OWNER tambÃ©m remove membros.</li>
 *   <li>A empresa nÃ£o tem frota/funcionÃ¡rios motoristas: quem dirige Ã© sempre um motorista da plataforma.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
@Service
public class CompanyService {

    private static final List<MemberStatus> OPEN = List.of(MemberStatus.INVITED, MemberStatus.ACTIVE);

    private final CompanyRepository companies;
    private final CompanyMemberRepository members;
    private final CnpjLookup cnpjLookup;
    private final CompanyInviteMailer inviteMailer;

    public CompanyService(CompanyRepository companies, CompanyMemberRepository members,
                          CnpjLookup cnpjLookup, CompanyInviteMailer inviteMailer) {
        this.companies = companies;
        this.members = members;
        this.cnpjLookup = cnpjLookup;
        this.inviteMailer = inviteMailer;
    }

    /** PrÃ©via: o que a Receita diz desse CNPJ (para a pessoa confirmar antes de cadastrar). */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CnpjPreview preview(String rawCnpj) {
        String cnpj = validCnpj(rawCnpj);
        CnpjInfo info = consultar(cnpj);
        return new CnpjPreview(cnpj, Cnpj.format(cnpj), info.legalName(), info.tradeName(),
                info.mei() ? CompanyKind.MEI : CompanyKind.EMPRESA, info.registrationStatus(), info.active(),
                info.mainActivity(), info.city(), info.state(),
                companies.findByCnpjAndDeletedAtIsNull(cnpj).isPresent());
    }

    @Transactional
    public CompanyResponse register(Jwt jwt, String rawCnpj) {
        String cnpj = validCnpj(rawCnpj);
        if (companies.findByCnpjAndDeletedAtIsNull(cnpj).isPresent()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta empresa jÃ¡ estÃ¡ cadastrada no Raiji. PeÃ§a a um dos gestores para convidar vocÃª.");
        }
        String email = verifiedEmail(jwt);
        CnpjInfo info = consultar(cnpj);
        if (!info.active()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                    "O CNPJ nÃ£o estÃ¡ ativo na Receita Federal (situaÃ§Ã£o: "
                            + (info.registrationStatus() == null ? "desconhecida" : info.registrationStatus()) + ").");
        }

        Company company = new Company();
        company.setCnpj(cnpj);
        company.setLegalName(info.legalName() == null ? "Empresa " + Cnpj.format(cnpj) : info.legalName());
        company.setTradeName(info.tradeName());
        company.setKind(info.mei() ? CompanyKind.MEI : CompanyKind.EMPRESA);
        company.setRegistrationStatus(info.registrationStatus());
        company.setMainActivity(truncate(info.mainActivity(), 255));
        company.setCity(info.city());
        company.setState(info.state() == null ? null : info.state().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
        company.setVerifiedAt(Instant.now());
        company = companies.save(company);

        CompanyMember owner = new CompanyMember();
        owner.setCompanyId(company.getId());
        owner.setUserSub(jwt.getSubject());
        owner.setEmail(email);
        owner.setDisplayName(jwt.getClaimAsString("name"));
        owner.setRole(MemberRole.OWNER);
        owner.setStatus(MemberStatus.ACTIVE);
        owner.setJoinedAt(Instant.now());
        members.save(owner);

        return CompanyResponse.of(company, MemberRole.OWNER);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<CompanyResponse> mine(String userSub) {
        List<CompanyMember> minhas = members.findByUserSubAndStatus(userSub, MemberStatus.ACTIVE);
        Map<UUID, Company> porId = companies.findAllById(minhas.stream().map(CompanyMember::getCompanyId).toList())
                .stream().filter(c -> c.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(Company::getId, Function.identity()));
        return minhas.stream().filter(m -> porId.containsKey(m.getCompanyId()))
                .map(m -> CompanyResponse.of(porId.get(m.getCompanyId()), m.getRole()))
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(CompanyResponse::displayName, String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER))
                .toList();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public CompanyDetailResponse get(UUID companyId, String userSub) {
        Company company = companies.findById(companyId).filter(c -> c.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);
        CompanyMember eu = members.findByCompanyIdAndUserSubAndStatus(companyId, userSub, MemberStatus.ACTIVE)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);
        List<MemberResponse> lista = members.findByCompanyIdAndStatusIn(companyId, OPEN).stream()
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing((CompanyMember m) -> m.getRole() != MemberRole.OWNER)
                        .thenComparing(m -> m.getStatus() != MemberStatus.ACTIVE)
                        .thenComparing(CompanyMember::getEmail))
                .map(m -> MemberResponse.of(m, userSub)).toList();
        return new CompanyDetailResponse(CompanyResponse.of(company, eu.getRole()), lista);
    }

    /** Qualquer membro ativo convida alguÃ©m por e-mail. */
    @Transactional
    public MemberResponse invite(UUID companyId, Jwt jwt, String rawEmail, String name) {
        Company company = companies.findById(companyId).filter(c -> c.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);
        if (!members.existsByCompanyIdAndUserSubAndStatus(companyId, jwt.getSubject(), MemberStatus.ACTIVE)) {
            throw naoEncontrada();
        }
        String email = rawEmail.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (members.findOpenByEmail(companyId, email, OPEN).isPresent()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Esta pessoa jÃ¡ Ã© membro ou jÃ¡ foi convidada.");
        }
        CompanyMember invite = new CompanyMember();
        invite.setCompanyId(companyId);
        invite.setEmail(email);
        invite.setDisplayName(name == null || name.isBlank() ? null : name.trim());
        invite.setRole(MemberRole.MEMBER);
        invite.setStatus(MemberStatus.INVITED);
        invite.setInvitedBy(jwt.getSubject());
        invite.setInvitedAt(Instant.now());
        invite = members.save(invite);
        inviteMailer.sendInvite(invite, company, jwt.getClaimAsString("name"));
        return MemberResponse.of(invite, jwt.getSubject());
    }

    /** Convites pendentes para o e-mail (verificado) de quem estÃ¡ logado. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<InviteResponse> myInvites(Jwt jwt) {
        String email = emailOrNull(jwt);
        if (email == null) return List.of();
        return members.findByEmailAndStatus(email, MemberStatus.INVITED).stream()
                .map(m -> companies.findById(m.getCompanyId()).filter(c -> c.getDeletedAt() == null)
                        .map(c -> new InviteResponse(m.getId(), c.getId(), c.displayName(), Cnpj.format(c.getCnpj()),
                                c.getKind(), m.getInvitedAt()))
                        .orElse(null))
                .filter(i -> i != null).toList();
    }

    @Transactional
    public CompanyResponse acceptInvite(UUID memberId, Jwt jwt) {
        CompanyMember invite = meuConvite(memberId, jwt);
        if (members.existsByCompanyIdAndUserSubAndStatus(invite.getCompanyId(), jwt.getSubject(), MemberStatus.ACTIVE)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "VocÃª jÃ¡ Ã© membro desta empresa.");
        }
        invite.setUserSub(jwt.getSubject());
        if (invite.getDisplayName() == null) invite.setDisplayName(jwt.getClaimAsString("name"));
        invite.setStatus(MemberStatus.ACTIVE);
        invite.setJoinedAt(Instant.now());
        members.save(invite);
        Company company = companies.findById(invite.getCompanyId()).orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);
        return CompanyResponse.of(company, invite.getRole());
    }

    @Transactional
    public void declineInvite(UUID memberId, Jwt jwt) {
        CompanyMember invite = meuConvite(memberId, jwt);
        invite.setStatus(MemberStatus.DECLINED);
        members.save(invite);
    }

    /**
     * Remove um membro (ou cancela um convite). O dono remove qualquer um; um
     * membro sÃ³ pode sair (remover a si mesmo). O dono nÃ£o sai da empresa.
     */
    @Transactional
    public void removeMember(UUID companyId, UUID memberId, String userSub) {
        CompanyMember eu = members.findByCompanyIdAndUserSubAndStatus(companyId, userSub, MemberStatus.ACTIVE)
                .orElseThrow(this::naoEncontrada);
        CompanyMember alvo = members.findById(memberId)
                .filter(m -> m.getCompanyId().equals(companyId) && OPEN.contains(m.getStatus()))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Membro nÃ£o encontrado."));
        boolean souEu = alvo.getId().equals(eu.getId());
        if (souEu && eu.getRole() == MemberRole.OWNER) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "O dono nÃ£o pode sair da empresa.");
        }
        if (!souEu && eu.getRole() != MemberRole.OWNER) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "SÃ³ o dono da empresa remove outros membros.");
        }
        alvo.setStatus(MemberStatus.REMOVED);
        members.save(alvo);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ apoio

    private CompanyMember meuConvite(UUID memberId, Jwt jwt) {
        String email = verifiedEmail(jwt);
        return members.findById(memberId)
                .filter(m -> m.getStatus() == MemberStatus.INVITED && m.getEmail().equalsIgnoreCase(email))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Convite nÃ£o encontrado."));
    }

    private CnpjInfo consultar(String cnpj) {
        try {
            return cnpjLookup.find(cnpj).orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                    "CNPJ nÃ£o encontrado na Receita Federal."));
        } catch (CnpjLookup.CnpjLookupUnavailableException e) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                    "A consulta de CNPJ estÃ¡ fora do ar. Tente de novo em alguns minutos.");
        }
    }

    private static String validCnpj(String raw) {
        String cnpj = Cnpj.normalize(raw);
        if (!Cnpj.isValid(cnpj)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "CNPJ invÃ¡lido.");
        }
        return cnpj;
    }

    private static String emailOrNull(Jwt jwt) {
        String email = jwt.getClaimAsString("email");
        Boolean verified = jwt.getClaimAsBoolean("email_verified");
        if (email == null || email.isBlank() || !Boolean.TRUE.equals(verified)) return null;
        return email.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private static String verifiedEmail(Jwt jwt) {
        String email = emailOrNull(jwt);
        if (email == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, "Confirme o seu e-mail antes de gerenciar empresas.");
        }
        return email;
    }

    private ResponseStatusException naoEncontrada() {
        return new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Empresa nÃ£o encontrada.");
    }

    private static String truncate(String s, int max) {
        return s == null || s.length() <= max ? s : s.substring(0, max);
    }
}

package com.raiji.users.config;

import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.data.domain.AuditorAware;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.config.EnableJpaAuditing;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;

@Configuration
@EnableJpaAuditing(auditorAwareRef = "auditorAware")
public class JpaAuditingConfig {

    @Bean
    public AuditorAware<String> auditorAware() {
        return () -> Optional.ofNullable(SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication())
                .filter(Authentication::isAuthenticated)
                .map(Authentication::getName)
                .or(() -> Optional.of("system"));
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/driververification/CnhDecision.java =====
package com.raiji.users.driververification;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Regras da verificaÃ§Ã£o da CNH (sem rede, sem banco: fÃ¡cil de testar).
 *
 * <p>CÃ³digos da Infosimples: 200 = sucesso. Entre os 6xx, os que indicam problema
 * nos DADOS (cobrados) viram REJECTED; os tÃ©cnicos/transitÃ³rios (nÃ£o cobrados)
 * viram ERROR â€” o motorista tenta de novo, sem nova tentativa automÃ¡tica
 * (a prÃ³pria Infosimples recomenda nÃ£o repetir em loop, pela cobranÃ§a).
 */
public final class CnhDecision {

    public enum Outcome { APPROVED, REJECTED, ERROR }

    /** Dados lidos da foto que alimentam a validaÃ§Ã£o */
    public record OcrData(String nome, String cpf, String registro) {}

    /** Resultado do OCR: os dados, ou a decisÃ£o final se nÃ£o deu para ler */
    public record OcrOutcome(OcrData data, Result failure) {
        public boolean ok() {
            return data != null;
        }
    }

    public record Result(Outcome outcome, String reason, String categoria, LocalDate validade, String cnhName) {
        static Result rejected(String reason) {
            return new Result(Outcome.REJECTED, reason, null, null, null);
        }

        static Result error(String reason) {
            return new Result(Outcome.ERROR, reason, null, null, null);
        }
    }

    /** Problemas nos dados (cobrados pela Infosimples): nÃ£o adianta repetir igual */
    static final Set<Integer> DATA_PROBLEM = Set.of(606, 607, 608, 611, 612, 619, 620);
    static final double MIN_OCR_SCORE = 0.5;
    private static final DateTimeFormatter BR_DATE = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy");
    private static final Set<String> NAME_CONNECTORS = Set.of("DE", "DA", "DO", "DAS", "DOS", "E");

    static final String UNAVAILABLE = "A verificaÃ§Ã£o estÃ¡ indisponÃ­vel no momento. Tente novamente mais tarde.";
    static final String UNREADABLE = "NÃ£o conseguimos ler a CNH na foto. Envie uma foto nÃ­tida, sem reflexo, "
            + "mostrando a frente inteira do documento.";

    private CnhDecision() {
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ OCR

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static OcrOutcome readOcr(InfosimplesClient.Response ocr) {
        if (ocr.code() != 200) {
            return new OcrOutcome(null, DATA_PROBLEM.contains(ocr.code())
                    ? Result.rejected(UNREADABLE)
                    : Result.error(UNAVAILABLE));
        }
        Map<String, Object> first = ocr.first();
        Object tipo = first.get("tipo");
        if (tipo != null && !String.valueOf(tipo).toLowerCase().startsWith("cnh")) {
            return new OcrOutcome(null, Result.rejected("A imagem enviada nÃ£o parece ser uma CNH."));
        }
        Map<String, Object> campos = first.get("campos") instanceof Map<?, ?> c ? (Map<String, Object>) c : Map.of();
        String nome = field(campos, "nome");
        String cpf = digits(field(campos, "cpf"));
        String registro = digits(field(campos, "registro"));
        if (nome == null || cpf == null || cpf.length() != 11 || registro == null || registro.length() < 9) {
            return new OcrOutcome(null, Result.rejected(UNREADABLE));
        }
        return new OcrOutcome(new OcrData(nome.trim(), cpf, registro), null);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static String field(Map<String, Object> campos, String name) {
        if (!(campos.get(name) instanceof Map<?, ?> raw)) return null;
        Map<String, Object> f = (Map<String, Object>) raw;
        Object valor = f.get("valor");
        if (valor == null || String.valueOf(valor).isBlank()) return null;
        if (f.get("score") instanceof Number score && score.doubleValue() < MIN_OCR_SCORE) return null;
        return String.valueOf(valor);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ ValidaÃ§Ã£o

    /**
     * @param accountName nome da conta (Keycloak) â€” precisa estar contido no nome da CNH
     */
    public static Result decide(InfosimplesClient.Response validation, OcrData ocr, String accountName, LocalDate today) {
        if (validation.code() == 612) {
            return Result.rejected("NÃ£o encontramos esta CNH na base do SENATRAN. Confira o cÃ³digo de seguranÃ§a.");
        }
        if (DATA_PROBLEM.contains(validation.code())) {
            return Result.rejected("A base oficial recusou os dados da CNH. Confira o cÃ³digo de seguranÃ§a "
                    + "e envie uma foto nÃ­tida.");
        }
        if (validation.code() != 200) {
            return Result.error(UNAVAILABLE);
        }

        Map<String, Object> cnh = validation.first();
        String situacao = text(cnh.get("situacao"));
        String categoria = text(cnh.get("categoria"));
        String cnhName = text(cnh.get("nome")) != null ? text(cnh.get("nome")) : ocr.nome();
        LocalDate validade = parseDate(text(cnh.get("validade_data")));

        if (situacao == null || !"VALIDA".equals(normalize(situacao))) {
            return Result.rejected("Sua CNH estÃ¡ com a situaÃ§Ã£o \"" + (situacao == null ? "desconhecida" : situacao)
                    + "\" na base do SENATRAN.");
        }
        if (validade == null) {
            return Result.rejected("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel confirmar a validade da CNH.");
        }
        if (validade.isBefore(today)) {
            return Result.rejected("Sua CNH venceu em " + validade.format(BR_DATE) + ".");
        }
        if (categoria == null) {
            return Result.rejected("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel confirmar a categoria da CNH.");
        }
        if (!sameName(accountName, cnhName)) {
            return Result.rejected("O nome na CNH nÃ£o corresponde ao nome da sua conta. "
                    + "Atualize o nome da conta para o mesmo da CNH.");
        }
        return new Result(Outcome.APPROVED, null, categoria.trim().toUpperCase(), validade, cnhName);
    }

    /** Todas as palavras do nome da conta aparecem no nome da CNH (sem acento/maiÃºsculas; ignora "de", "da"...) */
    static boolean sameName(String accountName, String cnhName) {
        Set<String> account = nameTokens(accountName);
        if (account.isEmpty() || cnhName == null) return false;
        return nameTokens(cnhName).containsAll(account);
    }

    private static Set<String> nameTokens(String name) {
        if (name == null) return Set.of();
        return Arrays.stream(normalize(name).split(" "))
                .filter(t -> t.length() > 1 && !NAME_CONNECTORS.contains(t))
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());
    }

    static String normalize(String value) {
        return Normalizer.normalize(value, Normalizer.Form.NFD)
                .replaceAll("\\p{M}", "")
                .toUpperCase()
                .replaceAll("[^A-Z0-9 ]", " ")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    private static String text(Object value) {
        return value == null || String.valueOf(value).isBlank() ? null : String.valueOf(value).trim();
    }

    private static String digits(String value) {
        if (value == null) return null;
        String d = value.replaceAll("\\D", "");
        return d.isEmpty() ? null : d;
    }

    private static LocalDate parseDate(String value) {
        if (value == null) return null;
        try {
            return LocalDate.parse(value, BR_DATE);
        } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/driververification/CnhImageStorage.java =====
package com.raiji.users.driververification;

/**
 * Guarda a foto da CNH sÃ³ enquanto a verificaÃ§Ã£o acontece (apagada na decisÃ£o;
 * o bucket ainda tem uma regra de expiraÃ§Ã£o de 1 dia como garantia).
 */
public interface CnhImageStorage {

    void put(String key, byte[] content, String contentType);

    byte[] get(String key);

    void delete(String key);
}

package com.raiji.users.driververification;

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.EnableAsync;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionPhase;
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener;

/**
 * Processa a verificaÃ§Ã£o depois que o pedido foi gravado (AFTER_COMMIT), numa
 * thread Ã  parte: a consulta Ã  Infosimples pode levar dezenas de segundos e a
 * requisiÃ§Ã£o do app jÃ¡ respondeu 202. O app acompanha por GET /api/users/me/driver/cnh.
 */
@Component
public class DriverApplicationProcessor {

    private final DriverVerificationService service;

    public DriverApplicationProcessor(DriverVerificationService service) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @Async
    @TransactionalEventListener(phase = TransactionPhase.AFTER_COMMIT)
    public void onSubmitted(DriverApplicationSubmittedEvent event) {
        service.process(event.applicationId(), event.securityCode());
    }

    @Configuration
    @EnableAsync
    static class AsyncConfig {
    }
}

package com.raiji.users.driververification;

import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestPart;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

/**
 * VerificaÃ§Ã£o da CNH para virar motorista.
 *
 * <pre>
 * POST /api/users/me/driver/cnh   multipart: image (foto da CNH) + securityCode
 *                                 -> 202 { status: "PROCESSING" }
 * GET  /api/users/me/driver/cnh   -> { status: NONE | PROCESSING | APPROVED | REJECTED | ERROR, reason, ... }
 * </pre>
 *
 * Aprovado: a conta recebe a role DRIVER (o app deve renovar o token).
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/users/me/driver/cnh")
public class DriverVerificationController {

    private final DriverVerificationService service;

    public DriverVerificationController(DriverVerificationService service) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @PostMapping(consumes = MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_VALUE)
    public ResponseEntity<DriverApplicationResponse> submit(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            @RequestPart(value = "image", required = false) MultipartFile image,
            @RequestParam(value = "securityCode", required = false) String securityCode) {
        return ResponseEntity.accepted().body(service.submit(jwt, image, securityCode));
    }

    @GetMapping
    public DriverApplicationResponse status(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return service.latest(jwt.getSubject());
    }

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/driververification/DriverVerificationService.java =====
package com.raiji.users.driververification;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import com.raiji.users.mail.DriverApprovalMailer;
import com.raiji.users.service.UserCapabilitiesService;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider;
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/**
 * VerificaÃ§Ã£o da CNH para virar motorista:
 * <ol>
 *   <li>recebe a foto + cÃ³digo de seguranÃ§a; guarda a foto (temporÃ¡ria) â€” 202</li>
 *   <li>em segundo plano: OCR da foto -> validaÃ§Ã£o no SENATRAN -> regras ({@link CnhDecision})</li>
 *   <li>aprovado: a conta recebe a role DRIVER e um e-mail (Resend). Em qualquer
 *       desfecho a foto Ã© apagada.</li>
 * </ol>
 */
@Service
public class DriverVerificationService {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DriverVerificationService.class);

    /** VerificaÃ§Ã£o "em andamento" hÃ¡ mais tempo que isso Ã© considerada travada */
    static final Duration STALE_AFTER = Duration.ofMinutes(15);
    static final Set<String> ACCEPTED_TYPES = Set.of("image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp");
    private static final Pattern SECURITY_CODE = Pattern.compile("\\d{6,15}");

    private final DriverApplicationRepository repository;
    private final CnhImageStorage storage;
    private final InfosimplesClient infosimples;
    private final UserCapabilitiesService capabilities;
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher events;
    private final DriverApprovalMailer approvalMailer;
    private final Clock clock;

    public DriverVerificationService(
            DriverApplicationRepository repository,
            CnhImageStorage storage,
            InfosimplesClient infosimples,
            UserCapabilitiesService capabilities,
            ApplicationEventPublisher events,
            DriverApprovalMailer approvalMailer,
            ObjectProvider<Clock> clock) {
        this.repository = repository;
        this.storage = storage;
        this.infosimples = infosimples;
        this.capabilities = capabilities;
        this.events = events;
        this.approvalMailer = approvalMailer;
        this.clock = clock.getIfAvailable(Clock::systemDefaultZone);
    }

    @Transactional
    public DriverApplicationResponse submit(Jwt jwt, MultipartFile image, String securityCode) {
        if (!infosimples.configured()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                    "A verificaÃ§Ã£o de CNH estÃ¡ indisponÃ­vel no momento.");
        }
        if (image == null || image.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Envie a foto da CNH (campo \"image\").");
        }
        String contentType = image.getContentType() == null ? "" : image.getContentType().toLowerCase();
        if (!ACCEPTED_TYPES.contains(contentType)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE,
                    "Formato nÃ£o aceito: envie a foto em JPG, PNG ou WebP.");
        }
        String code = securityCode == null ? "" : securityCode.replaceAll("\\s", "");
        if (!SECURITY_CODE.matcher(code).matches()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "CÃ³digo de seguranÃ§a da CNH invÃ¡lido: informe apenas os nÃºmeros.");
        }

        String sub = jwt.getSubject();
        if (repository.existsBySubAndStatusAndCreatedAtAfter(
                sub, DriverApplicationStatus.PROCESSING, Instant.now(clock).minus(STALE_AFTER))) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "JÃ¡ existe uma verificaÃ§Ã£o de CNH em andamento. Aguarde o resultado.");
        }

        DriverApplication application = new DriverApplication();
        application.setSub(sub);
        application.setStatus(DriverApplicationStatus.PROCESSING);
        application.setAccountName(accountName(jwt));
        application.setImageKey("cnh/" + sub + "/" + UUID.randomUUID());
        repository.save(application);

        try {
            storage.put(application.getImageKey(), image.getBytes(), contentType);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Falha ao guardar a foto da CNH (pedido {}): {}", application.getId(), e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
                    "NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel receber a foto agora. Tente novamente.");
        }

        // Processado depois do commit, em segundo plano (DriverApplicationProcessor)
        events.publishEvent(new DriverApplicationSubmittedEvent(application.getId(), code));
        return DriverApplicationResponse.from(application);
    }

    /** Executado em segundo plano. Nunca relanÃ§a: todo desfecho vira um status. */
    public void process(UUID applicationId, String securityCode) {
        DriverApplication application = repository.findById(applicationId).orElse(null);
        if (application == null || application.getStatus() != DriverApplicationStatus.PROCESSING) {
            return;
        }
        CnhDecision.Result result;
        try {
            result = verify(application, securityCode);
            if (result.outcome() == CnhDecision.Outcome.APPROVED) {
                capabilities.grantVerifiedDriver(application.getSub());
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("VerificaÃ§Ã£o da CNH falhou (pedido {}): {}", applicationId, e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            result = CnhDecision.Result.error(CnhDecision.UNAVAILABLE);
        }

        application.setStatus(switch (result.outcome()) {
            case APPROVED -> DriverApplicationStatus.APPROVED;
            case REJECTED -> DriverApplicationStatus.REJECTED;
            case ERROR -> DriverApplicationStatus.ERROR;
        });
        application.setReason(result.reason());
        if (result.categoria() != null) application.setCategoria(result.categoria());
        if (result.validade() != null) application.setValidade(result.validade());
        if (result.cnhName() != null) application.setCnhName(result.cnhName());
        application.setDecidedAt(Instant.now(clock));
        deleteImage(application);
        repository.save(application);
        log.info("VerificaÃ§Ã£o da CNH (pedido {}): {}", applicationId, application.getStatus());

        if (application.getStatus() == DriverApplicationStatus.APPROVED) {
            try {
                approvalMailer.sendApproved(application.getSub(), application.getId(),
                        application.getCategoria(), application.getValidade());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                // O cadastro jÃ¡ estÃ¡ aprovado: falha no e-mail nÃ£o desfaz nada
                log.warn("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel enviar o e-mail de aprovaÃ§Ã£o (pedido {}): {}",
                        applicationId, e.getClass().getSimpleName());
            }
        }
    }

    private CnhDecision.Result verify(DriverApplication application, String securityCode) {
        byte[] image = storage.get(application.getImageKey());

        InfosimplesClient.Response ocr = infosimples.ocrCnh(image);
        application.setOcrCode(ocr.code());
        CnhDecision.OcrOutcome read = CnhDecision.readOcr(ocr);
        if (!read.ok()) {
            return read.failure();
        }
        CnhDecision.OcrData data = read.data();
        application.setCpf(data.cpf());
        application.setRegistro(data.registro());
        application.setCnhName(data.nome());

        InfosimplesClient.Response validation =
                infosimples.validarCnh(data.cpf(), data.registro(), securityCode, data.nome());
        application.setValidationCode(validation.code());
        return CnhDecision.decide(validation, data, application.getAccountName(), LocalDate.now(clock));
    }

    /** A foto Ã© temporÃ¡ria: sai do armazenamento em qualquer desfecho */
    private void deleteImage(DriverApplication application) {
        if (application.getImageKey() == null) return;
        try {
            storage.delete(application.getImageKey());
            application.setImageKey(null);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // A regra de expiraÃ§Ã£o do bucket (1 dia) apaga depois
            log.warn("NÃ£o foi possÃ­vel apagar a foto da CNH (pedido {})", application.getId());
        }
    }

    @Transactional
    public DriverApplicationResponse latest(String sub) {
        return repository.findTopBySubOrderByCreatedAtDesc(sub)
                .map(application -> {
                    if (application.getStatus() == DriverApplicationStatus.PROCESSING
                            && application.getCreatedAt().isBefore(Instant.now(clock).minus(STALE_AFTER))) {
                        application.setStatus(DriverApplicationStatus.ERROR);
                        application.setReason(CnhDecision.UNAVAILABLE);
                        application.setDecidedAt(Instant.now(clock));
                        repository.save(application);
                    }
                    return DriverApplicationResponse.from(application);
                })
                .orElseGet(DriverApplicationResponse::none);
    }

    private static String accountName(Jwt jwt) {
        String name = jwt.getClaimAsString("name");
        if (name != null && !name.isBlank()) return name;
        String given = jwt.getClaimAsString("given_name");
        String family = jwt.getClaimAsString("family_name");
        return ((given == null ? "" : given) + " " + (family == null ? "" : family)).trim();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/driververification/InfosimplesClient.java =====
package com.raiji.users.driververification;

import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.client.JdkClientHttpRequestFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;

/**
 * Cliente da API da Infosimples (sÃ³ o back-end chama: o token nunca vai ao app).
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>OCR / CNH: {@code POST /api/v2/imagens/ocr/cnh} â€” lÃª os dados da foto</li>
 *   <li>SENATRAN / Validar CNH: {@code POST /api/v2/consultas/senatran/validar-cnh}
 *       â€” confere na base RENACH, usando o login gov.br da empresa</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * A API responde HTTP 200 com o resultado real no campo {@code code}
 * (200 = sucesso; 6xx = erros, alguns cobrados). Ver {@link CnhDecision}.
 */
@Component
public class InfosimplesClient {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(InfosimplesClient.class);

    private final DriverVerificationProperties.Infosimples config;
    private final RestClient restClient;

    public InfosimplesClient(DriverVerificationProperties properties) {
        this.config = properties.infosimples();
        // Timeout do cliente HTTP maior que o "timeout" pedido Ã  Infosimples (recomendaÃ§Ã£o deles)
        JdkClientHttpRequestFactory factory = new JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(
                HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(15)).build());
        factory.setReadTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(config.timeout() + 30L));
        this.restClient = RestClient.builder()
                .baseUrl(config.baseUrl() == null ? "https://api.infosimples.com" : config.baseUrl())
                .requestFactory(factory)
                .build();
    }

    public boolean configured() {
        return config.configured();
    }

    /** LÃª os dados da CNH na imagem (frente, verso ou os dois lados). */
    public Response ocrCnh(byte[] image) {
        MultiValueMap<String, String> form = baseForm();
        form.add("image_base64", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(image));
        return post("/api/v2/imagens/ocr/cnh", form);
    }

    /** Confere a CNH na base do SENATRAN. */
    public Response validarCnh(String cpf, String registro, String codigoSeguranca, String nomeCondutor) {
        MultiValueMap<String, String> form = baseForm();
        form.add("cpf", cpf);
        form.add("registro", registro);
        form.add("codigo_seguranca", codigoSeguranca);
        if (nomeCondutor != null && !nomeCondutor.isBlank()) form.add("nome_condutor", nomeCondutor);
        if (config.hasGovbrLogin()) {
            form.add("login_cpf", config.govbrCpf());
            form.add("login_senha", config.govbrPassword());
        }
        return post("/api/v2/consultas/senatran/validar-cnh", form);
    }

    private MultiValueMap<String, String> baseForm() {
        if (!config.configured()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Infosimples sem token configurado");
        }
        MultiValueMap<String, String> form = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
        form.add("token", config.token());
        form.add("timeout", String.valueOf(config.timeout()));
        return form;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private Response post(String path, MultiValueMap<String, String> form) {
        Map<String, Object> body = restClient.post()
                .uri(path)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_FORM_URLENCODED)
                .body(form)
                .retrieve()
                .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
        if (body == null) {
            return new Response(600, "resposta vazia", List.of(), List.of(), false);
        }
        int code = body.get("code") instanceof Number n ? n.intValue() : 600;
        Map<String, Object> header = body.get("header") instanceof Map<?, ?> h ? (Map<String, Object>) h : Map.of();
        Response response = new Response(
                code,
                String.valueOf(body.getOrDefault("code_message", "")),
                body.get("data") instanceof List<?> d ? (List<Map<String, Object>>) d : List.of(),
                body.get("errors") instanceof List<?> e ? (List<String>) e : List.of(),
                Boolean.TRUE.equals(header.get("billable")));
        // Nunca loga dados pessoais nem o token: sÃ³ serviÃ§o, cÃ³digo e cobranÃ§a
        log.info("Infosimples {} -> code={} ({}), cobrado={}", path, code, response.codeMessage(), response.billable());
        if (code != 200 && !response.errors().isEmpty()) {
            log.debug("Infosimples {} errors={}", path, response.errors());
        }
        return response;
    }

    /**
     * @param errors mensagens tÃ©cnicas da Infosimples â€” NÃƒO devem ser mostradas ao usuÃ¡rio
     */
    public record Response(
            int code,
            String codeMessage,
            List<Map<String, Object>> data,
            List<String> errors,
            boolean billable) {

        public Map<String, Object> first() {
            return data.isEmpty() ? Map.of() : data.get(0);
        }
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/driververification/S3CnhImageStorage.java =====
package com.raiji.users.driververification;

import java.net.URI;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import software.amazon.awssdk.auth.credentials.AwsBasicCredentials;
import software.amazon.awssdk.auth.credentials.AwsCredentialsProvider;
import software.amazon.awssdk.auth.credentials.DefaultCredentialsProvider;
import software.amazon.awssdk.auth.credentials.StaticCredentialsProvider;
import software.amazon.awssdk.core.checksums.RequestChecksumCalculation;
import software.amazon.awssdk.core.checksums.ResponseChecksumValidation;
import software.amazon.awssdk.core.sync.RequestBody;
import software.amazon.awssdk.http.urlconnection.UrlConnectionHttpClient;
import software.amazon.awssdk.regions.Region;
import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.S3Client;
import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.model.DeleteObjectRequest;
import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.model.GetObjectRequest;
import software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.model.PutObjectRequest;

/**
 * S3 (produÃ§Ã£o) ou RustFS (local). O cliente Ã© criado sÃ³ no primeiro uso:
 * a aplicaÃ§Ã£o sobe mesmo sem o armazenamento no ar.
 */
@Component
public class S3CnhImageStorage implements CnhImageStorage {

    private final DriverVerificationProperties.Storage config;
    private volatile S3Client client;

    public S3CnhImageStorage(DriverVerificationProperties properties) {
        this.config = properties.storage();
    }

    @Override
    public void put(String key, byte[] content, String contentType) {
        s3().putObject(
                PutObjectRequest.builder().bucket(config.bucket()).key(key).contentType(contentType).build(),
                RequestBody.fromBytes(content));
    }

    @Override
    public byte[] get(String key) {
        return s3().getObjectAsBytes(
                GetObjectRequest.builder().bucket(config.bucket()).key(key).build()).asByteArray();
    }

    @Override
    public void delete(String key) {
        s3().deleteObject(DeleteObjectRequest.builder().bucket(config.bucket()).key(key).build());
    }

    private S3Client s3() {
        S3Client current = client;
        if (current == null) {
            synchronized (this) {
                if (client == null) client = build();
                current = client;
            }
        }
        return current;
    }

    private S3Client build() {
        var builder = S3Client.builder()
                .httpClient(UrlConnectionHttpClient.create())
                .region(Region.of(blank(config.region()) ? "us-east-1" : config.region()))
                .forcePathStyle(Boolean.TRUE.equals(config.pathStyle()))
                .credentialsProvider(credentials());
        if (!blank(config.endpoint())) {
            builder.endpointOverride(URI.create(config.endpoint()))
                    // S3 compatÃ­vel (RustFS): checksums sÃ³ quando a operaÃ§Ã£o exige
                    .requestChecksumCalculation(RequestChecksumCalculation.WHEN_REQUIRED)
                    .responseChecksumValidation(ResponseChecksumValidation.WHEN_REQUIRED);
        }
        return builder.build();
    }

    private AwsCredentialsProvider credentials() {
        if (!blank(config.accessKey()) && !blank(config.secretKey())) {
            return StaticCredentialsProvider.create(AwsBasicCredentials.create(config.accessKey(), config.secretKey()));
        }
        return DefaultCredentialsProvider.builder().build();
    }

    private static boolean blank(String value) {
        return value == null || value.isBlank();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/keycloak/KeycloakAdminService.java =====
package com.raiji.users.keycloak;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;

@Service
public class KeycloakAdminService {

    private final KeycloakAdminProperties properties;
    private final RestClient restClient;

    public KeycloakAdminService(KeycloakAdminProperties properties) {
        this.properties = properties;
        this.restClient = RestClient.create();
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Realm roles
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    public void assignRealmRole(String userId, String roleName) {
        String token = adminToken();
        Map<String, Object> role = fetchRealmRole(roleName, token);

        restClient.post()
                .uri(adminBaseUrl() + "/users/" + userId + "/role-mappings/realm")
                .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + token)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .body(List.of(role))
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity();
    }

    public void removeRealmRole(String userId, String roleName) {
        String token = adminToken();
        Map<String, Object> role = fetchRealmRole(roleName, token);

        restClient.method(HttpMethod.DELETE)
                .uri(adminBaseUrl() + "/users/" + userId + "/role-mappings/realm")
                .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + token)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .body(List.of(role))
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity();
    }

    /** E-mail e primeiro nome atuais do usuÃ¡rio (para e-mails transacionais) */
    public record UserContact(String email, String firstName) {
    }

    public UserContact findUserContact(String userId) {
        Map<String, Object> user = restClient.get()
                .uri(adminBaseUrl() + "/users/" + userId)
                .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + adminToken())
                .retrieve()
                .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
        if (user == null) return null;
        return new UserContact(
                user.get("email") == null ? null : String.valueOf(user.get("email")),
                user.get("firstName") == null ? null : String.valueOf(user.get("firstName")));
    }

    /**
     * Roles EFETIVAS do usuÃ¡rio no realm (inclui as que vÃªm de roles compostas,
     * como default-roles-raiji -> PASSENGER). Ã‰ o que aparece no prÃ³ximo token.
     */
    public List<String> effectiveRealmRoles(String userId) {
        List<Map<String, Object>> roles = restClient.get()
                .uri(adminBaseUrl() + "/users/" + userId + "/role-mappings/realm/composite")
                .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + adminToken())
                .retrieve()
                .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
        return roles == null
                ? List.of()
                : roles.stream().map(role -> String.valueOf(role.get("name"))).toList();
    }

    /**
     * Troca o tipo PF/PJ: remove as duas e adiciona a nova.
     */
    public void setUserType(String userId, String userType) {
        if (userType == null) return;
        removeRealmRoleQuietly(userId, "PF");
        removeRealmRoleQuietly(userId, "PJ");
        assignRealmRole(userId, userType);
    }

    /**
     * Mescla (merge) atributos no usuÃ¡rio do Keycloak.
     * Ex.: Map.of("cnh_number", List.of("123"), "cnh_category", List.of("AB"))
     */
    public void updateUserAttributes(String userId, Map<String, List<String>> attributes) {
        if (attributes == null || attributes.isEmpty()) return;

        String token = adminToken();

        Map<String, Object> user = restClient.get()
                .uri(adminBaseUrl() + "/users/" + userId)
                .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + token)
                .retrieve()
                .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});

        if (user == null) return;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<String, List<String>> merged =
                user.get("attributes") instanceof Map<?, ?> existing
                        ? new HashMap<>((Map<String, List<String>>) existing)
                        : new HashMap<>();
        merged.putAll(attributes);
        user.put("attributes", merged);

        restClient.put()
                .uri(adminBaseUrl() + "/users/" + userId)
                .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + token)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .body(user)
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity();
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void removeRealmRoleQuietly(String userId, String roleName) {
        try {
            removeRealmRole(userId, roleName);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Role nÃ£o existia ou jÃ¡ nÃ£o estava atribuÃ­da â€” segue o jogo.
        }
    }

    private Map<String, Object> fetchRealmRole(String roleName, String adminToken) {
        return restClient.get()
                .uri(adminBaseUrl() + "/roles/" + roleName)
                .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + adminToken)
                .retrieve()
                .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
    }

    private String adminToken() {
        MultiValueMap<String, String> form = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
        form.add("grant_type", "client_credentials");
        form.add("client_id", properties.adminClientId());
        form.add("client_secret", properties.adminClientSecret());

        Map<String, Object> response = restClient.post()
                .uri(properties.baseUrl() + "/realms/" + properties.realm()
                        + "/protocol/openid-connect/token")
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_FORM_URLENCODED)
                .body(form)
                .retrieve()
                .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});

        return (String) response.get("access_token");
    }

    private String adminBaseUrl() {
        return properties.baseUrl() + "/admin/realms/" + properties.realm();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/mail/ResendEmailSender.java =====
package com.raiji.users.mail;

import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.client.JdkClientHttpRequestFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;

/**
 * Resend â€” {@code POST https://api.resend.com/emails} com a chave no cabeÃ§alho.
 * Usa o cabeÃ§alho Idempotency-Key para nÃ£o duplicar envios.
 */
@Component
public class ResendEmailSender implements EmailSender {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ResendEmailSender.class);

    private final MailProperties.Resend config;
    private final RestClient restClient;

    public ResendEmailSender(MailProperties properties) {
        this.config = properties.resend();
        JdkClientHttpRequestFactory factory = new JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(
                HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build());
        factory.setReadTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20));
        this.restClient = RestClient.builder()
                .baseUrl(config.baseUrl() == null || config.baseUrl().isBlank() ? "https://api.resend.com" : config.baseUrl())
                .requestFactory(factory)
                .build();
    }

    @Override
    public void send(EmailMessage message) {
        if (!config.configured()) {
            log.info("Resend sem chave (RESEND_API_KEY): e-mail \"{}\" nÃ£o enviado", message.subject());
            return;
        }
        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        body.put("from", config.from());
        body.put("to", List.of(message.to()));
        body.put("subject", message.subject());
        body.put("html", message.html());
        body.put("text", message.text());

        restClient.post()
                .uri("/emails")
                .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + config.apiKey())
                .header("Idempotency-Key", message.idempotencyKey())
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .body(body)
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity();
        // Sem o endereÃ§o no log (dado pessoal)
        log.info("E-mail \"{}\" enviado pelo Resend", message.subject());
    }
}

package com.raiji.users.service;

import com.raiji.users.domain.UserBusinessProfile;
import com.raiji.users.repository.UserBusinessProfileRepository;

import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

public class UserBusinessProfileService {

    private final UserBusinessProfileRepository repository;

    public UserBusinessProfileService(
            UserBusinessProfileRepository repository) {
        this.repository = repository;
    }

    @Transactional
    public UserBusinessProfile upsert(
            String sub,
            String phone,
            String photoUrl) {

        UserBusinessProfile profile = repository.findById(sub)
                .orElseGet(() -> {
                    UserBusinessProfile newProfile =
                            new UserBusinessProfile();
                    newProfile.setSub(sub);
                    return newProfile;
                });

        // Atualiza somente os campos enviados.
        if (phone != null) {
            profile.setPhone(phone);
        }

        if (photoUrl != null) {
            profile.setPhotoUrl(photoUrl);
        }

        profile.setUpdatedAt(OffsetDateTime.now());

        return repository.save(profile);
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/service/UserCapabilitiesService.java =====
package com.raiji.users.service;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import com.raiji.common.Roles;
import com.raiji.users.driververification.DriverApplicationRepository;
import com.raiji.users.driververification.DriverApplicationStatus;
import com.raiji.users.dto.UserProfileResponse;
import com.raiji.users.keycloak.KeycloakAdminService;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/**
 * Capacidades da conta. Regra: PASSAGEIRO e MOTORISTA sÃ£o acumulÃ¡veis.
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Toda conta Ã© passageira: PASSENGER faz parte das roles padrÃ£o do realm
 *       (default-roles-raiji), inclusive para contas que jÃ¡ existiam.</li>
 *   <li>Tornar-se motorista ADICIONA a role DRIVER; nunca remove PASSENGER.
 *       DRIVER sÃ³ vem de uma CNH verificada (ver driververification).</li>
 *   <li>PF/PJ continua exclusivo (Ã© o tipo da conta, outro assunto).</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * As roles chegam ao app pelo token: depois de uma mudanÃ§a aqui o app precisa
 * renovar o token para enxergÃ¡-la (a resposta destas operaÃ§Ãµes jÃ¡ vem atualizada).
 */
@Service
public class UserCapabilitiesService {

    static final String CNH_REQUIRED = "Para ser motorista, envie sua CNH para verificaÃ§Ã£o "
            + "(POST /api/users/me/driver/cnh).";

    private final KeycloakAdminService keycloakAdminService;
    private final ObjectProvider<DriverActivityChecker> driverActivityChecker;
    private final DriverApplicationRepository driverApplications;

    public UserCapabilitiesService(
            KeycloakAdminService keycloakAdminService,
            ObjectProvider<DriverActivityChecker> driverActivityChecker,
            DriverApplicationRepository driverApplications) {
        this.keycloakAdminService = keycloakAdminService;
        this.driverActivityChecker = driverActivityChecker;
        this.driverApplications = driverApplications;
    }

    /**
     * Chamado pela verificaÃ§Ã£o da CNH aprovada: Ã© a ÃšNICA forma de ganhar DRIVER
     * (alÃ©m de um admin atribuir a role direto no Keycloak).
     */
    public void grantVerifiedDriver(String sub) {
        keycloakAdminService.assignRealmRole(sub, Roles.DRIVER);
    }

    /** 409 se a conta nÃ£o tiver CNH aprovada e dentro da validade. */
    private void requireVerifiedCnh(String sub) {
        boolean verified = driverApplications.existsBySubAndStatusAndValidadeGreaterThanEqual(
                sub, DriverApplicationStatus.APPROVED, LocalDate.now());
        if (!verified) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, CNH_REQUIRED);
        }
    }

    /** Perfil a partir do token (sem chamar o Keycloak). */
    public UserProfileResponse fromToken(Jwt jwt) {
        return build(jwt, tokenRoles(jwt));
    }

    public UserProfileResponse setAccountType(Jwt jwt, String userType) {
        keycloakAdminService.setUserType(jwt.getSubject(), userType);
        return current(jwt);
    }

    /**
     * Volta a ser motorista (ex.: depois de DELETE /driver) sem reenviar a CNH,
     * desde que jÃ¡ exista uma verificaÃ§Ã£o aprovada e a CNH continue vÃ¡lida.
     * Sem isso: 409 pedindo a verificaÃ§Ã£o. Idempotente.
     */
    public UserProfileResponse becomeDriver(Jwt jwt) {
        requireVerifiedCnh(jwt.getSubject());
        keycloakAdminService.assignRealmRole(jwt.getSubject(), Roles.DRIVER);
        return current(jwt);
    }

    /** Recusado (409) se houver carona como motorista planejada ou em andamento. */
    public UserProfileResponse stopBeingDriver(Jwt jwt) {
        DriverActivityChecker checker = driverActivityChecker.getIfAvailable();
        if (checker != null && checker.hasActiveRidesAsDriver(jwt.getSubject())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "VocÃª tem caronas planejadas ou em andamento como motorista. "
                            + "Cancele ou conclua antes de deixar de ser motorista.");
        }
        keycloakAdminService.removeRealmRole(jwt.getSubject(), Roles.DRIVER);
        return current(jwt);
    }

    /**
     * Compatibilidade com o antigo POST /profile: define PF/PJ e, se pedir
     * DRIVER, ADICIONA a role â€” sÃ³ com CNH verificada (senÃ£o 409, sem mudar nada).
     * Nunca remove a outra (PASSENGER continua).
     */
    public UserProfileResponse applyLegacyProfile(Jwt jwt, String role, String userType) {
        if (Roles.DRIVER.equals(role)) {
            requireVerifiedCnh(jwt.getSubject());
        }
        keycloakAdminService.setUserType(jwt.getSubject(), userType);
        if (Roles.DRIVER.equals(role)) {
            keycloakAdminService.assignRealmRole(jwt.getSubject(), Roles.DRIVER);
        }
        return current(jwt);
    }

    /** Estado real no Keycloak, jÃ¡ com a mudanÃ§a (o token do pedido ainda Ã© o antigo). */
    private UserProfileResponse current(Jwt jwt) {
        return build(jwt, keycloakAdminService.effectiveRealmRoles(jwt.getSubject()));
    }

    private static UserProfileResponse build(Jwt jwt, Collection<String> roles) {
        List<String> realmRoles = List.copyOf(roles);
        String userType = realmRoles.contains(Roles.PJ) ? Roles.PJ
                : realmRoles.contains(Roles.PF) ? Roles.PF
                : null;
        return new UserProfileResponse(
                jwt.getSubject(),
                jwt.getClaimAsString("email"),
                jwt.getClaimAsString("name"),
                userType,
                realmRoles.contains(Roles.PASSENGER),
                realmRoles.contains(Roles.DRIVER),
                realmRoles,
                userType != null);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static List<String> tokenRoles(Jwt jwt) {
        Map<String, Object> realmAccess = jwt.getClaimAsMap("realm_access");
        if (realmAccess == null || !(realmAccess.get("roles") instanceof List<?> roles)) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return (List<String>) roles;
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/java/com/raiji/users/service/VehicleService.java =====

package com.raiji.users.service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.users.domain.Vehicle;
import com.raiji.users.dto.VehicleRequest;
import com.raiji.users.dto.VehicleResponse;
import com.raiji.users.repository.VehicleRepository;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

@Service
public class VehicleService {

    private final VehicleRepository vehicleRepository;

    public VehicleService(VehicleRepository vehicleRepository) {
        this.vehicleRepository = vehicleRepository;
    }

    @Transactional
    public VehicleResponse create(VehicleRequest request, String ownerSub) {
        String plate = normalizePlate(request.plate());

        if (vehicleRepository.existsByPlate(plate)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "JÃ¡ existe um veÃ­culo cadastrado com essa placa."
            );
        }

        Vehicle vehicle = new Vehicle();
        vehicle.setOwnerSub(ownerSub);
        vehicle.setPlate(plate);
        applyRequest(vehicle, request);

        return toResponse(vehicleRepository.save(vehicle));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<VehicleResponse> listByOwner(String ownerSub) {
        return vehicleRepository
                .findByOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull(ownerSub)
                .stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .toList();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public VehicleResponse findById(UUID id, String ownerSub) {
        return toResponse(findOwnedVehicle(id, ownerSub));
    }

    @Transactional
    public VehicleResponse update(
            UUID id,
            String ownerSub,
            VehicleRequest request
    ) {
        Vehicle vehicle = findOwnedVehicle(id, ownerSub);
        String plate = normalizePlate(request.plate());

        if (vehicleRepository.existsByPlateAndIdNot(plate, id)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "JÃ¡ existe um veÃ­culo cadastrado com essa placa."
            );
        }

        vehicle.setPlate(plate);
        applyRequest(vehicle, request);

        return toResponse(vehicleRepository.save(vehicle));
    }

    @Transactional
    public void deactivate(UUID id, String ownerSub) {
        Vehicle vehicle = findOwnedVehicle(id, ownerSub);
        vehicle.softDelete();
        vehicle.setActive(false);
        vehicleRepository.save(vehicle);
    }

    private Vehicle findOwnedVehicle(UUID id, String ownerSub) {
        return vehicleRepository
                .findByIdAndOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull(id, ownerSub)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "VeÃ­culo nÃ£o encontrado."
                ));
    }

    private void applyRequest(Vehicle vehicle, VehicleRequest request) {
        vehicle.setType(request.type().trim());
        vehicle.setModel(request.model().trim());
        vehicle.setColor(
                request.color() == null ? null : request.color().trim()
        );
        vehicle.setYear(request.year());
        vehicle.setPassengerSeats(request.passengerSeats());
        vehicle.setCargoVolumeLiters(request.cargoVolumeLiters());
    }

    private String normalizePlate(String plate) {
        return plate.trim().toUpperCase();
    }

    private VehicleResponse toResponse(Vehicle vehicle) {
        return new VehicleResponse(
                vehicle.getId(),
                vehicle.getOwnerSub(),
                vehicle.getPlate(),
                vehicle.getType(),
                vehicle.getModel(),
                vehicle.getColor(),
                vehicle.getYear(),
                vehicle.getPassengerSeats(),
                vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters(),
                vehicle.isActive()
        );
    }
}

package com.raiji.users.web;

import com.raiji.users.dto.AccountTypeRequest;
import com.raiji.users.dto.SetProfileRequest;
import com.raiji.users.dto.UpdateProfileRequest;
import com.raiji.users.dto.UserProfileResponse;
import com.raiji.users.dto.UpdateProfileResponse;
import com.raiji.users.domain.UserBusinessProfile;
import com.raiji.users.service.UserBusinessProfileService;
import com.raiji.users.service.UserCapabilitiesService;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PatchMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

/**
 * Perfil do usuÃ¡rio. Passageiro e motorista sÃ£o CAPACIDADES acumulÃ¡veis:
 * toda conta Ã© passageira; tornar-se motorista acrescenta, nÃ£o substitui.
 *
 * <pre>
 * GET    /api/users/me               perfil (do token)
 * PUT    /api/users/me/account-type  { "userType": "PF" | "PJ" }
 * POST   /api/users/me/driver        torna-se motorista (idempotente)
 * DELETE /api/users/me/driver        deixa de ser motorista (409 com carona ativa)
 * POST   /api/users/me/profile       legado: PF/PJ + DRIVER (aditivo)
 * PATCH  /api/users/me               telefone / foto
 * </pre>
 *
 * ApÃ³s PUT/POST/DELETE o app deve renovar o token para ver as roles novas.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/users/me")
public class UserProfileController {

    private final UserCapabilitiesService capabilitiesService;
    private final UserBusinessProfileService businessProfileService;

    public UserProfileController(
            UserCapabilitiesService capabilitiesService,
            UserBusinessProfileService businessProfileService) {
        this.capabilitiesService = capabilitiesService;
        this.businessProfileService = businessProfileService;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public UserProfileResponse me(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return capabilitiesService.fromToken(jwt);
    }

    @PutMapping("/account-type")
    public UserProfileResponse setAccountType(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            @Valid @RequestBody AccountTypeRequest request) {
        return capabilitiesService.setAccountType(jwt, request.userType());
    }

    @PostMapping("/driver")
    public UserProfileResponse becomeDriver(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return capabilitiesService.becomeDriver(jwt);
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/driver")
    public UserProfileResponse stopBeingDriver(@AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {
        return capabilitiesService.stopBeingDriver(jwt);
    }

    /**
     * Legado (mantido por compatibilidade): define PF/PJ e, com role=DRIVER,
     * ACRESCENTA a capacidade de motorista. NÃ£o remove mais a outra role.
     * Prefira PUT /account-type e POST /driver.
     */
    @PostMapping("/profile")
    public ResponseEntity<UserProfileResponse> setProfile(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            @Valid @RequestBody SetProfileRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                capabilitiesService.applyLegacyProfile(jwt, request.role(), request.userType()));
    }

    @PatchMapping
    public ResponseEntity<UpdateProfileResponse> updateBusinessProfile(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            @Valid @RequestBody UpdateProfileRequest request) {

        if (request.phone() == null && request.photoUrl() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Informe pelo menos phone ou photoUrl.");
        }

        String sub = jwt.getSubject();

        UserBusinessProfile profile = businessProfileService.upsert(
                sub,
                request.phone(),
                request.photoUrl());

        UpdateProfileResponse response = new UpdateProfileResponse(
                sub,
                jwt.getClaimAsString("email"),
                jwt.getClaimAsString("name"),
                profile.getPhone(),
                profile.getPhotoUrl());

        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
}

package com.raiji.users.web;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.users.dto.VehicleRequest;
import com.raiji.users.dto.VehicleResponse;
import com.raiji.users.service.VehicleService;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/vehicles")
@PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
public class VehicleController {

    private final VehicleService vehicleService;

    public VehicleController(VehicleService vehicleService) {
        this.vehicleService = vehicleService;
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<VehicleResponse> create(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            @Valid @RequestBody VehicleRequest request) {

        VehicleResponse response =
                vehicleService.create(request, jwt.getSubject());

        return ResponseEntity
                .status(HttpStatus.CREATED)
                .body(response);
    }

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<List<VehicleResponse>> list(
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                vehicleService.listByOwner(jwt.getSubject())
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<VehicleResponse> findById(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                vehicleService.findById(id, jwt.getSubject())
        );
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<VehicleResponse> update(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt,
            @Valid @RequestBody VehicleRequest request) {

        return ResponseEntity.ok(
                vehicleService.update(id, jwt.getSubject(), request)
        );
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> deactivate(
            @PathVariable UUID id,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt) {

        vehicleService.deactivate(id, jwt.getSubject());

        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/resources/db/migration/V5__migrate_to_keycloak_ids.sql =====
-- V5: migraÃ§Ã£o User/UserProfile -> Keycloak
--
-- Idempotente: funciona tanto em bancos ANTIGOS (que tinham users/user_profiles
-- e colunas *_id UUID) quanto em bancos NOVOS (onde o V1 revisado jÃ¡ criou as
-- colunas *_sub VARCHAR direto). Se a coluna jÃ¡ tiver o nome novo, o bloco
-- simplesmente ignora o RENAME.

-- 1) drop legado (idempotente)
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS user_profiles;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users;

-- 2) vehicles.owner_id -> owner_sub
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
               WHERE table_name = 'vehicles' AND column_name = 'owner_id') THEN
        ALTER TABLE vehicles RENAME COLUMN owner_id TO owner_sub;
        ALTER TABLE vehicles ALTER COLUMN owner_sub TYPE VARCHAR(64) USING owner_sub::text;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- 3) rides.driver_id -> driver_sub
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
               WHERE table_name = 'rides' AND column_name = 'driver_id') THEN
        ALTER TABLE rides RENAME COLUMN driver_id TO driver_sub;
        ALTER TABLE rides ALTER COLUMN driver_sub TYPE VARCHAR(64) USING driver_sub::text;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- 4) ride_passengers.passenger_id -> passenger_sub
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
               WHERE table_name = 'ride_passengers' AND column_name = 'passenger_id') THEN
        ALTER TABLE ride_passengers RENAME COLUMN passenger_id TO passenger_sub;
        ALTER TABLE ride_passengers ALTER COLUMN passenger_sub TYPE VARCHAR(64) USING passenger_sub::text;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- 5) deliveries.sender_id -> sender_sub
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
               WHERE table_name = 'deliveries' AND column_name = 'sender_id') THEN
        ALTER TABLE deliveries RENAME COLUMN sender_id TO sender_sub;
        ALTER TABLE deliveries ALTER COLUMN sender_sub TYPE VARCHAR(64) USING sender_sub::text;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- 6) renomeia Ã­ndices (opcional)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'idx_vehicles_owner') THEN
        ALTER INDEX idx_vehicles_owner RENAME TO idx_vehicles_owner_sub;
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'idx_rides_driver_status') THEN
        ALTER INDEX idx_rides_driver_status RENAME TO idx_rides_driver_sub_status;
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'idx_ride_passengers_passenger') THEN
        ALTER INDEX idx_ride_passengers_passenger RENAME TO idx_ride_pass_passenger_sub;
    END IF;
END $$;

===== ./raiji-users/src/main/resources/db/migration/V6__create_user_business_profiles.sql =====
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_business_profiles(
    sub VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,

package com.raiji.users.driververification;

import java.time.LocalDate;

class CnhDecisionTest {

    private static final LocalDate HOJE = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 10);
    private static final CnhDecision.OcrData OCR = new CnhDecision.OcrData("MARIA DA SILVA SOUZA", "12345678901", "98765432100");

    private static InfosimplesClient.Response resposta(int code, Map<String, Object> data) {
        return new InfosimplesClient.Response(code, "msg", data == null ? List.of() : List.of(data), List.of(), true);
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> cnh(String situacao, String validade, String categoria, String nome) {
        Map<String, Object> m = new HashMap<>();
        m.put("situacao", situacao);
        m.put("validade_data", validade);
        m.put("categoria", categoria);
        m.put("nome", nome);
        return m;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> campo(Object valor, double score) {
        return Map.of("valor", valor, "score", score);
    }

    private static InfosimplesClient.Response ocr(String tipo, Map<String, Object> campos) {
        return resposta(200, Map.of("tipo", tipo, "campos", campos));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ OCR

                "nome", campo("MARIA", 0.9),
                "cpf", campo("123.456.789-01", 0.2),
                "registro", campo("98765432100", 0.9))));

        assertThat(r.ok()).isFalse();
        assertThat(r.failure().outcome()).isEqualTo(Outcome.REJECTED);
        assertThat(r.failure().reason()).contains("foto nÃ­tida");
    }
