package com.raiji.users.driververification;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

/**
 * Testa o cliente contra um servidor HTTP LOCAL que imita a Infosimples.
 * Nenhuma chamada sai da mÃ¡quina (sem custo, sem token real).
 */
class InfosimplesClientTest {

    private HttpServer server;
    private final Map<String, Map<String, String>> recebido = new HashMap<>();
    private String resposta = "{}";

    @BeforeEach
    void start() throws IOException {
        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
        server.createContext("/", exchange -> {
            String body = new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            recebido.put(exchange.getRequestURI().getPath(), parseForm(body));
            byte[] out = resposta.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, out.length);
            try (OutputStream os = exchange.getResponseBody()) {
                os.write(out);
            }
        });
        server.start();
    }

    @AfterEach
    void stop() {
        server.stop(0);
    }

    private InfosimplesClient client(String token, String govbrCpf, String govbrSenha) {
        var props = new DriverVerificationProperties(
                new DriverVerificationProperties.Infosimples(
                        "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort(), token, govbrCpf, govbrSenha, 60),
                null);
        return new InfosimplesClient(props);
    }

    private static Map<String, String> parseForm(String body) {
        Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
        for (String pair : body.split("&")) {
            if (pair.isEmpty()) continue;
            String[] kv = pair.split("=", 2);
            map.put(URLDecoder.decode(kv[0], StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                    kv.length > 1 ? URLDecoder.decode(kv[1], StandardCharsets.UTF_8) : "");
        }
        return map;
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("OCR: envia token e a imagem em Base64; lÃª code, data e cobranÃ§a")
    void ocr() {
        resposta = """
                {"code":200,"code_message":"ok","header":{"billable":true},
                 "data":[{"tipo":"cnh_frente","campos":{"nome":{"valor":"MARIA","score":0.9}}}],
                 "errors":[]}""";
        byte[] imagem = {1, 2, 3, 4};

        InfosimplesClient.Response r = client("tok-123", null, null).ocrCnh(imagem);

        Map<String, String> form = recebido.get("/api/v2/imagens/ocr/cnh");
        assertThat(form).containsEntry("token", "tok-123");
        assertThat(form).containsEntry("image_base64", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(imagem));
        assertThat(r.code()).isEqualTo(200);
        assertThat(r.billable()).isTrue();
        assertThat(r.first()).containsEntry("tipo", "cnh_frente");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Validar CNH: envia CPF, registro, cÃ³digo e o login gov.br quando configurado")
    void validarComLogin() {
        resposta = """
                {"code":612,"code_message":"sem dados","header":{"billable":true},"data":[],"errors":["x"]}""";

        InfosimplesClient.Response r = client("tok", "11122233344", "senha")
                .validarCnh("12345678901", "98765432100", "55566677788", "MARIA");

        Map<String, String> form = recebido.get("/api/v2/consultas/senatran/validar-cnh");
        assertThat(form).containsEntry("cpf", "12345678901")
                .containsEntry("registro", "98765432100")
                .containsEntry("codigo_seguranca", "55566677788")
                .containsEntry("nome_condutor", "MARIA")
                .containsEntry("login_cpf", "11122233344")
                .containsEntry("login_senha", "senha")
                .containsKey("timeout");
        assertThat(r.code()).isEqualTo(612);
        assertThat(r.data()).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("Validar CNH sem login gov.br configurado: nÃ£o envia login_cpf/login_senha")
    void validarSemLogin() {
        resposta = "{\"code\":200,\"data\":[{}]}";

        client("tok", "", "").validarCnh("1", "2", "3", null);

        assertThat(recebido.get("/api/v2/consultas/senatran/validar-cnh"))
                .doesNotContainKeys("login_cpf", "login_senha", "nome_condutor");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("sem token: nÃ£o chama nada")
    void semToken() {
        InfosimplesClient c = client("", null, null);

        assertThat(c.configured()).isFalse();
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> c.ocrCnh(new byte[] {1})).isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class);
        assertThat(recebido).isEmpty();
    }
}

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.users.keycloak.KeycloakAdminService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;

class DriverApprovalMailerTest {

    private final KeycloakAdminService keycloak = mock(KeycloakAdminService.class);
    private final EmailSender sender = mock(EmailSender.class);
    private final DriverApprovalMailer mailer = new DriverApprovalMailer(keycloak, sender);

    @Test

        mailer.sendApproved("sub-1", pedido, "B", LocalDate.of(2030, 5, 20));

        verify(sender).send(msg.capture());
        assertThat(msg.getValue().to()).isEqualTo("maria@exemplo.com");
        assertThat(msg.getValue().subject()).contains("motorista").contains("aprovado");
        assertThat(msg.getValue().html()).contains("OlÃ¡, Maria!").contains("<b>B</b>").contains("20/05/2030");
        assertThat(msg.getValue().text()).contains("OlÃ¡, Maria!").contains("vÃ¡lida atÃ© 20/05/2030");
        assertThat(msg.getValue().idempotencyKey()).isEqualTo("driver-approved-" + pedido);
    }

    @DisplayName("nome com HTML Ã© escapado (o nome vem do cadastro do usuÃ¡rio)")

===== ./raiji-users/src/test/java/com/raiji/users/mail/ResendEmailSenderTest.java =====
package com.raiji.users.mail;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

/** Contra um servidor HTTP LOCAL que imita o Resend: nenhum e-mail real Ã© enviado. */
class ResendEmailSenderTest {

    private HttpServer server;
    private final List<Map<String, String>> requests = new ArrayList<>();

    @BeforeEach
    void start() throws IOException {
        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
        server.createContext("/", exchange -> {
            requests.add(Map.of(
                    "path", exchange.getRequestURI().getPath(),
                    "auth", String.valueOf(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization")),
                    "idem", String.valueOf(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Idempotency-Key")),
                    "body", new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
            byte[] out = "{\"id\":\"email-1\"}".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, out.length);
            try (OutputStream os = exchange.getResponseBody()) {
                os.write(out);
            }
        });
        server.start();
    }

    @AfterEach
    void stop() {
        server.stop(0);
    }

    private ResendEmailSender sender(String key) {
        return new ResendEmailSender(new MailProperties(new MailProperties.Resend(
                key, "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort(), "Raiji <nao-responda@raiji.test>")));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("envia para /emails com a chave, Idempotency-Key, remetente e destinatÃ¡rio")
    void envia() {
        sender("re_falsa").send(new EmailSender.EmailMessage(
                "maria@exemplo.com", "Assunto", "<p>oi</p>", "oi", "driver-approved-1"));

        assertThat(requests).hasSize(1);
        Map<String, String> r = requests.get(0);
        assertThat(r.get("path")).isEqualTo("/emails");
        assertThat(r.get("auth")).isEqualTo("Bearer re_falsa");
        assertThat(r.get("idem")).isEqualTo("driver-approved-1");
        assertThat(r.get("body"))
                .contains("\"from\":\"Raiji <nao-responda@raiji.test>\"")
                .contains("\"to\":[\"maria@exemplo.com\"]")
                .contains("\"subject\":\"Assunto\"");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("sem chave: nÃ£o chama o Resend")
    void semChave() {
        sender("").send(new EmailSender.EmailMessage("maria@exemplo.com", "Assunto", "h", "t", "k"));

        assertThat(requests).isEmpty();
    }
}

===== ./raiji-users/src/test/java/com/raiji/users/service/UserCapabilitiesServiceTest.java =====
package com.raiji.users.service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import com.raiji.common.Roles;
import com.raiji.users.driververification.DriverApplicationRepository;
import com.raiji.users.driververification.DriverApplicationStatus;
import com.raiji.users.dto.UserProfileResponse;
import com.raiji.users.keycloak.KeycloakAdminService;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

class UserCapabilitiesServiceTest {

    private static final String SUB = "user-123";

    private KeycloakAdminService keycloak;
    private DriverActivityChecker activity;
    private DriverApplicationRepository applications;
    private UserCapabilitiesService service;

    @BeforeEach
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    void setUp() {
        keycloak = mock(KeycloakAdminService.class);
        activity = mock(DriverActivityChecker.class);
        ObjectProvider<DriverActivityChecker> provider = mock(ObjectProvider.class);
        when(provider.getIfAvailable()).thenReturn(activity);
        applications = mock(DriverApplicationRepository.class);
        service = new UserCapabilitiesService(keycloak, provider, applications);
    }

    private static Jwt jwt(String... roles) {
        return Jwt.withTokenValue("t")
                .header("alg", "none")
                .subject(SUB)
                .claim("email", "maria@raiji.com")
                .claim("name", "Maria")
                .claim("realm_access", Map.of("roles", List.of(roles)))
                .build();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("conta nova: passageira por padrÃ£o, ainda sem PF/PJ")
    void newAccountIsPassenger() {
        UserProfileResponse me = service.fromToken(jwt("default-roles-raiji", Roles.PASSENGER));

        assertThat(me.passenger()).isTrue();
        assertThat(me.driver()).isFalse();
        assertThat(me.userType()).isNull();
        assertThat(me.profileConfigured()).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("motorista E passageira ao mesmo tempo")
    void driverAndPassenger() {
        UserProfileResponse me = service.fromToken(jwt(Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.DRIVER, Roles.PF));

        assertThat(me.passenger()).isTrue();
        assertThat(me.driver()).isTrue();
        assertThat(me.userType()).isEqualTo(Roles.PF);
        assertThat(me.profileConfigured()).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("tornar-se motorista (com CNH verificada) ADICIONA DRIVER e nunca remove PASSENGER")
    void becomeDriverIsAdditive() {
        cnhVerificada(true);
        when(keycloak.effectiveRealmRoles(SUB)).thenReturn(List.of(Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.DRIVER, Roles.PF));

        UserProfileResponse me = service.becomeDriver(jwt(Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.PF));

        verify(keycloak).assignRealmRole(SUB, Roles.DRIVER);
        verify(keycloak, never()).removeRealmRole(anyString(), anyString());
        assertThat(me.driver()).isTrue();
        assertThat(me.passenger()).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("deixar de ser motorista com carona ativa: 409 e nada muda")
    void stopBeingDriverWithActiveRides() {
        when(activity.hasActiveRidesAsDriver(SUB)).thenReturn(true);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.stopBeingDriver(jwt(Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.DRIVER)))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class)
                .extracting(e -> ((ResponseStatusException) e).getStatusCode())
                .isEqualTo(HttpStatus.CONFLICT);
        verify(keycloak, never()).removeRealmRole(anyString(), anyString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("deixar de ser motorista sem carona ativa: remove sÃ³ DRIVER")
    void stopBeingDriver() {
        when(activity.hasActiveRidesAsDriver(SUB)).thenReturn(false);
        when(keycloak.effectiveRealmRoles(SUB)).thenReturn(List.of(Roles.PASSENGER));

        UserProfileResponse me = service.stopBeingDriver(jwt(Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.DRIVER));

        verify(keycloak).removeRealmRole(SUB, Roles.DRIVER);
        verify(keycloak, never()).removeRealmRole(eq(SUB), eq(Roles.PASSENGER));
        assertThat(me.driver()).isFalse();
        assertThat(me.passenger()).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("legado POST /profile com PASSENGER nÃ£o tira DRIVER de quem jÃ¡ Ã© motorista")
    void legacyPassengerKeepsDriver() {
        when(keycloak.effectiveRealmRoles(SUB)).thenReturn(List.of(Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.DRIVER, Roles.PJ));

        UserProfileResponse me = service.applyLegacyProfile(jwt(Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.DRIVER), Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.PJ);

        verify(keycloak).setUserType(SUB, Roles.PJ);
        verify(keycloak, never()).removeRealmRole(anyString(), anyString());
        verify(keycloak, never()).assignRealmRole(anyString(), anyString());
        assertThat(me.driver()).isTrue();
        assertThat(me.userType()).isEqualTo(Roles.PJ);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("legado POST /profile com DRIVER (CNH verificada) acrescenta a role")
    void legacyDriverAdds() {
        cnhVerificada(true);
        when(keycloak.effectiveRealmRoles(SUB)).thenReturn(List.of(Roles.PASSENGER, Roles.DRIVER, Roles.PF));

        service.applyLegacyProfile(jwt(Roles.PASSENGER), Roles.DRIVER, Roles.PF);

        verify(keycloak).assignRealmRole(SUB, Roles.DRIVER);
        verify(keycloak, never()).removeRealmRole(anyString(), anyString());
    }

    private void cnhVerificada(boolean verificada) {
        when(applications.existsBySubAndStatusAndValidadeGreaterThanEqual(
                eq(SUB), eq(DriverApplicationStatus.APPROVED), any())).thenReturn(verificada);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("sem CNH verificada: POST /driver responde 409 e nÃ£o dÃ¡ a role")
    void becomeDriverWithoutCnh() {
        cnhVerificada(false);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.becomeDriver(jwt(Roles.PASSENGER)))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class)
                .extracting(e -> ((ResponseStatusException) e).getStatusCode())
                .isEqualTo(HttpStatus.CONFLICT);
        verify(keycloak, never()).assignRealmRole(anyString(), anyString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("sem CNH verificada: legado /profile com DRIVER responde 409 e nÃ£o muda nada")
    void legacyDriverWithoutCnh() {
        cnhVerificada(false);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.applyLegacyProfile(jwt(Roles.PASSENGER), Roles.DRIVER, Roles.PF))
                .isInstanceOf(ResponseStatusException.class);
        verify(keycloak, never()).setUserType(anyString(), anyString());
        verify(keycloak, never()).assignRealmRole(anyString(), anyString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("CNH aprovada na verificaÃ§Ã£o: a conta recebe DRIVER")
    void grantVerifiedDriver() {
        service.grantVerifiedDriver(SUB);

        verify(keycloak).assignRealmRole(SUB, Roles.DRIVER);
    }
}

package com.raiji.users.service;

import com.raiji.users.domain.Vehicle;

import com.raiji.users.repository.VehicleRepository;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;

import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

class VehicleServiceTest {

    private VehicleRepository vehicleRepository;
    private VehicleService vehicleService;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        vehicleRepository = mock(VehicleRepository.class);
        vehicleService = new VehicleService(vehicleRepository);
    }

    private VehicleRequest request(String plate, String model) {
        return new VehicleRequest(
                plate, " CARRO ", model, " Branco ", 2020, 4, 300
        );
    }

    private Vehicle vehicle(String owner, String plate, String model) {
        Vehicle vehicle = new Vehicle();
        vehicle.setOwnerSub(owner);
        vehicle.setPlate(plate);
        vehicle.setType("CARRO");
        vehicle.setModel(model);
        vehicle.setColor("Branco");
        vehicle.setYear(2020);
        vehicle.setPassengerSeats(4);
        vehicle.setCargoVolumeLiters(300);
        return vehicle;
    }

    @Test
    void deveCadastrarVeiculoNormalizandoPlacaECampos() {
        when(vehicleRepository.existsByPlate("ABC1234")).thenReturn(false);
        when(vehicleRepository.save(any(Vehicle.class)))
                .thenAnswer(invocation -> invocation.getArgument(0));

        VehicleResponse response = vehicleService.create(
                request(" abc1234 ", " Fiat Uno "),
                "usuario-123"
        );

        assertEquals("usuario-123", response.ownerSub());
        assertEquals("ABC1234", response.plate());
        assertEquals("CARRO", response.type());
        assertEquals("Fiat Uno", response.model());
        assertEquals("Branco", response.color());
        assertEquals(2020, response.year());
        assertEquals(4, response.passengerSeats());
        assertEquals(300, response.cargoVolumeLiters());
        assertTrue(response.active());

        verify(vehicleRepository).existsByPlate("ABC1234");
        verify(vehicleRepository).save(any(Vehicle.class));
    }

    @Test
    void naoDeveCadastrarPlacaDuplicada() {
        when(vehicleRepository.existsByPlate("ABC1234")).thenReturn(true);

        ResponseStatusException exception = assertThrows(
                ResponseStatusException.class,
                () -> vehicleService.create(
                        request("abc1234", "Fiat Uno"),
                        "usuario-123"
                )
        );

        assertEquals(409, exception.getStatusCode().value());
        assertTrue(exception.getReason().contains("placa"));
        verify(vehicleRepository, never()).save(any(Vehicle.class));
    }

    @Test
    void deveListarVeiculosDoProprietario() {
        Vehicle vehicle = vehicle("usuario-123", "ABC1234", "Fiat Uno");

        when(vehicleRepository.findByOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull("usuario-123"))
                .thenReturn(List.of(vehicle));

        List<VehicleResponse> responses =
                vehicleService.listByOwner("usuario-123");

        assertEquals(1, responses.size());
        assertEquals("usuario-123", responses.get(0).ownerSub());
        assertEquals("ABC1234", responses.get(0).plate());

        verify(vehicleRepository)
                .findByOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull("usuario-123");
    }

    @Test
    void deveRetornarListaVaziaQuandoProprietarioNaoTemVeiculos() {
        when(vehicleRepository.findByOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull("usuario-123"))
                .thenReturn(List.of());

        List<VehicleResponse> responses =
                vehicleService.listByOwner("usuario-123");

        assertTrue(responses.isEmpty());
        verify(vehicleRepository)
                .findByOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull("usuario-123");
    }

package com.raiji.users.web;

import com.raiji.users.domain.UserBusinessProfile;
import com.raiji.users.service.UserBusinessProfileService;
import com.raiji.users.service.UserCapabilitiesService;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.WebMvcTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoder;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;

import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.isNull;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.jwt;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.patch;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;

@WebMvcTest(controllers = UserProfileController.class)
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
@Import({
        UserProfileController.class,
        UserProfileControllerTest.TestConfig.class
})
class UserProfileControllerTest {

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @MockitoBean
    private UserCapabilitiesService capabilitiesService;

    @MockitoBean
    private UserBusinessProfileService businessProfileService;

    private UserBusinessProfile profile(String phone, String photoUrl) {
        UserBusinessProfile profile = new UserBusinessProfile();
        profile.setSub("user-123");
        profile.setPhone(phone);
        profile.setPhotoUrl(photoUrl);
        return profile;
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUpdatePhoneAndPhotoAndReturn200() throws Exception {
        String phone = "+5585999999999";
        String photoUrl = "https://storage.example.com/foto.jpg";

        when(businessProfileService.upsert(
                eq("user-123"), eq(phone), eq(photoUrl)
        )).thenReturn(profile(phone, photoUrl));

        mockMvc.perform(patch("/api/users/me")
                        .with(jwt().jwt(token -> token
                                .subject("user-123")
                                .claim("email", "user@example.com")
                                .claim("name", "UsuÃ¡rio Teste")))
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("""
                                {
                                  "phone": "+5585999999999",
                                  "photoUrl": "https://storage.example.com/foto.jpg"
                                }
                                """))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.sub").value("user-123"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.email").value("user@example.com"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.fullName").value("UsuÃ¡rio Teste"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.phone").value(phone))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.photoUrl").value(photoUrl));

        verify(businessProfileService).upsert(
                "user-123", phone, photoUrl
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturn400WhenNoFieldsAreProvided() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(patch("/api/users/me")
                        .with(jwt().jwt(token -> token.subject("user-123")))
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("{}"))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
    }

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.WebMvcTest;

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import;

@WebMvcTest(controllers = VehicleController.class)
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
@Import({
        VehicleController.class,
        VehicleControllerTest.TestConfig.class

class VehicleControllerTest {

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @Autowired
    private ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    @MockitoBean
    private VehicleService vehicleService;

    private final UUID vehicleId =
            UUID.fromString("aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa");

    private VehicleRequest validRequest() {
        return new VehicleRequest(
                "ABC1D23",
                "CARRO",
                "Toyota Corolla",
                "Prata",
                2024,
                4,
                400
        );
    }

    private VehicleResponse vehicleResponse() {
        return new VehicleResponse(
                vehicleId,
                "driver-123",
                "ABC1D23",
                "CARRO",
                "Toyota Corolla",
                "Prata",
                2024,
                4,
                400,
                true
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldCreateVehicleAndReturn201() throws Exception {
        when(vehicleService.create(
                any(VehicleRequest.class),
                eq("driver-123")
        )).thenReturn(vehicleResponse());

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/vehicles")
                        .with(jwt()
                                .jwt(token -> token.subject("driver-123"))
                                .authorities(
                                        new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_DRIVER")
                                ))
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(validRequest())))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.id").value(vehicleId.toString()))

                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.plate").value("ABC1D23"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.active").value(true));

        verify(vehicleService).create(
                any(VehicleRequest.class),
                eq("driver-123")
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturn400WhenRequestIsInvalid() throws Exception {
        String invalidJson = """
                {
                  "plate": "",
                  "type": "",
                  "model": "",
                  "color": "",
                  "year": 0,
                  "passengerSeats": 0,
                  "cargoVolumeLiters": -1
                }
                """;

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/vehicles")

                                        new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_DRIVER")
                                ))

    }

    @Test

                                        new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_PASSENGER")
                                )))
                .andExpect(status().isForbidden());
    }

    @Test
    void shouldListVehiclesForDriver() throws Exception {
        when(vehicleService.listByOwner("driver-123"))
                .thenReturn(List.of(vehicleResponse()));

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/vehicles")
                        .with(jwt()
                                .jwt(token -> token.subject("driver-123"))
                                .authorities(
                                        new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_DRIVER")

                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[0].plate").value("ABC1D23"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[0].active").value(true));

    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnVehicleById() throws Exception {
        when(vehicleService.findById(vehicleId, "driver-123"))

    @Test

    }

    @Test

                                .authorities(
                                        new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_DRIVER")
                                )))
                .andExpect(status().isNoContent());

        verify(vehicleService).deactivate(vehicleId, "driver-123");
    }

    @TestConfiguration
    @EnableMethodSecurity
    static class TestConfig {

        @Bean
        JwtDecoder jwtDecoder() {
            return token -> {
                throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
                        "O JwtDecoder nÃ£o deve ser chamado neste teste"
                );
            };
        }

        @Bean
        SecurityFilterChain testSecurityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http)
                throws Exception {

            return http
                    .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                    .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                            .anyRequest().authenticated())
                    .oauth2ResourceServer(oauth2 -> oauth2
                            .jwt(jwt -> jwt
                                    .jwtAuthenticationConverter(
                                            new org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.resource.authentication
                                                    .JwtAuthenticationConverter()
                                    )))
                    .build();
        }
    }

  A aplicaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o inicia
  Consulte os logs:
  docker compose logs -f app
  Confirme se PostgreSQL e Keycloak estÃ£o em execuÃ§Ã£o e se as configuraÃ§Ãµes de conexÃ£o correspondem ao ambiente utilizado.
  O banco nÃ£o fica saudÃ¡vel
  docker compose logs -f postgres
  docker compose ps
  Verifique se a porta 5432 nÃ£o estÃ¡ sendo utilizada por outro serviÃ§o e se o volume estÃ¡ acessÃ­vel.
  O Keycloak demora a iniciar
  docker compose logs -f keycloak
  O Keycloak depende do PostgreSQL. Aguarde a inicializaÃ§Ã£o do banco e confira as configuraÃ§Ãµes de conexÃ£o.
  A porta jÃ¡ estÃ¡ em uso
  Se 8080, 8180 ou 5432 estiver ocupada, encerre o serviÃ§o conflitante ou ajuste o mapeamento de portas no docker-compose.yml, mantendo as referÃªncias de conexÃ£o consistentes.
  O Git retorna 403 ao fazer push
  Um 403 normalmente indica falta de permissÃ£o de escrita ou autenticaÃ§Ã£o inadequada. Confirme que a conta GitHub utilizada tem acesso de escrita ao repositÃ³rio e que o Git estÃ¡ autenticando com a conta correta.
  O build Maven falha
  Confira a versÃ£o do Java:
  java -version
  mvn -version
  Utilize JDK 21 e consulte a mensagem completa do Maven para identificar o mÃ³dulo e a dependÃªncia que falharam.
  Estado da documentaÃ§Ã£o
  Este README documenta a estrutura Maven e os serviÃ§os definidos nos arquivos raiz do repositÃ³rio. Para detalhes especÃ­ficos de endpoints, regras de negÃ³cio, entidades, variÃ¡veis obrigatÃ³rias e perfis de execuÃ§Ã£o, consulte o cÃ³digo e os arquivos de configuraÃ§Ã£o de cada mÃ³dulo.

===== ./rustfs/init/01-create-bucket.sh =====
#!/bin/sh
# =============================================================================
# Executado pelo container `rustfs-init` (amazon/aws-cli) a cada `up`.
# Idempotente: cria o bucket sÃ³ se nÃ£o existir e reaplica as regras.
#
#   - bucket privado (sem acesso anÃ´nimo â€” sÃ³ com link prÃ©-assinado)
#   - lifecycle: apaga conversations/* apÃ³s 1 dia (o chat jÃ¡ corta em 24h)
#   - CORS: o app envia/baixa direto do navegador
#
# VariÃ¡veis: S3_ENDPOINT, S3_BUCKET, CORS_ORIGINS (separadas por vÃ­rgula)
# =============================================================================
set -eu

S3_ENDPOINT="${S3_ENDPOINT:-http://rustfs:9000}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:?S3_BUCKET obrigatÃ³rio}"
CORS_ORIGINS="${CORS_ORIGINS:-http://localhost,http://localhost:3000}"

s3api() { aws --endpoint-url "$S3_ENDPOINT" s3api "$@"; }

echo "[rustfs-init] aguardando $S3_ENDPOINT ..."
tries=0
until s3api list-buckets >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  tries=$((tries + 1))
  if [ "$tries" -ge 60 ]; then
    echo "[rustfs-init] ERRO: RustFS nÃ£o respondeu" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 2
done

if s3api head-bucket --bucket "$S3_BUCKET" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[rustfs-init] bucket $S3_BUCKET jÃ¡ existe"
else
  s3api create-bucket --bucket "$S3_BUCKET" >/dev/null
  echo "[rustfs-init] bucket $S3_BUCKET criado"
fi

s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket "$S3_BUCKET" --lifecycle-configuration '{
  "Rules": [{
    "ID": "chat-media-24h",
    "Status": "Enabled",
    "Filter": { "Prefix": "conversations/" },
    "Expiration": { "Days": 1 },
    "AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload": { "DaysAfterInitiation": 1 }
  }]
}'

ORIGINS_JSON="$(printf '%s' "$CORS_ORIGINS" | sed 's/[[:space:]]//g; s/,/","/g; s/^/"/; s/$/"/')"
s3api put-bucket-cors --bucket "$S3_BUCKET" --cors-configuration "{
  \"CORSRules\": [{
    \"AllowedOrigins\": [$ORIGINS_JSON],
    \"AllowedMethods\": [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\"],
    \"AllowedHeaders\": [\"*\"],
    \"ExposeHeaders\": [\"ETag\"],
    \"MaxAgeSeconds\": 3000
  }]
}"

echo "[rustfs-init] lifecycle (1 dia) e CORS ($CORS_ORIGINS) aplicados"

# --- Bucket de documentos de motorista (foto da CNH na verificaÃ§Ã£o) -----------
# Privado, SEM CORS (sÃ³ o back-end acessa) e com expiraÃ§Ã£o de 1 dia como garantia:
# o monolito jÃ¡ apaga a foto assim que decide a verificaÃ§Ã£o.
if [ -n "${DOCS_BUCKET:-}" ]; then
  if s3api head-bucket --bucket "$DOCS_BUCKET" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[rustfs-init] bucket $DOCS_BUCKET jÃ¡ existe"
  else
    s3api create-bucket --bucket "$DOCS_BUCKET" >/dev/null
    echo "[rustfs-init] bucket $DOCS_BUCKET criado"
  fi
  s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket "$DOCS_BUCKET" --lifecycle-configuration '{
    "Rules": [{
      "ID": "driver-docs-1d",
      "Status": "Enabled",
      "Filter": { "Prefix": "cnh/" },
      "Expiration": { "Days": 1 },
      "AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload": { "DaysAfterInitiation": 1 }
    }]
  }'
  echo "[rustfs-init] $DOCS_BUCKET: privado, expiraÃ§Ã£o de 1 dia"
fi

===== ./scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# bootstrap-aws.sh â€” provisiona (e MANTÃ‰M) a infra AWS de cada ambiente.
#
# Idempotente: rode de novo sempre que quiser. LÃª a configuraÃ§Ã£o de
# infra/aws/aws-config.env (tipo de mÃ¡quina, regiÃ£o, portas, AMI). Flags de
# CLI tÃªm precedÃªncia sobre o arquivo.
#
#   ./scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh --env dev
#   ./scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh --env homolog
#   ./scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh --env dev --instance-type t3.medium   # resize
#
# MUDOU O TIPO DE MÃQUINA no aws-config.env? Rerode o bootstrap: ele detecta
# a diferenÃ§a, para a instÃ¢ncia, aplica o novo tipo e religa (resize automÃ¡tico).
#
# Cria (uma vez): ECR `raiji-app`, security group, key pair, IAM role (pull
# ECR) e instÃ¢ncia EC2 Ubuntu 24.04 com Docker+Compose via user-data.
# No final, imprime EXATAMENTE o que configurar no GitHub (secrets/variables).
#
# Requer: aws cli v2 configurado com permissÃµes de EC2/IAM/ECR.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

CONFIG_FILE="infra/aws/aws-config.env"
CLI_ENV="" CLI_REGION="" CLI_INSTANCE_TYPE="" CLI_BASE_PORT="" CLI_KC_PORT="" CLI_AMI=""

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --env) CLI_ENV="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --region) CLI_REGION="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --instance-type) CLI_INSTANCE_TYPE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --base-port) CLI_BASE_PORT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --kc-port) CLI_KC_PORT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --ami) CLI_AMI="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --config) CONFIG_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    *) echo "opÃ§Ã£o invÃ¡lida: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

ENVIRONMENT="$CLI_ENV"
[[ "$ENVIRONMENT" =~ ^(dev|homolog)$ ]] || { echo "--env deve ser dev|homolog" >&2; exit 2; }

# --- carrega o arquivo de configuraÃ§Ã£o (fonte Ãºnica) ---------------------------
if [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
  set -a; . "$CONFIG_FILE"; set +a
  echo "[bootstrap] configuraÃ§Ã£o carregada de $CONFIG_FILE"
else
  echo "[bootstrap] AVISO: $CONFIG_FILE nÃ£o encontrado â€” usando padrÃµes do script."
fi
SUFFIX="$(echo "$ENVIRONMENT" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"
it_var="INSTANCE_TYPE_$SUFFIX"; bp_var="BASE_PORT_$SUFFIX"; kp_var="KC_PORT_$SUFFIX"; ami_var="AMI_$SUFFIX"

REGION="${CLI_REGION:-${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}}"
INSTANCE_TYPE="${CLI_INSTANCE_TYPE:-${!it_var:-t3.small}}"
BASE_PORT="${CLI_BASE_PORT:-${!bp_var:-8000}}"
KC_PORT="${CLI_KC_PORT:-${!kp_var:-$((BASE_PORT + 180))}}"
AMI="${CLI_AMI:-${!ami_var:-}}"

KEY_NAME="raiji-${ENVIRONMENT}-key"
REPO="raiji-app"
ROLE="raiji-ec2-ecr-${ENVIRONMENT}"
SG_NAME="raiji-${ENVIRONMENT}-sg"
ACTIONS_USER="raiji-actions"
log() { echo "[bootstrap:$ENVIRONMENT] $*"; }

command -v aws >/dev/null || { echo "aws cli nÃ£o encontrado" >&2; exit 1; }
ACCOUNT_ID="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)" \
  || { echo "aws sts falhou â€” confira suas credenciais" >&2; exit 1; }
# Bucket do S3 para a foto da CNH (nome Ãºnico por conta+ambiente).
DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET="raiji-driver-docs-${ACCOUNT_ID}-${ENVIRONMENT}"
log "configuraÃ§Ã£o: conta=$ACCOUNT_ID regiÃ£o=$REGION tipo=$INSTANCE_TYPE portas=$BASE_PORT/$KC_PORT"
log "bucket CNH: $DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET"

# --- S3: bucket privado para a foto da CNH (idempotente) ------------------------
if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "bucket S3 $DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET jÃ¡ existe."
else
  log "criando bucket S3 $DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET ..."
  if [[ "$REGION" == "us-east-1" ]]; then
    aws s3api create-bucket --bucket "$DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET" --region "$REGION" >/dev/null
  else
    aws s3api create-bucket --bucket "$DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET" --region "$REGION" \
      --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint="$REGION" >/dev/null
  fi
fi
# Sempre reaplica as proteÃ§Ãµes (barato e idempotente).
aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket "$DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET" \
  --public-access-block-configuration \
  BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true >/dev/null
aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket "$DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET" \
  --server-side-encryption-configuration \
  '{"Rules":[{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault":{"SSEAlgorithm":"AES256"}}]}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# --- ECR (idempotente) ----------------------------------------------------------
if ! aws ecr describe-repositories --region "$REGION" --repository-names "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "criando repositÃ³rio ECR $REPO ..."
  aws ecr create-repository --region "$REGION" --repository-name "$REPO" \
    --image-scanning-configuration scanOnPush=true >/dev/null
else
  log "ECR $REPO jÃ¡ existe."
fi

# --- IAM role da EC2: pull do ECR + S3 da CNH -----------------------------------
if ! aws iam get-role --role-name "$ROLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "criando IAM role $ROLE ..."
  aws iam create-role --role-name "$ROLE" \
    --assume-role-policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"ec2.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}' >/dev/null
else
  log "IAM role $ROLE jÃ¡ existe."
fi
# Reaplica a policy sempre: assim roles antigas ganham S3 sem recriar a instÃ¢ncia.
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name "$ROLE" --policy-name ecr-pull --policy-document "{
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\": [{
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Action\": [\"ecr:GetAuthorizationToken\"],
    \"Resource\": \"*\"
  }, {
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Action\": [\"ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability\",\"ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer\",\"ecr:BatchGetImage\"],
    \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:ecr:${REGION}:${ACCOUNT_ID}:repository/${REPO}\"
  }, {
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Action\": [\"s3:ListBucket\"],
    \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:s3:::${DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET}\"
  }, {
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Action\": [\"s3:PutObject\",\"s3:GetObject\",\"s3:DeleteObject\"],
    \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:s3:::${DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET}/*\"
  }]
}"
if ! aws iam get-instance-profile --instance-profile-name "$ROLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  aws iam create-instance-profile --instance-profile-name "$ROLE" >/dev/null
  aws iam add-role-to-instance-profile --instance-profile-name "$ROLE" --role-name "$ROLE"
  sleep 10
fi

# --- IAM user do GitHub Actions: push/retag no ECR + STS ------------------------
if ! aws iam get-user --user-name "$ACTIONS_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "criando IAM user $ACTIONS_USER (usado pelo GitHub Actions) ..."
  aws iam create-user --user-name "$ACTIONS_USER" >/dev/null
else
  log "IAM user $ACTIONS_USER jÃ¡ existe."
fi
aws iam put-user-policy --user-name "$ACTIONS_USER" --policy-name raiji-actions-ecr --policy-document "{
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\": [{
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Action\": [\"ecr:GetAuthorizationToken\"],
    \"Resource\": \"*\"
  }, {
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Action\": [
      \"ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability\",\"ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer\",\"ecr:BatchGetImage\",
      \"ecr:PutImage\",\"ecr:InitiateLayerUpload\",\"ecr:UploadLayerPart\",
      \"ecr:CompleteLayerUpload\",\"ecr:DescribeImages\"
    ],
    \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:ecr:${REGION}:${ACCOUNT_ID}:repository/${REPO}\"
  }, {
    \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
    \"Action\": [\"sts:GetCallerIdentity\"],
    \"Resource\": \"*\"
  }]
}"
ACTIONS_KEY_FILE="$HOME/.ssh/raiji-actions-access-key.json"
if [[ "$(aws iam list-access-keys --user-name "$ACTIONS_USER" --query 'length(AccessKeyMetadata)' --output text)" == "0" ]]; then
  log "criando access key para $ACTIONS_USER -> $ACTIONS_KEY_FILE"
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh"
  (umask 077; aws iam create-access-key --user-name "$ACTIONS_USER" --output json > "$ACTIONS_KEY_FILE")
else
  log "access key de $ACTIONS_USER jÃ¡ existe (nÃ£o Ã© possÃ­vel exibir a secret de novo)."
fi

# --- Security group (cria e garante as portas do config) --------------------------
VPC_ID="$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$REGION" \
  --filters Name=is-default,Values=true --query 'Vpcs[0].VpcId' --output text)"
SG_ID="$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$REGION" \
  --filters Name=group-name,Values="$SG_NAME" --query 'SecurityGroups[0].GroupId' --output text 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -z "$SG_ID" || "$SG_ID" == "None" ]]; then
  log "criando security group $SG_NAME (22, $BASE_PORT, $KC_PORT) ..."
  SG_ID="$(aws ec2 create-security-group --region "$REGION" --group-name "$SG_NAME" \
    --description "Raiji $ENVIRONMENT" --vpc-id "$VPC_ID" --query GroupId --output text)"
  aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --region "$REGION" --group-id "$SG_ID" \
    --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0 >/dev/null
  log "AVISO: SSH (22) aberto para 0.0.0.0/0 â€” restrinja o CIDR em produÃ§Ã£o."
else
  log "security group jÃ¡ existe: $SG_ID"
fi
for P in "$BASE_PORT" "$KC_PORT"; do
  aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --region "$REGION" --group-id "$SG_ID" \
    --protocol tcp --port "$P" --cidr 0.0.0.0/0 >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "porta $P liberada no security group" \
    || log "porta $P jÃ¡ liberada"
done

# --- Key pair -----------------------------------------------------------------------
KEY_FILE="$HOME/.ssh/raiji-${ENVIRONMENT}-pem"
if ! aws ec2 describe-key-pairs --region "$REGION" --key-names "$KEY_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "criando key pair $KEY_NAME -> $KEY_FILE"
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh"
  aws ec2 create-key-pair --region "$REGION" --key-name "$KEY_NAME" \
    --query 'KeyMaterial' --output text > "$KEY_FILE"
  chmod 600 "$KEY_FILE"
else
  log "key pair $KEY_NAME jÃ¡ existe (use a .pem salva anteriormente)."
fi

# --- AMI ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -z "$AMI" ]]; then
  AMI="$(aws ssm get-parameters --region "$REGION" \
    --names /aws/service/canonical/ubuntu/server/24.04/stable/current/amd64/hvm/ebs-gp3/ami-id \
    --query 'Parameters[0].Value' --output text)"
fi

USER_DATA='#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2 awscli curl jq
systemctl enable --now docker
usermod -aG docker ubuntu
mkdir -p /opt/raiji
chown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /opt/raiji'

# --- InstÃ¢ncia: cria, ou REDIMENSIONA se o tipo mudou no config --------------------
EXISTING="$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$REGION" \
  --filters "Name=tag:RaijiEnv,Values=$ENVIRONMENT" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running,stopped,pending" \
  --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].InstanceId' --output text 2>/dev/null || true)"

if [[ -n "$EXISTING" && "$EXISTING" != "None" ]]; then
  CURRENT_TYPE="$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$REGION" --instance-ids "$EXISTING" \
    --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].InstanceType' --output text)"
  STATE="$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$REGION" --instance-ids "$EXISTING" \
    --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].State.Name' --output text)"
  log "instÃ¢ncia existente: $EXISTING ($CURRENT_TYPE, $STATE)"
  ID="$EXISTING"

  if [[ "$CURRENT_TYPE" != "$INSTANCE_TYPE" ]]; then
    log "ALTERANDO tipo de mÃ¡quina: $CURRENT_TYPE -> $INSTANCE_TYPE ..."
    if [[ "$STATE" == "running" || "$STATE" == "pending" ]]; then
      aws ec2 wait instance-running --region "$REGION" --instance-ids "$EXISTING" 2>/dev/null || true
      aws ec2 stop-instances --region "$REGION" --instance-ids "$EXISTING" >/dev/null
      aws ec2 wait instance-stopped --region "$REGION" --instance-ids "$EXISTING"
    fi
    aws ec2 modify-instance-attribute --region "$REGION" --instance-id "$EXISTING" \
      --instance-type "{\"Value\": \"$INSTANCE_TYPE\"}"
    aws ec2 start-instances --region "$REGION" --instance-ids "$EXISTING" >/dev/null
    aws ec2 wait instance-running --region "$REGION" --instance-ids "$EXISTING"
    log "resize concluÃ­do: $INSTANCE_TYPE"
  fi
else
  log "lanÃ§ando instÃ¢ncia $INSTANCE_TYPE (AMI $AMI) ..."
  ID="$(aws ec2 run-instances --region "$REGION" --image-id "$AMI" \
    --instance-type "$INSTANCE_TYPE" --key-name "$KEY_NAME" \
    --security-group-ids "$SG_ID" --iam-instance-profile Name="$ROLE" \
    --tag-specifications "ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=raiji-$ENVIRONMENT},{Key=RaijiEnv,Value=$ENVIRONMENT}]" \
    --user-data "$USER_DATA" \
    --query 'Instances[0].InstanceId' --output text)"
  log "aguardando a instÃ¢ncia $ID ficar running ..."
  aws ec2 wait instance-running --region "$REGION" --instance-ids "$ID"
fi

# --- Elastic IP: o host nÃ£o muda em stop/start (variÃ¡vel do GitHub estÃ¡vel) ------
EIP_ALLOC="$(aws ec2 describe-addresses --region "$REGION" \
  --filters "Name=tag:RaijiEnv,Values=$ENVIRONMENT" \
  --query 'Addresses[0].AllocationId' --output text 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -z "$EIP_ALLOC" || "$EIP_ALLOC" == "None" ]]; then
  log "alocando Elastic IP para $ENVIRONMENT ..."
  EIP_ALLOC="$(aws ec2 allocate-address --region "$REGION" --domain vpc \
    --query 'AllocationId' --output text)"
  aws ec2 create-tags --region "$REGION" --resources "$EIP_ALLOC" \
    --tags "Key=Name,Value=raiji-$ENVIRONMENT-eip" "Key=RaijiEnv,Value=$ENVIRONMENT"
else
  log "Elastic IP jÃ¡ existe: $EIP_ALLOC"
fi
aws ec2 associate-address --region "$REGION" --instance-id "$ID" \
  --allocation-id "$EIP_ALLOC" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && log "Elastic IP associado Ã  instÃ¢ncia $ID" \
  || log "Elastic IP jÃ¡ associado (ou associaÃ§Ã£o pendente)"
IP="$(aws ec2 describe-addresses --region "$REGION" --allocation-ids "$EIP_ALLOC" \
  --query 'Addresses[0].PublicIp' --output text)"

SUFIXO="$SUFFIX"
cat <<FIM

============================================================
 Bootstrap $ENVIRONMENT concluÃ­do!
============================================================
 Config em uso: $CONFIG_FILE (edite-o para mudar tipo de
 mÃ¡quina/regiÃ£o/portas e rerode este script).

 URL do ambiente: http://$IP:$BASE_PORT
 Bucket S3 da CNH: $DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET

 Configure no GitHub (Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions):

 [Variables] (aba Variables)
   AWS_EC2_HOST_$SUFIXO = $IP

 [Secrets] (aba Secrets â€” repositÃ³rio)
   AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID               = <AccessKeyId de $ACTIONS_KEY_FILE>
   AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY           = <SecretAccessKey de $ACTIONS_KEY_FILE>

 [Secrets] (Environment '$ENVIRONMENT' â€” Settings -> Environments)
   AWS_SSH_KEY_$SUFIXO             = conteÃºdo de $KEY_FILE
   DB_PASSWORD_$SUFIXO             = <senha forte do banco>
   KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET_$SUFIXO = <segredo do client raiji-admin>
   SMOKE_USERNAME_$SUFIXO          = teste            (opcional)
   SMOKE_PASSWORD_$SUFIXO          = <senha do usuÃ¡rio de smoke> (opcional)

 [Secrets opcionais] (repositÃ³rio â€” funcionalidades da aplicaÃ§Ã£o)
   INFO_SIMPLES_KEY, INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_CPF, INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_SENHA,
   RESEND_API_KEY, RESEND_FROM, STRIPE_API_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
   RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

 Credenciais do IAM user do Actions (NÃƒO commitar):
   $ACTIONS_KEY_FILE

 A instÃ¢ncia nova precisa de ~2-5 min para instalar Docker (user-data).
 Teste: ssh -i $KEY_FILE ubuntu@$IP 'docker --version'
