FIM

===== ./scripts/aws/check-github-config.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# check-github-config.sh â€” diagnostica o que falta no GitHub para o CD rodar.
#
# Somente LEITURA (nÃ£o altera nada). Requer `gh` autenticado com permissÃ£o de
# admin no repositÃ³rio (para listar secrets/variables/environments):
#
#   gh auth login
#   ./scripts/aws/check-github-config.sh
#
# SaÃ­da: OK/FALTA para cada item + dica de onde configurar.
# Exit code: 0 = tudo pronto; 1 = falta algo; 2 = gh ausente/sem auth.
# =============================================================================
set -uo pipefail

if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERRO: gh (GitHub CLI) nÃ£o instalado." >&2
  echo "Instale: https://cli.github.com/  (ou use o checklist manual em docs/CD-CHECKLIST.md)" >&2
  exit 2
fi
if ! gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERRO: gh nÃ£o autenticado. Rode: gh auth login" >&2
  exit 2
fi

REPO="$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner 2>/dev/null)" || {
  echo "ERRO: nÃ£o foi possÃ­vel detectar o repositÃ³rio (rode dentro do clone)." >&2
  exit 2
}
DEFAULT_BRANCH="$(gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name 2>/dev/null || echo main)"

GRN=$'\033[0;32m'; RED=$'\033[0;31m'; YLW=$'\033[1;33m'; NC=$'\033[0m'
FAIL=0
ok()   { printf '  %sOK%s    %s\n' "$GRN" "$NC" "$*"; }
bad()  { printf '  %sFALTA%s %s\n' "$RED" "$NC" "$*"; FAIL=1; }
warn() { printf '  %sAVISO%s %s\n' "$YLW" "$NC" "$*"; }

has_secret() { # repo|env, name
  local scope="$1" name="$2"
  if [[ "$scope" == "repo" ]]; then
    gh api "repos/$REPO/actions/secrets" --jq '.secrets[].name' 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "$name"
  else
    gh api "repos/$REPO/environments/$scope/secrets" --jq '.secrets[].name' 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "$name"
  fi
}
has_var() {
  gh api "repos/$REPO/actions/variables" --jq '.variables[].name' 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "$1"
}
has_env() {
  gh api "repos/$REPO/environments" --jq '.environments[].name' 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "$1"
}

echo
echo "RepositÃ³rio: $REPO (branch default: $DEFAULT_BRANCH)"
echo

echo "[1] Secrets do repositÃ³rio (Actions)"
for s in AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; do
  if has_secret repo "$s"; then ok "$s"; else bad "$s â€” Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions -> Secrets"; fi
done

echo
echo "[2] Variables do repositÃ³rio (Actions)"
for v in AWS_EC2_HOST_DEV AWS_EC2_HOST_HOMOLOG; do
  if has_var "$v"; then ok "$v"; else bad "$v â€” Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions -> Variables"; fi
done

for env in dev homolog; do
  echo
  echo "[3] Environment '$env'"
  if has_env "$env"; then
    ok "environment existe"
  else
    bad "environment '$env' nÃ£o existe â€” Settings -> Environments -> New environment"
    continue
  fi
  suffix="$(echo "$env" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"
  for s in "AWS_SSH_KEY_$suffix" "DB_PASSWORD_$suffix" "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET_$suffix"; do
    if has_secret "$env" "$s"; then ok "$s"; else bad "$s â€” Environment '$env' -> Environment secrets"; fi
  done
  for s in "SMOKE_USERNAME_$suffix" "SMOKE_PASSWORD_$suffix"; do
    if has_secret "$env" "$s"; then ok "$s (opcional)"; else warn "$s (opcional) â€” padrÃ£o teste/teste123"; fi
  done
done

echo
echo "[4] Funcionalidades opcionais (repository secrets)"
for s in INFO_SIMPLES_KEY INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_CPF INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_SENHA \
         RESEND_API_KEY RESEND_FROM STRIPE_API_KEY STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET \
         RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS; do
  if has_secret repo "$s"; then ok "$s"; else warn "$s (nÃ£o configurado â€” recurso fica desligado)"; fi
done

echo
echo "[5] Workflows visÃ­veis no GitHub"
for w in "CI" "Deploy DEV (develop -> AWS dev)" "Deploy HOMOLOG (main -> AWS sistema)" "Rollback (manual)" "Guardian (smoke contÃ­nuo + rollback automÃ¡tico)"; do
  if gh api "repos/$REPO/actions/workflows" --jq '.workflows[].name' 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF "$w"; then
    ok "$w"
  else
    bad "$w â€” nÃ£o registrado. Os workflows sÃ³ aparecem no branch default ($DEFAULT_BRANCH)."
  fi
done

echo
if [[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]]; then
  printf '%sTudo pronto para o CD. âœ…%s\n' "$GRN" "$NC"
  exit 0
fi
printf '%sFaltam itens acima. Veja docs/CD-CHECKLIST.md.%s\n' "$RED" "$NC"
exit 1

===== ./scripts/aws/deploy-remote.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# deploy-remote.sh â€” roda NA instÃ¢ncia EC2 (invocado via SSH pelo deploy.sh).
# LÃª o .env do diretÃ³rio, faz login no ECR, puxa a imagem nova, recria o stack,
# aguarda o health-gate e, se falhar, faz self-rollback para a imagem anterior.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.."   # /opt/raiji/<env>
[[ -f .env ]] || { echo "[remote] ERRO: .env nÃ£o encontrado" >&2; exit 1; }
set -a; . ./.env; set +a

: "${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:?}"
: "${IMAGE_TAG:?}"
: "${BASE_PORT:?}"

COMPOSE=(docker compose -p "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME" -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.aws.yml)
STATE_FILE=".deploy-state"
log() { echo "[remote:${ENVIRONMENT:-?}] $*"; }

# --- prÃ©-requisito: Compose >= 2.24 (tags !override/!reset) --------------------
COMPOSE_VERSION="$(docker compose version --short 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -z "$COMPOSE_VERSION" ]]; then
  echo "[remote] ERRO: 'docker compose' nÃ£o encontrado. Instale docker-compose-v2." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$(printf '%s\n2.24\n' "$COMPOSE_VERSION" | sort -V | head -n1)" != "2.24" ]]; then
  echo "[remote] ERRO: Docker Compose $COMPOSE_VERSION Ã© antigo; o override AWS exige >= 2.24." >&2
  exit 1
fi
log "docker compose $COMPOSE_VERSION"

# --- registra a versÃ£o atualmente em execuÃ§Ã£o (para rollback) ------------------
PREVIOUS_TAG=""
if [[ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]]; then
  PREVIOUS_TAG="$(sed -n 's/^IMAGE_TAG=//p' "$STATE_FILE" | tail -n1)"
fi
if [[ -n "$PREVIOUS_TAG" && "$PREVIOUS_TAG" != "$IMAGE_TAG" ]]; then
  cp "$STATE_FILE" ".deploy-state.previous"
  log "versÃ£o anterior registrada: $PREVIOUS_TAG"
fi

# --- login no ECR (usa o instance profile da EC2) ------------------------------
if command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  aws ecr get-login-password --region "${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}" \
    | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$ECR_REGISTRY" >/dev/null \
    && log "login ECR ok" || log "AVISO: login ECR falhou (seguindo assim mesmo)"
fi

# --- pull + up ------------------------------------------------------------------
log "pull das imagens (IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG) ..."
"${COMPOSE[@]}" pull --quiet app || { echo "[remote] ERRO: pull da imagem falhou" >&2; exit 1; }

log "subindo o stack ..."
UP_OK=1
"${COMPOSE[@]}" up -d --remove-orphans || UP_OK=0

if [[ "$UP_OK" -eq 1 ]]; then
  # grava estado atual
  grep -v '^IMAGE_TAG=' "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null > "$STATE_FILE.tmp" || true
  echo "IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG" >> "$STATE_FILE.tmp"
  echo "DEPLOYED_AT=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$STATE_FILE.tmp"
  mv "$STATE_FILE.tmp" "$STATE_FILE"

  # --- health-gate (reusa o smoke-test) ------------------------------------------
  # 90 x 10s = 15 min: primeiro boot (Keycloak import + Postgres + app) Ã© lento.
  HEALTH_RETRIES="${HEALTH_RETRIES:-90}"
  log "aguardando health-gate em http://localhost:$BASE_PORT (atÃ© $((HEALTH_RETRIES * 10 / 60)) min) ..."
  if BASE_URL="http://localhost:$BASE_PORT" ./scripts/smoke-test.sh --check health --retries "$HEALTH_RETRIES" --retry-delay 10; then
    log "health OK â€” deploy concluÃ­do."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "[remote] ERRO: health-gate falhou." >&2
else
  echo "[remote] ERRO: 'docker compose up' falhou (veja logs acima)." >&2
fi

# --- self-rollback local ----------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -n "$PREVIOUS_TAG" ]]; then
  echo "[remote] self-rollback para $PREVIOUS_TAG ..." >&2
  IMAGE_TAG="$PREVIOUS_TAG" "${COMPOSE[@]}" up -d --no-deps --no-build app || true
  cp ".deploy-state.previous" "$STATE_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true
else
  # Sem versÃ£o anterior: NÃƒO servir versÃ£o quebrada â€” o app fica parado atÃ©
  # que um deploy correto seja publicado ("nÃ£o deixe subir atÃ© subir certo").
  echo "[remote] SEM versÃ£o anterior â€” parando o app para nÃ£o servir versÃ£o quebrada." >&2
  "${COMPOSE[@]}" stop app >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
exit 1

===== ./scripts/aws/deploy.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# deploy.sh â€” publica um ambiente na EC2 (roda no GitHub Actions runner).
#
# Requer (env):
#   ENVIRONMENT (dev|homolog), EC2_HOST, EC2_USER (ubuntu), SSH_PRIVATE_KEY,
#   AWS_REGION_NAME, BASE_PORT; segredos: DB_PASSWORD, KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET
# Requer (ferramentas): aws cli (credenciais jÃ¡ configuradas), ssh, tar.
#
# Passos:
#   1. descobre o registry ECR da conta
#   2. sincroniza os arquivos de infra para /opt/raiji/<env> na EC2
#   3. grava o .env remoto (variÃ¡veis do provedor â€” nunca commitado)
#   4. executa deploy-remote.sh (pull da imagem, up -d, health-gate, self-rollback)
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

: "${ENVIRONMENT:?ENVIRONMENT obrigatÃ³rio (dev|homolog)}"
: "${EC2_HOST:?EC2_HOST obrigatÃ³rio (defina a variÃ¡vel AWS_EC2_HOST_${ENVIRONMENT^^} no GitHub)}"
: "${EC2_USER:=ubuntu}"
: "${SSH_PRIVATE_KEY:?SSH_PRIVATE_KEY obrigatÃ³rio}"
: "${AWS_REGION_NAME:=us-east-1}"
: "${BASE_PORT:?BASE_PORT obrigatÃ³rio (dev=8000, homolog=9000)}"
: "${DB_PASSWORD:?DB_PASSWORD obrigatÃ³rio}"
: "${KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET:?KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET obrigatÃ³rio}"

REMOTE_DIR="/opt/raiji/$ENVIRONMENT"
KC_PORT="${KC_PORT:-$((BASE_PORT + 180))}"

log() { echo "[deploy:$ENVIRONMENT] $*"; }
die() { echo "[deploy:$ENVIRONMENT] ERRO: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# --- 1) SSH key temporÃ¡ria ---------------------------------------------------
KEY_FILE="$(mktemp)"
umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$KEY_FILE"
cleanup() { rm -f "$KEY_FILE"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

SSH_OPTS=(-i "$KEY_FILE" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR -o ConnectTimeout=15)
SSH_TARGET="$EC2_USER@$EC2_HOST"

# --- 2) Registry ECR ----------------------------------------------------------
ACCOUNT_ID="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)" \
  || die "aws sts falhou â€” confira AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
ECR_REGISTRY="${ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_NAME}.amazonaws.com"
IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG:-${ENVIRONMENT}-current}"
# Bucket do S3 para a foto da CNH. O bootstrap cria exatamente este nome.
DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET="${DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET:-raiji-driver-docs-${ACCOUNT_ID}-${ENVIRONMENT}}"
log "ECR registry: $ECR_REGISTRY | tag: $IMAGE_TAG | bucket CNH: $DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET"

# Aspas simples seguras para o formato .env do Compose (aceita espaÃ§os e $).
sq() { printf "'%s'" "${1//\'/\'\\\'\'}"; }

# --- 3) Sincronizar arquivos de infra -----------------------------------------
log "sincronizando arquivos para $SSH_TARGET:$REMOTE_DIR ..."
ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$SSH_TARGET" "mkdir -p '$REMOTE_DIR/scripts/aws'"
tar czf - --exclude='.env' --exclude='target' \
  docker-compose.yml docker-compose.aws.yml \
  kong keycloak postgres rabbitmq \
  scripts/aws/deploy-remote.sh scripts/smoke-test.sh \
  | ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$SSH_TARGET" "tar xzf - -C '$REMOTE_DIR'"

# --- 4) Gravar .env remoto (stdin â€” segredos nÃ£o aparecem em linha de comando)
log "gravando .env remoto (umask 077) ..."
ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$SSH_TARGET" "umask 077; cat > '$REMOTE_DIR/.env'" <<ENV_EOF
COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=raiji-$ENVIRONMENT
ENVIRONMENT=$ENVIRONMENT
ECR_REGISTRY=$ECR_REGISTRY
ECR_REPOSITORY=raiji-app
IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG
BASE_PORT=$BASE_PORT
PUBLIC_BASE_URL=$(sq "${PUBLIC_BASE_URL:-http://$EC2_HOST:$BASE_PORT}")
KC_PORT=$KC_PORT
SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=docker
DB_URL=jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/raiji_app
DB_USER=raiji
DB_PASSWORD=$(sq "$DB_PASSWORD")
POSTGRES_DB=raiji_keycloak
JWK_SET_URI=http://keycloak:8080/realms/raiji/protocol/openid-connect/certs
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=$(sq "$KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET")
AWS_REGION=$AWS_REGION_NAME
# --- funcionalidades opcionais (vazio = desligado) ---------------------------
INFO_SIMPLES_KEY=$(sq "${INFO_SIMPLES_KEY:-}")
INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_CPF=$(sq "${INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_CPF:-}")
INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_SENHA=$(sq "${INFOSIMPLES_GOVBR_SENHA:-}")
RESEND_API_KEY=$(sq "${RESEND_API_KEY:-}")
RESEND_FROM=$(sq "${RESEND_FROM:-}")
STRIPE_API_KEY=$(sq "${STRIPE_API_KEY:-}")
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=$(sq "${STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET:-}")
RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=$(sq "${RAIJI_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-}")
DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET=$(sq "$DRIVER_DOCS_BUCKET")
RAIJI_PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT=$(sq "${RAIJI_PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT:-1.5}")
RAIJI_TIME_ZONE=$(sq "${RAIJI_TIME_ZONE:-America/Sao_Paulo}")
ENV_EOF

# --- 5) Deploy remoto ----------------------------------------------------------
log "executando deploy-remote.sh na EC2 ..."
ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$SSH_TARGET" \
  "cd '$REMOTE_DIR' && chmod +x scripts/aws/deploy-remote.sh scripts/smoke-test.sh && ./scripts/aws/deploy-remote.sh" \
  || die "deploy remoto falhou (health-gate). Se havia versÃ£o anterior, o self-rollback jÃ¡ foi tentado; veja logs acima."

log "deploy concluÃ­do com sucesso. URL: http://$EC2_HOST:$BASE_PORT"

===== ./scripts/aws/ecr-retag.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# ecr-retag.sh â€” movc uma tag de imagem no ECR sem re-upload (retag).
# Uso: ecr-retag.sh <repo-completo> <tag-origem> <tag-destino> [--region r] [--if-missing=skip|fail]
# Exemplo: ecr-retag.sh 123.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/raiji-app homolog-previous homolog-current
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

REPO="${1:?uso: ecr-retag.sh <repo> <tag-origem> <tag-destino>}"
SRC="${2:?tag de origem ausente}"
DST="${3:?tag de destino ausente}"
shift 3
REGION="${AWS_REGION_NAME:-${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}}"
IF_MISSING="fail"
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --region) REGION="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --if-missing=*) IF_MISSING="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    *) echo "opÃ§Ã£o invÃ¡lida: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

REPO_NAME="${REPO##*/}"

MANIFEST="$(aws ecr batch-get-image --region "$REGION" \
  --repository-name "$REPO_NAME" --image-ids imageTag="$SRC" \
  --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text 2>/dev/null || true)"

if [[ -z "$MANIFEST" || "$MANIFEST" == "None" ]]; then
  if [[ "$IF_MISSING" == "skip" ]]; then
    echo "[ecr-retag] tag '$SRC' nÃ£o existe em $REPO_NAME â€” nada a fazer (primeiro deploy?)."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "[ecr-retag] ERRO: tag '$SRC' nÃ£o encontrada em $REPO_NAME." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if aws ecr put-image --region "$REGION" --repository-name "$REPO_NAME" \
     --image-tag "$DST" --image-manifest "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[ecr-retag] $REPO_NAME:$SRC -> $REPO_NAME:$DST (retag OK)"
else
  # ImageAlreadyExistsException: a tag destino jÃ¡ aponta para a mesma imagem.
  echo "[ecr-retag] $REPO_NAME:$DST jÃ¡ aponta para esta imagem (ok)."
fi

===== ./scripts/aws/guardian.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# guardian.sh â€” vigia pÃ³s-deploy (proteÃ§Ã£o contra erros inesperados).
# Executado periodicamente pelo .github/workflows/guardian.yml:
#   1. Smoke completo (4 checagens em PARALELO)
#   2. Se falhar, aguarda GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY e reconfirma (evita falso
#      positivo de rede/latÃªncia)
#   3. Falha confirmada + existe imagem <env>-previous -> ROLLBACK AUTOMÃTICO
#      (rollback.sh: retag + redeploy + smoke)
#   4. Sem histÃ³rico OU rollback falhou -> exit 1 (o workflow abre Issue)
#
# Requer (env): ENVIRONMENT, BASE_URL; para o rollback: EC2_HOST, EC2_USER,
#   SSH_PRIVATE_KEY, AWS_REGION_NAME, BASE_PORT, SMOKE_USERNAME/SMOKE_PASSWORD
# SaÃ­da: 0 = saudÃ¡vel (ou recuperado) | 1 = irrecuperÃ¡vel (gera alerta)
# =============================================================================
set -uo pipefail

: "${ENVIRONMENT:?ENVIRONMENT obrigatÃ³rio}"
: "${BASE_URL:?BASE_URL obrigatÃ³rio}"

GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY="${GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY:-60}"
GUARDIAN_RETRY="${GUARDIAN_RETRY:-3}"
GUARDIAN_DELAY="${GUARDIAN_DELAY:-5}"
GUARDIAN_RETRY_RECHECK="${GUARDIAN_RETRY_RECHECK:-6}"
GUARDIAN_DELAY_RECHECK="${GUARDIAN_DELAY_RECHECK:-10}"
REPO="${ECR_REPOSITORY:-raiji-app}"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
log() { echo "[guardian:$ENVIRONMENT] $*"; }

smoke() { # <retries> <delay>
  BASE_URL="$BASE_URL" \
  SMOKE_USERNAME="${SMOKE_USERNAME:-teste}" \
  SMOKE_PASSWORD="${SMOKE_PASSWORD:-teste123}" \
    "$SCRIPT_DIR/../smoke-test.sh" --parallel --retries "$1" --retry-delay "$2"
}

log "smoke periÃ³dico em $BASE_URL"
if smoke "$GUARDIAN_RETRY" "$GUARDIAN_DELAY"; then
  log "ambiente saudÃ¡vel âœ”"
  exit 0
fi

log "smoke FALHOU â€” reconfirmando em ${GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY}s (evitar falso positivo) ..."
sleep "$GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY"
if smoke "$GUARDIAN_RETRY_RECHECK" "$GUARDIAN_DELAY_RECHECK"; then
  log "falha transitÃ³ria â€” ambiente saudÃ¡vel na reconfirmaÃ§Ã£o âœ”"
  exit 0
fi

log "falha CONFIRMADA. Verificando versÃ£o anterior no ECR ..."
PREV="$(aws ecr describe-images --region "${AWS_REGION_NAME:-us-east-1}" \
  --repository-name "$REPO" --image-ids imageTag="${ENVIRONMENT}-previous" \
  --query 'imageDetails[0].imageTags[0]' --output text 2>/dev/null || true)"

if [[ -n "$PREV" && "$PREV" != "None" ]]; then
  log "existe versÃ£o anterior (${ENVIRONMENT}-previous) â€” rollback automÃ¡tico ..."
  if "$SCRIPT_DIR/rollback.sh" --auto; then
    log "ambiente RECUPERADO via rollback âœ”"
    exit 0
  fi
  log "rollback FALHOU â€” intervenÃ§Ã£o manual necessÃ¡ria."
  exit 1
fi

log "SEM versÃ£o anterior â€” impossÃ­vel reverter automaticamente; gerando alerta."
exit 1

===== ./scripts/aws/rollback.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# rollback.sh â€” procedimento de rollback da issue S1-03:
#   0) Verifica se EXISTE versÃ£o anterior (<env>-previous no ECR).
#      Sem anterior -> para o app na EC2 (nÃ£o serve versÃ£o quebrada) e falha:
#      o ambiente fica offline atÃ© uma versÃ£o correta ser publicada.
#   1) RETAG no ECR: <env>-previous -> <env>-current (sem re-upload)
#   2) REDEPLOY na EC2 (compose pull + up -d + health-gate)
#   3) SMOKE TEST completo (paralelo) para confirmar a recuperaÃ§Ã£o
#
# Uso (runner ou mÃ¡quina com aws cli + acesso SSH):
#   ./scripts/aws/rollback.sh [--auto]
# Requer (env): ENVIRONMENT, EC2_HOST, EC2_USER, SSH_PRIVATE_KEY,
#               AWS_REGION_NAME, BASE_PORT, BASE_URL, SMOKE_USERNAME/SMOKE_PASSWORD
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

: "${ENVIRONMENT:?ENVIRONMENT obrigatÃ³rio (dev|homolog)}"
: "${EC2_HOST:?EC2_HOST obrigatÃ³rio}"
: "${EC2_USER:=ubuntu}"
: "${SSH_PRIVATE_KEY:?SSH_PRIVATE_KEY obrigatÃ³rio}"
: "${AWS_REGION_NAME:=us-east-1}"
: "${BASE_PORT:?BASE_PORT obrigatÃ³rio}"
BASE_URL="${BASE_URL:-http://$EC2_HOST:$BASE_PORT}"
REPO="${ECR_REPOSITORY:-raiji-app}"

AUTO="${1:-}"
log() { echo "[rollback:$ENVIRONMENT] $*"; }
die() { echo "[rollback:$ENVIRONMENT] ERRO: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

ACCOUNT_ID="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)" || die "aws sts falhou"
ECR_REGISTRY="${ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_NAME}.amazonaws.com"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# --- SSH (chave temporÃ¡ria) ------------------------------------------------------
KEY_FILE="$(mktemp)"; umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$KEY_FILE"
cleanup() { rm -f "$KEY_FILE"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
SSH_OPTS=(-i "$KEY_FILE" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR -o ConnectTimeout=15)

# --- 0) Existe versÃ£o anterior? ----------------------------------------------------
log "verificando imagem anterior (${ENVIRONMENT}-previous) no ECR ..."
PREV="$(aws ecr describe-images --region "$AWS_REGION_NAME" --repository-name "$REPO" \
  --image-ids imageTag="${ENVIRONMENT}-previous" \
  --query 'imageDetails[0].imageTags[0]' --output text 2>/dev/null || true)"

if [[ -z "$PREV" || "$PREV" == "None" ]]; then
  log "NÃƒO existe versÃ£o anterior para reverter."
  log "Parando o app na EC2 para nÃ£o servir versÃ£o quebrada ..."
  ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$EC2_USER@$EC2_HOST" "ENVIRONMENT='$ENVIRONMENT' bash -s" <<'STOP_EOF' || true
set -u
cd "/opt/raiji/$ENVIRONMENT" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
set -a; . ./.env 2>/dev/null; set +a
docker compose -p "${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-raiji-$ENVIRONMENT}" \
  -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.aws.yml stop app 2>/dev/null || true
STOP_EOF
  die "ambiente SEM histÃ³rico de rollback â€” mantido offline atÃ© que uma versÃ£o correta suba (release bloqueado)."
fi

# --- 1) RETAG da imagem anterior ---------------------------------------------------
log "retag ${ENVIRONMENT}-previous -> ${ENVIRONMENT}-current no ECR ..."
"$SCRIPT_DIR/ecr-retag.sh" "$ECR_REGISTRY/$REPO" \
  "${ENVIRONMENT}-previous" "${ENVIRONMENT}-current" --region "$AWS_REGION_NAME" \
  || die "retag falhou"

# --- 2) REDEPLOY na EC2 -------------------------------------------------------------
log "redeploy na EC2 ($EC2_USER@$EC2_HOST) ..."
ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$EC2_USER@$EC2_HOST" "ENVIRONMENT='$ENVIRONMENT' bash -s" <<'REMOTE_EOF' || die "redeploy remoto falhou"
set -euo pipefail
cd "/opt/raiji/$ENVIRONMENT"
set -a; . ./.env; set +a
COMPOSE=(docker compose -p "$COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME" -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.aws.yml)
aws ecr get-login-password --region "${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$ECR_REGISTRY" >/dev/null
"${COMPOSE[@]}" pull --quiet app
IMAGE_TAG="${ENVIRONMENT}-current" "${COMPOSE[@]}" up -d --no-deps --no-build app
sed -i "s/^IMAGE_TAG=.*/IMAGE_TAG=${ENVIRONMENT}-current/" .deploy-state 2>/dev/null || true
BASE_URL="http://localhost:$BASE_PORT" ./scripts/smoke-test.sh --check health --retries "${HEALTH_RETRIES:-90}" --retry-delay 10
REMOTE_EOF

# --- 3) SMOKE completo (paralelo) ----------------------------------------------------
log "smoke test completo em $BASE_URL ..."
SMOKE_USERNAME="${SMOKE_USERNAME:-teste}" SMOKE_PASSWORD="${SMOKE_PASSWORD:-teste123}" \
BASE_URL="$BASE_URL" "$SCRIPT_DIR/../smoke-test.sh" --parallel --retries 6 --retry-delay 10 \
  || die "smoke pÃ³s-rollback falhou â€” intervenÃ§Ã£o manual necessÃ¡ria (veja docs/DEPLOY.md)"

log "rollback concluÃ­do com sucesso. Ambiente restaurado: $BASE_URL"
[[ "$AUTO" == "--auto" ]] && log "(executado automaticamente)"
exit 0

===== ./scripts/keycloak-configure-auth.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# keycloak-configure-auth.sh â€” aplica a configuraÃ§Ã£o de LOGIN num Keycloak que
# jÃ¡ estÃ¡ rodando (o --import-realm sÃ³ vale na primeira vez que o realm Ã© criado).
#
#   - pt-BR, cadastro aberto (e-mail como usuÃ¡rio)
#   - toda conta Ã© PASSAGEIRA (PASSENGER nas roles padrÃ£o); DRIVER Ã© acumulÃ¡vel
#   - E-MAIL (Resend via SMTP): com RESEND_API_KEY, liga a CONFIRMAÃ‡ÃƒO de e-mail
#     no cadastro e o "ESQUECI A SENHA". Sem a chave, os dois ficam desligados
#     (ninguÃ©m fica preso esperando um e-mail que nunca chega).
#   - client raiji-api: PKCE S256, retorno do app Android, CORS do Capacitor
#   - Google (login social): sÃ³ se GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID e GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
#     estiverem definidos â€” o segredo nunca vai para o repositÃ³rio
#
# Lidos automaticamente (arquivos fora do git; variÃ¡vel de ambiente tem prioridade):
#   keycloak/.env   GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=xxx.apps.googleusercontent.com
#                   GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=GOCSPX-...
#   .env (raiz)     RESEND_API_KEY=re_...
#                   RESEND_FROM=Raiji <nao-responda@seudominio.com.br>   (domÃ­nio verificado no Resend)
#
# Uso:
#   ./scripts/keycloak-configure-auth.sh
#   GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=... GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=... ./scripts/keycloak-configure-auth.sh
#
# VariÃ¡veis: KEYCLOAK_URL (http://127.0.0.1:8180), KC_ADMIN (admin), KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD (admin),
#            REALM (raiji), CLIENT_ID (raiji-api)
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

# LÃª sÃ³ variÃ¡veis permitidas dos .env (sem executar os arquivos)
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
load_env() { # arquivo nomes-permitidos...
  local file="$1"; shift
  [[ -f "$file" ]] || return 0
  while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
    key="$(printf '%s' "$key" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
    local allowed=false
    for name in "$@"; do [[ "$key" == "$name" ]] && allowed=true; done
    $allowed || continue
    value="$(printf '%s' "$value" | tr -d '\r' | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$//g; s/^"(.*)"$/\1/; s/^'"'"'(.*)'"'"'$/\1/')"
    [[ -n "${!key:-}" ]] || printf -v "$key" '%s' "$value" # variÃ¡vel de ambiente tem prioridade
  done < "$file"
}
load_env "$ROOT_DIR/keycloak/.env" GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
load_env "$ROOT_DIR/.env" RESEND_API_KEY RESEND_FROM

KEYCLOAK_URL="${KEYCLOAK_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8180}"
KC_ADMIN="${KC_ADMIN:-admin}"
KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD="${KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}"
REALM="${REALM:-raiji}"
CLIENT_ID="${CLIENT_ID:-raiji-api}"

log() { echo "[keycloak-auth] $*"; }
die() { echo "[keycloak-auth] ERRO: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

TOKEN="$(curl -fsS -X POST "$KEYCLOAK_URL/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" \
  -d grant_type=password -d client_id=admin-cli \
  --data-urlencode "username=$KC_ADMIN" --data-urlencode "password=$KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
  | sed -n 's/.*"access_token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')" || die "nÃ£o foi possÃ­vel autenticar no Keycloak ($KEYCLOAK_URL)"
[[ -n "$TOKEN" ]] || die "token de admin vazio"

api() { # mÃ©todo caminho [json]
  local method="$1" path="$2" body="${3:-}"
  curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X "$method" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    ${body:+--data "$body"} "$KEYCLOAK_URL/admin/realms/$REALM$path"
}

# --- 1) Realm ------------------------------------------------------------------
json_escape() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g'; }

if [[ -n "${RESEND_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
  # "Raiji <nao-responda@dominio>" -> nome + e-mail (o Keycloak quer o e-mail puro em "from")
  FROM_RAW="${RESEND_FROM:-Raiji <onboarding@resend.dev>}"
  if [[ "$FROM_RAW" =~ ^(.*)\<([^>]+)\>[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
    FROM_NAME="$(printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" | sed -E 's/[[:space:]]+$//')"
    FROM_EMAIL="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
  else
    FROM_NAME="Raiji"; FROM_EMAIL="$FROM_RAW"
  fi
  [[ -n "$FROM_NAME" ]] || FROM_NAME="Raiji"

  # Resend via SMTP: smtp.resend.com:465 (SSL), usuÃ¡rio "resend", senha = chave da API
  api PUT "" "{
    \"registrationAllowed\": true,
    \"registrationEmailAsUsername\": true,
    \"resetPasswordAllowed\": true,
    \"verifyEmail\": true,
    \"loginWithEmailAllowed\": true,
    \"internationalizationEnabled\": true,
    \"supportedLocales\": [\"pt-BR\", \"en\"],
    \"defaultLocale\": \"pt-BR\",
    \"smtpServer\": {
      \"host\": \"smtp.resend.com\",
      \"port\": \"465\",
      \"ssl\": \"true\",
      \"starttls\": \"false\",
      \"auth\": \"true\",
      \"user\": \"resend\",
      \"password\": \"$(json_escape "$RESEND_API_KEY")\",
      \"from\": \"$(json_escape "$FROM_EMAIL")\",
      \"fromDisplayName\": \"$(json_escape "$FROM_NAME")\"
    }
  }" >/dev/null
  log "realm: pt-BR, CONFIRMAÃ‡ÃƒO de e-mail e ESQUECI A SENHA ligados (Resend, remetente $FROM_EMAIL)"
  [[ "$FROM_EMAIL" == *@resend.dev ]] && \
    log "AVISO: remetente de teste do Resend â€” sÃ³ entrega para o e-mail do dono da conta Resend. Verifique seu domÃ­nio no Resend e defina RESEND_FROM."
else
  api PUT "" '{
    "registrationAllowed": true,
    "registrationEmailAsUsername": true,
    "resetPasswordAllowed": false,
    "verifyEmail": false,
    "loginWithEmailAllowed": true,
    "internationalizationEnabled": true,
    "supportedLocales": ["pt-BR", "en"],
    "defaultLocale": "pt-BR"
  }' >/dev/null
  log "realm: pt-BR; SEM e-mail (defina RESEND_API_KEY): confirmaÃ§Ã£o e recuperaÃ§Ã£o de senha desligadas"
fi

# --- 1b) Toda conta Ã© passageira (PASSENGER nas roles padrÃ£o) --------------------
# Vale tambÃ©m para as contas que jÃ¡ existem: elas tÃªm default-roles-raiji, e a
# composiÃ§Ã£o Ã© avaliada a cada token. DRIVER continua sendo acrescentado Ã  parte.
PASSENGER_ROLE="$(curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$KEYCLOAK_URL/admin/realms/$REALM/roles/PASSENGER")" \
  || die "role PASSENGER nÃ£o encontrada no realm $REALM"
api POST "/roles/default-roles-$REALM/composites" "[$PASSENGER_ROLE]" >/dev/null
log "roles padrÃ£o: PASSENGER incluÃ­da (toda conta pode pedir vaga; motorista Ã© acumulÃ¡vel)"

# --- 2) Client do app ----------------------------------------------------------
CLIENT_UUID="$(curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "$KEYCLOAK_URL/admin/realms/$REALM/clients?clientId=$CLIENT_ID" \
  | sed -n 's/^\[{"id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"
[[ -n "$CLIENT_UUID" ]] || die "client $CLIENT_ID nÃ£o encontrado"

api PUT "/clients/$CLIENT_UUID" '{
  "redirectUris": ["http://localhost:3000/*", "http://localhost:5173/*", "http://localhost:8080/*",
                   "http://localhost:8000/*", "com.raiji.app://auth/callback"],
  "webOrigins": ["+", "http://localhost"],
  "attributes": { "pkce.code.challenge.method": "S256", "post.logout.redirect.uris": "+" }
}' >/dev/null
log "client $CLIENT_ID: PKCE S256, retorno com.raiji.app://auth/callback, CORS http://localhost"

# --- 3) Google -------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -n "${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:-}" && -n "${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET:-}" ]]; then
  IDP="{
    \"alias\": \"google\",
    \"displayName\": \"Google\",
    \"providerId\": \"google\",
    \"enabled\": true,
    \"trustEmail\": true,
    \"firstBrokerLoginFlowAlias\": \"first broker login\",
    \"config\": {
      \"clientId\": \"$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID\",
      \"clientSecret\": \"$GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET\",
      \"defaultScope\": \"openid profile email\",
      \"syncMode\": \"IMPORT\"
    }
  }"
  code="$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    "$KEYCLOAK_URL/admin/realms/$REALM/identity-provider/instances/google")"
  if [[ "$code" == "200" ]]; then
    api PUT "/identity-provider/instances/google" "$IDP" >/dev/null
    log "Google atualizado"
  else
    api POST "/identity-provider/instances" "$IDP" >/dev/null
    log "Google criado"
  fi
  PUBLIC_URL="$(curl -fsS "$KEYCLOAK_URL/realms/$REALM/.well-known/openid-configuration" \
    | sed -n 's/.*"issuer":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"
  log "No Google Cloud, a 'Authorized redirect URI' deve ser: $PUBLIC_URL/broker/google/endpoint"
else
  log "Google: pulado (defina GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID e GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET para ativar)"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# setup-cicd.sh â€” NÃƒO gera mais arquivos (modo somente verificaÃ§Ã£o).
#
# HistÃ³rico: este script era um gerador "tudo-em-um" que sobrescrevia os
# workflows e os scripts de deploy. Ele ficou desatualizado e, ao rodar,
# APAGAVA correÃ§Ãµes mais novas (ex.: `build: !reset`, `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`,
# sincronizaÃ§Ã£o do RabbitMQ). Para evitar regressÃ£o, ele agora apenas:
#
#   1. verifica se todos os arquivos de CI/CD existem;
#   2. imprime os prÃ³ximos passos.
#
# Ã‰ idempotente por construÃ§Ã£o: nunca escreve em arquivos versionados.
# Uso: ./scripts/setup-cicd.sh
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

REQUIRED=(
  .github/workflows/ci.yml
  .github/workflows/deploy.yml
  .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml
  .github/workflows/deploy-homolog.yml
  .github/workflows/rollback.yml
  .github/workflows/guardian.yml
  scripts/smoke-test.sh
  scripts/aws/deploy.sh
  scripts/aws/deploy-remote.sh
  scripts/aws/rollback.sh
  scripts/aws/ecr-retag.sh
  scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh
  scripts/aws/guardian.sh
  docker-compose.aws.yml
  docs/DEPLOY.md
  docs/CD-CHECKLIST.md
  infra/aws/aws-config.env
)

missing=0
for f in "${REQUIRED[@]}"; do
  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
    echo "[setup-cicd] FALTANDO: $f" >&2
    missing=1
  fi
done

if [[ "$missing" -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo "[setup-cicd] ERRO: arquivos de CI/CD ausentes (veja acima)." >&2
  exit 1
fi

cat <<'FIM'

[setup-cicd] OK â€” todos os arquivos de CI/CD estÃ£o presentes.
[setup-cicd] Este script nÃ£o gera nem sobrescreve nada (somente verificaÃ§Ã£o).

PrÃ³ximos passos para o CD funcionar:
  1) ./scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh --env dev
     ./scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh --env homolog
  2) Configure os secrets/variables no GitHub (veja docs/CD-CHECKLIST.md)
  3) ./scripts/aws/check-github-config.sh   (requer gh autenticado)
  4) git push origin develop                (dispara o Deploy DEV)
  5) git push origin develop:main           (sincroniza main -> HOMOLOG/Guardian)

FIM

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# setup-s2-01.sh â€” S2-01 Â· DeclaraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem na solicitaÃ§Ã£o de vaga (RF18)
# =============================================================================
# Script ÃšNICO e autocontido que implementa toda a issue no projeto:
#
#   NOVOS:

#   * RideRequestCreateRequest -> baggage @NotEmpty @Valid (obrigatÃ³rio)

#   * RidePassengerService     -> persiste bagagem junto com a solicitaÃ§Ã£o
#   * RideRequestController    -> repassa baggage

# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

MODE="apply"
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check" ]]; then MODE="check"; fi

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# --- Detecta a RAIZ DO PROJETO com seguranÃ§a ----------------------------------
ROOT=""
GIT_TOP="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"
for cand in "$SCRIPT_DIR" "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." "$GIT_TOP" "$PWD"; do

  if [[ -f "$cand/pom.xml" && -f "$cand/docker-compose.yml" ]]; then
    ROOT="$(cd "$cand" && pwd)"
    break
  fi

if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
  echo "[setup-s2-01] ERRO: raiz do projeto nÃ£o encontrada (pom.xml + docker-compose.yml)." >&2
  exit 1

  cp "$SELF" "$CANONICAL"

fi

  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$1")"
  cat > "$1"
  log "gravado: $1"

# =============================================================================
# 1) BaggageType â€” enum com cÃ³digos minÃºsculos no JSON (contrato da issue)
# =============================================================================
write_file "$RIDES_MAIN/domain/BaggageType.java" <<'@@BAGGAGE_TYPE@@'
package com.raiji.rides.domain;

import java.util.Locale;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonCreator;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonValue;

/**
 * S2-01 / RF18 â€” Tipos de bagagem aceitos na declaraÃ§Ã£o.
 *
 * <p>O contrato da API usa cÃ³digos em minÃºsculas ({@code mochila}, {@code sacola},
 * {@code mala}, {@code caixa}); o banco armazena o {@code name()} do enum
 * (VARCHAR). Valor fora do enum na requisiÃ§Ã£o => erro de desserializaÃ§Ã£o => 400.
 */
public enum BaggageType {

    MOCHILA,
    SACOLA,
    MALA,
    CAIXA;

    @JsonValue
    public String getCode() {
        return name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    @JsonCreator
    public static BaggageType fromCode(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        for (BaggageType type : values()) {
            if (type.name().equalsIgnoreCase(code.trim())) {
                return type;
            }
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Tipo de bagagem invÃ¡lido: '" + code
                        + "'. Valores aceitos: mochila, sacola, mala, caixa."
        );
    }
}
@@BAGGAGE_TYPE@@

package com.raiji.rides.domain;

import java.util.UUID;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.FetchType;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;

/**

 *
 * <p>Tabela Ãºnica com coluna {@code type} VARCHAR (sem tabela separada por

@Entity

        @Index(name = "idx_baggage_ride_passenger", columnList = "ride_passenger_id")

public class Baggage extends AuditableEntity {

    @Id

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY, optional = false)

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)

    @Column(name = "quantity", nullable = false)

    @Column(name = "length_cm", nullable = false)

    @Column(name = "width_cm", nullable = false)

    @Column(name = "height_cm", nullable = false)

    @Column(name = "description", columnDefinition = "TEXT")

    public UUID getId() { return id; }

    public RidePassenger getRidePassenger() { return ridePassenger; }
    public void setRidePassenger(RidePassenger v) { this.ridePassenger = v; }

    public BaggageType getType() { return type; }
    public void setType(BaggageType v) { this.type = v; }

    public Integer getQuantity() { return quantity; }
    public void setQuantity(Integer v) { this.quantity = v; }

    public Integer getLengthCm() { return lengthCm; }

    public Integer getWidthCm() { return widthCm; }
    public void setWidthCm(Integer v) { this.widthCm = v; }

    public Integer getHeightCm() { return heightCm; }
    public void setHeightCm(Integer v) { this.heightCm = v; }

    public String getDescription() { return description; }
    public void setDescription(String v) { this.description = v; }

package com.raiji.rides.domain;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.base.AuditableEntity;
import com.raiji.common.enums.RidePassengerStatus;
import jakarta.persistence.CascadeType;
import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.EnumType;
import jakarta.persistence.Enumerated;
import jakarta.persistence.FetchType;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Index;
import jakarta.persistence.OneToMany;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

@Entity
@Table(name = "ride_passengers", indexes = {
        @Index(name = "idx_ride_pass_ride", columnList = "ride_id"),
        @Index(name = "idx_ride_pass_passenger_sub", columnList = "passenger_sub")
})
public class RidePassenger extends AuditableEntity {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.UUID)
    private UUID id;

    @Column(name = "ride_id", nullable = false)
    private UUID rideId;

    /** Sub do passageiro no Keycloak. */
    @Column(name = "passenger_sub", nullable = false, length = 64)
    private String passengerSub;

    @Column(name = "passenger_name", length = 150)
    private String passengerName;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private RidePassengerStatus status = RidePassengerStatus.PENDING;

    @Column(name = "joined_at")
    private Instant joinedAt = Instant.now();

    @Column(name = "confirmed_at")
    private Instant confirmedAt;

    @Column(name = "cancellation_reason", columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    private String cancellationReason;

    /**
     * S2-01 / RF18 â€” bagagem declarada na solicitaÃ§Ã£o.
     * Cascade ALL: persistida junto com a solicitaÃ§Ã£o na MESMA transaÃ§Ã£o.
     */
    @OneToMany(
            mappedBy = "ridePassenger",
            cascade = CascadeType.ALL,
            orphanRemoval = true,
            fetch = FetchType.LAZY
    )
    private List<Baggage> baggage = new ArrayList<>();

    public void confirm() {
        this.status = RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED;
        this.confirmedAt = Instant.now();
    }

    public void cancel(String reason) {
        this.status = RidePassengerStatus.CANCELLED;
        this.cancellationReason = reason;
    }

    /** Adiciona um item de bagagem mantendo os dois lados do relacionamento. */
    public void addBaggage(Baggage item) {
        item.setRidePassenger(this);
        this.baggage.add(item);
    }

    public UUID getId() { return id; }
    public UUID getRideId() { return rideId; }
    public void setRideId(UUID v) { this.rideId = v; }
    public String getPassengerSub() { return passengerSub; }
    public void setPassengerSub(String v) { this.passengerSub = v; }
    public String getPassengerName() { return passengerName; }
    public void setPassengerName(String v) { this.passengerName = v; }
    public RidePassengerStatus getStatus() { return status; }
    public Instant getJoinedAt() { return joinedAt; }
    public Instant getConfirmedAt() { return confirmedAt; }
    public String getCancellationReason() { return cancellationReason; }
    public List<Baggage> getBaggage() { return baggage; }
}

package com.raiji.rides.dto;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.RidePassenger;
import com.raiji.common.enums.RidePassengerStatus;

/**
 * Resposta de solicitaÃ§Ã£o de vaga.
 * S2-01 / RF18: inclui a bagagem declarada â€” o motorista a vÃª ANTES de
 * aceitar/recusar (GET /api/rides/{rideId}/requests).
 */
public record RidePassengerResponse(
        UUID id,
        UUID rideId,
        String passengerSub,
        String passengerName,
        RidePassengerStatus status,
        Instant joinedAt,
        List<BaggageItemResponse> baggage
) {

    public static RidePassengerResponse from(RidePassenger passenger) {
        List<BaggageItemResponse> baggage = passenger.getBaggage() == null
                ? List.of()
                : passenger.getBaggage().stream()
                        .map(BaggageItemResponse::from)
                        .toList();

        return new RidePassengerResponse(
                passenger.getId(),
                passenger.getRideId(),
                passenger.getPassengerSub(),
                passenger.getPassengerName(),
                passenger.getStatus(),
                passenger.getJoinedAt(),
                baggage
        );
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.service;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.common.enums.RidePassengerStatus;
import com.raiji.common.enums.RideStatus;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Baggage;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import com.raiji.rides.domain.RidePassenger;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.BaggageItemRequest;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RidePassengerResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.event.RideRequestCreatedEvent;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RidePassengerRepository;
import com.raiji.rides.repository.RideRepository;

import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

@Service
public class RidePassengerService {

    private static final List<RidePassengerStatus> ACTIVE_STATUSES =
            List.of(
                    RidePassengerStatus.PENDING,
                    RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED
            );

    private final RideRepository rideRepository;
    private final RidePassengerRepository ridePassengerRepository;
    private final ApplicationEventPublisher eventPublisher;

    public RidePassengerService(
            RideRepository rideRepository,
            RidePassengerRepository ridePassengerRepository,
            ApplicationEventPublisher eventPublisher
    ) {
        this.rideRepository = rideRepository;
        this.ridePassengerRepository = ridePassengerRepository;
        this.eventPublisher = eventPublisher;
    }

    /**
     * S2-01 / RF18: a solicitaÃ§Ã£o de vaga exige a declaraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem.
     * SolicitaÃ§Ã£o + bagagem sÃ£o persistidas na MESMA transaÃ§Ã£o
     * (cascade ALL em RidePassenger.baggage).
     */
    @Transactional
    public RidePassengerResponse request(
            UUID rideId,
            String passengerSub,
            String passengerName,
            List<BaggageItemRequest> baggage
    ) {
        if (baggage == null || baggage.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "A declaraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem Ã© obrigatÃ³ria (mÃ­nimo 1 item)."
            );
        }

        Ride ride = rideRepository.findById(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        if (ride.getStatus() != RideStatus.PLANNED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta carona nÃ£o estÃ¡ disponÃ­vel para solicitaÃ§Ãµes."
            );
        }

        if (ride.getDepartureDate() == null
                || !ride.getDepartureDate().isAfter(LocalDateTime.now())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "NÃ£o Ã© possÃ­vel solicitar uma carona com partida passada."
            );
        }

        boolean alreadyRequested =
                ridePassengerRepository
                        .existsByRideIdAndPassengerSubAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                                rideId,
                                passengerSub,
                                ACTIVE_STATUSES
                        );

        if (alreadyRequested) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "VocÃª jÃ¡ possui uma solicitaÃ§Ã£o ativa para esta carona."
            );
        }

        long activeRequests =
                ridePassengerRepository
                        .countByRideIdAndStatusInAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                                rideId,
                                ACTIVE_STATUSES
                        );

        if (ride.getAvailableSeats() == null
                || ride.getAvailableSeats() <= 0
                || activeRequests >= ride.getTotalSeats()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "NÃ£o hÃ¡ vagas disponÃ­veis nesta carona."
            );
        }

        RidePassenger passenger = new RidePassenger();
        passenger.setRideId(rideId);
        passenger.setPassengerSub(passengerSub);
        passenger.setPassengerName(passengerName.trim());

        for (BaggageItemRequest item : baggage) {
            Baggage baggageEntity = new Baggage();
            baggageEntity.setType(item.type());
            baggageEntity.setQuantity(item.quantity());
            baggageEntity.setLengthCm(item.lengthCm());
            baggageEntity.setWidthCm(item.widthCm());
            baggageEntity.setHeightCm(item.heightCm());
            baggageEntity.setDescription(item.description());
            passenger.addBaggage(baggageEntity);
        }

        // cascade ALL: solicitaÃ§Ã£o + bagagem persistidas juntas (mesma transaÃ§Ã£o)
        RidePassenger saved = ridePassengerRepository.save(passenger);

        eventPublisher.publishEvent(
                new RideRequestCreatedEvent(
                        ride.getId(),
                        ride.getDriverSub(),
                        ride.getDriverName(),
                        saved.getPassengerSub(),
                        saved.getPassengerName(),
                        saved.getJoinedAt()
                )
        );

        return RidePassengerResponse.from(saved);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<RidePassengerResponse> listForDriver(
            UUID rideId,
            String driverSub
    ) {
        Ride ride = rideRepository.findById(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        if (!ride.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o tem permissÃ£o para visualizar as solicitaÃ§Ãµes desta carona."
            );
        }

        return ridePassengerRepository
                .findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId)
                .stream()
                .map(RidePassengerResponse::from)
                .toList();
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.web;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.rides.dto.RidePassengerResponse;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideRequestCreateRequest;
import com.raiji.rides.service.RidePassengerService;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
import org.springframework.security.core.annotation.AuthenticationPrincipal;
import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/rides/{rideId}/requests")
public class RideRequestController {

    private final RidePassengerService ridePassengerService;

    public RideRequestController(
            RidePassengerService ridePassengerService
    ) {
        this.ridePassengerService = ridePassengerService;
    }

    /** S2-01: payload exige passengerName + baggage (>= 1 item). */
    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('PASSENGER')")
    public RidePassengerResponse request(
            @PathVariable UUID rideId,
            @Valid @RequestBody RideRequestCreateRequest request,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt
    ) {
        return ridePassengerService.request(
                rideId,
                jwt.getSubject(),
                request.passengerName(),
                request.baggage()
        );
    }

    /** S2-01: visÃ£o do motorista â€” inclui a bagagem antes de aceitar/recusar. */
    @GetMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('DRIVER')")
    public List<RidePassengerResponse> listRequests(
            @PathVariable UUID rideId,
            @AuthenticationPrincipal Jwt jwt
    ) {
        return ridePassengerService.listForDriver(
                rideId,
                jwt.getSubject()
        );
    }
}

import re
import sys

def load(p):
    with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()

def save(p, s):
    with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(s)

def patch(path, guard, patches, must_apply_all=True):
    src = load(path)
    if guard in src:
        print(f"  [skip] {path} (jÃ¡ patcheado)")
        return
    for old, new, count in patches:
        found = src.count(old)
        if found == 0:
            if must_apply_all:
                sys.exit(f"ERRO: anchor nÃ£o encontrado em {path}:\n---\n{old[:300]}\n---")
            continue
        if count is not None and found != count:
            sys.exit(f"ERRO: anchor {found}x (esperado {count}x) em {path}:\n{old[:200]}")
        src = src.replace(old, new)
    save(path, src)
    print(f"  [ok]   {path}")

---

## Solicitacao de vaga (S1-06 + S2-01)

### POST /api/rides/{rideId}/requests

Autenticacao: Bearer token com role `PASSENGER`.

A partir da S2-01 (RF18) o payload EXIGE a declaracao de bagagem
(`baggage` com pelo menos 1 item):

```json
{
  "passengerName": "JoÃ£o Silva",
  "baggage": [
    {
      "type": "mala",
      "quantity": 1,
      "lengthCm": 60,
      "widthCm": 40,
      "heightCm": 30,
      "description": "Mala de bordo"
    }
  ]
}
```

| Campo | Tipo | Obrigatorio | Regras |
|---|---|---:|---|
| passengerName | string | sim | 1..150 caracteres |
| baggage | array | sim | minimo 1 item |
| baggage[].type | string | sim | `mochila` \\| `sacola` \\| `mala` \\| `caixa` |
| baggage[].quantity | int | sim | >= 1 |
| baggage[].lengthCm | int | sim | > 0 |
| baggage[].widthCm | int | sim | > 0 |
| baggage[].heightCm | int | sim | > 0 |
| baggage[].description | string | nao | <= 500 caracteres |

Erros:

- `400` baggage ausente/vazio, quantity <= 0, dimensao <= 0, type fora do enum, nome invalido
- `401` sem token Â· `403` sem role PASSENGER
- `404` carona inexistente
- `409` solicitacao duplicada, sem vagas, carona nao PLANNED ou partida passada

A resposta `201` ecoa a solicitacao com `status: PENDING` e a `baggage` declarada.

### GET /api/rides/{rideId}/requests (visao do motorista)

Autenticacao: Bearer token com role `DRIVER` (dono da carona).

Retorna as solicitacoes com a bagagem declarada â€” o motorista ve a bagagem
ANTES de aceitar/recusar:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "â€¦",
    "rideId": "â€¦",
    "passengerSub": "â€¦",
    "passengerName": "Maria Silva",
    "status": "PENDING",
    "joinedAt": "â€¦",
    "baggage": [
      { "type": "mala", "quantity": 1, "lengthCm": 60, "widthCm": 40, "heightCm": 30, "description": "Mala de bordo" }
    ]
  }
]
```

Observacoes:

- `type` e aceito em qualquer caixa na entrada e sempre devolvido em minusculas.
- A soma de peso/volume contra a capacidade da carona sera validada na S2-03.
'''

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# setup-s2-02.sh â€” S2-02 Â· Aceite/recusa de solicitaÃ§Ã£o com bagagem (RF08/RF19)
# =============================================================================
# Script ÃšNICO e autocontido que implementa toda a issue #9 no projeto:
#
#   NOVOS:
#   * raiji-rides/.../domain/RideDecision.java        (enum ACCEPT|REJECT)
#   * raiji-rides/.../dto/RideDecisionRequest.java    (record + @AssertTrue)
#   * raiji-rides/.../dto/RideDecisionResponse.java   (record {id,status,confirmedAt})
#   * raiji-rides/.../event/RideDecisionEvent.java    (evento de decisÃ£o)
#   * raiji-rides/.../web/RidePassengerController.java(PATCH /{requestId})
#   * raiji-app/.../it/RideDecisionApiIT.java         (critÃ©rios de aceite)
#   * tests/s2-02/*                                   (suÃ­te de verificaÃ§Ã£o)
#
#   ATUALIZADOS:
#   * RidePassengerService -> decide() (dono, PENDING, vagas, motivo, evento)
#   * NotificationService  -> handleRideDecision() (notifica o passageiro)
#   * RidePassengerServiceTest -> 7 testes unitÃ¡rios do decide()
#   * docs/API.md          -> contrato PATCH documentado
#   * scripts/setup-s2-01.sh -> proteÃ§Ã£o: nÃ£o regrava o service se o
#                               decide() da S2-02 jÃ¡ estiver aplicado
#
#   SEM migration: REJECT reutiliza o status CANCELLED (decisÃ£o da issue).
#
# Uso (a partir da RAIZ DO PROJETO):
#   bash setup-s2-02.sh           # implementa tudo (idempotente)
#   bash setup-s2-02.sh --check   # implementa e roda a verificaÃ§Ã£o
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

MODE="apply"
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--check" ]]; then MODE="check"; fi

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# --- Detecta a RAIZ DO PROJETO com seguranÃ§a ----------------------------------
ROOT=""
GIT_TOP="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR" && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"
for cand in "$PWD" "$SCRIPT_DIR" "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." "$GIT_TOP"; do
  [[ -n "$cand" ]] || continue
  if [[ -f "$cand/pom.xml" && -f "$cand/docker-compose.yml" ]]; then
    ROOT="$(cd "$cand" && pwd)"
    break
  fi
done
if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
  echo "[setup-s2-02] ERRO: raiz do projeto nÃ£o encontrada (pom.xml + docker-compose.yml)." >&2
  exit 1
fi
cd "$ROOT"
echo "[setup-s2-02] raiz do projeto: $ROOT"

SELF="$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
CANONICAL="$ROOT/scripts/setup-s2-02.sh"
mkdir -p scripts
if [[ "$SELF" != "$CANONICAL" ]]; then
  cp "$SELF" "$CANONICAL"
  echo "[setup-s2-02] gerador instalado em scripts/setup-s2-02.sh (local canÃ´nico)"
fi

GRN=$'\033[0;32m'; NC=$'\033[0m'
log() { printf '%s[setup-s2-02]%s %s\n' "$GRN" "$NC" "$*"; }

write_file "$RIDES_MAIN/domain/RideDecision.java" <<'@@RIDE_DECISION@@'
package com.raiji.rides.domain;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonCreator;

/**
 * S2-02 / RF08 â€” decisÃ£o do motorista sobre uma solicitaÃ§Ã£o de vaga.
 *
 * <p>O contrato da API usa maiÃºsculas ({@code ACCEPT}, {@code REJECT});
 * a entrada aceita qualquer caixa. Valor fora do enum na requisiÃ§Ã£o
 * => erro de desserializaÃ§Ã£o => 400.
 */
public enum RideDecision {

    ACCEPT,
    REJECT;

    @JsonCreator
    public static RideDecision from(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        for (RideDecision decision : values()) {
            if (decision.name().equalsIgnoreCase(value.trim())) {
                return decision;
            }
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "DecisÃ£o invÃ¡lida: '" + value
                        + "'. Valores aceitos: ACCEPT, REJECT."
        );
    }
}
@@RIDE_DECISION@@

package com.raiji.rides.dto;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.RideDecision;

import jakarta.validation.constraints.AssertTrue;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;

/**
 * S2-02 / RF08 â€” payload do PATCH /api/rides/{rideId}/requests/{requestId}.
 *
 * <p>{@code reason} Ã© obrigatÃ³rio quando {@code decision = REJECT}
 * (validaÃ§Ã£o cross-field com @AssertTrue, mesmo padrÃ£o do
 * UpdateProfileRequest.hasAtLeastOneField()).
 */
public record RideDecisionRequest(

        @NotNull(message = "A decisÃ£o Ã© obrigatÃ³ria (ACCEPT ou REJECT).")
        RideDecision decision,

        @Size(max = 500, message = "O motivo deve ter no mÃ¡ximo 500 caracteres.")
        String reason
) {

    @AssertTrue(message = "O motivo (reason) Ã© obrigatÃ³rio ao recusar (REJECT).")
    public boolean hasReasonWhenReject() {
        return decision != RideDecision.REJECT
                || (reason != null && !reason.isBlank());
    }
}

package com.raiji.rides.web;

import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideDecisionRequest;
import com.raiji.rides.dto.RideDecisionResponse;

/**
 * S2-02 / RF08+RF19 â€” aceite/recusa do motorista sobre as solicitaÃ§Ãµes,
 * decididos APÃ“S visualizar a bagagem declarada (GET da S1-06/S2-01).

# =============================================================================
# 6) PATCHes nos arquivos existentes (python â€” Ã¢ncoras exatas + guards)
# =============================================================================
python3 - <<'@@PYPATCH@@'
import sys

def load(p):
    with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()

def save(p, s):
    with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(s)

def patch(path, guard, patches, must_apply_all=True):
    src = load(path)
    if guard in src:
        print(f"  [skip] {path} (jÃ¡ patcheado)")
        return
    for old, new, count in patches:
        found = src.count(old)
        if found == 0:
            if must_apply_all:
                sys.exit(f"ERRO: anchor nÃ£o encontrado em {path}:\n---\n{old[:300]}\n---")
            continue
        if count is not None and found != count:
            sys.exit(f"ERRO: anchor {found}x (esperado {count}x) em {path}:\n{old[:200]}")
        src = src.replace(old, new)
    save(path, src)
    print(f"  [ok]   {path}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A) RidePassengerService â€” decide() (RF08)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SVC = "raiji-rides/src/main/java/com/raiji/rides/service/RidePassengerService.java"

decide = '''
    /**
     * S2-02 / RF08: o motorista aceita (ACCEPT) ou recusa (REJECT) a
     * solicitaÃ§Ã£o apÃ³s visualizar a bagagem declarada (S2-01).
     *
     * <p>ACCEPT => CONFIRMED + confirmedAt + decremento de availableSeats.
     * REJECT => CANCELLED + cancellationReason (vagas permanecem intactas).
     * Nos dois casos o passageiro Ã© notificado via RideDecisionEvent (RF19).
     */
    @Transactional
    public RideDecisionResponse decide(
            UUID rideId,
            UUID requestId,
            String driverSub,
            RideDecision decision,
            String reason
    ) {
        if (decision == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "A decisÃ£o Ã© obrigatÃ³ria (ACCEPT ou REJECT)."
            );
        }

        if (decision == RideDecision.REJECT
                && (reason == null || reason.isBlank())) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "O motivo (reason) Ã© obrigatÃ³rio ao recusar (REJECT)."
            );
        }

        Ride ride = rideRepository.findById(rideId)
                .filter(r -> r.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "Carona nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        if (!ride.getDriverSub().equals(driverSub)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN,
                    "VocÃª nÃ£o tem permissÃ£o para decidir solicitaÃ§Ãµes desta carona."
            );
        }

        RidePassenger passenger = ridePassengerRepository.findById(requestId)
                .filter(p -> p.getDeletedAt() == null)
                .filter(p -> rideId.equals(p.getRideId()))
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                        "SolicitaÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o encontrada."
                ));

        if (passenger.getStatus() != RidePassengerStatus.PENDING) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Esta solicitaÃ§Ã£o jÃ¡ foi decidida."
            );
        }

        Instant decidedAt;
        if (decision == RideDecision.ACCEPT) {
            if (ride.getAvailableSeats() == null
                    || ride.getAvailableSeats() <= 0) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                        "NÃ£o hÃ¡ vagas disponÃ­veis nesta carona."
                );
            }
            ride.setAvailableSeats(ride.getAvailableSeats() - 1);
            passenger.confirm();
            decidedAt = passenger.getConfirmedAt();
        } else {
            passenger.cancel(reason.trim());
            decidedAt = Instant.now();
        }

        rideRepository.save(ride);
        RidePassenger saved = ridePassengerRepository.save(passenger);

        eventPublisher.publishEvent(
                new RideDecisionEvent(
                        ride.getId(),
                        saved.getId(),
                        ride.getDriverSub(),
                        ride.getDriverName(),
                        saved.getPassengerSub(),
                        saved.getPassengerName(),
                        decision,
                        decision == RideDecision.REJECT ? reason.trim() : null,
                        decidedAt
                )
        );

        return RideDecisionResponse.from(saved);

    /**
     * S2-02 / RF19: notifica o passageiro sobre a decisÃ£o do motorista
     * (aceite ou recusa com o motivo declarado).
     */
    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    public void handleRideDecision(RideDecisionEvent event) {

        String message = event.decision() == RideDecision.ACCEPT
                ? "Sua solicitaÃ§Ã£o de carona com " + event.driverName()
                        + " foi ACEITA."
                : "Sua solicitaÃ§Ã£o de carona com " + event.driverName()
                        + " foi RECUSADA. Motivo: " + event.reason();

        // coluna message VARCHAR(500) â€” defesa contra motivos longos
        if (message.length() > 500) {
            message = message.substring(0, 500);
        }

        Notification notification = new Notification();
        notification.setRecipientSub(event.passengerSub());
        notification.setRideId(event.rideId());
        notification.setMessage(message);

        notificationRepository.save(notification);

        log.info(
                "NotificaÃ§Ã£o de decisÃ£o ({}) criada para o passageiro {} na carona {}",
                event.decision(),
                event.passengerSub(),
                event.rideId()
        );
    }
'''

---

## Decisao do motorista (S2-02)

### PATCH /api/rides/{rideId}/requests/{requestId}

Autenticacao: Bearer token com role `DRIVER` (dono da carona).

O motorista decide apos ver a bagagem declarada (GET da S1-06/S2-01).
`ACCEPT` confirma o passageiro e decrementa `availableSeats`; `REJECT`
cancela a solicitacao com status `CANCELLED` (reutilizado â€” sem novo valor
de enum nem migration) e EXIGE `reason`. O passageiro e notificado nos
dois casos (NotificationService, S1-06).

Body (JSON):

```json
{ "decision": "ACCEPT" }
```

```json
{ "decision": "REJECT", "reason": "A bagagem excede a capacidade do veiculo." }
```

| Campo | Tipo | Obrigatorio | Regras |
|---|---|---:|---|
| decision | string | sim | `ACCEPT` \| `REJECT` (qualquer caixa na entrada) |
| reason | string | REJECT | 1..500 caracteres; obrigatorio quando REJECT |

Resposta `200`:

```json
{ "id": "â€¦", "status": "CONFIRMED", "confirmedAt": "â€¦" }
```

No REJECT: `{ "id": "â€¦", "status": "CANCELLED", "confirmedAt": null }`.

Erros:

- `400` decision ausente/fora do enum; REJECT sem reason; reason > 500
- `401` sem token Â· `403` sem role DRIVER ou motorista nao dono da carona
- `404` carona ou solicitacao inexistente (ou de outra carona)
- `409` solicitacao ja decidida (status != PENDING); ACCEPT sem vagas

Observacoes:

- Aceite/recusa considera apenas vaga de passageiro; a validacao de
  peso/volume da bagagem contra o veiculo fica para a S2-03.
'''

patch(DOCS, "Decisao do motorista (S2-02)", [
    (docs_old, docs_new, 1),
])
