write_file "$APP_IT/RideDecisionApiIT.java" <<'@@DECISION_IT@@'
package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.hasSize;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.notNullValue;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.nullValue;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import io.restassured.response.Response;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

@DisplayName("Testes de integraÃ§Ã£o â€” aceite/recusa com bagagem declarada (RF08/RF19)")
class RideDecisionApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO =
            DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    private record UserSetup(String token, String sub) {}

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    // ===== fixtures (mesmo estilo do RideRequestApiIT) =====

    private UserSetup criarUsuarioComRole(String prefixo, String role) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);

        if (role != null) {
            atribuirRoleRealm(userId, role);
        }

        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        String sub = given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("sub");

        return new UserSetup(token, sub);
    }

    private DriverSetup criarMotorista() {
        UserSetup user = criarUsuarioComRole("decision-driver", "DRIVER");

        String plate = "R" + String.format(
                "%06d",
                ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000)
        );

        String vehicleId = given()
                .auth().oauth2(user.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(Map.of(
                        "plate", plate,
                        "type", "CARRO",
                        "model", "Toyota Corolla",
                        "color", "Prata",
                        "year", 2024,
                        "passengerSeats", 4,
                        "cargoVolumeLiters", 400
                ))
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");

        return new DriverSetup(
                user.token(),
                UUID.fromString(vehicleId),
                user.sub()
        );
    }

    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver, int totalSeats) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", driver.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", "Fortaleza");
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now()
                .plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", totalSeats);

        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private UserSetup criarPassageiro() {
        return criarUsuarioComRole("decision-passenger", "PASSENGER");
    }

    private String solicitarVaga(String token, String rideId, String nome) {
        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao(nome))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> itemBagagem() {
        Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
        item.put("type", "mala");
        item.put("quantity", 1);
        item.put("lengthCm", 60);
        item.put("widthCm", 40);
        item.put("heightCm", 30);
        item.put("description", "Mala de bordo");
        return item;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> payloadSolicitacao(String nome) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("passengerName", nome);
        payload.put("baggage", List.of(itemBagagem()));
        return payload;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> payloadDecisao(
            String decision, String reason) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("decision", decision);
        payload.put("reason", reason);
        return payload;
    }

    private Response decidir(String token, String rideId, String requestId,
                             String decision, String reason) {
        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadDecisao(decision, reason))
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId
                        + "/requests/" + requestId));
    }

    // ===== helpers de banco =====

    private int vagasDisponiveis(String rideId) {
        Integer vagas = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT available_seats FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        return vagas == null ? -1 : vagas;
    }

    private Map<String, Object> solicitacaoNoBanco(String requestId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForMap(
                "SELECT status, confirmed_at, cancellation_reason "
                        + "FROM ride_passengers WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                requestId);
    }

    private int notificacoesDo(String rideId, String recipientSub) {
        Integer total = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications "
                        + "WHERE ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid) AND recipient_sub = ?",
                Integer.class, rideId, recipientSub);
        return total == null ? 0 : total;
    }

    // ===== critÃ©rios de aceite =====

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: ACCEPT confirma, grava confirmedAt e decrementa vagas")
    void acceptConfirmaEDecrementaVagas() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        int vagasAntes = vagasDisponiveis(rideId);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("id", equalTo(requestId))
                .body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"))
                .body("confirmedAt", notNullValue());

        Map<String, Object> row = solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId);
        Assertions.assertEquals("CONFIRMED", row.get("status").toString());
        Assertions.assertNotNull(row.get("confirmed_at"));
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                vagasAntes - 1, vagasDisponiveis(rideId));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF19: passageiro Ã© notificado no ACCEPT")
    void acceptNotificaPassageiro() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(200);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                1, notificacoesDo(rideId, passenger.sub()),
                "passageiro deve receber 1 notificaÃ§Ã£o de aceite");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08/RF19: motorista vÃª a bagagem e REJECT cancela com motivo, preserva vagas e notifica")
    void rejectCancelaComMotivoPreservaVagasENotifica() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");
        int vagasAntes = vagasDisponiveis(rideId);

        // RF19: o motorista visualiza a bagagem declarada ANTES de decidir
        given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("$", hasSize(1))
                .body("[0].id", equalTo(requestId))
                .body("[0].status", equalTo("PENDING"))
                .body("[0].baggage", hasSize(1))
                .body("[0].baggage[0].type", equalTo("mala"));

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "REJECT",
                "A bagagem excede a capacidade do veÃ­culo.")
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("id", equalTo(requestId))
                .body("status", equalTo("CANCELLED"))
                .body("confirmedAt", nullValue());

        Map<String, Object> row = solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId);
        Assertions.assertEquals("CANCELLED", row.get("status").toString());
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "A bagagem excede a capacidade do veÃ­culo.",
                row.get("cancellation_reason").toString());
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                vagasAntes, vagasDisponiveis(rideId),
                "vagas devem permanecer intactas no REJECT");
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                1, notificacoesDo(rideId, passenger.sub()),
                "passageiro deve receber 1 notificaÃ§Ã£o de recusa");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: REJECT sem reason retorna 400 e mantÃ©m PENDING")
    void rejectSemReasonRetorna400() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "REJECT", null)
                .then().statusCode(400);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "PENDING", solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId).get("status").toString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: REJECT com reason em branco retorna 400")
    void rejectComReasonEmBrancoRetorna400() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "REJECT", "   ")
                .then().statusCode(400);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "PENDING", solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId).get("status").toString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: decision fora do enum, nula ou ausente retorna 400")
    void decisionInvalidaRetorna400() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        // valor fora do enum => erro de desserializaÃ§Ã£o => 400
        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "MAYBE", null)
                .then().statusCode(400);

        // decision explicitamente nulo => @NotNull => 400
        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, null, null)
                .then().statusCode(400);

        // decision ausente no payload => @NotNull => 400
        Map<String, Object> semDecision = new HashMap<>();
        semDecision.put("reason", "motivo qualquer");
        given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(semDecision)
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId
                        + "/requests/" + requestId))
                .then().statusCode(400);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "PENDING", solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId).get("status").toString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: motorista nÃ£o dono da carona recebe 403")
    void motoristaNaoDonoRetorna403() {
        DriverSetup owner = criarMotorista();
        DriverSetup intruso = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(owner, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");
        int vagasAntes = vagasDisponiveis(rideId);

        decidir(intruso.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(403);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "PENDING", solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId).get("status").toString());
        Assertions.assertEquals(vagasAntes, vagasDisponiveis(rideId));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: passageiro (role != DRIVER) nÃ£o pode decidir â€” 403")
    void passageiroNaoPodeDecidir() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        // payload VÃLIDO: o 403 deve vir da role, nÃ£o da validaÃ§Ã£o
        decidir(passenger.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(403);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: solicitaÃ§Ã£o jÃ¡ decidida retorna 409")
    void solicitacaoJaDecididaRetorna409() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(200);
        int vagasAposAccept = vagasDisponiveis(rideId);

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(409);

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "REJECT", "Motivo qualquer")
                .then().statusCode(409);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                vagasAposAccept, vagasDisponiveis(rideId),
                "vagas sÃ³ podem ser decrementadas uma vez");
        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "CONFIRMED", solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId).get("status").toString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: ACCEPT sem vaga disponÃ­vel retorna 409")
    void acceptSemVagaRetorna409() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista();
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3);
        String requestId =
                solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria Silva");

        // esgota as vagas diretamente no banco (cenÃ¡rio de corrida)
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET available_seats = 0 WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                rideId);

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(409);

        Assertions.assertEquals(
                "PENDING", solicitacaoNoBanco(requestId).get("status").toString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RF08: solicitaÃ§Ã£o inexistente retorna 404")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-maven.sh â€” validaÃ§Ã£o REAL da S2-02 (compilaÃ§Ã£o, testes unitÃ¡rios e IT)
# Requer: JDK 17+, Maven e Docker (Testcontainers/Jakarta para as ITs).
# =============================================================================

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

command -v mvn >/dev/null || { echo "[run-maven] mvn nÃ£o encontrado." >&2; exit 1; }

echo "[run-maven] 1/2 â€” testes unitÃ¡rios do raiji-rides (+ deps)..."
mvn -q -pl raiji-rides -am test -Djacoco.skip=true

echo "[run-maven] 2/2 â€” integraÃ§Ã£o RideDecisionApiIT no raiji-app..."
if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mvn -q -pl raiji-app -am verify \
      -Dit.test=RideDecisionApiIT -Dtest=NONE \
      -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
      -Djacoco.skip=true
else
  echo "[run-maven] AVISO: docker indisponÃ­vel â€” pulando ITs." >&2
  echo "[run-maven] Rode depois: mvn -pl raiji-app -am verify -Dit.test=RideDecisionApiIT -Dtest=NONE -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false" >&2
fi

echo "[run-maven] regressÃ£o completa (S1-06 + S2-01 + JaCoCo 80%):"
echo "  mvn -q verify   # roda TUDO"
echo "[run-maven] OK"
@@RUNMV@@

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-all.sh â€” verificaÃ§Ã£o completa da S2-02
#   1. sintaxe dos scripts
#   2. testes estruturais (python, sem Maven)
#   3. idempotÃªncia do gerador (2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o altera nada)
#   4. opcional: --with-maven â†’ compilaÃ§Ã£o + testes reais
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ROOT="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

GRN=$'\033[0;32m'; RED=$'\033[0;31m'; NC=$'\033[0m'
ok()   { printf '%s[PASS]%s %s\n' "$GRN" "$NC" "$*"; }
fail() { printf '%s[FAIL]%s %s\n' "$RED" "$NC" "$*"; exit 1; }

echo "== 1/4 sintaxe dos scripts =="
for s in scripts/setup-s2-02.sh tests/s2-02/run-maven.sh tests/s2-02/run-all.sh; do
  bash -n "$s" || fail "sintaxe: $s"
done
ok "bash -n em 3 scripts"

echo "== 2/4 testes estruturais =="
python3 "$HERE/test_s2_02.py" || fail "testes estruturais"
ok "test_s2_02.py"

echo "== 3/4 idempotÃªncia do gerador =="
ALVO=$(find raiji-rides raiji-app docs scripts -type f \
        \( -name '*.java' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.sh' \) \
        | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum)
bash scripts/setup-s2-02.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "re-execuÃ§Ã£o do gerador"
ALVO2=$(find raiji-rides raiji-app docs scripts -type f \
        \( -name '*.java' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.sh' \) \
        | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum)
[[ "$ALVO" == "$ALVO2" ]] || fail "gerador nÃ£o idempotente (2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o alterou arquivos)"
ok "2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o do gerador: Ã¡rvore idÃªntica"

echo "== 4/4 validaÃ§Ã£o real (opcional) =="
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--with-maven" ]]; then
  bash "$HERE/run-maven.sh" || fail "run-maven.sh"
  ok "Maven: unitÃ¡rios + RideDecisionApiIT"
else
  echo "  (pulada â€” use: bash tests/s2-02/run-all.sh --with-maven)"
fi

echo
ok "S2-02 verificada com sucesso."
@@RUNALL@@

#   NOVOS:

for cand in "$PWD" "$SCRIPT_DIR" "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." "$GIT_TOP"; do
  [[ -n "$cand" ]] || continue
  if [[ -f "$cand/pom.xml" && -f "$cand/docker-compose.yml" ]]; then
    ROOT="$(cd "$cand" && pwd)"
    break
  fi
done
if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
  echo "[setup-s2-03] ERRO: raiz do projeto nÃ£o encontrada (pom.xml + docker-compose.yml)." >&2
  exit 1
fi
cd "$ROOT"
echo "[setup-s2-03] raiz do projeto: $ROOT"

  cp "$SELF" "$CANONICAL"

fi

package com.raiji.rides.repository;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.Ride;
import jakarta.persistence.LockModeType;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaSpecificationExecutor;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Lock;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

public interface RideRepository extends JpaRepository<Ride, UUID>, JpaSpecificationExecutor<Ride> {

    /**
     * S2-03 / RN03 â€” trava pessimista ({@code SELECT ... FOR UPDATE}) na linha
     * da carona: serializa decisÃµes concorrentes. Dois aceites simultÃ¢neos
     * sobre a Ãºltima vaga => um confirma e o outro, ao reler a carona apÃ³s o
     * commit do primeiro, recebe 409. EstratÃ©gia documentada em
     * docs/ARQUITETURA.md (o {@code @Version} herdado de AuditableEntity
     * permanece como rede de seguranÃ§a).
     */
    @Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
    @Query("select r from Ride r where r.id = :id")
    Optional<Ride> findByIdForUpdate(@Param("id") UUID id);
}
@@RIDE_REPO@@

# 3) docs/ARQUITETURA.md â€” decisÃ£o de locking e regras de capacidade

write_file "docs/ARQUITETURA.md" <<'@@ARQ@@'
# Arquitetura â€” decisÃµes registradas

## S2-03 Â· Trava de capacidade de assentos e carga (RN03 / RN12)

### Problema

Reservas confirmadas nunca podem exceder os assentos da carona nem a
capacidade de carga (peso e volume), **mesmo sob concorrÃªncia**: dois aceites
simultÃ¢neos da Ãºltima vaga nÃ£o podem ambos confirmar (a issue #10 pede
explicitamente testes de concorrÃªncia com ExecutorService).

### DecisÃ£o â€” lock pessimista na linha da carona

`RidePassengerService.decide()` (PATCH
`/api/rides/{rideId}/requests/{requestId}`) carrega a carona com
`RideRepository.findByIdForUpdate(...)`:

```java
@Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
@Query("select r from Ride r where r.id = :id")
Optional<Ride> findByIdForUpdate(@Param("id") UUID id);
```

- `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` serializa as decisÃµes sobre a mesma carona: a
  segunda transaÃ§Ã£o aguarda o commit da primeira e entÃ£o **relÃª**
  `available_seats` jÃ¡ decrementado â†’ responde **409** em vez de
  sobrescrever o contador.
- Escolhido pela **simplicidade** (observaÃ§Ã£o da issue #10): transaÃ§Ã£o curta,
  uma Ãºnica linha "quente" (a carona), sem necessidade de retry
  application-level sobre `OptimisticLockException`.
- O **lock otimista** (`@Version` herdado de `AuditableEntity`) permanece
  ativo em todas as entidades como rede de seguranÃ§a contra escrita perdida
  nos demais fluxos (ex.: ediÃ§Ã£o de carona), mas nÃ£o Ã© a linha de defesa do
  aceite â€” quem garante a serializaÃ§Ã£o Ã© o `FOR UPDATE`.

### Regras de capacidade aplicadas no ACCEPT

| Trava | Regra | Falha |
|---|---|---|
| Assentos | `rides.available_seats > 0` antes de decrementar | 409 |
| Peso | Î£ `weight_kg Ã— quantity` das bagagens **CONFIRMED** (+ as do candidato) â‰¤ `rides.cargo_max_weight_kg` | 400 |
| Volume | Î£ `length_cm Ã— width_cm Ã— height_cm Ã— quantity Ã· 1000` (litros) â‰¤ `vehicles.cargo_volume_liters` do veÃ­culo da carona | 400 |

- Peso e volume sÃ³ sÃ£o verificados **se existir** limite declarado
  (`cargoDetails.maxWeightKg > 0` na carona / `cargoVolumeLiters > 0` no
  veÃ­culo) â€” sem limite declarado, a trava Ã© ignorada (caronas e veÃ­culos
  antigos continuam vÃ¡lidos).
- `weightKg` Ã© **opcional** na declaraÃ§Ã£o de bagagem (contrato da S2-01
  permanece retrocompatÃ­vel); item sem peso contribui 0 kg na soma.
- SolicitaÃ§Ãµes PENDING **nÃ£o** reservam capacidade: entram na soma apenas as
  bagagens CONFIRMED e as da solicitaÃ§Ã£o em aceite.
- Exceder o limite Ã© erro de requisiÃ§Ã£o (**400**, critÃ©rio de aceite da
  issue); esgotar assentos Ã© conflito de estado (**409**).

### ConsistÃªncia

O `decide()` roda em uma Ãºnica transaÃ§Ã£o: lock â†’ validaÃ§Ãµes (dono, PENDING,
vagas, peso, volume) â†’ decremento de vagas â†’ `confirm()`/`cancel()` â†’ evento
de decisÃ£o (notificaÃ§Ã£o). Qualquer falha faz **rollback completo** â€” nenhuma
reserva fica em estado inconsistente e `available_seats` nunca fica negativo.

### Testes

- `CapacityLockApiIT.confirmacoesSimultaneasNaoEstouramLotacao`:
  `ExecutorService` + `CyclicBarrier` disparam 2 aceites simultÃ¢neos sobre a
  Ãºltima vaga â†’ exatamente 1Ã— 200 e 1Ã— 409, `available_seats = 0`, 1 reserva
  CONFIRMED.
- Limites: peso/volume **exatamente no limite** (aceito) e **1 acima**
  (400), alÃ©m da soma acumulada entre passageiros CONFIRMED.
- UnitÃ¡rios (`RidePassengerServiceTest`): mesmas fronteiras com mocks +
  verificaÃ§Ã£o do uso de `findByIdForUpdate`.
@@ARQ@@

import os
import sys

def load(p):
    with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()

def save(p, s):
    with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(s)

def patch(path, guard, patches, must_apply_all=True):
    src = load(path)
    if guard in src:
        print(f"  [skip] {path} (jÃ¡ patcheado)")
        return
    for old, new, count in patches:
        found = src.count(old)
        if found == 0:
            if must_apply_all:
                sys.exit(f"ERRO: anchor nÃ£o encontrado em {path}:\n---\n{old[:300]}\n---")
            continue
        if count is not None and found != count:
            sys.exit(f"ERRO: anchor {found}x (esperado {count}x) em {path}:\n{old[:200]}")
        src = src.replace(old, new)
    save(path, src)
    print(f"  [ok]   {path}")

SVC = f"{RIDES}/service/RidePassengerService.java"

capacity_methods = '''
    /**
     * S2-03 / RN12 â€” trava de capacidade de carga no ACCEPT.
     *
     * <p>Soma o peso (weightKg Ã— quantity) e o volume
     * (lengthCm Ã— widthCm Ã— heightCm Ã— quantity Ã· 1000, em litros) das
     * bagagens CONFIRMED na carona + as da solicitaÃ§Ã£o em aceite, e compara
     * com cargoDetails.maxWeightKg (carona) e cargoVolumeLiters (veÃ­culo),
     * quando declarados. Excedeu => 400; sem limite declarado => ignora
     * ("se existir", critÃ©rio da issue #10).
     */
    private void validarCapacidadeCarga(Ride ride, RidePassenger candidato) {
        List<RidePassenger> passageiros = ridePassengerRepository
                .findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(ride.getId());

        BigDecimal pesoTotal = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        BigDecimal volumeTotalLitros = BigDecimal.ZERO;

        for (RidePassenger p : passageiros) {
            boolean confirmado =
                    p.getStatus() == RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED;
            boolean ehCandidato = p.getId() != null
                    && p.getId().equals(candidato.getId());
            if (!confirmado && !ehCandidato) {
                continue; // PENDING nÃ£o reserva capacidade
            }
            for (Baggage item : p.getBaggage()) {
                pesoTotal = pesoTotal.add(pesoTotalDoItem(item));
                volumeTotalLitros =
                        volumeTotalLitros.add(volumeDoItemEmLitros(item));
            }
        }

        CargoDetails cargo = ride.getCargoDetails();
        if (cargo != null && cargo.hasCargoCapacity()
                && pesoTotal.compareTo(cargo.getMaxWeightKg()) > 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Peso total das bagagens ("
                            + pesoTotal.stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString()
                            + " kg) excede o limite da carona ("
                            + cargo.getMaxWeightKg().stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString()
                            + " kg)."
            );
        }

        Vehicle vehicle = vehicleRepository
                .findByIdAndOwnerSubAndDeletedAtIsNull(
                        ride.getVehicleId(), ride.getDriverSub())
                .orElse(null);

        if (vehicle != null
                && vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters() != null
                && vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters() > 0
                && volumeTotalLitros.compareTo(
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters())) > 0) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(
                    HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Volume total das bagagens ("
                            + volumeTotalLitros.stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString()
                            + " L) excede a capacidade do veÃ­culo ("
                            + vehicle.getCargoVolumeLiters() + " L)."
            );
        }
    }

    /** Peso do item = weightKg Ã— quantity; sem weightKg declarado => 0. */
    private static BigDecimal pesoTotalDoItem(Baggage item) {
        if (item.getWeightKg() == null) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }
        return item.getWeightKg()
                .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(item.getQuantity()));
    }

    /** Volume do item = (lengthCm Ã— widthCm Ã— heightCm Ã· 1000) Ã— quantity, em litros. */
    private static BigDecimal volumeDoItemEmLitros(Baggage item) {
        BigDecimal volumeUnitarioLitros = BigDecimal
                .valueOf((long) item.getLengthCm()
                        * item.getWidthCm()
                        * item.getHeightCm())
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(1000), 3, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        return volumeUnitarioLitros
                .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(item.getQuantity()));
    }
'''

SVCTEST = "raiji-rides/src/test/java/com/raiji/rides/service/RidePassengerServiceTest.java"

capacity_tests = '''
    // =========================================================================
    // S2-03 / RN03+RN12 â€” trava de capacidade (lock pessimista, peso, volume)
    // =========================================================================

    private static Baggage bagagem(String pesoKg, int quantidade,
                                   int lengthCm, int widthCm, int heightCm) {
        Baggage b = new Baggage();
        b.setType(BaggageType.MALA);
        b.setQuantity(quantidade);
        b.setLengthCm(lengthCm);
        b.setWidthCm(widthCm);
        b.setHeightCm(heightCm);
        if (pesoKg != null) {
            b.setWeightKg(new BigDecimal(pesoKg));
        }
        return b;
    }

    private RidePassenger solicitacaoPendenteComBagagem(Baggage... itens) {
        RidePassenger passenger = solicitacaoPendente();
        for (Baggage b : itens) {
            passenger.addBaggage(b);
        }
        // em produÃ§Ã£o o candidato consta na listagem da carona (mesma
        // transaÃ§Ã£o); no teste unitÃ¡rio garantimos o mesmo comportamento
        when(passengerRepository.findByRideIdAndDeletedAtIsNull(rideId))
                .thenReturn(List.of(passenger));
        return passenger;
    }

    private RidePassenger confirmadoComBagagem(Baggage... itens) {
        RidePassenger passenger = new RidePassenger();
        ReflectionTestUtils.setField(passenger, "id", UUID.randomUUID());
        passenger.setRideId(rideId);
        passenger.setPassengerSub("confirmado-" + UUID.randomUUID());
        passenger.setPassengerName("Passageiro Confirmado");
        passenger.confirm();
        for (Baggage b : itens) {
            passenger.addBaggage(b);
        }
        return passenger;
    }

    private void comCargoDetails(String maxWeightKg) {
        CargoDetails cargo = new CargoDetails();
        cargo.setMaxWeightKg(new BigDecimal(maxWeightKg));
        ride.setCargoDetails(cargo);
    }

    @Test
    void deveUsarLockPessimistaAoDecidir() {
        RidePassenger pendente = solicitacaoPendente();

        service.decide(rideId, pendente.getId(), DRIVER_SUB,
                RideDecision.ACCEPT, null);

        verify(rideRepository).findByIdForUpdate(rideId);
    }

    @Test
    void deveAceitarPesoExatamenteNoLimite() {
        comCargoDetails("20");
        RidePassenger pendente = solicitacaoPendenteComBagagem(
                bagagem("10", 2, 40, 30, 20)); // 10 kg Ã— 2 = 20 kg == limite

        RideDecisionResponse response = service.decide(
                rideId, pendente.getId(), DRIVER_SUB, RideDecision.ACCEPT, null);

        assertEquals(RidePassengerStatus.CONFIRMED, response.status());
        verify(passengerRepository).save(any(RidePassenger.class));
    }

    @Test
    void deveRejeitarPesoUmAcimaDoLimite() {

S201 = "scripts/setup-s2-01.sh"

def guard_s201(write_line, delim, arquivo, rotulo):
    old_open = write_line
    new_open = ('if grep -q "weightKg" "' + arquivo + '" 2>/dev/null; then\n'
                '  log "preservado: ' + rotulo + ' (weightKg da S2-03 presente â€” nÃ£o regredir)"\n'
                'else\n' + write_line)
    old_close = "\n" + delim + "\n"
    new_close = "\n" + delim + "\nfi\n"
    return [(old_open, new_open, 1), (old_close, new_close, 1)]

# K) setup-s2-01.sh e setup-s2-02.sh â€” nÃ£o regredir os prÃ³prios arquivos de

#    patch de compatibilidade a cada re-execuÃ§Ã£o das suÃ­tes).

def proteger_write_test(gerador, marcador, write_line, delim, rotulo):
    if not os.path.isfile(gerador):
        print(f"  [skip] {gerador} (ausente)")
        return
    old_open = write_line
    new_open = ('if grep -qF ' + '"' + marcador + '" ' + rotulo + ' 2>/dev/null; then\n'
                '  log "preservado: ' + rotulo + ' (compat S2-03 presente â€” nÃ£o regredir)"\n'
                'else\n' + write_line)
    old_close = "\n" + delim + "\n"
    new_close = "\n" + delim + "\nfi\n"
    patch(gerador, "compat S2-03 presente", [
        (old_open, new_open, 1),
        (old_close, new_close, 1),
    ])

proteger_write_test(
    "scripts/setup-s2-01.sh",
    "weightKg opcional desde a S2-03",
    """write_file "tests/s2-01/test_s2_01.py" <<'@@PYTEST@@'""",
    "@@PYTEST@@",
    "tests/s2-01/test_s2_01.py")

proteger_write_test(
    "scripts/setup-s2-02.sh",
    "V9",
    """write_file "tests/s2-02/test_s2_02.py" <<'@@TESTPY@@'""",
    "@@TESTPY@@",
    "tests/s2-02/test_s2_02.py")

print("[patcher] S2-03: todos os patches aplicados com sucesso.")

package com.raiji.it;

import static io.restassured.RestAssured.given;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.equalTo;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CyclicBarrier;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

import com.raiji.rides.domain.RideDecision;
import com.raiji.rides.service.RidePassengerService;
import io.restassured.http.ContentType;
import io.restassured.response.Response;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

@DisplayName("Testes de integraÃ§Ã£o â€” trava de capacidade de assentos e carga (RN03/RN12)")
class CapacityLockApiIT extends RaijiTestSupport {

    private static final DateTimeFormatter ISO =
            DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private RidePassengerService ridePassengerService;

    private record UserSetup(String token, String sub) {}

    private record DriverSetup(String token, UUID vehicleId, String sub) {}

    // ===== fixtures =====

    private UserSetup criarUsuarioComRole(String prefixo, String role) {
        String username = prefixo + "-" + System.nanoTime();
        String userId = criarUsuario(username);

        if (role != null) {
            atribuirRoleRealm(userId, role);
        }

        String token = obterToken(username, SENHA_NOVOS_USUARIOS);

        String sub = given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .when().get(app("/api/users/me"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .extract().path("sub");

        return new UserSetup(token, sub);
    }

    private DriverSetup criarMotorista(Integer cargoVolumeLiters) {
        UserSetup user = criarUsuarioComRole("capacity-driver", "DRIVER");

        String plate = "R" + String.format(
                "%06d",
                ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0, 1_000_000)
        );

        Map<String, Object> vehicle = new HashMap<>();
        vehicle.put("plate", plate);
        vehicle.put("type", "CARRO");
        vehicle.put("model", "Toyota Corolla");
        vehicle.put("color", "Prata");
        vehicle.put("year", 2024);
        vehicle.put("passengerSeats", 4);
        if (cargoVolumeLiters != null) {
            vehicle.put("cargoVolumeLiters", cargoVolumeLiters);
        }

        String vehicleId = given()
                .auth().oauth2(user.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(vehicle)
                .when().post(app("/api/vehicles"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");

        return new DriverSetup(
                user.token(),
                UUID.fromString(vehicleId),
                user.sub()
        );
    }

    private String criarCarona(DriverSetup driver, int totalSeats,
                               Map<String, Object> cargoDetails) {
        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();
        body.put("vehicleId", driver.vehicleId().toString());
        body.put("type", "PASSENGER");
        body.put("originCity", "Fortaleza");
        body.put("originState", "CE");
        body.put("destinationCity", "Sobral");
        body.put("destinationState", "CE");
        body.put("departureDate", LocalDateTime.now()
                .plusDays(1).format(ISO));
        body.put("totalSeats", totalSeats);
        if (cargoDetails != null) {
            body.put("cargoDetails", cargoDetails);
        }

        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(body)
                .when().post(app("/api/rides"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private UserSetup criarPassageiro() {
        return criarUsuarioComRole("capacity-passenger", "PASSENGER");
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> itemBagagem(
            String weightKg, int quantity,
            int lengthCm, int widthCm, int heightCm) {
        Map<String, Object> item = new HashMap<>();
        item.put("type", "mala");
        item.put("quantity", quantity);
        item.put("lengthCm", lengthCm);
        item.put("widthCm", widthCm);
        item.put("heightCm", heightCm);
        if (weightKg != null) {
            item.put("weightKg", weightKg);
        }
        item.put("description", "Mala de bordo");
        return item;
    }

    private static Map<String, Object> payloadSolicitacao(
            String nome, Map<String, Object> item) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("passengerName", nome);
        payload.put("baggage", List.of(item));
        return payload;
    }

    private String solicitarVaga(String token, String rideId, String nome,
                                 Map<String, Object> item) {
        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao(nome, item))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(201)
                .extract().path("id");
    }

    private void solicitarEsperando400(String token, String rideId,
                                       String nome, Map<String, Object> item) {
        given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payloadSolicitacao(nome, item))
                .when().post(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(400);
    }

    private Response decidir(String token, String rideId, String requestId,
                             String decision, String reason) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = new HashMap<>();
        payload.put("decision", decision);
        payload.put("reason", reason);
        return given()
                .auth().oauth2(token)
                .contentType(ContentType.JSON)
                .body(payload)
                .when().patch(app("/api/rides/" + rideId
                        + "/requests/" + requestId));
    }

    // ===== helpers de banco =====

    private int vagasDisponiveis(String rideId) {
        Integer vagas = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT available_seats FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        return vagas == null ? -1 : vagas;
    }

    private String statusNoBanco(String requestId) {
        return jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT status FROM ride_passengers WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                String.class, requestId);
    }

    // ===== critÃ©rios de aceite (issue #10) =====

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN03: duas confirmaÃ§Ãµes simultÃ¢neas nÃ£o estouram a lotaÃ§Ã£o (1Ã— 200, 1Ã— 409)")
    void confirmacoesSimultaneasNaoEstouramLotacao() throws Exception {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista(400);
        UserSetup pax1 = criarPassageiro();
        UserSetup pax2 = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 2, null);
        String req1 = solicitarVaga(pax1.token(), rideId, "Pax Um",
                itemBagagem(null, 1, 40, 30, 20));
        String req2 = solicitarVaga(pax2.token(), rideId, "Pax Dois",
                itemBagagem(null, 1, 40, 30, 20));

        // sÃ³ 1 vaga livre â€” os dois aceites correm simultaneamente por ela
        jdbcTemplate.update(
                "UPDATE rides SET available_seats = 1 WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                rideId);

        int threads = 2;
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads);
        CyclicBarrier largada = new CyclicBarrier(threads);
        List<Future<Integer>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        for (String requestId : List.of(req1, req2)) {
            futures.add(pool.submit(() -> {
                largada.await(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS); // largada simultÃ¢nea
                try {
                    ridePassengerService.decide(
                            UUID.fromString(rideId),
                            UUID.fromString(requestId),
                            driver.sub(),
                            RideDecision.ACCEPT,
                            null);
                    return 200;
                } catch (ResponseStatusException ex) {
                    return ex.getStatusCode().value();
                }
            }));
        }

        pool.shutdown();
        Assertions.assertTrue(pool.awaitTermination(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS),
                "as decisÃµes concorrentes devem terminar");

        List<Integer> codes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Future<Integer> f : futures) {
            codes.add(f.get());
        }

        Assertions.assertEquals(1,
                codes.stream().filter(c -> c == 200).count(),
                "exatamente uma confirmaÃ§Ã£o pode passar");
        Assertions.assertEquals(1,
                codes.stream().filter(c -> c == 409).count(),
                "a outra decisÃ£o deve receber 409 (sem vagas)");

        Integer vagas = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT available_seats FROM rides WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        Assertions.assertEquals(0, vagas.intValue(),
                "vagas nunca podem ficar negativas");

        Integer confirmados = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ride_passengers "
                        + "WHERE ride_id = CAST(? AS uuid) AND status = 'CONFIRMED'",
                Integer.class, rideId);
        Assertions.assertEquals(1, confirmados.intValue(),
                "apenas uma reserva pode ficar CONFIRMED");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN12: peso exatamente no limite Ã© aceito (CONFIRMED)")
    void pesoNoLimiteExatoEhAceito() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista(400);
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 2, Map.of("maxWeightKg", 20));
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria",
                itemBagagem("10", 2, 40, 30, 20)); // 10 kg Ã— 2 = 20 kg == limite

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("status", equalTo("CONFIRMED"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN12: peso 1 acima do limite retorna 400 e mantÃ©m PENDING")
    void pesoAcimaDoLimiteRetorna400() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista(400);
        UserSetup passenger = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 2, Map.of("maxWeightKg", 20));
        String requestId = solicitarVaga(passenger.token(), rideId, "Maria",
                itemBagagem("20.5", 1, 40, 30, 20)); // 20.5 kg > 20 kg
        int vagasAntes = vagasDisponiveis(rideId);

        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, requestId, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(400);

        Assertions.assertEquals("PENDING", statusNoBanco(requestId));
        Assertions.assertEquals(vagasAntes, vagasDisponiveis(rideId),
                "vagas nÃ£o mudam quando a capacidade de carga reprova");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("RN12: peso soma as bagagens jÃ¡ CONFIRMED na carona")
    void pesoSomaBagagensConfirmadas() {
        DriverSetup driver = criarMotorista(400);
        UserSetup pax1 = criarPassageiro();
        UserSetup pax2 = criarPassageiro();
        String rideId = criarCarona(driver, 3, Map.of("maxWeightKg", 30));

        String req1 = solicitarVaga(pax1.token(), rideId, "Pax Um",
                itemBagagem("15", 1, 40, 30, 20));
        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, req1, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(200);

        String req2 = solicitarVaga(pax2.token(), rideId, "Pax Dois",
                itemBagagem("16", 1, 40, 30, 20)); // 15 + 16 = 31 kg > 30 kg
        decidir(driver.token(), rideId, req2, "ACCEPT", null)
                .then().statusCode(400);

        Assertions.assertEquals("CONFIRMED", statusNoBanco(req1));
        Assertions.assertEquals("PENDING", statusNoBanco(req2));
    }

    void volumeNoLimiteExatoEhAceito() {

                itemBagagem(null, 1, 40, 30, 20));
        Assertions.assertNotNull(requestId);

                .then().statusCode(201)

                .body("baggage[0].type", equalTo("mala"));

        given()
                .auth().oauth2(driver.token())
                .when().get(app("/api/rides/" + rideId + "/requests"))
                .then().statusCode(200)
                .body("[0].baggage[0].weightKg", equalTo(12.5f));
    }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-maven.sh â€” validaÃ§Ã£o REAL da S2-03 (compilaÃ§Ã£o, testes unitÃ¡rios e IT)
# Requer: JDK 17+, Maven e Docker (Testcontainers/Jakarta para as ITs).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

command -v mvn >/dev/null || { echo "[run-maven] mvn nÃ£o encontrado." >&2; exit 1; }

echo "[run-maven] 1/2 â€” testes unitÃ¡rios do raiji-rides (+ deps)..."
mvn -q -pl raiji-rides -am test -Djacoco.skip=true

echo "[run-maven] 2/2 â€” integraÃ§Ã£o CapacityLockApiIT no raiji-app..."
if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mvn -q -pl raiji-app -am verify \
      -Dit.test=CapacityLockApiIT -Dtest=NONE \
      -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
      -Djacoco.skip=true
else
  echo "[run-maven] AVISO: docker indisponÃ­vel â€” pulando ITs." >&2
  echo "[run-maven] Rode depois: mvn -pl raiji-app -am verify -Dit.test=CapacityLockApiIT -Dtest=NONE -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false" >&2
fi

echo "[run-maven] regressÃ£o completa (S1-06 + S2-01 + S2-02 + JaCoCo 80%):"
echo "  mvn -q verify   # roda TUDO"
echo "[run-maven] OK"
@@RUNMV@@

write_file "tests/s2-03/run-all.sh" <<'@@RUNALL@@'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-all.sh â€” verificaÃ§Ã£o completa da S2-03
#   1. sintaxe dos scripts
#   2. testes estruturais (python, sem Maven)
#   3. idempotÃªncia do gerador (2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o altera nada)
#   4. opcional: --with-maven â†’ compilaÃ§Ã£o + testes reais
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ROOT="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

GRN=$'\033[0;32m'; RED=$'\033[0;31m'; NC=$'\033[0m'
ok()   { printf '%s[PASS]%s %s\n' "$GRN" "$NC" "$*"; }
fail() { printf '%s[FAIL]%s %s\n' "$RED" "$NC" "$*"; exit 1; }

echo "== 1/4 sintaxe dos scripts =="
for s in scripts/setup-s2-03.sh tests/s2-03/run-maven.sh tests/s2-03/run-all.sh; do
  bash -n "$s" || fail "sintaxe: $s"
done
ok "bash -n em 3 scripts"

echo "== 2/4 testes estruturais =="
python3 "$HERE/test_s2_03.py" || fail "testes estruturais"
ok "test_s2_03.py"

echo "== 3/4 idempotÃªncia do gerador =="
ALVO=$(find raiji-rides raiji-app docs scripts -type f \
        \( -name '*.java' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.sh' \) \
        | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum)
bash scripts/setup-s2-03.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "re-execuÃ§Ã£o do gerador"
ALVO2=$(find raiji-rides raiji-app docs scripts -type f \
        \( -name '*.java' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.sh' \) \
        | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum)
[[ "$ALVO" == "$ALVO2" ]] || fail "gerador nÃ£o idempotente (2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o alterou arquivos)"
ok "2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o do gerador: Ã¡rvore idÃªntica"

echo "== 4/4 validaÃ§Ã£o real (opcional) =="
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--with-maven" ]]; then
  bash "$HERE/run-maven.sh" || fail "run-maven.sh"
  ok "Maven: unitÃ¡rios + CapacityLockApiIT"
else
  echo "  (pulada â€” use: bash tests/s2-03/run-all.sh --with-maven)"
fi

echo
ok "S2-03 verificada com sucesso."
@@RUNALL@@

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# smoke-test.sh â€” S1-03 Â· Smoke tests pÃ³s-deploy
#
# Checagens (exatamente as da issue):
#   health -> GET  {BASE_URL}/actuator/health            == 200 e {"status":"UP"}
#   realm  -> GET  {KEYCLOAK_URL}/realms/raiji           == 200
#   token  -> POST {KEYCLOAK_URL}/realms/raiji/protocol/openid-connect/token == 200
#   me     -> GET  {BASE_URL}/api/me com Bearer token    == 200
#
# Uso:
#   ./scripts/smoke-test.sh                       # todas, em PARALELO (padrÃ£o)
#   ./scripts/smoke-test.sh --serial              # todas, em sÃ©rie
#   ./scripts/smoke-test.sh --check health        # uma checagem (usado na matriz do CD)
#
# VariÃ¡veis de ambiente:
#   BASE_URL (default http://localhost:8000)  KEYCLOAK_URL (default = BASE_URL)
#   REALM (raiji)  CLIENT_ID (raiji-api)  SMOKE_USERNAME (teste)  SMOKE_PASSWORD (teste123)
#   HTTP_TIMEOUT (10)  RETRIES (3)  RETRY_DELAY (5)  SMOKE_FORCE_PYTHON (0|1)
#
# HTTP: usa curl se existir; senÃ£o, python3 (urllib) como fallback.
# SaÃ­da: 0 = todas passaram | 1 = alguma falhou | 2 = erro de uso
# =============================================================================
set -u

CHECKS_ALL=(health realm token me)
CHECK=""
MODE="parallel"
BASE_URL="${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8000}"
KEYCLOAK_URL="${KEYCLOAK_URL:-}"
REALM="${REALM:-raiji}"
CLIENT_ID="${CLIENT_ID:-raiji-api}"
SMOKE_USERNAME="${SMOKE_USERNAME:-teste}"
SMOKE_PASSWORD="${SMOKE_PASSWORD:-teste123}"
HTTP_TIMEOUT="${HTTP_TIMEOUT:-10}"
RETRIES="${RETRIES:-3}"
RETRY_DELAY="${RETRY_DELAY:-5}"

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --check)        CHECK="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --all)          CHECK=""; shift ;;
    --parallel)     MODE="parallel"; shift ;;
    --serial)       MODE="serial"; shift ;;
    --base)         BASE_URL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --keycloak)     KEYCLOAK_URL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --realm)        REALM="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --client-id)    CLIENT_ID="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --user)         SMOKE_USERNAME="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --password)     SMOKE_PASSWORD="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --retries)      RETRIES="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --retry-delay)  RETRY_DELAY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --timeout)      HTTP_TIMEOUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help)      grep '^#' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "OpÃ§Ã£o desconhecida: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

# KEYCLOAK_URL padrÃ£o = BASE_URL (o Kong roteia /realms) â€” resolvido DEPOIS do
# parse para respeitar --base.
[[ -n "$KEYCLOAK_URL" ]] || KEYCLOAK_URL="$BASE_URL"

# Cores apenas em terminal (logs de CI saem limpos e "grepÃ¡veis").
if [[ -t 1 && -z "${NO_COLOR:-}" ]]; then
  RED=$'\033[0;31m'; GRN=$'\033[0;32m'; YLW=$'\033[1;33m'; NC=$'\033[0m'
else
  RED=""; GRN=""; YLW=""; NC=""
fi
ok()   { printf '%s[PASS]%s %s\n' "$GRN" "$NC" "$*"; }
fail() { printf '%s[FAIL]%s %s\n' "$RED" "$NC" "$*"; }
info() { printf '%s[..]%s %s\n'   "$YLW" "$NC" "$*"; }

TMPDIR_SMOKE="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMPDIR_SMOKE"' EXIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Camada HTTP â€” curl preferencial, python3 como fallback.
# Preenche: HTTP_CODE (numÃ©rico; 0 = erro de conexÃ£o) e HTTP_BODY (arquivo).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
_urlencode() {
  local s="$1" out="" i c
  for (( i = 0; i < ${#s}; i++ )); do
    c="${s:i:1}"
    case "$c" in
      [a-zA-Z0-9.~_-]) out+="$c" ;;
      *) out+="$(printf '%%%02X' "'$c")" ;;
    esac
  done
  printf '%s' "$out"
}

_http_python() { # method url outfile content-type body auth
  SMOKE_METHOD="$1" SMOKE_URL="$2" SMOKE_CT="${4:-}" SMOKE_BODY="${5:-}" \
  SMOKE_AUTH="${6:-}" SMOKE_TIMEOUT="$HTTP_TIMEOUT" \
  python3 - "$3" <<'PYEOF'
import os, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error
req = urllib.request.Request(os.environ["SMOKE_URL"], method=os.environ["SMOKE_METHOD"])
body = os.environ.get("SMOKE_BODY") or ""
data = body.encode() if body else None
if data is not None:
    req.add_header("Content-Type", os.environ.get("SMOKE_CT") or "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
auth = os.environ.get("SMOKE_AUTH") or ""
if auth:
    req.add_header("Authorization", auth)
try:
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, data=data, timeout=int(float(os.environ.get("SMOKE_TIMEOUT", "10"))))
    code, payload = resp.status, resp.read()
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    code, payload = e.code, e.read() if e.fp else b""
except Exception as e:  # conexÃ£o recusada, timeout, DNS...
    code, payload = 0, str(e).encode()
with open(sys.argv[1], "wb") as f:
    f.write(payload)
print(code)
PYEOF
}

_http_curl() { # method url outfile content-type body auth
  local method="$1" url="$2" out="$3" ct="${4:-}" body="${5:-}" auth="${6:-}"
  local args=(-sS -o "$out" -w '%{http_code}' --max-time "$HTTP_TIMEOUT" -X "$method")
  [[ -n "$ct"   ]] && args+=(-H "Content-Type: $ct")
  [[ -n "$auth" ]] && args+=(-H "Authorization: $auth")
  [[ -n "$body" ]] && args+=(--data "$body")
  local code
  code="$(curl "${args[@]}" "$url" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$code" == "000" || -z "$code" ]] && code=0
  printf '%s' "$code"
}

HTTP_CODE=0
HTTP_BODY=""
http_request() { # method url [content-type] [body] [auth]
  HTTP_BODY="$TMPDIR_SMOKE/body.$$.$RANDOM"
  if [[ "${SMOKE_FORCE_PYTHON:-0}" == "1" ]] || ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    HTTP_CODE="$(_http_python "$1" "$2" "$HTTP_BODY" "${3:-}" "${4:-}" "${5:-}")"
  else
    HTTP_CODE="$(_http_curl "$1" "$2" "$HTTP_BODY" "${3:-}" "${4:-}" "${5:-}")"
  fi
  [[ -z "$HTTP_CODE" ]] && HTTP_CODE=0
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Checagens
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
obter_token() { # -> grava token em TOKEN; retorna 0/1
  TOKEN=""
  local body
  body="grant_type=password&client_id=$(_urlencode "$CLIENT_ID")&username=$(_urlencode "$SMOKE_USERNAME")&password=$(_urlencode "$SMOKE_PASSWORD")"
  http_request POST "$KEYCLOAK_URL/realms/$REALM/protocol/openid-connect/token" \
    "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" "$body" ""
  [[ "$HTTP_CODE" == "200" ]] || return 1
  TOKEN="$(sed -n 's/.*"access_token"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$HTTP_BODY" | head -n1)"
  [[ -n "$TOKEN" ]]
}

check_health() {
  http_request GET "$BASE_URL/actuator/health"
  if [[ "$HTTP_CODE" == "200" ]] && grep -Eq '"status"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"UP"' "$HTTP_BODY"; then
    ok "health â€” GET /actuator/health -> 200 {\"status\":\"UP\"}"
    return 0
  fi
  fail "health â€” GET /actuator/health -> HTTP $HTTP_CODE (esperado 200 + status UP); body: $(head -c 200 "$HTTP_BODY" 2>/dev/null)"
  return 1
}

check_realm() {
  http_request GET "$KEYCLOAK_URL/realms/$REALM"
  if [[ "$HTTP_CODE" == "200" ]]; then
    ok "realm â€” GET /realms/$REALM -> 200"
    return 0
  fi
  fail "realm â€” GET /realms/$REALM -> HTTP $HTTP_CODE (esperado 200)"
  return 1
}

check_token() {
  if obter_token; then
    ok "token â€” POST /realms/$REALM/protocol/openid-connect/token ($SMOKE_USERNAME) -> 200 + access_token"
    return 0
  fi
  fail "token â€” POST /realms/$REALM/protocol/openid-connect/token -> HTTP $HTTP_CODE (esperado 200); body: $(head -c 200 "$HTTP_BODY" 2>/dev/null)"
  return 1
}

check_me() {
  if ! obter_token; then
    fail "me â€” nÃ£o foi possÃ­vel obter token (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
    return 1
  fi
  http_request GET "$BASE_URL/api/me" "" "" "Bearer $TOKEN"
  if [[ "$HTTP_CODE" == "200" ]]; then
    ok "me â€” GET /api/me com Bearer token -> 200"
    return 0
  fi
  fail "me â€” GET /api/me -> HTTP $HTTP_CODE (esperado 200); body: $(head -c 200 "$HTTP_BODY" 2>/dev/null)"
  return 1
}

run_with_retries() { # check_name
  local name="$1" attempt
  for (( attempt = 1; attempt <= RETRIES; attempt++ )); do
    if "check_$name"; then return 0; fi
    [[ "$attempt" -lt "$RETRIES" ]] && sleep "$RETRY_DELAY"
  done
  return 1
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ExecuÃ§Ã£o
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_one() { # name -> grava rc em arquivo (modo paralelo)
  local name="$1"
  if run_with_retries "$name"; then
    echo 0 > "$TMPDIR_SMOKE/$name.rc"
  else
    echo 1 > "$TMPDIR_SMOKE/$name.rc"
  fi
}

main() {
  local checks=()
  if [[ -n "$CHECK" ]]; then
    case "$CHECK" in
      health|realm|token|me) checks=("$CHECK") ;;
      all|"") checks=("${CHECKS_ALL[@]}") ;;
      *) echo "Check invÃ¡lido: $CHECK (use health|realm|token|me|all)" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
  else
    checks=("${CHECKS_ALL[@]}")
  fi

  info "Smoke tests em $BASE_URL (modo: $MODE, checagens: ${checks[*]})"

  if [[ "$MODE" == "parallel" && ${#checks[@]} -gt 1 ]]; then
    # Paralelo: cada checagem em subshell independente (o check 'me' obtÃ©m o
    # prÃ³prio token, logo nÃ£o hÃ¡ dependÃªncia entre os jobs).
    local name pids=()
    for name in "${checks[@]}"; do
      run_one "$name" &
      pids+=($!)
    done
    for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid" || true; done
  else
    local name
    for name in "${checks[@]}"; do
      run_one "$name"
    done
  fi

  local failed=0 name rc
  echo "----------------------------------------"
  for name in "${checks[@]}"; do
    rc="$(cat "$TMPDIR_SMOKE/$name.rc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
    [[ "$rc" != "0" ]] && failed=$((failed + 1))
  done

  if [[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]]; then
    ok "SMOKE OK â€” ${#checks[@]}/${#checks[@]} checagens passaram"
    exit 0
  fi
  fail "SMOKE FALHOU â€” $failed/${#checks[@]} checagens falharam"
  exit 1
}

main

===== ./tests/cicd/curl-shim/curl =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Shim de `curl` para testes: implementa o subconjunto usado pelo smoke-test.sh
(-sS -o FILE -w '%{http_code}' --max-time N -X METHOD -H K:V --data BODY URL)
usando urllib. Permite exercitar o ramo 'curl' do script em mÃ¡quinas sem curl.
"""
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

args = sys.argv[1:]
out = None
write_out = None
method = "GET"
data = None
headers = {}
url = None
timeout = 10

i = 0
while i < len(args):
    a = args[i]
    if a == "-sS":
        pass
    elif a == "-o":
        i += 1
        out = args[i]
    elif a == "-w":
        i += 1
        write_out = args[i]
    elif a == "--max-time":
        i += 1
        timeout = float(args[i])
    elif a == "-X":
        i += 1
        method = args[i]
    elif a == "-H":
        i += 1
        k, _, v = args[i].partition(":")
        headers[k] = v.strip()
    elif a == "--data":
        i += 1
        data = args[i].encode()
    elif not a.startswith("-"):
        url = a
    i += 1

code = 0
body = b""
try:
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=method, data=data)
    for k, v in headers.items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    r = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout)
    code, body = r.status, r.read()
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    code, body = e.code, (e.read() if e.fp else b"")
except Exception as e:
    code, body = 0, str(e).encode()

if out:
    with open(out, "wb") as f:
        f.write(body)
else:
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(body)
if write_out:
    sys.stdout.write(write_out.replace("%{http_code}", "%03d" % code))

===== ./tests/cicd/mock_server.py =====
"""Mock do stack (Kong + App + Keycloak) para testar o smoke-test.sh localmente.

Estado controlado por arquivos em MOCK_STATE_DIR:
  health.status   -> conteÃºdo do campo status ("UP"/"DOWN"); default UP
  token.mode      -> "ok" (aceita user/pass corretos) | "reject" (401 sempre)
"""
import json
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.parse import parse_qs

STATE_DIR = os.environ.get("MOCK_STATE_DIR", "/tmp/raiji-mock-state")
REALM = "raiji"
CLIENT_ID = "raiji-api"
USER = os.environ.get("MOCK_USER", "teste")
PASSWORD = os.environ.get("MOCK_PASSWORD", "teste123")
FAKE_TOKEN = "mock-access-token-abc123"


def _state(name, default):
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(STATE_DIR, name), encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return f.read().strip()
    except OSError:
        return default


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args):  # silencioso
        pass

    def _send(self, code, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/actuator/health":
            status = _state("health.status", "UP")
            self._send(200, {"status": status})
        elif self.path.startswith(f"/realms/{REALM}"):
            self._send(200, {"realm": REALM, "public_key": "xxx"})
        elif self.path == "/api/me":
            auth = self.headers.get("Authorization", "")
            if auth == f"Bearer {FAKE_TOKEN}":
                self._send(200, {"id": 1, "username": USER})
            else:
                self._send(401, {"error": "unauthorized"})
        else:
            self._send(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == f"/realms/{REALM}/protocol/openid-connect/token":
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            form = parse_qs(self.rfile.read(length).decode())
            mode = _state("token.mode", "ok")
            creds_ok = (
                form.get("username", [""])[0] == USER
                and form.get("password", [""])[0] == PASSWORD
                and form.get("client_id", [""])[0] == CLIENT_ID
                and form.get("grant_type", [""])[0] == "password"
            )
            if mode == "ok" and creds_ok:
                self._send(200, {"access_token": FAKE_TOKEN, "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_in": 300})
            else:
                self._send(401, {"error": "invalid_grant"})
        else:
            self._send(404, {"error": "not found"})


def main():
    os.makedirs(STATE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    port = int(os.environ.get("MOCK_PORT", "18080"))
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), Handler)
    print(f"mock listening on 127.0.0.1:{port} (state: {STATE_DIR})", flush=True)
    server.serve_forever()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

===== ./tests/cicd/run-all.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-all.sh â€” suÃ­te de verificaÃ§Ã£o da S1-03.
#   1. bash -n (sintaxe) em todos os scripts
#   2. actionlint nos workflows (se disponÃ­vel; senÃ£o, tenta baixar; senÃ£o, avisa)
#   3. testes estruturais (python3 + unittest) â€” YAML, gatilhos, etapas, docs
#   4. teste funcional do smoke-test.sh contra um servidor mock (passa E falha)
#   5. idempotÃªncia do setup-cicd.sh (rodar 2x nÃ£o muda nada)
# Uso: tests/cicd/run-all.sh [--quick]
# =============================================================================
set -uo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"
QUICK="${1:-}"
FAILURES=0

GRN=$'\033[0;32m'; RED=$'\033[0;31m'; YLW=$'\033[1;33m'; NC=$'\033[0m'
step() { printf '\n%s==>%s %s\n' "$YLW" "$NC" "$*"; }
ok()   { printf '%s OK %s %s\n' "$GRN" "$NC" "$*"; }
ko()   { printf '%sFAIL%s %s\n' "$RED" "$NC" "$*"; FAILURES=$((FAILURES+1)); }

# --- PYTHONPATH p/ PyYAML (usa .tools se o sistema nÃ£o tiver) --------------------
export PYTHONPATH="${PYTHONPATH:-}"
if ! python3 -c 'import yaml' 2>/dev/null; then
  for cand in "$ROOT/.tools/pylibs" "$ROOT/../.tools/pylibs"; do
    if PYTHONPATH="$cand" python3 -c 'import yaml' 2>/dev/null; then
      export PYTHONPATH="$cand${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

# --- 1) sintaxe dos scripts ------------------------------------------------------
step "1/5 Â· Sintaxe bash (bash -n)"
while IFS= read -r f; do
  if bash -n "$f" 2>/dev/null; then ok "$f"; else ko "$f (sintaxe invÃ¡lida)"; bash -n "$f"; fi
done < <(find scripts tests -name '*.sh' -type f | sort)

# --- 2) actionlint ----------------------------------------------------------------
step "2/5 Â· actionlint (workflows)"
ACTIONLINT=""
for cand in "$(command -v actionlint || true)" "$ROOT/.tools/actionlint" "$ROOT/../.tools/actionlint"; do
  [[ -n "$cand" && -x "$cand" ]] && { ACTIONLINT="$cand"; break; }
done
if [[ -z "$ACTIONLINT" ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$ROOT/.tools"
  if curl -fsSL -o "$ROOT/.tools/actionlint.tgz" \
      https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v1.7.12/actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz 2>/dev/null; then
    tar xzf "$ROOT/.tools/actionlint.tgz" -C "$ROOT/.tools" actionlint && chmod +x "$ROOT/.tools/actionlint"
    ACTIONLINT="$ROOT/.tools/actionlint"
  fi
fi
if [[ -n "$ACTIONLINT" ]]; then
  if "$ACTIONLINT" -no-color .github/workflows/*.yml; then
    ok "actionlint: workflows vÃ¡lidos"
  else
    ko "actionlint apontou problemas nos workflows"
  fi
else
  printf '%sWARN%s actionlint indisponÃ­vel (sem rede?) â€” etapa pulada\n' "$YLW" "$NC"
fi

# --- 3) testes estruturais ----------------------------------------------------------
step "3/5 Â· Testes estruturais (python unittest)"
if python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/cicd -p 'test_*.py' -v 2>&1 | tail -n 25; then
  if python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/cicd -p 'test_*.py' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ok "testes estruturais passaram"
  else
    ko "testes estruturais falharam"
  fi
else
  ko "testes estruturais falharam (execuÃ§Ã£o)"
fi

# --- 4) teste funcional do smoke-test ------------------------------------------------
step "4/5 Â· Teste funcional do smoke-test.sh (mock server)"
if [[ "$QUICK" == "--quick" ]]; then
  printf '%sWARN%s --quick: pulando teste funcional\n' "$YLW" "$NC"
elif bash tests/cicd/test_smoke_functional.sh; then
  ok "smoke-test.sh se comporta corretamente (cenÃ¡rios positivos e negativos)"
else
  ko "teste funcional do smoke-test.sh falhou"
fi

# --- 5) idempotÃªncia do setup ----------------------------------------------------------
step "5/5 Â· IdempotÃªncia do setup-cicd.sh"
SNAP_BEFORE="$(mktemp)"; SNAP_AFTER="$(mktemp)"
find .github scripts tests docs infra docker-compose.aws.yml -type f \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.py' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.env' \) \
  -exec sha256sum {} + | sort > "$SNAP_BEFORE"
bash scripts/setup-cicd.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
find .github scripts tests docs infra docker-compose.aws.yml -type f \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.py' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.env' \) \
  -exec sha256sum {} + | sort > "$SNAP_AFTER"
if diff -q "$SNAP_BEFORE" "$SNAP_AFTER" >/dev/null; then
  ok "rodar setup-cicd.sh duas vezes nÃ£o altera nada (idempotente)"
else
  ko "setup-cicd.sh NÃƒO Ã© idempotente"; diff "$SNAP_BEFORE" "$SNAP_AFTER" | head -20
fi
rm -f "$SNAP_BEFORE" "$SNAP_AFTER"

# --- resumo ------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo
if [[ "$FAILURES" -eq 0 ]]; then
  printf '%s============================================%s\n' "$GRN" "$NC"
  printf '%s TODOS OS TESTES DA S1-03 PASSARAM âœ…%s\n' "$GRN" "$NC"
  printf '%s============================================%s\n' "$GRN" "$NC"
  exit 0
fi
printf '%s============================================%s\n' "$RED" "$NC"
printf '%s %d etapa(s) falharam âŒ%s\n' "$RED" "$FAILURES" "$NC"
printf '%s============================================%s\n' "$RED" "$NC"
exit 1

===== ./tests/cicd/test_cicd.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Testes estruturais da S1-03 â€” verificam se TUDO da issue foi implementado.

Rodam sem dependÃªncias obrigatÃ³rias (PyYAML Ã© usado quando disponÃ­vel para
validaÃ§Ã£o profunda dos workflows; sem ele, os testes YAML sÃ£o pulados).
"""
import os
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import unittest

try:
    import yaml  # type: ignore
    HAS_YAML = True
except ImportError:
    HAS_YAML = False

ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", ".."))


def path(*parts):
    return os.path.join(ROOT, *parts)


def read(*parts):
    with open(path(*parts), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()


if HAS_YAML:
    class _Loader(yaml.SafeLoader):
        """SafeLoader que tolera tags do Compose Spec (!override, !reset)."""

    def _any_tag(loader, tag_suffix, node):
        if isinstance(node, yaml.SequenceNode):
            return loader.construct_sequence(node, deep=True)
        if isinstance(node, yaml.MappingNode):
            return loader.construct_mapping(node, deep=True)
        return loader.construct_scalar(node)

    _Loader.add_multi_constructor("!", _any_tag)

    def load_yaml(*parts):
        return yaml.load(read(*parts), Loader=_Loader)
else:  # pragma: no cover
    def load_yaml(*parts):
        raise unittest.SkipTest("PyYAML indisponÃ­vel")


def is_executable(*parts):
    return os.stat(path(*parts)).st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR != 0


REQUIRED_FILES = [
    ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
    ".github/workflows/deploy.yml",
    ".github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml",
    ".github/workflows/deploy-homolog.yml",
    ".github/workflows/rollback.yml",
    "scripts/smoke-test.sh",
    "scripts/aws/deploy.sh",
    "scripts/aws/deploy-remote.sh",
    "scripts/aws/rollback.sh",
    "scripts/aws/ecr-retag.sh",
    "scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh",
    "docker-compose.aws.yml",
    "docs/DEPLOY.md",
    "infra/aws/aws-config.env",
    ".github/workflows/guardian.yml",
    "scripts/aws/guardian.sh",
    "scripts/aws/check-github-config.sh",
    "tests/cicd/run-all.sh",
    "tests/cicd/mock_server.py",
    "tests/cicd/test_smoke_functional.sh",
    "tests/cicd/test_cicd.py",
    "tests/cicd/curl-shim/curl",
]

EXECUTABLE_FILES = [
    "scripts/smoke-test.sh",
    "scripts/aws/deploy.sh",
    "scripts/aws/deploy-remote.sh",
    "scripts/aws/rollback.sh",
    "scripts/aws/ecr-retag.sh",
    "scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh",
    "scripts/aws/guardian.sh",
    "scripts/aws/check-github-config.sh",
    "scripts/setup-cicd.sh",
    "docs/CD-CHECKLIST.md",
    "tests/cicd/run-all.sh",
    "tests/cicd/test_smoke_functional.sh",
]


class TestArquivosExistentes(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_arquivos_criados(self):
        for f in REQUIRED_FILES:
            with self.subTest(arquivo=f):
                self.assertTrue(os.path.isfile(path(f)), f"faltando: {f}")

    def test_scripts_executaveis(self):
        for f in EXECUTABLE_FILES:
            with self.subTest(arquivo=f):
                self.assertTrue(is_executable(f), f"sem +x: {f}")

    def test_sintaxe_bash(self):
        for f in EXECUTABLE_FILES:
            with self.subTest(arquivo=f):
                r = subprocess.run(["bash", "-n", path(f)], capture_output=True)
                self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr.decode())


@unittest.skipUnless(HAS_YAML, "PyYAML indisponÃ­vel")
class TestCiWorkflow(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.wf = load_yaml(".github", "workflows", "ci.yml")

    def test_gatilhos_pr_e_push(self):
        on = self.wf[True] if True in self.wf else self.wf["on"]  # 'on' vira True no YAML
        self.assertIn("pull_request", on)
        self.assertIn("push", on)
        self.assertEqual(set(on["push"]["branches"]), {"main", "develop"})

    def test_concurrency_cancela_antigos(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.wf["concurrency"]["cancel-in-progress"])

    def test_matriz_dinamica_paralela(self):
        ut = self.wf["jobs"]["unit-tests"]
        self.assertEqual(ut["strategy"]["fail-fast"], False)
        self.assertIn("fromJSON", str(ut["strategy"]["matrix"]["module"]))
        self.assertIn("detect-modules", ut["needs"])

    def test_pipeline_da_issue(self):
        steps = self.wf["jobs"]["verify"]["steps"]
        blob = str(steps)
        self.assertIn("actions/checkout", blob)                       # checkout
        self.assertIn("actions/setup-java", blob)                     # setup JDK
        java_step = [s for s in steps if str(s.get("uses", "")).startswith("actions/setup-java")][0]
        self.assertEqual(str(java_step["with"]["java-version"]), "21")
        self.assertEqual(java_step["with"]["cache"], "maven")         # cache Maven
        verify_cmds = [s.get("run", "") for s in steps if "clean verify" in s.get("run", "")]
        self.assertTrue(verify_cmds, "etapa 'mvn clean verify' ausente")
        uploads = [s for s in steps if str(s.get("uses", "")).startswith("actions/upload-artifact")]
        self.assertTrue(any("jacoco" in str(s["with"]["name"]).lower() or
                            "jacoco" in str(s["with"]["path"]).lower() for s in uploads),
                        "upload do relatÃ³rio JaCoCo ausente")

    def test_build_docker_paralelo(self):

@unittest.skipUnless(HAS_YAML, "PyYAML indisponÃ­vel")
class TestDeployWorkflows(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.deploy = load_yaml(".github", "workflows", "deploy.yml")
        cls.dev = load_yaml(".github", "workflows", "deploy-dev.yml")
        cls.homolog = load_yaml(".github", "workflows", "deploy-homolog.yml")
        cls.rollback = load_yaml(".github", "workflows", "rollback.yml")

    @staticmethod
    def _on(wf):
        return wf[True] if True in wf else wf["on"]

    def test_dev_dispara_em_develop(self):
        self.assertEqual(self._on(self.dev)["push"]["branches"], ["develop"])

    def test_homolog_dispara_em_main(self):
        self.assertEqual(self._on(self.homolog)["push"]["branches"], ["main"])

    def test_ambos_chamam_workflow_reutilizavel(self):
        for wf, env in ((self.dev, "dev"), (self.homolog, "homolog")):
            job = next(j for j in wf["jobs"].values() if "uses" in j)
            self.assertTrue(job["uses"].endswith(".github/workflows/deploy.yml"))
            self.assertEqual(job["with"]["environment"], env)

    def test_preflight_valida_configuracao(self):
        for wf, env in ((self.dev, "dev"), (self.homolog, "homolog")):
            pre = next(j for j in wf["jobs"].values() if j.get("name", "").startswith("PrÃ©-requisitos"))
            self.assertEqual(pre["environment"], env)
            self.assertIn("AWS_EC2_HOST_", str(pre["steps"]))

    def test_deploy_e_workflow_call_com_secrets(self):
        self.assertIn("workflow_call", self._on(self.deploy))
        secrets = self._on(self.deploy)["workflow_call"]["secrets"]
        for s in ("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", "SSH_PRIVATE_KEY",
                  "DB_PASSWORD", "KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET"):
            self.assertIn(s, secrets)

    @staticmethod
    def _needs(job):
        n = job.get("needs", [])
        return [n] if isinstance(n, str) else list(n)

    def test_fluxo_build_deploy_smoke_release(self):
        jobs = self.deploy["jobs"]
        for j in ("config", "tests", "build-push", "deploy", "smoke", "release", "rollback"):
            self.assertIn(j, jobs)
        self.assertIn("tests", self._needs(jobs["build-push"]))
        self.assertIn("build-push", self._needs(jobs["deploy"]))
        self.assertIn("deploy", self._needs(jobs["smoke"]))
        # release bloqueado pelo smoke
        self.assertIn("smoke", self._needs(jobs["release"]))
        self.assertEqual(jobs["release"]["if"], "success()")

    def test_smoke_paralelo_4_checagens(self):
        smoke = self.deploy["jobs"]["smoke"]
        self.assertEqual(smoke["strategy"]["fail-fast"], False)
        self.assertEqual(smoke["strategy"]["matrix"]["check"], ["health", "realm", "token", "me"])
        run = str(smoke["steps"][-1]["run"])
        self.assertIn("smoke-test.sh", run)
        self.assertIn("--check", run)

    def test_rollback_automatico_em_falha(self):
        rb = self.deploy["jobs"]["rollback"]
        self.assertIn("failure()", rb["if"])
        self.assertIn("rollback.sh", str(rb["steps"][-1]["run"]))

    def test_imagem_vai_para_ecr(self):
        blob = str(self.deploy["jobs"]["build-push"]["steps"])
        self.assertIn("amazon-ecr-login", blob)
        self.assertIn("docker/build-push-action", blob)
        self.assertIn("ecr-retag.sh", blob)  # preserva <env>-previous

    def test_rollback_manual_dispatch(self):
        self.assertIn("workflow_dispatch", self._on(self.rollback))
        opts = self._on(self.rollback)["workflow_dispatch"]["inputs"]["environment"]["options"]
        self.assertEqual(list(opts), ["dev", "homolog"])
