@unittest.skipUnless(HAS_YAML, "PyYAML indisponÃ­vel")
class TestConfigAwsFacil(unittest.TestCase):
    """ConfiguraÃ§Ã£o AWS centralizada: 1 arquivo, lido por bootstrap e workflows."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.cfg = read("infra", "aws", "aws-config.env")
        cls.deploy = load_yaml(".github", "workflows", "deploy.yml")
        cls.bootstrap = read("scripts", "aws", "bootstrap-aws.sh")

    def test_arquivo_config_com_todas_as_chaves(self):
        for key in ("AWS_REGION",
                    "INSTANCE_TYPE_DEV", "INSTANCE_TYPE_HOMOLOG",
                    "BASE_PORT_DEV", "BASE_PORT_HOMOLOG",
                    "KC_PORT_DEV", "KC_PORT_HOMOLOG"):
            with self.subTest(chave=key):
                self.assertRegex(self.cfg, rf"(?m)^{key}=", f"{key} ausente em aws-config.env")

    def test_bootstrap_le_o_config(self):
        self.assertIn("aws-config.env", self.bootstrap)
        self.assertIn("--config", self.bootstrap)
        self.assertIn("INSTANCE_TYPE_", self.bootstrap)

    def test_bootstrap_redimensiona_instancia(self):
        # mudar o tipo de mÃ¡quina = editar o config e rerodar o bootstrap
        self.assertIn("modify-instance-attribute", self.bootstrap)
        self.assertIn("stop-instances", self.bootstrap)
        self.assertIn("start-instances", self.bootstrap)

    def test_deploy_tem_job_config(self):
        cfg = self.deploy["jobs"]["config"]
        self.assertIn("aws-region", cfg["outputs"])
        self.assertIn("base-port", cfg["outputs"])
        self.assertIn("infra/aws/aws-config.env", str(cfg["steps"]))

    def test_portas_e_regiao_nao_hardcoded_nos_triggers(self):
        for f in ("deploy-dev.yml", "deploy-homolog.yml"):
            wf = load_yaml(".github", "workflows", f)
            job = list(wf["jobs"].values())[0]
            with self.subTest(workflow=f):
                self.assertNotIn("base-port", job["with"])
                self.assertNotIn("aws-region", job["with"])

class TestGuardian(unittest.TestCase):
    """VigilÃ¢ncia contÃ­nua: erro inesperado pÃ³s-deploy -> rollback + alerta."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.wf = load_yaml(".github", "workflows", "guardian.yml")
        cls.sh = read("scripts", "aws", "guardian.sh")

    def test_agendado_e_manual(self):
        on = self.wf[True] if True in self.wf else self.wf["on"]
        self.assertIn("schedule", on)
        self.assertIn("cron", str(on["schedule"]))
        self.assertIn("workflow_dispatch", on)

    def test_dois_ambientes_paralelos_serializados_com_deploy(self):
        jobs = self.wf["jobs"]
        self.assertIn("guard-dev", jobs)
        self.assertIn("guard-homolog", jobs)
        # mesmo concurrency group do deploy: nunca concorre com um deploy
        self.assertEqual(jobs["guard-dev"]["concurrency"]["group"], "deploy-dev")
        self.assertEqual(jobs["guard-homolog"]["concurrency"]["group"], "deploy-homolog")

    def test_abre_issue_de_alerta(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.wf["permissions"]["issues"], "write")
        blob = str(self.wf["jobs"]["guard-dev"]["steps"])
        self.assertIn("github-script", blob)
        self.assertIn("issues.create", blob)

    def test_reconfirma_antes_de_reverter(self):
        self.assertIn("GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY", self.sh)
        self.assertIn("sleep", self.sh)

    def test_so_rollback_se_houver_versao_anterior(self):
        self.assertIn("describe-images", self.sh)
        self.assertIn("-previous", self.sh)
        self.assertIn("rollback.sh", self.sh)

class TestSemSegredosCommitados(unittest.TestCase):
    ARQUIVOS = [
        ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
        ".github/workflows/deploy.yml",
        ".github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml",
        ".github/workflows/deploy-homolog.yml",
        ".github/workflows/rollback.yml",
        ".github/workflows/guardian.yml",
        "scripts/aws/deploy.sh",
        "scripts/aws/rollback.sh",
        "scripts/aws/guardian.sh",
        "scripts/aws/bootstrap-aws.sh",
        "docker-compose.aws.yml",
        "infra/aws/aws-config.env",
    ]
    PADROES = [
        re.compile(r"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}"),                    # AWS access key
        re.compile(r"-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----"),  # chaves privadas
        re.compile(r"(?i)(aws_secret_access_key|ssh_private_key)\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9/+=]{20,}"),
    ]

    def test_arquivos_nao_contem_segredos(self):
        for f in self.ARQUIVOS:
            src = read(f)
            for p in self.PADROES:
                with self.subTest(arquivo=f, padrao=p.pattern):
                    self.assertIsNone(p.search(src))

    def test_segredos_vem_do_github(self):
        dev = read(".github", "workflows", "deploy-dev.yml")
        self.assertIn("secrets.AWS_SSH_KEY_DEV", dev)
        self.assertIn("secrets.DB_PASSWORD_DEV", dev)
        hom = read(".github", "workflows", "deploy-homolog.yml")
        self.assertIn("secrets.AWS_SSH_KEY_HOMOLOG", hom)
        self.assertIn("secrets.KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET_HOMOLOG", hom)

    def test_env_remoto_nao_commitado(self):
        gi = read(".gitignore")
        self.assertIn(".env", gi)
        self.assertIn("*.pem", gi)

    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

===== ./tests/cicd/test_smoke_functional.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# test_smoke_functional.sh â€” valida o COMPORTAMENTO do scripts/smoke-test.sh
# contra um servidor mock (Kong+App+Keycloak simulados):
#   cenÃ¡rio 1: tudo saudÃ¡vel, modo serial    -> exit 0, 4 PASS
#   cenÃ¡rio 2: tudo saudÃ¡vel, modo paralelo  -> exit 0
#   cenÃ¡rio 3: --check health isolado        -> exit 0
#   cenÃ¡rio 4: senha errada                  -> exit 1, token/me FAIL, health PASS
#   cenÃ¡rio 5: health DOWN                   -> exit 1
#   cenÃ¡rio 6: servidor fora do ar           -> exit 1 (retries=1 p/ ser rÃ¡pido)
# =============================================================================
set -u

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

PORT="${MOCK_PORT:-18080}"
STATE_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
export MOCK_PORT="$PORT" MOCK_STATE_DIR="$STATE_DIR"

PASS=0; FAIL=0
t_ok() { echo "  âœ… $*"; PASS=$((PASS+1)); }
t_ko() { echo "  âŒ $*"; FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); }
assert_exit() { # esperado cmd...
  local want="$1"; shift
  "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1
  local got=$?
  [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]
}

cleanup() {
  [[ -n "${SERVER_PID:-}" ]] && kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null
  rm -rf "$STATE_DIR"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

echo "== subindo mock server na porta $PORT =="
python3 tests/cicd/mock_server.py & SERVER_PID=$!
for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
  python3 - "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/actuator/health" <<'PY' && break
import sys, urllib.request
try: urllib.request.urlopen(sys.argv[1], timeout=1)
except Exception: sys.exit(1)
PY
  sleep 0.2
done

SMOKE=(./scripts/smoke-test.sh --base "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" --retries 1 --retry-delay 0)
SMOKE_ENV=(env SMOKE_USERNAME=teste SMOKE_PASSWORD=teste123)

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 1: saudÃ¡vel, serial =="
if assert_exit 0 "${SMOKE_ENV[@]}" "${SMOKE[@]}" --serial; then t_ok "todas as checagens passam (serial)"; else t_ko "deveria passar (serial)"; fi
OUT="$("${SMOKE_ENV[@]}" "${SMOKE[@]}" --serial 2>&1)"
for c in health realm token me; do
  if grep -Eq "\[PASS\].*\b$c\b" <<<"$OUT"; then t_ok "check $c reportado"; else t_ko "check $c nÃ£o reportado"; fi
done

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 2: saudÃ¡vel, paralelo =="
if assert_exit 0 "${SMOKE_ENV[@]}" "${SMOKE[@]}" --parallel; then t_ok "todas as checagens passam (paralelo)"; else t_ko "deveria passar (paralelo)"; fi

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 3: --check isolado =="
for c in health realm token me; do
  if assert_exit 0 "${SMOKE_ENV[@]}" "${SMOKE[@]}" --check "$c"; then t_ok "--check $c ok"; else t_ko "--check $c deveria passar"; fi
done

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 4: credenciais invÃ¡lidas (token 401) =="
env SMOKE_USERNAME=teste SMOKE_PASSWORD=errada "${SMOKE[@]}" --serial >/dev/null 2>&1
[[ $? -eq 1 ]] && t_ok "exit=1 com senha errada" || t_ko "deveria falhar com senha errada"
OUT="$(env SMOKE_USERNAME=teste SMOKE_PASSWORD=errada "${SMOKE[@]}" --serial 2>&1)"
grep -Eq "\[PASS\].*\bhealth\b" <<<"$OUT" && t_ok "health continua PASS (falha parcial detectada)" || t_ko "health deveria passar"
grep -Eq "\[FAIL\].*\btoken\b" <<<"$OUT" && t_ok "token FAIL reportado" || t_ko "token deveria falhar"
grep -Eq "\[FAIL\].*\bme\b" <<<"$OUT" && t_ok "me FAIL reportado (depende do token)" || t_ko "me deveria falhar"

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 5: health DOWN =="
echo DOWN > "$STATE_DIR/health.status"
env SMOKE_USERNAME=teste SMOKE_PASSWORD=teste123 "${SMOKE[@]}" --check health >/dev/null 2>&1
[[ $? -eq 1 ]] && t_ok "exit=1 com status DOWN" || t_ko "deveria falhar com DOWN"
echo UP > "$STATE_DIR/health.status"

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 6: servidor fora do ar =="
env SMOKE_USERNAME=teste SMOKE_PASSWORD=teste123 \
  ./scripts/smoke-test.sh --base "http://127.0.0.1:$((PORT+1))" --retries 1 --retry-delay 0 >/dev/null 2>&1
[[ $? -eq 1 ]] && t_ok "exit=1 com servidor indisponÃ­vel" || t_ko "deveria falhar sem servidor"

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 7: ramo HTTP via curl (shim) =="
SHIM_DIR="$ROOT/tests/cicd/curl-shim"
chmod +x "$SHIM_DIR/curl" 2>/dev/null
if [[ -x "$SHIM_DIR/curl" ]]; then
  ( export PATH="$SHIM_DIR:$PATH"
    command -v curl >/dev/null && "${SMOKE_ENV[@]}" "${SMOKE[@]}" --parallel ) >/dev/null 2>&1
  [[ $? -eq 0 ]] && t_ok "modo curl: todas as checagens passam" || t_ko "modo curl: deveria passar"
  ( export PATH="$SHIM_DIR:$PATH"
    env SMOKE_USERNAME=teste SMOKE_PASSWORD=errada "${SMOKE[@]}" --serial ) >/dev/null 2>&1
  [[ $? -eq 1 ]] && t_ok "modo curl: exit=1 com senha errada" || t_ko "modo curl: deveria falhar com senha errada"
else
  echo "  (shim de curl indisponÃ­vel â€” pulado)"
fi

GUARDIAN_ENV=(env ENVIRONMENT=dev "BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"
              SMOKE_USERNAME=teste SMOKE_PASSWORD=teste123
              GUARDIAN_RETRY=1 GUARDIAN_DELAY=0
              GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY=1
              GUARDIAN_RETRY_RECHECK=1 GUARDIAN_DELAY_RECHECK=0)

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 8: guardian â€” ambiente saudÃ¡vel =="
echo UP > "$STATE_DIR/health.status"
OUT="$("${GUARDIAN_ENV[@]}" ./scripts/aws/guardian.sh 2>&1)"
if [[ $? -eq 0 ]] && grep -q "saudÃ¡vel" <<<"$OUT"; then
  t_ok "guardian exit=0 com ambiente saudÃ¡vel"
else
  t_ko "guardian deveria sair 0 (saudÃ¡vel): $OUT"
fi

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 9: guardian â€” falha transitÃ³ria (recupera na reconfirmaÃ§Ã£o) =="
echo DOWN > "$STATE_DIR/health.status"
( sleep 2; echo UP > "$STATE_DIR/health.status" ) & TOGGLER=$!
OUT="$(env ENVIRONMENT=dev "BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" \
      SMOKE_USERNAME=teste SMOKE_PASSWORD=teste123 \
      GUARDIAN_RETRY=1 GUARDIAN_DELAY=0 GUARDIAN_RECHECK_DELAY=3 \
      GUARDIAN_RETRY_RECHECK=10 GUARDIAN_DELAY_RECHECK=1 \
      ./scripts/aws/guardian.sh 2>&1)"
RC=$?
wait "$TOGGLER" 2>/dev/null
if [[ $RC -eq 0 ]] && grep -q "transitÃ³ria" <<<"$OUT"; then
  t_ok "guardian exit=0 detectando falha transitÃ³ria na reconfirmaÃ§Ã£o"
else
  t_ko "guardian deveria recuperar na reconfirmaÃ§Ã£o (rc=$RC): $OUT"
fi

echo "== cenÃ¡rio 10: guardian â€” falha confirmada SEM versÃ£o anterior =="
echo DOWN > "$STATE_DIR/health.status"
OUT="$("${GUARDIAN_ENV[@]}" ./scripts/aws/guardian.sh 2>&1)"
RC=$?
echo UP > "$STATE_DIR/health.status"
if [[ $RC -eq 1 ]] && grep -q "SEM versÃ£o anterior" <<<"$OUT"; then
  t_ok "guardian exit=1 + alerta 'SEM versÃ£o anterior' (rollback sÃ³ com histÃ³rico)"
else
  t_ko "guardian deveria falhar sem versÃ£o anterior (rc=$RC): $OUT"
fi

echo
echo "resultado: $PASS passaram, $FAIL falharam"
[[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ]]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-all.sh â€” verificaÃ§Ã£o completa da S2-01
#   1. sintaxe dos scripts
#   2. testes estruturais (python, sem Maven)

===== ./tests/s2-01/run-maven.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-maven.sh â€” validaÃ§Ã£o REAL da S2-01 (compilaÃ§Ã£o, testes unitÃ¡rios e IT)
# Requer: JDK 17+, Maven e Docker (Testcontainers/Jakarta para as ITs).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

command -v mvn >/dev/null || { echo "[run-maven] mvn nÃ£o encontrado." >&2; exit 1; }

echo "[run-maven] 1/2 â€” testes unitÃ¡rios do raiji-rides (+ deps)..."
mvn -q -pl raiji-rides -am test -Djacoco.skip=true

echo "[run-maven] 2/2 â€” integraÃ§Ã£o BaggageApiIT no raiji-app..."
if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mvn -q -pl raiji-app -am verify \
      -Dit.test=BaggageApiIT -Dtest=NONE -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
      -Djacoco.skip=true
else
  echo "[run-maven] AVISO: docker indisponÃ­vel â€” pulando ITs." >&2
  echo "[run-maven] Rode depois: mvn -pl raiji-app -am verify -Dit.test=BaggageApiIT -Dtest=NONE -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false" >&2
fi

echo "[run-maven] cobertura agregada (gate 80% do raiji-app cobre os â‰¥70% do raiji-rides):"
echo "  mvn -q verify   # roda tudo com JaCoCo"
echo "[run-maven] OK"

                         "S2-01: tabela Ãºnica (sem tabela por tipo)")

        self.assertIn("CascadeType.ALL", src)

        self.assertIn("public void addBaggage(Baggage", src)

        src = read(RIDES_MAIN / "service/RidePassengerService.java")

        self.assertIn("@Transactional", src)

        # 400 defensivo ANTES de qualquer consulta
        idx_bag = src.index("baggage == null || baggage.isEmpty()")
        idx_ride = src.index("rideRepository.findById(rideId)")
        self.assertLess(idx_bag, idx_ride,
                        "validaÃ§Ã£o de bagagem deve preceder o findById")

        src = read(RIDES_MAIN / "web/RideRequestController.java")

===== ./tests/s2-03/run-all.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-all.sh â€” verificaÃ§Ã£o completa da S2-03
#   1. sintaxe dos scripts
#   2. testes estruturais (python, sem Maven)
#   3. idempotÃªncia do gerador (2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o nÃ£o altera nada)
#   4. opcional: --with-maven â†’ compilaÃ§Ã£o + testes reais
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ROOT="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

GRN=$'\033[0;32m'; RED=$'\033[0;31m'; NC=$'\033[0m'
ok()   { printf '%s[PASS]%s %s\n' "$GRN" "$NC" "$*"; }
fail() { printf '%s[FAIL]%s %s\n' "$RED" "$NC" "$*"; exit 1; }

echo "== 1/4 sintaxe dos scripts =="
for s in scripts/setup-s2-03.sh tests/s2-03/run-maven.sh tests/s2-03/run-all.sh; do
  bash -n "$s" || fail "sintaxe: $s"
done
ok "bash -n em 3 scripts"

echo "== 2/4 testes estruturais =="
python3 "$HERE/test_s2_03.py" || fail "testes estruturais"
ok "test_s2_03.py"

echo "== 3/4 idempotÃªncia do gerador =="
ALVO=$(find raiji-rides raiji-app docs scripts -type f \
        \( -name '*.java' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.sh' \) \
        | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum)
bash scripts/setup-s2-03.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "re-execuÃ§Ã£o do gerador"
ALVO2=$(find raiji-rides raiji-app docs scripts -type f \
        \( -name '*.java' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.sh' \) \
        | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum)
[[ "$ALVO" == "$ALVO2" ]] || fail "gerador nÃ£o idempotente (2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o alterou arquivos)"
ok "2Âª execuÃ§Ã£o do gerador: Ã¡rvore idÃªntica"

echo "== 4/4 validaÃ§Ã£o real (opcional) =="
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--with-maven" ]]; then
  bash "$HERE/run-maven.sh" || fail "run-maven.sh"
  ok "Maven: unitÃ¡rios + CapacityLockApiIT"
else
  echo "  (pulada â€” use: bash tests/s2-03/run-all.sh --with-maven)"
fi

echo
ok "S2-03 verificada com sucesso."

===== ./tests/s2-03/run-maven.sh =====
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-maven.sh â€” validaÃ§Ã£o REAL da S2-03 (compilaÃ§Ã£o, testes unitÃ¡rios e IT)
# Requer: JDK 17+, Maven e Docker (Testcontainers/Jakarta para as ITs).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

command -v mvn >/dev/null || { echo "[run-maven] mvn nÃ£o encontrado." >&2; exit 1; }

echo "[run-maven] 1/2 â€” testes unitÃ¡rios do raiji-rides (+ deps)..."
mvn -q -pl raiji-rides -am test -Djacoco.skip=true

echo "[run-maven] 2/2 â€” integraÃ§Ã£o CapacityLockApiIT no raiji-app..."
if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mvn -q -pl raiji-app -am verify \
      -Dit.test=CapacityLockApiIT -Dtest=NONE \
      -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
      -Djacoco.skip=true
else
  echo "[run-maven] AVISO: docker indisponÃ­vel â€” pulando ITs." >&2
  echo "[run-maven] Rode depois: mvn -pl raiji-app -am verify -Dit.test=CapacityLockApiIT -Dtest=NONE -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false" >&2
fi

echo "[run-maven] regressÃ£o completa (S1-06 + S2-01 + S2-02 + JaCoCo 80%):"
echo "  mvn -q verify   # roda TUDO"
echo "[run-maven] OK"

    def test_suite_s2_01_aceita_weight_kg(self):
        t201 = ROOT / "tests/s2-01/test_s2_01.py"
        if not t201.is_file():
            self.skipTest("tests/s2-01 ausente neste checkout")
        self.assertIn("weightKg opcional desde a S2-03", read(t201))

    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

Usage: actionlint [FLAGS] [FILES...] [-]

  actionlint is a linter for GitHub Actions workflow files.

  To check all YAML files in current repository, just run actionlint without
  arguments. It automatically finds the nearest '.github/workflows' directory:

    $ actionlint

  To check specific files, pass the file paths as arguments:

    $ actionlint file1.yaml file2.yaml

  To check content which is not saved in file yet (e.g. output from some
  command), pass - argument. It reads stdin and checks it as workflow file:

    $ actionlint -

  To serialize errors into JSON, use -format option. It allows to format error
  messages flexibly with Go template syntax.

    $ actionlint -format '{{json .}}'

  - Usage:          https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/tree/%s/docs/usage.md
  - Configuration:  https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/tree/%s/docs/config.md

␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀y␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀z␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀{␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀b␀␀␀|␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀}␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀~␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀€␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀‚␀␀␀ƒ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀„␀␀␀…␀␀␀␀␀␀␀†␀␀␀‡␀␀␀␀␀␀␀ˆ␀␀␀‰␀␀␀Š␀␀␀‹␀␀␀Œ␀␀␀␀␀␀Ž␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀‘␀␀␀␀␀␀␀’␀␀␀“␀␀␀”␀␀␀•␀␀␀–␀␀␀—␀␀␀˜␀␀␀™␀␀␀š␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀›␀␀␀œ␀␀␀␀␀␀ž␀␀␀Ÿ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀ ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀¡␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀¢␀␀␀£␀␀␀␀␀␀␀¤␀␀␀¥␀␀␀¦␀␀␀§␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀¨␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀©␀␀␀␀␀␀␀ª␀␀␀␀␀␀␀«␀␀␀¬␀␀␀­␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀®␀␀␀¯␀␀␀°␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀±␀␀␀²␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀³␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀´␀␀␀µ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀¶␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀·␀␀␀¸␀␀␀¹␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀º␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀»␀␀␀¼␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀½␀␀␀¾␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀¿␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀À␀␀␀Á␀␀␀Â␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀Ã␀␀␀␀␀␀␀Ä␀␀␀␀␀␀␀µ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀Å␀␀␀Æ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀Æ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀Ç␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀
